eng_Latn: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow's side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkathhazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ācɛ nēe bá nyā gaá bī ɔ́mpā nū ɛyí, lɛ ɛ̄wā gwū ɔ̄ áklō, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ofu ce ɛnɛ ā gā ajɛ le pɛ́ gekwú ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nēé hī ajɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn abɔ́ɔ ā ka Uhélkatásūrim .

eng_Latn: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
idu_Latn: Aá géē má ojibó o tēelihɔ, nɛ̄ Udánīyɛ̄lu ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kɛlā nū ā háyi ɛga otīihɔ ā .

eng_Latn: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le odúúdú íne mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ ɔ́ ā kpó tá tāajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋjɛ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī blibli lɛ ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó le ede gwó ikpó ɛfu ā, ɛcɔ̄ éyééye kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔma éyééye kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú alelékwū ā wā aflɛ́yí ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ā nɛ̄ n. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ kú alelékwū wā gboce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, nēe kē wɛ ígwu kú aálá kú uwɔ ā, géē tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó.

eng_Latn: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá amānyā ā, ofíyɛ́ dúú aɛ́nɛ̄ e wɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father's house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ odúúdú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa á. É lɛ ɛwa klla lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄hi ɔlɛ́ uwā. Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔ́ja glá ā wɛ úlā ofɛtá cɛ̄hɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: And Noah went forth, and his sons, and his wife, and his sons' wives with him:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unówa le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipū ɔwú ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla ayí nū, mɛ́mla anyā ayí nū á.

eng_Latn: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?
idu_Latn: Aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bá ī hɛ́ɛkwɛ bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́wū āa? Aɛ́fu nɛ̄ncɛ́ ɔdí kē yá nɛ̄ aá bá ī hɛ́ɛkwɛ biílí bɛ̄ɛka ayí álá ā?.

eng_Latn: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
idu_Latn: Alɔ pó ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā Ubɛ́tulɛhɛ̄m. Alɔ le ikpati kú okónu ōce kú Óndú ā, pīyɛ̄ ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ajɛ kú Ujɛyarím.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, Itíca, ŋmíífī nɛ̄ n wɛ ɔyípɛ ā, n lɛ odúúdú aíne nēe bá nyā tū.

eng_Latn: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he hath swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
idu_Latn: N géē yá Ubélu, ɛcí nɛ̄ Ubábīlɔn ī pā ā, italā. N klla í yá kóō kpó aíyó nóō kpó uwī ɔ́ɔmā kwúcē. Ācɛ aéwo ā í klla gáā nyɔ̄ í pā ɔ̄ gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdɔ kú Ubábīlɔn kwú catāajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So the people went out into the field against Israel: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ Udéfīdi ā le pɛ́ ga ɔgbɛ́fú nyɔ̄ í le ɛfú kpó tá aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ipú ūpū kú Ɛ́frem á.

eng_Latn: And their feet were straight feet; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf's foot: and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass.
idu_Latn: Ikpó kú uwā kwu ajɛ kpaakpa, é klla lɛ āpīice bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā. É bá i ceyī ŋáaŋáa bɛ̄ɛka ugóolu nēé lɛ ɔ́ nya pélúú ā.

eng_Latn: It was planted in a good soil by great waters, that it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a goodly vine.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tɛtɛ kwu ɛga olɔhi, nōo yɔ̄ i má éŋkpɔ̄, nɛ̄ ó gē jɛ̄ klla i lū, klla gwá īkpō ɛɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō le pīya ɔcí ufáyin onwuné nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ī pīyatɔ̄há mla anú í kē ī bīyíne ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī bīyíne í má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó ī jé ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ami, Utátīyɔsi, ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔkpá nyā lɛ Upɔlu ā gē hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: And the land shall mourn, every family apart; the family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aípɔ́nū ā géē yēkwu kú abɔ̄ iyī ūwā. Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Udéfīdi mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ uwā í bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí. Ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ Unátan mɛ́mla anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā í bá ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers: now the magicians of Egypt, they also did in like manner with their enchantments.
idu_Latn: Uféro lɛ odúúdú ācɛ o jéeyī, ācogwɛ́bā mɛ́mla ācɛ ō yíimabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó hīīgwú. O ŋmá lɛ ɔdā kú imabɔ̄ kú uwā ā, é lɛ ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ Árɔ̄ni yá ā yá dúú.

eng_Latn: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ɔhá mɛ́mla aálá, aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aɛ́na nyɔ̄ mla uwá dúú.

eng_Latn: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ le pīyeyī gbɔɔ́ ō wā ajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, bī usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa nōó tá ɛka ā tū ɔ̄ ā. Ó ka ɔlá yɔ̄ i yi ŋmá ɛfu ā.

eng_Latn: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Églɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri mɛ́mla ācɛ Ámālɛ̄ki kwú píya tɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ é gaá le ɛfú kpó tá Ísrɛ̄lu á. É le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yálé klla mīyɛ Ujérīko, igelī nɛ̄hi kú alī ā.

eng_Latn: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá ŋ́, aá géē tá ipú aálagbá, yɔ̄ ī gwonū tá ɔwɔɔwɛ. ámāŋ é géē kpó aá ŋmó mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé géē ŋmó ā. Náaná Óndú ā í yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū kpɔ́, ó kē le tútū ō yá uwá italā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Ásāfu ācogwíijē kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, wɛ, ofɛhīlī ce ahātá .

eng_Latn: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa ā. Ohígbū ka aá lɛ ɔwɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō gwū tū ācɛ, aá bēhé ŋ́, aá ke cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe tíne kéē bēhé ā bēhé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Antothite,
idu_Latn: Íra, ɔyí kú Ukíss ŋmá Utékōwa, Abíyɛ̄sa ŋmá Ánatɔ̄ɔtu.

eng_Latn: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray thee; for the LORD hath sent me to Jericho. And he said, As the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. So they came to Jericho.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da Ɛláyíssa kahíníī, Yɔ̄ amānyā gbēyī um, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū um ga Ujérīko. Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Abɔ̄ Óndú ā yēeyī ā, nāa kē yēeyī dúú ā, ń gāa cīghīhi gwū uwɔ tá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ i tá Ujérīko á.

eng_Latn: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ofu ɛpa ce igwó ā le yɛce uwá le tá Ujɔ́dan á. Anɔ́ɔ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ofu ɛpa cigwó ā gaá háyi ɛcɛɛcɛ hɛ uwá tá ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ Ɛláyíja mɛ́mla Ɛláyíssa háyi pī ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: But sought to the Lord God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbā Ɔwɔicō kú ádā nū ā ɛ̄gbā klla gē lɛyí táajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú nū ā. Ó yá ucē mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄nɛ̄ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā kú Usáyɔn, aá wā gāa má Usólōmɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā. Ó lɛ ɔfulā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū le wu ɔ́ ɛyí ɛ̄cī nōó lɛ ɔnyā ā wu ɛyí. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛ̄cī kú éeyē mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄hɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Uhosíya ɔyí kú Ubíyɛ́rí, ɛ́pléeko ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usíya, Ujɔ́tam, Áhāsi mɛ́mla Uhɛsɛkíya wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda, nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Ujówāsi, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, ɔdā nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā gē ka lɛ ācɛ ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ ka oŋmɛ́yí kú odúúdú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɛlá kwu okónu nāa ce lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ufílīpu lɛyíkwu ɔkōolɔhi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, é le uwá yúbatísim kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā.

eng_Latn: At that time when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ɛ̄nyā má ā, ó jé ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ anúɔ gbā ā pó ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó klla lɛ ɛya gwo ɛyí ede nōó gwó lɛ Óndú ā ɛgowíikpɔ̄dā ɛhɔ̄ kú Arawúna.

eng_Latn: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
idu_Latn: Umérɛ̄di klla lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá lɛ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda. Ó ma ayí ɛtá nēe bá ā lɛ ɔ́: Ujérɛ̄di nōo wɛ ádā kú Ugɛ́dɔ ā, Uhɛ́ba nōo wɛ ádā kú ācɛ Usóko ā mɛ́mla Ujɛkutíyɛlu, nōo wɛ ádā kú Usánōwa ā.

eng_Latn: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n géē bī le jé ɛdɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá wɛ ā yɔ̄ á. Oŋmá lɛ oyēeyī kú Uféro ā, aá gaá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá amānyā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ámōōmɛ kú aá bī wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.
idu_Latn: Kwú unwū kú íne kú uwɔ ō le tū ú tá um ɔtū, fíyɛ́ unwū kú ije mla agbénú ō lɛ.

eng_Latn: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē yá ádā nū ɛbɛ́, nɛ̄ ó klla gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ŋ́, ɔtagláma cíkā ō lɛ ɔ́ īkpēyī kpó nwúla, cɛ́ɛ́ epu kwú ɛbɛ́ kú nū ohile ú lé.

eng_Latn: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus saith unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them.
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ Unásārēti ā nɛ. Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ami wɛ anú á. Ujúdasi oyíbīyājɛ ā háyi mla uwá.

eng_Latn: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
idu_Latn: Aa géē bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna mɛ́mla omlede éyi mɛ́mla aómlede kú iháyí éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ aháapa lɛ gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka, n yɛ bū ipú ɛga nōo dobū nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlékwū ā, ń gáā yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka a yɔ̄ pī um. Ɔ́kpa mɛ́mla okwutɛ kú uwɔ ī tá um ɔtū lé á.

eng_Latn: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá gē nyɔ̄ ā, é le ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí nōó gē kɛlā gla ŋ́ bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
idu_Latn: É lɛ uwɔ ofɛpa ce igwó kú ugóolu yá kóō lɛ īlī ā kwú bɔ́há kéē wɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: For there is no respect of persons with God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í gē má eyīgoo kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, that they proclaimed a fast before the LORD to all the people in Jerusalem, and to all the people that came from the cities of Judah unto Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā ahāanɛ kú iháyí ɔ́mɛɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, ācɛ ā lɛ okónu gwū kéē má eyī olɔhi kú Óndú ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ŋmá aígelī kú Ujúda wā ā, gwū okónu nyā á.

eng_Latn: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé ga ɛyí ɛfu ā, Ugɛ́hási mīyɛ iyó ā ŋmá uwá ɛyí. Ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó tū ipú inu, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kéē nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And I commanded, and search hath been made, and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings, and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein.
idu_Latn: N kē lɛ ɔ́da je ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá ka lɛ ā, é kē lɛ ɔkwu kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm bū, n kē má ka, ŋmíífī íkée ā, é wɛ ācɛ obɔ̄bí, nēe tōō gbō ŋ́, é klla ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú mɛ́mla unwalu eko dóódu ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of the LORD in the LORD's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubárūku lɛ ɛlā nɛ Óndú ā ka ā jé ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujeremíya da ɔ́ lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā kóō híī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yíífi ŋ́. Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nōó hɛ́tá ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ otrɛ̄yí éyééye fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma éyééye igwɛ́ɛpa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ káā lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ajɛ kú Ukénan jila tayínū. Ajɛ nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
idu_Latn: Aá hokónu tū Uherodíyɔn ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ɔmáapú um. Aá hokónu tū ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ Unakísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said unto him, Go, say unto him, Thou mayest certainly recover: howbeit the LORD hath shewed me that he shall surely die.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óndú ā le mafú gā um ka ɔ́ɔ géē kwú. Amáŋ nyɔ̄ gaá da ɔ́ ka, ó géē wī ŋmá ōcē kú nú ā.

eng_Latn: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.
idu_Latn: Ujehóyākim wɛ iháyí ofu cɛ̄ɛhɔ̄, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda á. Ó gbō ācɛ kú Ujúda ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm iháyí igwóléyi. Ó le íne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ā bīya.

eng_Latn: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ le anyā nū, mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ā kpó, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú aɛ́na, mɛ́mla odúúdú agbénú kú nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔyínɛ́ nū, Ujékɔ̄pu gaá lā ajɛ ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ tīile nwuné fíyɛ́ álá á! Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, íne ā cɛ̄ ka ācɛ kɛ́ɛ yá ɔdōolɔhi ɛ̄cī Usábāti.

eng_Latn: Did I then begin to enquire of God for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for thy servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
idu_Latn: Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki ka anúɔ kɛlā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū nū gbóó, amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ wɛ aflɛ́yí ŋ́. Ó da Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ híī kpó ɛlā ce anúɔ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúdú kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú anúɔ lɛyíkwu ujɔ̄ ō tū tū ɔ̄ ŋ́. Ó ka anúɔ í jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Usiríya nēe bá Udamáskɔ̄si ā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá tá Uhadadésa abɔ̄ ā, Udéfīdi klla kpɛ́fú tá uwā dúú lɛ úlā ofɛpa cuúlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya gbā ā pó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú yá uwá ɛhi, anɔ́ɔ ó yá uwá ɔdā dúúmā gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men's feet that were with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā gā ɔlɛ́, anɔ́ɔ Ulában le iyó wī ŋmá igbīhi kú aínyankwūlūmī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ácí mɛ́mla ɔdōlé kpó lɛ uwá á. Ó klla le éŋkpɔ̄ bī gé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe wā mémla anú ā kéē lɛ ikpó na.

eng_Latn: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them, and hid my face from them.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo cíkā ā nɛ̄ n yá uwá ohígbū ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ucē ɔdāhá kú uwā á, abɔ̄ n je eyī kú um pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā á.

eng_Latn: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ó tá uwā abɔ̄ iháyí ofɛpa ipú ígbíli nááná nɛ̄ ucē kú uwā mafú lɛ ɔ́ koó he uwá ɔtū ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: They shall come with weeping, and with supplications will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by the rivers of waters in a straight way, wherein they shall not stumble: for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é géē bá ī wā ā, é géē bá i jikwū klla bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ. N kē í tú uwā ɔtū lé abɔ̄ n géē yɔ̄ ī bī uwā kwúcē ā. N géē bī uwā jé ɔwɛ ga aɔ́kpá nēé ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄, bū ɛga nōo i mɛ̄ɛ̄lɛ́ nēé gáā lɛ ikpó gbo ajɛ ŋ́. Aá kē jé ka n lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ɛ́frem wɛ ɔ́kplá kú um á.

eng_Latn: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄, nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī ga iyāwu ā, ó lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú agbénú kú nū ú kpó tū uwa abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the people said unto me, Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us, that thou doest so?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā da um ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa gē yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: When thy wares went forth out of the seas, thou filledst many people; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ aíyó ɔ́sú kú uwɔ le tá ogbeé ísu nɛɛ, é gē yá ɛgbá kú ācɛ éwo dóódu lɛ uwá. Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛbɛɛbɛ ī lɛ agbénú ŋmá lɛ agbénú kú iyó ɔ́sú kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ kú aɔ́cí ā nɛ̄ aígbáanɔ gē gwó ɔlɛ́ kú uwā ce á, aómlɛgwā gē gwó ɔlɛ́ kú uwā ce icó ɔcí nēé hī ka Ufɛ́ɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
idu_Latn: É le ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ uwā kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ uwā í má ɔbá lɛ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le iyē tēelihɔ nɛ̄ ó yá iyī nū yēŋēē ŋ́, géē wɛ oōtēelihɔ, ohígbū ka é tá éŋkpɔ̄ kú oōyá yēŋēē ā klá anú iyē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó le Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Óndú ā nyílá, ó klla gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, Thy blood be upon thy head; for thy mouth hath testified against thee, saying, I have slain the LORD's anointed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ̄cɛ Ámālɛ̄ki ā kahíníī, Oyī kú uwɔ kóō ce uwɔ ɛyí, ohígbū ka okónu kú uwɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ cījáalí tū uwɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú fu lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá da īyī um ka aá nēe le ɛcɛ lé ɛɛ́ mā cíkā ō kɛlā á. Ka anyākwɔ́cɛ klla cíkā ō nwū ācɛ íjééyī á.

eng_Latn: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD's, and he hath set the world upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aógbɛhá ú cāŋjɛ ŋmá úmlá. Ó klla í je ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā cāŋjɛ ŋmá ɔtūnōbí mɛ́mla ōwē kú uwā. Ó kwu uwā u ce mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí ɛga kú ojīlīmā. Óndú le ikpó kú ɛcɛ nyā táajɛ á, ɛyí nū nɛ̄ ó gwó ɛcɛ ce á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aítíca kú íne ōhī da ɔ́mpa ūwā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā le ɛbí ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ olɔhi gē gbɛlá ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛyīkwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá. Amáŋ ɛlá nɛ̄ ācɛ obɔ́bíipú gē gbo ā wɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɛ́plla.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Aɛ́bɛ́ oyēeyī ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú uwā lɛ ā kéē wā í bá ipú éŋkpɔ̄. Ká aígbáanɔ kéē kē wu icō.

eng_Latn: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔnyā lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄, á bīya íne dúú ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōó lɛ ɔbá jééjēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ lɛ ɔbá lɛ, ó bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ o lɛ ɔbá ā, lɛ unwalu alɛwa, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā n gē lɛ aá tū ŋmá unwalu nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔnyā amáŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔbá gē lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá kwú ɔdōcīce ú ce ijakī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da éyi kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Cɛ̄ lɛ ijakī ā kóō kwinya lɔfú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kwu lɛ glá ā, ā híī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú ikpó tū ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ka ā yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
idu_Latn: Aá leyīkwɛcɛ ohígbū ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā, aéwo ɔdāhá, ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā wɛ ācɛ nēe ī pi ācɛ kéē lɛ apī hɛ́ piíí ā.

eng_Latn: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é géē má Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ gē wā ŋmá ipú ojuja mla ɛgahi mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nɛ̄ alɔ pó ā? Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kē í ma ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū nōó gē le yúklɔ́ ā fú lɛ ɔ́ āa?.

eng_Latn: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master's use, and prepared unto every good work.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ iyīnū yá yēŋēē ŋmá aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n̄ húmáyī i kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aógo nēé gē kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ eko kú ugbɔga ōjīlīmā āa, ohígbū ka ó i tīile le ɔkpani nū. E ke í lɛ uwa tūtu kéē bī uwa yúklɔ́ olɔhi dóódu.

eng_Latn: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ pó ɔkɔ kú ikwū ō je ajɛ kú Uráma. Ɔkɔ kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī jikwū klla yɔ̄ ī tɛ̄gíkwū. Urécɛ̄lu yɔ̄ gē jikwū ohígbū ayí nū á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í yɔ̄ nōo tá ɔ̄ ɔtūlé glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ayí ā le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nāa pó klla má ā. N géē ka aíne mɛ́mla aɔ́da kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā gā uwɔ. Lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi ká ā jé ācɛ nēe géē ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ é gáā ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka anúɔ géē habɔ̄ ācɛ o bɔ́ɔtū mɛ́mla ācɛ o tá iyī uwā wāajɛ ā tá abɔ́ɔ. Ó ka é géē wā kú anúɔ tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ ká ā pó ɛnyā, awɔ nɛ̄ abahi he uwɔ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā. A gbɛlá ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā kwu anúɔ glá ŋ́, ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lā ɛbɔ́. A gbɛlá ka anúɔ lɔfú bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ. Ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā ɔ́ɔ klla yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka anúɔ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. A gbɛlá ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā cice ɔnyōkwū glá ŋ́. Ayí anúɔ í kē gáā pɛ́ kwú hɛ̄ anúɔ abɔ̄ tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ ī hī aá igwú ka aá wā í jikwū, ka aá yɔ̄ ekwu, ká aá lɛ ɛyí pla, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ īlī ekwu kpo wiyē.

eng_Latn: And they arose, and went to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the wilderness of Maon, in the plain on the south of Jeshimon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́, le tá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā gbɔbū lɛ oō wā kú Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bá ígbíli kú Umáyɔn, ɔpɛ́ kú ɛháajɛ kú ígbíli kú Ujudéya ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ Ujúda, ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi, mɛ́mla odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wā í jīla abɔ́ɔ ā, mɛ́mla ugbɔga dóódu nēé lā mla uwá ā gwéeyē dúú ohígbū ucɛ ā nēé lé ā.

eng_Latn: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:
idu_Latn: A kwú ɔ̄ ū yá otrɛ̄yí kú ɔdā dóódu nāa yá ā. A klla le ɔdā dóódu kpó tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ ɔnyā ā le kwu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō nuunu tú ayááyí kú ɔnyā ā á. Ó nuunu tú odúúdú ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā.

eng_Latn: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni má yɔ̄ ī bēhé ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ó le ɛ̄ba ba uwá.

eng_Latn: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gbɛlá á, ka aílɔ́wá nēé dɔɔ̄kā ō le kagwó mla Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ uwá, ohígbū kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū.

eng_Latn: Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti tine kóō le Ujísɔ̄si hɛ́tá, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɛlā ka lɛ ācɛ ā kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said, Nay, I pray thee, if now I have found grace in thy sight, then receive my present at my hand: for therefore I have seen thy face, as though I had seen the face of God, and thou wast pleased with me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Ehée, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔtū kú uwɔ gāajɛ ɛgiyí um ɔkwɛ̄yi, mīyɛ ɛhi kú um ŋmá abɔ̄ um. Eyī kú uwɔ nɛ̄ n má ícɛ nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka eyī kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n má ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā. Ofíyɛ́ dúú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a mīya um lɔɔlɔhi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Laban said to Jacob, Behold this heap, and behold this pillar, which I have cast betwixt me and thee:
idu_Latn: Ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ n tīkwu bá ɔtāhɛ̄ alɔ mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ kú oblatū ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī éyi, ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ī wúlatū ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ ī ga Ujérīko. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá gwōtū ipú abɔ̄ kú ācohéjulúgwu á. É lɛ ɔ́ ŋmíjē nɛ̄hi, lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kú nū kpó ŋmá ɔ́ɔ iyē, anɔ́ɔ é mā ɔ̄ tá okwōōkwū á.

eng_Latn: And I thought to advertise thee, saying, Buy it before the inhabitants, and before the elders of my people. If thou wilt redeem it, redeem it: but if thou wilt not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know: for there is none to redeem it beside thee; and I am after thee. And he said, I will redeem it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ gbɛlá ka ɔnyīlɔ ā ɔ́ɔ jé odée lɛyíkwu ɔ́. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō lá ajɛ ā, ɛ́mba ɔ́ɔ le lá ipéyī anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe bá ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ō lá ajɛ ā ŋ́, ayíka ɔ́ɔ le ka amānyā, ohígbū ka anú ɔ́ɔ lɛ íkwu kóō lá ajɛ ā aflɛ́yí á, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔgba ɔ́ɔ gē wā ī ce anúɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ohi ka anúɔ géē lá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Íssmɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ahātá le hɛ́ Ujohánan abɔ̄ le kwu ga ajɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri.

eng_Latn: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord GOD will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ opiíí ka īkpō dúú nēé nyi tū ajɛ géē bū klla gē jɛ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē yá kú ācɛ kéē yá ɔdā okpaakpaá. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā géē cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
idu_Latn: Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Usɔ́lu ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi da uwá ā kpó ka lɛ Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ hɛ́ aíjakī kú ipácí tá kéē yɛ ga ɛga dúú nēe he uwá ɔtū ā. Ami mā uwá tá kéē bā ī yɛ gajɛ gicō ipácí á?.

eng_Latn: Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.
idu_Latn: Ɔlɛcɛ, n kwú uwɔ ú yá ɔ̄cogbāājɛ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā a, jāhɔ̄ ká a pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n géē ka gā uwɔ ā ká ā pi uwá ahɔ̄ gā um.

eng_Latn: And as for thee, if thou wilt walk before me, as David thy father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded thee, and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a gbā um kpaakpa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ Udéfīdi gbā um, klla lɛyítáajɛ le íne kú um dóódu, klla í yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ́ ádā uwɔ ka awɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá iyɔ̄bu Upáyílēti gaá ba ɔ́ kóō kwú okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ú lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ī wɔ́tū aá, aá bla ka ācɛ kú ɛcɛ le ɔtū um wú gbɔbū, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́tū aá.

eng_Latn: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus Christ,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō Ádā ā mla Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo wɛ Óndú alɔ ā, kéē ma ogbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi kú uwā fú lɛ aá, kéē yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Yá ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó lɛ ká ā híī je ɔyí um cīgbīhi ga abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And likewise for the north side in length there shall be hangings of an hundred cubits long, and his twenty pillars and their twenty sockets of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nāa géē yá ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā dúú ā.

eng_Latn: That they shall drive thee from men, and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen, and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over thee, till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.
idu_Latn: Keé géē nū uwɔ ŋmá ipú alɛɛcɛ gaá lā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí, cɛ́ɛ́ a géē yɔ̄ ī lé ácí klla ī lé ēpū bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā, iháyí ahāapa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a le jé ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ́ɔ gē gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú alɛɛcɛ á. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla ī je ɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo hi ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú áluka kú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā wɛ úlā bá ɛga úlā ce úlā ofɛɛtá ce úlā ɛhīlī . Aɛ́nyā wɛ ācɛ nēe gbɔbū á.

eng_Latn: And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Le eje nɔ̄wá nɛ̄ a he nyā je gā um ká n lé, ohígbū ka ɛmiyɛ gáā ŋmó um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yɛ bū Íjīpiti ipú kóō ŋmó ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, ó géē má oyī nōo bá aɔ́cí kú odūngwɔ̄wɛ mɛ́mla ɔcí ō bá ɛhícō kú okómpíinu ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gáā cɛ̄ Alelékwū ō ŋmɔ́ɔ́cɛ ā bēhé ga ipú inu ɔlɛ́ aá gaá ŋmó aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ujehóyākim yá ā, ɛcí ō pā kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá ā, é lɛ uwā tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujehōyákim le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛfú nyā gā ā, anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di nyɔ̄ í lɛ Ujɛ́futa hīīgwú cīgbīhi wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá Utóbu.

eng_Latn: Both riches and honour come of thee, and thou reignest over all; and in thine hand is power and might; and in thine hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
idu_Latn: Awɔ gē je agbénú mɛ́mla ojīlīmā dóódu lɛ ɔ̄cɛ á. Awɔ kē lɛ íkwu ō gbō ɔdā dóódu á. Awɔ kē ī je ācɛ pīya ācɛ nɛ̄hi, nēe lɛ ágbénú, lɔfú, klla lóofu á.

eng_Latn: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í tayínū ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ n gáā má ɔ glá ŋ nɛɛ ŋ́? N yɔ̄ ɛbɛɛbɛ ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú cɔ̄nū le ɔkpá ce īyī um kahíníī, Aá klla gáā ga ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aá kú aá nyɔ̄ gaá mlɛ́nyɔ́ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō yíihɔtū tá uwɔ, Udánīyɛlu, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā je unwalu gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā gē tū uwɔ ufi ŋ́. Eko nōo lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ā, iyē kú um klla kwú lɔfú tōōtɔ̄ɔ̄ gɔbū, anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔkpani, kɛlā nɛ̄ a bī ā gā um mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, a cɛ̄ lɛ iyē i lɔfú gā um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ eko o lé ɔdōlé ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ le yá ā, Ubówāsi da Urútu ká ɔ̄ wā gaá mīyɛ igbō ká ɔ̄ lɛ nwū ejé ā lé. Anɔ́ɔ Urútu gáā gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔdōlé mla ācoyúklɔ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ubówāsi kwú igbō kú īkpɔ̄dā ō ŋmɔ́lá ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō lé. Ó lé igbō ā gbóógbó gbéeko nɛ̄ ó le ipú nū. Igbō ā kē hile kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du í kē ŋmó ɔ̄ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́ dúú, ohígbū ka anú je ɔ́ kwúcē gé lɛ alɔ á. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā yá nēe cíkā ō ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness, (woe, woe unto thee! saith the LORD GOD;)
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ákú uwɔ mɛ ɛɛ́, ohóō gā uwɔ. A le odúúdú ɔ́bíipú nyā bī.

eng_Latn: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
idu_Latn: N lɛ īlī pllá tóohɛ́ɛwa ɛɛ́, abɔ̄ n géē kpó īlī ā tū ohí igbɔhá gɛ. N kē le ikpó nā ɛɛ́, n klla kwú ɔ̄ ú blínyī igbɔhá kpɔ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
idu_Latn: Pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā, ká ā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ikwū nɛ̄ n je ká ā tá um abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē tíne kóō wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aá, géē wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú aá.

eng_Latn: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā gɔbū ā, aɔ́gbágwu nɛ̄hi gbɔɔ́ ō lā ipú ɛcɛ. É wɛ ayí aálelékwū nēé hī ka ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō, ayí nɛ̄ ācɛnyā kú alɛɛcɛ ma lɛ aálelékwū nɛ̄ é hī ka ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kù ɔwoicō ā. Ayí ā wɛ aógbējūwā olɔfū nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ācɛ olófu nɛ̄hi kú íkée ā á.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
idu_Latn: ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē tɔ́ɔna nū lɛ odúúdú ɛcɛ ā. Ó kahíníī Aá le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī wā í nya aá tá ɛɛ́. Ó klla bī ulé nōó í cílā ɔnyɔ̄ɔ̄nyɛ ā wā mɛ́mla īyī nū.

eng_Latn: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā, ojuja ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ nōo yɔ̄ ī ceyī wā gaá klá uwá. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ éyi ŋmá ipú ojuja ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um nōo he um ɔtū, nɛ̄ ɛlā nū kē he um ɔtū fíyábɔ̄ ā á. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú uwā wɛ úlā ofɛhīlī ce úlā igwóléyi ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: The LORD called thy name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú ólīifu, nōo wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ klla ī gwá ikpō lɔhi nɛ̄hi ā. Amáŋ abālɔbányā, n géē gbo akpáabana klá uwá, í tū ɔlá klá ɔcí ā, í je aábɔ̄ kú nū kpó yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka, Ádā um le iyó ogbɛnú ce aá, n géē yá kóō klla gbɛnú fíyɛ́. Ó bī itali le ŋmó aá ijē nɛɛ, ami ā géē bī itali ɛdɛ le ŋmá ijē.

eng_Latn: Then thus came every maiden unto the king; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king's house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā gē ŋmá ɛga nēé bá ga agblɔ̄cɛ́ ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā, a ɔ́dīfa dóódu nēe he ɔ́ ɔtū ā nɛ̄ ó gē wiiyē á.

eng_Latn: And oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.
idu_Latn: Aá híī pīya anyōkwū, ayókwū, aógbɛhá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dóódu nōo wɛ ugbɔga nōo lā ɔlɛ́ aá ā tū ŋ́. Aá yá ojuju kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí tū aɔ́mpa aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, and with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ācɛ nēe háyi kpaakpa ga uwɔ ā, a gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa lɛ uwá. A klla í yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛ ācɛ nēé lɛ ɛnyá dōōdu ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: If the priest's daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo lɛ ɔbá nōó wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ŋ́ mā, í gáā lé ɔdōlé otīihɔ nyā a ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É gē pi okwū kú nū ajɛ kpūuulū gáā tá tónū eyīyɛcɛ kú igá kú Ujerúsālɛm bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē yá okwū ijakī ā.

eng_Latn: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how hath Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
idu_Latn: Aá dīíbá, é kwú Umówābu ú catāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔjá nēé i ca ɛɛ́. Uwēyī lɛ ācɛ Umówābu kwú. Ó kwú pīya ɛbɛ ohéyī nɛ̄ odúúdú aéwɔhá ā bá í yá ɔ̄ okónu ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
idu_Latn: É wɛ úlā ɛhīlī ce ofigwóléyi ce igwó .

eng_Latn: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je pīya ɛga nɛ̄ álá, mɛ́mla ɛna mɛ́mla ɛ́dɔ ɛbɛ́ kú ipácí dóódu géē lā. Ogwugwu géē lā ipú alácɛ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ā. É géē ce uwíndo kú ɔlɛ́ ā géē bá ī jikwū. Ɔtágláma géē yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba, kwaá kwaá, okómpíinu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā. É géē je aɔ́cí ō jɛ̄ nɛ̄hi nēé bī le gwó inu kú uwā ā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ohile ā kpó wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ɛga nēé bá ī cɔ̄fiyɛ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ gē yā gē bī éŋkpɔ̄ wā ipú ɔtɔ̄ɔkpá nōo le ŋmó klīklī ā.

eng_Latn: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nyā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nōo lɔhi, aɔ́dā nēe le kpaakpa mɛ́mla aɔ́dā nēe wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ híīī jé Óndú ā má ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā yá nɛ̄ ɛgwā kpó uwā ŋmó ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ Ujúda géē tá alácɛ̄, nōó gāa tōō má ŋ́. Ujúda mɛ́mla aéwo nēe kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā géē yúklɔ́ ɔfiyɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn iháyí ofɛtá cigwó.

eng_Latn: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captives: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd putteth on his garment; and he shall go forth from thence in peace.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ tū aágbla kú aɛ́cí kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā ɔlá. Ó géē yi aɛ́cí ā ōhī ɔlá, klla í kpó aóhī nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbálá gē fu iko ŋmá úwé kú nū dúúdú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Unebukádinēsa géē je ajɛ Íjīpiti tá áncā á. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē nyɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will entice him. And the LORD said unto him, Wherewith?
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alelékwū éyi ga ɛcɛ iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, gaá da ɔ́ ka, N géē nyɔ̄ í plla anú. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
idu_Latn: A gē bī íjéeyī nɛ̄hi le yá ojuju, a klla ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi. A gē má ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ā, a kē ī cílá ācɛ ulé, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nēé yá ā lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass over: for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed over.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ umíta úlā ce ofɛhɔ̄ ɔhá mīya gɔbū, anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú lipú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n yāwu ipú nū glá gɛ ŋ́ má. Ó le lipú fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í yāwu anú glá, ayíka ó tágwā bū ɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Odúúdú aéwɔhá mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá nēe gē kpɛ́fú tá igelī nɛ̄ ede kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɛga olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā géē bítāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā kú ɔ̄na ámāŋ ka obócádēde ō je ɔ̄cɛ otú ā.

eng_Latn: Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔnyīlɔ dóódu nōo gē gwutá mla ɛbɛ́, aá lɛ ɔɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔflla ā géē wɛ ɔdā ō bī blatū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā piyóó. Kóō wɛ ojīlīmā kú Uhɛ́lidáyi Utobíja, Ujedáya mɛ́mla Ujosáya.

eng_Latn: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi eko nɛ̄ ācɛ le oji cē, é gē bī iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo fíyɛ́ uwā lɛ cē oji ā, cɛ́ɛ́ áafú dúú í yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ebilíi kahíníī, Olɔhi, ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ Ujóbu lɛ ā yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ, amáŋ ā híī lɛ abɔ̄ kwu Ujóbu abɔ̄yī nū nóó ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ebilíi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā fúlufúlu ŋ́, gbɛlá ka anúɔ wɛ odée, ayíka ó gē plla iyī nū icííci.

eng_Latn: Ye offer polluted bread upon mine altar; and ye say, Wherein have we polluted thee? In that ye say, The table of the LORD is contemptible.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ nyā anúɔ ojīlīmā, o ŋmá lɛ ɔdōlé icííci nēé gē bī wā í le gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú anúɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ nyí uwɔ ojīlīmā ā? Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē da uwá ka, o ŋmá lɛ ojīlīmā nēé le ce ede kú anúɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā nū tɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo dokónu ā gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa ā le kpó hídáagó, klla kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā í yá ajɛ Ísrɛ̄lu jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ o kwu ayīnu mɛɛɛ kú ācɛ gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū he ɔ̄cɛ, ɔ̄kā olɔhi gē lɔfú tū ɔ̄cɛ iyē.

eng_Latn: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.
idu_Latn: O cɛ̄ manya kú ɔyī ō cɔ̄ɔ̄lá kú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ fíyoo ā, mla o fíyajɛ kú óbō kú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ ī ceyī ā, cɛ̄ lɛ ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā kéē le ɔnya kwú háyi ɛga éyi cíí.

eng_Latn: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
idu_Latn: Ɛga nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā lɛ ɛlā nwū tā ɔ̄ ipú lɛyíkwu Upɔ́lu. É le ɔkɔ gbā le Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: In the LORD shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē nya odúúdú ayááyí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujékɔ̄pu tá. É kē í bī um gwō klla í cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔlamu ī bī abɔ̄ kú nū yá ɔdā nōo ce ɔ́ ɛgbá glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka anú abɔ̄yī nū gē je oyēeyī mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī fu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu lɛ ācɛ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
idu_Latn: Ń yúufi aólɛlā úlúúlā nēe le um yɛ jīla tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ bī abɔ̄ kú uwɔ le yɔ́ɔna, klla yá um ā, awɔ piíí ɔ́ɔma, klla ī je um yíífi á āa?.

eng_Latn: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ipí ā le nyīla eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya le ɔ́ jila, le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē ā, ó klla géē ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, kóō lɛ ɔ́ jila kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé le yá agbe, nēe bá ī kwú ā bá ī tíifi, klla bá ī jikwū hī Ɔwɔicō kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ ipú igelī ā. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í lɛ ɛlá wu ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄hi ā bá ī yá aógbɛhá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ahāapa ce úlā ahātá ce ofɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ ka Óndú ā kóō géē mīyɛ, ó géē wɛ ɔbá kú ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛna dúúmā nōó lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the LORD shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi géē wā nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē jíla ajɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi mɛ́mla ɔkpá nōo kwu ɛjī kú Íjīpiti ā iyē. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yā kékeké bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tá igwu owu ŋmá igbóngbō ā.

eng_Latn: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá wā kóō kpó úgla nɛ̄ ācɛ kpó ā bónū, anú abɔ̄yī nū í kē bīyíne dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And a voice of a multitude being at ease was with her: and with the men of the common sort were brought Sabeans from the wilderness, which put bracelets upon their hands, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
idu_Latn: Inu ɔlɛ́ uwā le mu eko dóódu mla ɛwa kú ācɛ ɛflɛ́ɛfu nēé kpó ŋmá ígbíli wā, bá ī yá uya klla bá ī gwá ejé. É kwú aóje otābɔ̄ í kpó tū anyā ā abɔ̄, klla kwú aɔfūlā ohéyīfuú í kpó kwu uwá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ Émɔ̄si, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ācogbāálá nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Utɛ́kōwa ka lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā yɔ̄ á. Ó kɛlā ā eko nɛ̄ Ussáya wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam, ɔyí kú Ujéhāssi wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, iháyí ɛpa gbɔbū lɛ ajɛ ohɛ́wulu ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto the LORD, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: É bī aɛ́na úlā ofɛpa cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla aálá úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ le gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ú tū Óndú ā abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
idu_Latn: Usérūgi, Unáhɔ, Utéra.

eng_Latn: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ í lɛ eyī kú alɔ kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī gē má ā ŋ́, amáŋ alɔ gē kpó eyī kú alɔ kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī í má glá ŋ́ mā ā. Ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī gē má glá ā í gē yɔ̄ piyóó ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā nɛ̄ eyī í má glá ŋ́ mā gē yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Aá híī ma aɛ́cí ámāŋ aójibó, ámāŋ aɔ́kpa kú ɛcɔ̄, ámāŋ ɛcɔ̄ ō gbā kwaajɛ kú aá gbā uwā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́. Ami ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá.

eng_Latn: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe túbá tɔ̄há bá ī kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ́, nōo nɔ̄ɔna, abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í lé ɔdōlé, nōo kwú héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄la nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄ kpɔ́ ā. Ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ijēēnyi yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ɔ̄, nōo nɔ̄ɔnā yɔ̄ í gwá énkpɔ̄, nōó kwú héyī nɛ̄ ijēēnyi ā yɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand, yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ kōō lɛ ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ulá ɛpa ce ofigwó kpó lɛ anúɔ nááná, anúɔ ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ abɔ̄ kú anúɔ kwu ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔcɛ́ ā glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka odúúdú aá pó, eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ gē da anú mɛ́mla Abíssāyi mɛ́mla Ítāyi ka ohígbū anúɔ ā ɛ́ɛ̄ yá Ábsālɔm ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
idu_Latn: a géē kwu um ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɔ́tɔ kpɔ́, nɛ̄ īlī kú um klla í yɔ̄ í yá uwēyī um dúú.

eng_Latn: But he, being full of the Holy Ghost, looked up stedfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usitífin nōo le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ ā, pīyeyī má ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ó le ojīlīmā kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ujísɔ̄si má háyi abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy God, thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, á yúúfi ŋ́. Oŋmá eko nɛ̄ a miya ka anúɔ í tá iyī anúɔ wāajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú anúɔ lɛ odéeyi jé ā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā á. N bī ohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā gé lɛ uwɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Then the king arose, and sat in the gate. And they told unto all the people, saying, Behold, the king doth sit in the gate. And all the people came before the king: for Israel had fled every man to his tent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ gaá cīce okómpinu kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le ka lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ gaá cīce okómpinu kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā kwú pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū abɔ́ɔ á. Eko nyā odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú pɛ́ kwu le pɛ́ ga ɔlɛ́ uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And hath put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le yá kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá kóō le íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú odúúdú aɔ́dā dóódu, ó klla kwú ɔ̄ ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci, mɛ́mla Óndú kú odúúdú ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, Ɔwɔicō kwú úklɔ́ kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ ákú ācɛ ohile ā ú lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ ɔwɛ ékpó mlá ɛka nōó yā tū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā lɔhi fíyɛ́, ohígbū kóō ŋmá lɛ okónu kú aɔ́dā olɔhi fíyɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.
idu_Latn: Óndú pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā, ohígbū ihɔtū kú uwɔ nōo yɔ̄ eko dóódu ā. Óndú lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka kpaakpa ká ā lɛ oyēeyī kú um tū.

eng_Latn: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that killeth him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ohi ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā tá ɔ̄ á. Ɔdā nēé géē yá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē ŋmó ɔ̄ ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah,
idu_Latn: Ámam, Séma, Umólāda.

eng_Latn: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā. É le pɛ́ tá icō ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ɔ ā ipéeyī ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔ́ plla mla ugóolu . A klla í bī ugóólū ā le hijā tū ókónu nū biílí.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka anúɔ géē tū owu nɛ̄hi, ɔwɔ nɛ̄hi mla ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ wā í klá ɔdɔ ā, í je ɔ́ ca tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálāk da Ubálam kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa gē yá um yɔ̄ āa? N bī uwɔ wā ká ā gaá tókónu lɛ aólɛlā kú um, amáŋ ɔdā nāa gē yá a lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔhā nāa ī hɛ́ ce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: I sleep, but my heart waketh: it is the voice of my beloved that knocketh, saying, Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, and my locks with the drops of the night.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī gbɔlā, amáŋ odo kú um yēeyī yɔ̄ ī nɔ̄nā. N nɔ̄na, anɔ́ɔ ohumɔtū ā yɔ̄ ī lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔwɛ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla gā um, ákú abɔ̄yī um, ohumɔtū, okóhō kú um, nōó lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ka ébú le cē klá um ɛyí. Ébú kú otú ā, yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ŋmá ɛyí kú um wā ajɛ kótókótó.

eng_Latn: And Azariah the son of Nathan was over the officers: and Zabud the son of Nathan was principal officer, and the king's friend:
idu_Latn: Asárīya, ɔyí kú Unátan gē leyīkwu odúúdú aígbómína kú ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ajɛ ā á. Usábūdu, ɔyí kú Unátan gē nwū ɔcɛ́ ɛlá á.

eng_Latn: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é bī ɛlā ā ɔtū, amáŋ igbo alɛwa é ge miya ɛlā ā mla iyī uwā gē kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí kú o héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of the LORD? let it come now.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē da um kahíníī, Ufi nɛ̄ Óndú ā ge tū alɔ ɔ́ɔmā yɔ iní gɛ? Óndú ā kóō wā í yá ɔ̄ mɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá lɛ yá lɛ ā, ɔbā kú aá géē wɛ oō tū mu mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ eko dóódu. Ɔjá kú enyi kú aá géē wɛ omōomu eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he made a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: with cherubims made he it of cunning work.
idu_Latn: É le ukɔ́tin kú īlī nɛ̄hɛ́ tá, lɛ ɔ́ wu tɔ̄há mla owú odufā, owú ɔgalúlā mɛ́mla owú nɔ̄wá. É klla le ijā kú ifotó kú Ucérūbim wu tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come!
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aɔ́dā nōo géē yá kú ācɛ kéē bīyíne ā géē yá piíí. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo géē yá kú ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kóō yá ā le jí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramothgilead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ iháyí alɛwa le gla ā, Ujɛhósāfati le tá Usamérīya gaá má Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Áhābu ŋmó aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na alɛwa nɛ̄hi le yá anú mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā ɔga. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujɛhósāfati kóō wā mla anúɔ ká aá nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Urámɔtu ipú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ ma ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ā nɛɛ? Kɛɛ keé ma ébú.

eng_Latn: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
idu_Latn: Awɔ pīya um bɛ̄ɛka enyi amɛ ā tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɔma kú ɛ́nɛ́ um, klla yá ka iyē kú um kóō gbɔɔ́ ō jɛ̄ ipú abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ je lɛ aá gwá ohígbū ka aá gē tá Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔkwu, Ɔwɔicō géē gbā ulé nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
idu_Latn: Ó kwúcē wā igbɔhá anɔ́ɔ ó má uwā bá ī gbɔlā, ohígbū ka eyī kú uwā wɛ iyɔ̄lā iyɔ̄lā.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdā dúúmā nōó cīce anú í je tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwú ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā cīce anú ā ú, géē na īlī kú nū klla í gwíiyē, ó kē tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in thy father's presence, so will I be in thy presence.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da Ábsālɔm ka ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ anúɔ géē gbā ɛ́ɛ́ mā ā, ó wɛ anú nōo wɛ ɔyí ɔkpani anúɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ gbā ádā nū ā, nɛ̄ anúɔ géē gbā ɔ̄ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, aá le jī ɛɛ́! Ó lɛ ā ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá ī yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka akwuna nōo lɛ īlī nɔ̄wá bōō nōo gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi wiyē ā. Ó klla bī ɛ́cɛ mɛ́mla ɔká le ifa yá klla lɛ ɛwɔ́ nya eyī kóō héyīfuuú. Aá bá ī yá áncā bɛ̄ɛka akwunā ɔ́ɔmā nēe ī yá īyī nū kóō jɔ́ncɛ́nyā áncā ā. Aéwo nēe ī yá ɛma tá ā bá ī bɛ́yíkwu aá, gē tíne kéē kpó aá ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gbeyīcíí ŋ́ mā í gbɔɔ́ ō gbɛlá cíí ɛ́ kéē yá ɔdá dúúmā. Ācɛ nēe ī hɔ́gwū ohígbū ké jé ɔdā ō ka ŋ́ mā, géē gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā fléflé tɛ́ɛcɛ pélúū.

eng_Latn: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial: for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je um ka n wɛ ɔnyā ɛfulɛ́ɛfu ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n húmáyī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ā ohígbū unwalu mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí kú um ā lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: Ujókmíim, Ubɛtórɔn.

eng_Latn: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ kóō le ŋmó tá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ ī yá ɔdā dóódu, ó géē yá ɔ̄ ga ajaajɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kē pīya ɔtū abɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā nōo he ɔ́ ɔtū ā, nōó gē yá á.

eng_Latn: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ussafán kahíníī, N le ɔkpá kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō ā pīyɛ̄ ŋmá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi amānyā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔkpá ā ú lɛ Ussafán á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n dɔ̄ɔ̄kā nū ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī, ó kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ń klla má ɔ̄ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ n dɔɔ̄kā nū abɔ́ɔ ā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō da Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ mla uwá ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja cáŋjɛ le yɛ mla uwá ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kéē yēeyī yɔ̄ ī gɔbū kpɔ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ ó í hɛ́pɔ̄hi, klla ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa lɛ aólɛhɔ́ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
idu_Latn: N da uwá ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ géē yá ka ámíyā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka koó í yá Ujerúsālɛm ā, koó le yá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe kwu ɔ́ ajaajɛ ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka uwá bá ī yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú, klla tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔda nɛ̄ anúɔ gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I remember that which Amalek did to Israel, how he laid wait for him in the way, when he came up from Egypt.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ka Óndú nɛ̄ ɔ́ lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka anúɔ géē yá ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki italā ohígbū ikpɛ́lā nēé yá tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko nēé bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Usɔ́lu kahíníī.

eng_Latn: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
idu_Latn: Ucē kú nū nyā í lɛ ɛyí ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī fú ewo lé ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī pā ɛcí ā líla nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ íla kú nū ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ le nyíleyī nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ó kē hɛ́ īyī nū tá glá ɛ́ nōó gē cɛ̄ gbóógbóō ka ɛcí nɛ̄ anúɔ bī abɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
idu_Latn: Aá kwú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla ugóolu mɛ́mla agbénú kú um ú kpó ga agbla kú ɛcí kú aá.

eng_Latn: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá dúú nɛ̄ ó lɛ aúcē nēé cɔ̄cí nēe bá nyā ŋ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ lɔhi ŋ́ mā, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ fúlufúlu ā. Ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā le mlanyī ka Ɔwɔicō kwú íne nōo bīya í yá ɔ̄ ɛhi klla lɛ ɔ́ na yēŋēē ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ga ɛgiyí Uhɛsɛkíya gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ka lɛ ā? Iní nɛ̄ uwá ŋmá ā? Uhɛsɛkíya tá ohi ka, É ŋmá ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.
idu_Latn: Iháyí ɔ́mofɛpa cigwó ā, aá gáā nyi ɔdā dóódu tū ɛhɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gēe cē inana kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē tú ikpó kú ɔcí dúúmā nɛ̄ aá gwó ābɔ̄ nū ŋ́ mā bá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.
idu_Latn: Ó gē wā í cá Ísrɛ̄lu ɛcá eko dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan, ɔyí kú ɔyínɛ́ kú Udéfīdi, Ussímēyi lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō, mɛ́mla ísu, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé bá ipú nū ā kéē cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: What mean ye, that ye use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí ita nyā nēé gē kwú Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó ā ɛ́ɛ́? É ī ka ka, Aɛ́nɛ́ mla aádā lé ugurepu oōmākáká á. Amáŋ ayīnu kú ayí uwā kē kwú ijile á.

eng_Latn: Now as they were making their hearts merry, behold, the men of the city, certain sons of Belial, beset the house round about, and beat at the door, and spake to the master of the house, the old man, saying, Bring forth the man that came into thine house, that we may know him.
idu_Latn: É bá ī jɔ́ɔnyɛ kú īyī uwā, anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe gē yá ɔdīcíci mɛ́mla īyī uwā ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā. É da uwá kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛnyílɔ nōo wā ɔlɛ́ nū ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ka aá ɔ́ɔ tíne ō cikpó nū.

eng_Latn: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ uwá gbo mla odúúdú īlī kú uwá, kwu ɔdōkwɛyí kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ é le uwá kpó tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ tū ipú ɔlá kú útuló á.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king.
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam le tá Usɛ́lɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛhícō kú Ísrɛ̄lu jīla gáā je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka abɔ̄ é le éwo ɔhá pūla nááná ā, ó ka anúɔ géē tū uwā bá ɛga éyi, cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ bī ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya lɛ italā nōo í lɔnɔ tū uwā nɛ̄hi yá ūwā.

eng_Latn: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him.
idu_Latn: É klla cá ɔ̄ ɛdɔ kú ɛcá dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed God, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛga kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ é ka ka Ébrahām cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kē lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō ka Ébrahām ɔ́ɔ wɛ oklóbīya anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
idu_Latn: N kē í kpó uwā kwúcē wā í lā ipú Ujerúsālɛm ŋmá ajɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. É géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, kú n̄ gbō uwā ɔwɛ ɔ̄kwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Then the magicians said unto Pharaoh, This is the finger of God: and Pharaoh's heart was hardened, and he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ o yíimabɔ̄ ā lɛ tá ɛgiyí Uféro gáā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū yá ɛ̄nyā á. Amáŋ ɔtū kú Uféro le lɔfu kpɔ́. Ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni ŋ́ kpɔ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
idu_Latn: N gē bī ɔdā nɛ̄ aá jé glá ā le yá ɔdōcabɔ̄ lɛ aá ohígbū ka aá ī jɛ́yí odée fíya ŋ́. Eko éyi aá kwú iyī aá ú bɛ̄ɛka ɔfiyɛ kú ɔdīcííci mɛ́mla aɔ́dā dóódu nēe bɔ̄bí ā. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā aá kwú iyī aá í pīya ɔfiyɛ abālɔbányā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá yá ɔdā nēe tīile.

eng_Latn: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ iyē tá nōó jégēdēe ŋ́, ó géē gwīiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē í yɔ̄ tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ éyi hí ɛga nēé hī ka Ídɛn ipú ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔlɛɛcɛ nōó yá ā ú tá abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwā ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá ka ɔwɔ kóō yā tū ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā ŋmá ɔkpáncō, klla géē hɔ́hā ce úklɔ́ kú uwā, nɛ̄ uwá géē lɛ ɔdā klla í le kplá aéwɔhá, amáŋ ɛ́ɛ gáā kplá ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí aéwo dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
idu_Latn: Ojuja mɛ́mla obū nɛ̄hi le yɛ ɔ́ jīla tá, ó ce ɔcɛ́ ī gbō ɛcɛ mla okpaakpa, ó klla gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyē kú uwɔ le mu mla ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ ābɔ̄ dúú í yɔ̄ ajodobū ŋ́, ó lɛ ā ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyē kú uwɔ géē fíyajɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ̄ agege gē bī ɔfú kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó fíyajɛ lɛ glá gē fíyajɛ gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu mɛ́mla Umerí cíkā ō gwu iyē ā le yá ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú íne kú Umósīsi ā, anɔ́ɔ é kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú ga Ujerúsālɛm gaá kwu ɔ̄ ú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ajɛ ā kpó lɛ aípɔ́ɔma ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ce āyā ā kē mīyɛ ɔdā kú úgwū kú uwā ɛɛ́. Ajɛ kú uwā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan nōo pīyeyī kwu Ujɛ́rīko ā.

eng_Latn: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú Ujerúsālɛm bá ī lɛ abɔ̄ ma ajɛ yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú uláyi ā bɛ̄ɛka aópeyī ā. É le īyī ūwā iye tēelihɔ mla oyī nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í cē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu úwé kú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā dúúdú. Anɔ́ɔ Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ó le odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó, klla le ɔlɛ́ ā wúlatāajɛ, le ɔmā pīya klá ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened, when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt: and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her: as for her, a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall go into captivity.
idu_Latn: Obū ī wā í klá Utapánhesi eko nɛ̄ n géē je ɔfú kú Íjīpiti nōo wɛ ɔdā ɔbɔ́cɛ kú uwā nɛ̄hi ā catāajɛ ā. Ojuja odobū géē klá Íjīpiti,abɔ̄ é géē bá i kpó odúúdú ācɛ kú igelī ā aálagbá kú ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet, and taketh not warning; if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head.
idu_Latn: ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le opo ā pó nōo tá ká ō jahɔ̄, nɛ̄ olɛlā ā wā í kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó, ayíka oyī kú nū ā ce anú abɔ̄yīnū īyī nū ɛyī.

eng_Latn: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gē tá ikpō kú ɔcí ufáyin bá ā le yá ā, ó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū éyi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ olufa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ikpō kú ɔcí ufáyin kú nū gē lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
idu_Latn: N húmáyī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je ɔ́da ga um kā n yá ā, ɔ́dáŋ ka n gekwú, n géē tóómbili í gwéeyē. N kóō gáā lɛ ɛlá wu ɔnɔ kú ikwū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā mīyɛ ɛhi kú Alelékwū Ihɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ mīyɛ ā dúú, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɔfú ci o bī éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ yá uwā ubatísim glá ā.

eng_Latn: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ɔlɛ́ Usáyímɔ̄n á. Áganá yɔ̄ ī yá ɛ́nɛ́ ɔnyā Usáyímɔ̄n, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from thy fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against thy people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ uwá kpó yíífi, ācɛ kú íjīpiti géē ka ka a bī ojuju obɔ̄bí ɔtū ā, yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ á. Ó wɛ ka o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó ɛyí ɛfu ā, kú ā klla lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ. A híī cɔ̄nū gɛ ŋ́, lɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ pīyabɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā híī kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; They also that uphold Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her power shall come down: from the tower of Syene shall they fall in it by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Ŋmá Umígdɔl ɛhícō, jāā ga Ásiwan ɛháajɛ ā, é géē je odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī cɛ̄ɛpɔ̄ Íjīpiti ā kpó ŋmó. Ɛfú géē lé aícɔ́ɔja oyɔ́bɔ́cɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a le ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē kwú opi ú, kóō wɛ ɛya kú íne ō bīya. Kéē klla kwú ɔyí ɛna kú iháyí éyi mɛ́mla omlede kú iháyí éyi nēé lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, kéē wɛ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Joseph died, and all his brethren, and all that generation.
idu_Latn: É bá abɔ́ɔ gbóógbó ā, Ujófɛ̄fu mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú eko ɔ́ɔmā le pɛ́ gekwú.

eng_Latn: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.
idu_Latn: Óndú, a híī hɛ́pɔ̄ ká ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lé ɛpɔ̄hi iyɔ̄bú uwɔ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau's son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau's wife.
idu_Latn: Utímna, odiyɔ̄ kú Ɛlífāasi ā le Ámālɛki ma lɛ Ɛlífāasi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ísɔ. Aɔ́ɔmā wɛ ayí kú Adá, ɔnyā aflɛ́yí kú Ísɔ á.

eng_Latn: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
idu_Latn: N le ɛya kú olétɔ̄há gwó kú ícɛ. N klla le okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā yá jīla. Ɛbɛ́ kú ucɛ ā hile ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
idu_Latn: Ussekaníya ma Ussmáya nōo ma ayí ɛhɔ̄ nēe bá ā: Uhátussi, Ígalu, Ubárīya, Uneríya mɛ́mla Ussáfāti.

eng_Latn: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
idu_Latn: A jé ɔdā nɛ̄ a í bī íjéeyī kú uwɔ yá mla anú. Á cɛ̄ lɛ Ujówābu kwú ɛbɔ́ eko ókplícī kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ alɔ í yá abɔ́ɔ ā mɛ ā, alɔ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā, lɛ alɔ bītá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā ga ɔkónu ísu, ɛga nɛ̄ alɔ le okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God: and he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá yɔ̄ ī wā ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī bī ɔdā o le fu ɔdā ukɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā abɔ̄. Ó lɛ ɔkɔ cɛyí dɛ̄gba hī aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je ɔfú lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ísu kpó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ a je alɔ, nēe wɛ aóklóbīya uwɔ ā, ka alɔ ɔ́ɔ líla lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́, nēé kɛlā glá ŋ́ mā tū īyī uwɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi géē dɔɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé géē je ɔ̄cɛ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū lɛ ā? Ɛdɔ iyē nyá nēé í lɛ ā?.

eng_Latn: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the LORD shall name.
idu_Latn: Ujerúsālɛm, aéwo ā géē má ɛpɔ̄hi nɛ̄ um géē hɛ́ ga uwɔ ā. Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kē ī má ojīlīma kú uwɔ. Óndú ā abɔyī nū kē í lɛ iyē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ce uwɔ.

eng_Latn: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā nēe bá ā wɛ ajɛ nēé je lɛ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi kóō wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā úgwū kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usímri, aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ɛ́lam mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umédīya le gwá.

eng_Latn: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɔnū kú um géē mɛ, ɔtū kú um klla í wā ajɛ. Ɔtū í klla gáā wú um ɛɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē je ányā giicō gɛ ŋ́.
