eng_Latn: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujɛhóram gaá ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū ā, ó kwú odúúdú ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ōhī ā ú kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ má ɔ̄, ádā anúɔ, ka okónōgwu kú awulú kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ bī abɔ̄ á. Ó klla da ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí ɔ́ɔ yá nɛ̄ anúɔ le okónōgwu kú awulú kú nū hɛ́ ōfōōfū nū nɛ̄ anúɔ í je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́ mā ā? Ka ɔ́ɔmā cíkā ō le mafú lɛ ɔ́ péee ka anúɔ í tútū ō bɛ́yíkwu ɔ́ ámāŋ ka o tíne ō yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ anú ā yɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó, nááná nɛ̄ anúɔ í yá ɔ̄ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
idu_Latn: Usébulu, otrɛ̄yí kú ɔlɛ́ ā, le cɔ̄nū eko nōó lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Ugáálu ka ā pó ā.

eng_Latn: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ tá ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu ā jāā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ésskɔ̄lu ā gáā le ajɛ ā jila.

eng_Latn: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú ajɛ mla agbénú kú uwā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú pīya ɔdā úgwū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for thy servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray thee, let thy servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wā gaá lā ajɛ nyā, ohígbū ka ɔkpɛtā ā nwuné nɛ̄hi ajɛ kú Ukénan, ácí í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ aɔ́dāajɛ kú alɔ ī lé ŋ́. kóocōō, lɛ ɛga je lɛ alɔ kú alɔ̄ lā ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn.

eng_Latn: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that ye might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē ka lɛ ɔ́ kóō wā í lɛ aá má kóō ka lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ bá lɛ ā, kóō kē lɔfú tū aá iyē.

eng_Latn: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú ɛlā kú uwā ú gé lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ o yá olɔhi gē dɔɔ̄kā ā, gē ŋmɛ́yí tá ipú olɔhi, amáŋ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ī dɔɔ̄kā ā lɛ, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ gē cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah; we will go up by lot against it;
idu_Latn: É ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá gáā yá ā wɛ ka, aá kóō lɛ ūlī tá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ācɛ nēe í nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá Ugíbɛya ā kpó fu.

eng_Latn: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the trumpet, and the people be not warned; if the sword come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at the watchman's hand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka, ɔ̄cɛ ogbāājɛ ā lɛ olɛlā má ī wā, anɔ́ɔ ó tá opo, pi ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ ŋ́ má, olɛlā í wā í kpó ācobɔ̄bíipú ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó. Amáŋ oyī kú uwá í ce ɔ̄cɛ ogbāājɛ ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance.
idu_Latn: A le ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī mafú gā um, anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ pī um ā, ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɛfú lé uwā, n géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpɛtá ŋmó uwā, klla í yá ka ōcē obɔ̄bí kóō kpó uwā ŋmó jāā gbéeko nēé kwú yíífi dúúdú ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojéeyī ā gē gwō ipú abahi piyóó, amáŋ, ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ olíla mīyɛ ije kú nū ā, ó gē je ɔ́ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka a le iyī uwɔ iyē nyílá, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá fíyɛ́ ɔbá uwɔ lɛ ohɛ́ɛwa kú uwɔ má, le gwutá mla uwɔ, eko nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ɔbá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be upon Aaron's forehead, that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things, which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts; and it shall be always upon his forehead, that they may be accepted before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni géē lɛ ɔ́ bá údɔ̄bū kú nū. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ami, nōo wɛ Óndú ā géē mīyɛ ɛgba nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē je gā um ā, nááná nɛ̄ ācɛ ā kōō le nyíleyī eko nēé ī gwɛ́ɛya gā um.

eng_Latn: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;
idu_Latn: Utímōti, ɔyí um ipú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ukɔ́ nēé tū wɔ nōo ŋmá lɛ ɛlā kú ɛbɛ nēé tɛtɛ má uwɔ a, ká ɛlā ā kóō lɛ ɔfú tū uwɔ iyē ká ā nuunu kú Óndú ā lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔfú tū iyē, ká aá lɔtūlé, odúúdú aá nēe kpɔ́tūce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú eyī ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā géē hídáagó kú ɔdā nōo yá ɔ̄ ā, okónu í kē gáā hɛ́ uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, when we come into the land, thou shalt bind this line of scarlet thread in the window which thou didst let us down by: and thou shalt bring thy father, and thy mother, and thy brethren, and all thy father's household, home unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ alɔ géē wā í mīyɛ ajɛ ā, lɛ īlī nɔ̄wá gbō playi uwíndo nāa jē alɔ bū ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, lɛ ádā uwɔ, ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ uwɔ, mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā, kpó bá inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka n kwú amānyā ú klla lɛ ɔ́ gwu kóō géē wɛ ɛga nēé géē gbā um ɛ̄gbā piyóó. N géē leyīkwu amānyā klla í gbō ɔ̄ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
idu_Latn: É klla géē bī ōwē le cíla uwā ulé kú ōwē nēé yá ācɛ ɔhá ā. Abahi nēé jé ā wɛ ka o yɔ̄ gē yá ɔdā dóódu nōo géē yá kú ɔtū kóō he únwū kú ɔkpíyē kú uwā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ cāā. Ó wɛ ɔdā uwēyī lɛ uwá abɔ̄ nēé gē wā ī lé ɔdōlé mla aá ā. Ɔwɛ nēé bī le plá aá ā he uwá ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya táajɛ ā le yá ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ɔ̄cɛnyā ma ɔ́ á, ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɛga dúúmā kú okwū kú uwā, géē na īlī kú nū, ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
idu_Latn: Ká n pó ɔkɔ kú uwɔ ŋmá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā, ohumɔtū, aɔ́mpa um bā ī gbēeyī kéē pó ɔkɛ̄lā kú uwɔ, ká ā kɛlā.

eng_Latn: And he hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance, and hath called all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab the captain of the host: but Solomon thy servant hath he not called.
idu_Latn: Ó bī aálá, aɔ́bɛ́ɛna, aómlede mɛ́mla ayí ɛna o tīije le ɛya gwó. Ó kōō le Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla Ujówābu, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔlɛ̄ uwɔ kpó hīgwú ga ɔnū ucɛ ā. Amáŋ ó hī ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ, Usólómɔ̄n igwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then she let them down by a cord through the window: for her house was upon the town wall, and she dwelt upon the wall.
idu_Latn: Uréhābu lā ɔlɛ́ nēé gwó kwu ɔdɔ kú igá kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɔ́ŋgbá kwú ācɛ ā ú kpó bū uwíndo ga ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he hath, which is in the end of his field; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you.
idu_Latn: kóō kwú ɔ̄gɛ̄cɔ̄ kú Umakpéla, nōo wɛ ákú nū ā ú gā um. Abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ oŋmɛ́yí kú ajɛ kú nū āa, kóō lɛ ɔ́lá nū dúúdú ka gā um ipéyī aá, ká n le lá, kóō le pīya ɛga o nyi okwū kú um.

eng_Latn: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
idu_Latn: Ami, Upɔ́lu, olagbá ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, mɛ́mla Utímōti ɔyínɛ́ alɔ, gē tɔ́kpá nyā fu wɔ, Ufílīmɔn, oklóbīya alɔ mɛ́mla ɔ́mpa alɔ ipú úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
idu_Latn: N dɔɔ̄kā ká aá gbɛlá kwu ɛlā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ otīihɔ ā ka eko nɛ̄ncɛ nōo yɛ ā, mɛ́mla íne nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ mɛ́mla ohɔ́nyɛ̄ta aá je lɛ aá ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ká aá ā.

eng_Latn: And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto thee in the way as thou camest, hath sent me, that thou mightest receive thy sight, and be filled with the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ananíyāsi le yɛ, le bēhé ga ipú inu ɛga nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ ā. Ó kwú abɔ̄ ú ce ɔ́ ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Usɔ́lu, ɔyínɛ́ um, Óndú ā Ujísɔ̄si nōo wā ɛgiyí uwɔ ɔwɛ ɛga nāa yɛ ŋmá ā, lɛ um tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ kpɔ́, ká ā klla le mu mla Alelékwū Ihɔ.

eng_Latn: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
idu_Latn: Aá géē pɛ́kwú ipú ígbíli amānyā.

eng_Latn: And if so be that the king's wrath arise, and he say unto thee, Wherefore approached ye so nigh unto the city when ye did fight? knew ye not that they would shoot from the wall?
idu_Latn: ka ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔ gē lɔfú cɔ̄nū, í dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ túblá igelī nɛ̄hi ā ajaajɛ lɛ āa? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ klla í ka ka ɛ́ɛ jé ka aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā ā ī tá ɔyī ŋmá ɛyí ɔdɔ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Judas Iscariot, one of the twelve, went unto the chief priests, to betray him unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúdasi Iskáriyɔ̄tu, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā, le yɛ tá ɛgiyí aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya, kóō lɛ ibīyājɛ yá tū Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abɔ̄ alɔ wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó géē yɛ í le kpaakpa lɛ alɔ kú ālɔ̄ dɔɔ̄kā odée ŋmá ɛgiyí aá. Amáŋ alɔ gbonɛnɛ lɛ aá, alɔ klla ī yíhɔtū tá aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ o je amɛ̄ le ɔyí nū gē leyīkwu ayí nū ā.

eng_Latn: These be the heads of their fathers' houses: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel; Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi: these be the families of Reuben.
idu_Latn: Urúbɛ̄n, ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā ma ayí ɛnɛ: Uhánɔ̄ku, Upalú, Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Ukámi. Uwá wɛ aádáádā kú aípɔ́ɔnū nēé lé iyī kwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ mīyɛ ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācohɛ́pɔ̄ ā hɛ́ ā ŋ́, kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛ́ɛ bī ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nū ŋmá ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu le yɛ tá Uráma, Usɔ́lu kē le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nū Ugíbēyi á.

eng_Latn: But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔma ālɔ̄ gbeyīgɔɔ. Ālɔ̄ lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ká ālɔ̄ klla yíhɔtū tá ɔ̄ piíí. Ɔ́ɔmā géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje o le klá ɔtū kpɛ́fú kú alɔ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛlā ā. Ká ālɔ̄ lɛ eyīyōce ka Ɔwɔicō í nya alɔ tá ā klá ɛyí bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpú ōje ā.

eng_Latn: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;
idu_Latn: Gbóógbó ā ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ í yá ɔdā dúú lɛyíkwu ɛpɔ̄ ā ŋ́. Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā, ó da iyī nū kahíníī, N yúúfi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō í le ojīlīmā ce ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si gā ɔlɛ́ otrɛ̄yí ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó má ācɛ otá ɔkpancílé mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá gē yúuya nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ufi le odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kwú, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄hi nāa yá ā. Ɔdā nāa ī yá ā, géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ī tɔ́ɔga kú éeyē ŋmá ɔ́kíkā dóódu kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
idu_Latn: Má ɔdā nōo gē yá ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtūce īyī uwā ā, mɛ́mla oŋmɛ́yí kú ācɛ nēe ka ka agbénú kú aá, ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ aá ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mīyɛ ɔdōlé ā ŋmá abɔ̄ uwá, anɔ́ɔ é kē da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu uwá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā le yá, é gē ka ucē kú ācɛ kú Uhíbru a ipú ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄hi, ɛhɔ̄ kú Íjīpiti a. Ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ a gēe ba í gbo ɛka klá í gwá ɔkpá kú uwá dóódu, ipú iyē kú Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a. Éyi kú ipú ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā, é gēe hī iyē nū kahíníī, Ipú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: As for the Jebusites the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the children of Judah could not drive them out: but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Judah at Jerusalem unto this day.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú Ujúda í lɔfú nū ācɛ kú Ujébūsi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā bɛ̄cɛ glá ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Ujébūsi lā abɔ́ɔ mla ācɛ kú Ujúda jāā kwu ícɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: But he himself went a day's journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O LORD, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi Ɛláyíja le iyāwu kú ɛ̄cī odunkwulu yɛ ga ipú ígbíli ōfōōfūnū. Ó gaá cīce ɔkwu alī éyi. Eyī yá ɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Unwalu kú um jɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Óndú, kwú oyēeyī kú um ú mɛ́ɛ̄. N gekwú mɛ́ɛ̄. Ń klla lɔhi fíyɛ́ aádáádā um nēe kwú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá ā le yá kwɛyí ā, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā yá ká Upɔ́lu kóō lɛ ŋmótū ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ géē yɛ bū Umasɛdónīya mɛ́mla Akáya ga Ujerúsālɛm. Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Eko nɛ̄ n le yɛ ga abɔ́ɔ ɛɛ́, n géē ga Uróm dúú.

eng_Latn: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nōo yá ɔ̄ nyā kpó ka lɛ ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla odúúdú aóklóbīya nū ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla aóklóbīya nū nōo jéeyī ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔfú kú uwɔ gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Umɔ́dɛkāyi ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu nɛ, á kē gáā yá ɔ̄ lé glá ŋ́. Ó géē yá uwɔ lé piíí.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ka ā, ka ɔ́ɔ géē yá kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ oyī kú nū le yá kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ ā. Ɔdā ɔhá nōo fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó yá nyā wɛ o nya alɔ tá ŋmá ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
idu_Latn: Ikpó kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka upíla kú ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hɛ́ ohéyīfuú nēé lɛ ɔ́ bu kwu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ojē ɔdɔ ā. Ó háyi glíímá bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́fu kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā, klla tū ɛgahi bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí usɛ́da kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
idu_Latn: Ká aá kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Ɛlísa, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, kéē lɛ ɔ́ bī ga eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ipéyī nū.

eng_Latn: Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, Óndú um, n gbɔ̄ɔ̄kɔ gā uwɔ ká ā blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe bá nyā nyíla āhɔ̄ kú úklɔ́ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla okónu nāa ce mla ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ káā lɛ italā yá uwā.

eng_Latn: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ éyi kú aɔ́cɛ́ ā wɛ Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ámɔn nōo lā Uhɛ́sibɔn ā. Ajɛ nɛ̄ ó gē leyīkwu ɔ́ ā wɛ, āyā kú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, nōo ŋmá Árōwɛ, nōo yɔ̄ okónōgwu kú ɔpɛ́ kú Aránɔn mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɔpɛ́ ā. Ó klla yɛ jāā ga ísu kú Ujábɔ̄ku, nōo wɛ ɛjī kú Ámɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā í yéyījii ŋ́! Ebilíi nááná ā kōō ī lɛ iyī nū yá kóō lɛbɛ̄ɛka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ofíyajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nyā nɛ̄ ó ka ā cɛ́ɛ́ lɛ ayíkpó kú nū le kpó hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō da iyī uwā ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ kē í ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō glá mɛ́ɛ́ ā gɛ.

eng_Latn: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufílīstiya kwú kwu gwū aójibó kú aɛ́cí kú uwá tá abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwú uwā í kpó á.

eng_Latn: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa nū kwú uwī, kwú ɔ̄ ú yá ɔfiyɛ ámāŋ kwú ɔ̄ ú lá, ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋmó. Ó ka ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ í nū ucē obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋmá ajɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.
idu_Latn: Ó le hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ Ufarísīi ā idáagó abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si í na abɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔdōlé ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi géē ka kahíníī, N lɛ ikwú ō yá ɔdā dóódu glá! Īī. Amáŋ ó wɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu lɔhi ga awɔ ā ŋ́. N lɔfú ka kéē je ɛga gā um ká n̄ yá ɔdā dóódu, amáŋ ń gáā jɛga lɛ ɔdā dóódu kóō lɛ um pīya ɔfiyɛ kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
idu_Latn: Ó le aúgbɔ́ɔnya kú ɛfú úlā ce ofigwó kú nū nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú mɛ́mla aɔ́há dóódu nēe bá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā kpó, klla lɛ aótrɛ̄yí fu kéē leyīkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;
idu_Latn: É je úklɔ́ lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ipɔ́ɔma ipɔ́ɔma. É gē je úklɔ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi dóódu nōo wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ígwíígwu.

eng_Latn: And when he was come near unto her, the woman said, Art thou Joab? And he answered, I am he. Then she said unto him, Hear the words of thine handmaid. And he answered, I do hear.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔnyā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ujówābu āa? Ujówābu tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ nɛ. Ɔnyā ā da ɔ́ ká ɔ̄ jāhɔ̄ lɛ anúɔ, ɔkpani. Ujówābu klla tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
idu_Latn: Anú wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ á. Anú lɛ íkwu gē hɛ́pɔ̄ odúúdú ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɛ́sra māhayicō iyɔ̄bū uwá abɔ́ɔ ā, odúúdú uwā leyī kpó kwu ɔ́. Obōōbū nōó lɛ ɔkpá kú íne ā nwūla ā, odúúdú uwá cāŋjɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē je eko dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē je ɔbá ɛna, ámāŋ omlede, ámāŋ álá amáŋ opī ú gwɛ́ɛya ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
idu_Latn: A yúklɔ́ idáagó alɛwa nɛ̄hi ɛgiyí Uféro, ɔcɛ́ ā, mla aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ohígbū ka a jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ōwē lɛ ā. Ojīlīma nāa lɛ mɛ́mla iyē kú uwɔ nōo lɔfú jāā kwu ícɛ nyā ŋmá ɔdā nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: Yea, ye yourselves know, that these hands have ministered unto my necessities, and to them that were with me.
idu_Latn: Aá abɔ̄ aá jé ka n gē bī abɔ̄ kú um nēe bá ā le yúklɔ́ ɛgbá kú um mla ákú ācɛ nēe bá mla um ā.

eng_Latn: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a dɔɔ̄kā kú ɔtū uwɔ kóō he ācɛ, kwú ɔdā dúúmā nēé yá uwɔ ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Ɔ̄cɛ mla oklóbīya nū gē hɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ó yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó gē yá ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the remnant of the people that remained in the city, and those that fell away, that fell to him, with the rest of the people that remained.
idu_Latn: Ámōmɛ ā, Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí dúúdú kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, kwú ācɛ nēe hile ipú igelī ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe cɔ̄nyā pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū ā í kpó aɔ́fiyɛ ga Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a yá yɔ̄ āa? Oyī kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, Ébɛ̄l, yɔ̄ ī jikwū ŋmáajɛ klá um gbōō kéē lɛ óluma kú anúɔ cílá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the second day after he had slain Gedaliah, and no man knew it,
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cí nū, ká ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kóō í pó ka é le Ugɛdalíya ŋmó dúú ā.

eng_Latn: But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔmálɛ ā tíne kóō mafú ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o jɔ́dā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄kā da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ wɛ ɔ́mpa um ā.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: ye have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, Usámūwɛ̄lu da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ yúufi ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ le ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā yá nááná ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ́ híī pīyeyī ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ŋ́, amáŋ, kéē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú nū í gáā plla anú ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū kōō ī gbenyi ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nōó le má ka ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Ācɛ nēe lā ɛga oligbó, ogbeé kú ísu ā bá ī leyī tɔ́ɔwɛ gbēyī ɛlā nōó í nwū uwā ā.

eng_Latn: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.
idu_Latn: É gē kpó aíjakī kú ayókwū ā uwī. É klla gē mīyɛ ɛna kú ɔnyōkwū kwɛyí ɔdā nēé le kplá ɔ̄ ā, gē bī ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nōó le gbā.

eng_Latn: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usedekíya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N gē yúúfi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ nēe kwu ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ubábīlɔn ā. É géē je um lɛ uwá kéē yá um ōwē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔgwú mɛ́mla ɔyí álá géē lúlé tɔ̄há. Ágábá mɛ́mla ɛna géē bá ī lé ácí tɔ̄há. Ajɛ géē wɛ ɔdōlé kú aɛ́gwā á. É gáā yá ɔ̄cɛ ɔdā dúúmā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdōbɔ̄bí, ɛ́ɛ́ nōo gē je ɔ̄cɛ yíífi ɛyí ɛfú kú um ā ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Uyáwe ā kɛlā nyā á.

eng_Latn: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
idu_Latn: Alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ pó ɔkɔ ā eko nɛ̄ alɔ bá mla anú ɛyí ɛfu otīihɔ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔdée kú ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ anɔ́ɔ ó le abɔ̄ fú ɔ̄ omōōmu, lɛ ɔ́ yɔlá ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ámɔ̄ri lā Áíjālɔn, Usáalubím, mɛ́mla ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɛ́rɛ̄si, kpɔ́. Amáŋ ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem mɛ́mla Umanásɛ, gbō uwā klla lɛ uwá yá aɔ́fiyɛ kú uwā jāā kwu eko nēé tá ɛkpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king's house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uréhobōwam le ɔkplɛ́fú kú udɔ yá kwɛyí nū, klla kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēe gē gbō ɔwɛ kú ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head, which against Judah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul thy father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered thee into the hand of David, that thou chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábna kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi kahíníī, A gbɛlá ka amíyɔ gē yá ibīyāajɛ tū Usɔ́ɔlu nɛɛ? Ka amīyɔ yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ lɛ ācɛ Ujúda bɛ̄ɛka éwo nēe ī tá ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwu ā? Ŋmá aflɛ́yí jāā kwu ícɛ, n húmáyī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ádā uwɔ, Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū mɛ́mla aóklóbīya nū. Ń klla cɛ̄ lɛ Udéfīdi yá aá lé ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ícɛ nyā, a gē kpɛ́lā ce um ohígbū ɔ̄cɛnyā á.

eng_Latn: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛ̄nyā yá mɛ, nɛ̄ n kwú ije nēé le tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā í lɛ uwá, n géē būce aá eko nɛ̄ n gáā yɛ ga Usipéni ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē je ije ā lɛ ɔ́ ŋmá ɔtū ékpónú, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kē í hɔ́hā ce uwá ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Árɔ̄ni bá ɔgbɔɔgba yɔ̄ á: Ɛlísa, Ufínɛ̄hasi, Abíssuwa.

eng_Latn: I saw the LORD standing upon the altar: and he said, Smite the lintel of the door, that the posts may shake: and cut them in the head, all of them; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not flee away, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si klla ka anúɔ má Óndú ā háyi pī ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔda éyi fīyɛ̄ ɛhícō kú upíla kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú etikpa kú nū kóō gbɔɔ́ ō jíliyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ca klá odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile ā ikpɛ̄yí.

eng_Latn: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayí dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ma ā kē í lɔfú yá ɛcɛ lé. Alɔ yá ɛcɛ lé oŋmá lɛ okpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
idu_Latn: ayí ɔlɛ́ Úsaa mɛ́mla Upásíi mɛ́mla Ubesáyi.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá kóō mīyɛ ɛya nēé gē bī wā ede ā, klla kwú igbīhi ú cē kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā le ɔdɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā wúla tā ajɛ. Aólɛlā ā gbogwú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā tɛtɛ ā, eko nēé le alɔ yálé ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú nū lɛ ɔ̄ yálé ɛɛ́. A cɛ̄ le aólɛlā kú nū le éeyē gwó tū ɔ̄ klla le ɛhɛ yɛ tū ɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í pla āpū kú iyē kú nū ā glá ɛ́ɛ́, nōó gē lɛ odée gwū ɔ̄ kóō yɛ āpū kú nū nōo lɔfú lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā klla cɛ̄ ka, aá klla géē lé ucɛ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhá kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ucɛ ā tū ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɔhá mla éeyē nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔ̄kā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Utéra á. Utéra wɛ ádā kú Ébram mɛ́mla Unáhɔ mɛ́mla Uháran á. Uháran wɛ ádā kú Ulɔ́tu á.

eng_Latn: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
idu_Latn: Anú gē gbó odúúdú ɛcɛ á, ŋmá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōo lipú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ga ɛyí ɛfu nōo licō fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Behold, I go out from thee, and I will intreat the LORD that the swarms of flies may depart from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people, to morrow: but let not Pharaoh deal deceitfully any more in not letting the people go to sacrifice to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ɔ́ ka, Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ n nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, n géē gbɔ̄kɔ lɛ Óndú ā, cɛ́ɛ́ óócí, aíju ā í n hī uwɔ, aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ tá. Amáŋ ā híī plla alɔ igbɛ́ɛ̄nyā kú ā lɛ ācɛ ā oōnyɔ̄ gaá gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ci gɛ nóó.

eng_Latn: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ɔdā dóódu kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla igbō nōo hile ā yɔlá.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon's army, which shall take it.
idu_Latn: Ujeremíya klla yɔ̄ ī da uwá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, N géē je igelī nyā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn, é kē í yá ɔ̄ lé.

eng_Latn: Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ nēe kwu ɔcɛ́ ajaajɛ klla í nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ā, da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kéē lɛ ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nēé jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ma dɔ̄ɔ̄ka ŋmá ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before the high God? shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves of a year old?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē bī gé lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō, eko nɛ̄ n wā iyɔ̄bū nū gáā gbā ɔ̄ ɛgbā ā? N̄ bī ɔyí ɛna nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́dúú ā wā í le gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú ɛ̄cī ucɛ kú igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́ mā le nyā, ó kē wɛ eko nēe gē ŋmó ɔyí álá ā.

eng_Latn: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ alɛwa géē fō klla í bɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā. Ācobɔ̄bíipú ōhī ŋmá éwo kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, Udánīyɛlu, gē fō klla í bɛyíkwu ɔcɛ́, o yá kú ɛbɛ nēé má ā kóō lɛ yá jīla. Amáŋ é géē yá uwā lé.

eng_Latn: And if the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth it in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her to be his wife;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā ɔ́ɔ klla tá ɔnyā ā kpɔ́, le ɔkpá-ɔnyā-ōtá je lɛ ɔnyā ā, lɛ ɔ́ nū ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū kpɔ́. Ámāŋ, ɔ̄cɛ í jé nɛ̄ ɔbá ɔmpa nɛ̄ ɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ɔmā gekwú á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɔ̄ ú playi ɔkpá kú akésiya nēé lɛ ugóolu ma plá anú, nēé kpó uwɔ playi anú ā. É le uwá kpó kwu ígbóoje-otáajɛ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́.

eng_Latn: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
idu_Latn: N gēe yɛ í lɛ ohi nōó lɛ ō tá um ā pó mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē tá ohi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.
idu_Latn: Ami ōfōōfū um wɛ Óndú ā á. Ohɔ́ɔnyɛtá dóódú í kē yɔ̄ gwū um tá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
idu_Latn: Uwá lɛ úklɔ́ kú eyī ō le kwu Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin nōo ī klá eyīpú nū mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o ī klá eyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ukɔ́tin kú ɔwɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū nōó hīīgwú ā, gaá le jīla ā. É gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū kú ojibó ā lɛ eyī pīya kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore Saul said unto the LORD God of Israel, Give a perfect lot. And Saul and Jonathan were taken: but the people escaped.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kū Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á tá um ohi ícɛ ŋ́ mā a? Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, lɛ ohi tá um ŋmá ɛcɔ̄ ō tīihɔ nyā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ami ámāŋ ka Ujonátan lɛ́pɔ̄bí á nɛɛ, lɛ ohi tá um bū Úrim, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ɔhá kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā lɛ́pɔ̄bí á nɛ̄ɛ, lɛ ohi tá um bū Utúmmim. Anɔ́ɔ ohi nɛ̄ Óndú ā tá ā, lɛ Ujonátan mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu kwú á. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi lé.

eng_Latn: It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,
idu_Latn: Ipú ójila kú alɔ, alɔ má ka ó cíkā ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ fu, lɛ uwá tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aá mɛ́mla Ubánābasi mɛ́mla Upɔ́lu, ācɛ nēe he alɔ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Now the LORD had told Samuel in his ear a day before Saul came, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú Usɔ́lu kóō wā ā, Óndú ā le mafú lɛ Usámūwɛ̄lu ka.

eng_Latn: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
idu_Latn: Āncɛnyā nēe bá nyā le uwá hīīgwú ga ɔnū ucɛ nēe gē gwɛ́ɛya klla í gbō aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ɛ̄gbā ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā bá ī lé ɔdōlé kú aɔ́wɔ kú Umówābu ā, klla bá ī gbā aɔ́wɔ ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá bla ka anyā ɔlɛ́ uwā ā jāhɔ̄ tá ɛlā kú Ubálam ajɛ kú Upéyɔ, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā á. Ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā bī ōcē obɔ̄bí wā í ŋmó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
idu_Latn: Ɛhɛ ō yɛ̄ wɛ íla oōlá. Abahi oōmá í yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.
idu_Latn: Ayí ɛpa nēé ma lɛ Ujósɛ̄fu Íjīpiti ā le pīyatɔ̄há mɛ́mla ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu nēe wā Íjīpiti ā, é wɛ ofɛtá cigwó.

eng_Latn: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si bī ita ɛ́gɛ́nyā alɛwa ɔhá, áluka nɛ̄ ācɛ pó í jɛ́yí nū glá ā le tɔ́ɔna kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
idu_Latn: Aígwɛ̄bɛ́ í gē jɛ̄ ajɛ nōó lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nwúné ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when we cried unto the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice, and looked on our affliction, and our labour, and our oppression:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aá le ikwū je klá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā kóō tá aá abɔ̄ á. Ka ɔ́ɔ le ikwū nɛ̄ aá je ā pó, klla le ōwē nɛ̄ aá bá í má abɔ́ɔ ā má.

eng_Latn: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered morter, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē ca ɔdɔ nēé lɛ áfū nɛ̄hɛ́ nyā ɔ́ ɔ́ɔmā, í je ɔ́ wúla tāajɛ, klla í je ɔ́ pahīla ka aɛ́cɔ̄ kú etikpa kú nū ká e gaá tɛ́ɛcɛ áncā. Ka ɔdɔ ā géē je wúla klá uwá, í je odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ācɛ dóódu le jé ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le pɛ́ tá ɔlɛ́ ā, ayíkpó ā da Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
idu_Latn: nááná, ó géē nyɔ̄ í tá aádáádā nū ɔlékwū, ɛga nɛ̄ obū yɔ̄ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: And he came by the Spirit into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law,
idu_Latn: Alelékwū lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Umerí mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ Ujísɔ̄si nōo wɛ ɔyí obene ā, bī wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kéē gaá lɛ uculo nɛ̄ íne ka kéē yá ā yá.

eng_Latn: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usébūlɔn ā wɛ, ācɛ úlā ofigwɛ́ɛhīlī cɛ̄hɔ̄ . Éwá jé ō bī ɛdɔ iyɛ́fú dóódu kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē yá aá italā bɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayí nū ohile ā ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā léka aá wɛ ayí abāābɔ̄yī nū ŋ́, amáŋ aá wɛ ayí obībá.

eng_Latn: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka igbīhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, ɔ́ɔ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá, é híī da īyī uwā ka, aá ɔ́ɔ mīyɛ ajɛ ā ohígbū ka aá cíkā lɛ ɔ́ɔ nɛɛ ŋ́. Ehée, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ nū ācɛ ā bɛ̄cɛ, ohígbū kéē wɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.
idu_Latn: Urúbɛn da uwá kahíníī, N da aá ka aá híī yá ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔdā dóódu ŋ́, amáŋ aá tá ō pó ɛlā kú um. Abālɔbányā, ulé kú oyī kú nū gā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, awɔ wɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nōo ī cɛ̄pɔ̄ ami nōo wɛ olɛkpɛ á. Awɔ kē gbō um ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
idu_Latn: Ujúda ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, nōo ī ŋmó ɛbɛ́ klla ī kwúcē gā ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú nū ā, nyɔ̄ ī nāŋdaa gwutá ajɛ mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́. Ɔ̄nyɛ bɔ́tū junwalu lɛ ɔ́ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aá nēe kwu ajaajɛ ā mɛ́mla aá nēe bá ligbó ā, aá gaá má ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā, ká aá kē cɛ̄ ka amíyɔ lɛ ɔfú.

eng_Latn: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before the LORD his God.
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́tam lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka ó yɛce Óndú ā. Ó bī ɔtū ékpónú lɛyí táajɛ kpaakpa lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū.

eng_Latn: Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú ā gā, ó géē bī odúúdú ɔfú nɛ̄ ebilíi je lɛ ɔ́ ā le yá ɛdɔ kú ɔdā idáagó ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ dóódu mɛ́mla ɔdōcābɔ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now therefore arise, go forth, and speak comfortably unto thy servants: for I swear by the LORD, if thou go not forth, there will not tarry one with thee this night: and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu klla da Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ cāŋjɛ ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā gaá lɛ ɛlā ogbɔtū ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, lɛ ahínyá tú uwā. Ó da ɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ nōó yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ka anúɔ gbo Ɔwɔicō ka otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cí, Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ gaá má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā yɔ̄ pī ɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ka ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ kē í bɔ̄bí lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ odúúdú unwalu nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ húmáyī lɛ ipú odúúdú oyēeyī kú nū ā á.

eng_Latn: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā kahíníī, Óndú ā, lɛ ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú uwɔ ā mafú bū Úrim mɛ́mla Utúmim, ŋmá ɛgiyí ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kpaakpa kú uwɔ, ayí kú Ulífāyi. A já uwā má Umása. A kē le má kéē wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ɛgiyí éŋkpɔ̄ kú Umɛ́rība ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Joshua, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And God said, Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed; and thou shalt call his name Isaac: and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehée! Ɔnyā uwɔ, Usára géē ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi gā uwɔ, nɛ̄ a géē hī iyē nū ka Áyísīki N géē gbo ɛka mɛ́mla anú mɛ́mla ayááyí nū nōo í yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
idu_Latn: Aá híī yá ucē kú ācɛ nɛ̄ n gē nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla aá nyā ŋ́. Ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nēé yá ā cɛ̄ le ɔtū kú uwā wá um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
idu_Latn: Ubánābasi le tá Utásɔsi gaá dɔɔ̄kā Usɔ́lu.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto the LORD thy God; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Aícɔ́ɔja kpó uwā wā ŋmá ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámālēki á. Aálá mɛ́mla aɛ́na nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nēé kpó wā kéē lɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ á. Amáŋ, alɔ le aɔ́dā ohile ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē le tútū kú ɛfú ō kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ci gwō ācɛ kú Umídīyan ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ayíkpó kú nū í jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōó ka ā ŋ́. É le abōkléyī yá uwā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jɛ́yí ɛlā ā ŋ́. Ufí í klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ɛlā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be, or that he heareth of me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n tíne ō gwō nááná, ń gáā wɛ olíla ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē ka á. Amáŋ ń gáā gwō ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń tíne ká ācɛ kéē je um gicō fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n wɛ ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n má ā ŋ́. É lɔfú je um gicō fíyɛ́ ohígbū ɔdā nēé má um yɔ̄ gē yá mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé pó ŋmá okónu kú um.

eng_Latn: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ojɔ́ɔdā ā le tútū eko dóódu kéē jé ɔdā nēé gē nwū ā.

eng_Latn: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
idu_Latn: amáŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā cāŋjɛ ŋmá ōcē ā igbīhājɛ, nɛ̄ó kwū ŋ́, nɛ̄ó gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ ɛcɛ, é gaá yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔ̄ odée ā ɔdā dúú ŋ́. Amáŋ ó géē gbā ulé kú eko nɛ̄ó kpó ɔ̄ anú bónū ā, ó kē í leyīkwu ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ōcē kú nū mɛ.

eng_Latn: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
idu_Latn: O yɛ mla ācɛ obɔ̄bí gē wú um ɔtū. N klla ī je ɔwɛ kú ācobɔ̄bí táajɛ.

eng_Latn: To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan unto God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ ā kóō le uwá eyī nwūla cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ uwá eyī pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí Ebilíi ga ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ o ŋmá lɛ o cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um, é géē je íne nēé bīya ā yá uwā ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛga éyi lɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
idu_Latn: Usádɔ̄ku, ɔyí kú Ahítūbu, mɛ́mla Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔyí kú Abíyāta wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya á. Useráya wɛ ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And I took my staff, even Beauty, and cut it asunder, that I might break my covenant which I had made with all the people.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú okwutɛ kú um, nɛ̄ n hī ka ɛhi ā ú, lɛ ɔ́ cē kóō mafú ka Óndú ā kwú ɛka nɛ̄ ó gbo lɛ odúúdú aéwo ā, ú bīya ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in, and told Pharaoh, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Let my people go, that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ yɛ tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā, anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, Mā ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá kéē nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ucɛ yá gā um ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ hɛ́tá ŋmá ínoōbīya nōo ī lɛ ɔ̄cɛ blínyī ipú ɛcɛ nyā ohígbū keé lɛ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si ohɔ́nyɛtá jé. Amáŋ ɔdāŋ́ keé kwúcē ga ɔwɛ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ kú uwā ā kpɔ́ nēe klla kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ucē kú ínoōbīya kpɔ́, oyēeyī kú igbīhāajɛ kú uwā géē bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ eko nēe je Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá jééjē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le tútū ɔkwɛ̄yi kóō nya ācɛ dóódu nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ā tá. Ó gē ma iyī nū fú klla ī nya alɔ tá ipú ajɛ kú alɔ.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Aá lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ kpó tū ipú ɛtɛ́ nēe bá ā. Anɔ́ɔ é le éŋkpɔ̄ kpó tū uwā kwu ɔkɔ kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́la, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ cɔcɛ́ Ɛ́dɔm. Iyē kú igelī nɛ̄hi nōó cɔcɛ́ ā lé ka Udinhába.

eng_Latn: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú ipú uwā nōo wɛ ulɔ́ya já Ujísɔ̄si má kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a jāhɔ̄ gā um, a géē jé ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa, mɛ́mla ɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi. A klla géē jé ɔdā nāa cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā nɛ̄ aá le ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nēe bá ā jé ā, ó géē lɔhi lɛ aá ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē bī uwā le yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ gē gbɛ̄gbā ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gē nya ɔ̄cɛ tá. Anú wɛ Óndú, nōo wɛ Óndú kú alɔ nōo gē hɛ́ alɔ tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ikwū á.

eng_Latn: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony, that they come up out of Jordan.
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya, nēé gē bī ikpati kú okónu ōce ā, kéē le bɛ̄cɛ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, Óndú ā ka, n géē tū ɔlá ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Utéman, cɛ́ɛ́, ó kwú igá olɔfú kú ɔkplɛ́fú kú nū nōo yɔ̄ Ubósira ā í yi tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
idu_Latn: Ebilíi ma ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ī bīyíne á, ohígbū ka ebilíi ā gbɔɔ́ ō bīyíne ŋmá ohútu kú ɛcɛ. Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nēé ma Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō wā á. O yá cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ úklɔ́ kú ebilíi bīya.

eng_Latn: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le iyī nū mafū ipú ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa nɛ̄ ó ka ā ɛɛ́. Ɔ́bíipú kú ācobɔ̄bíipū ā le uwá kwú bɛ̄ɛka ukpa ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujósuwa, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɛlíyēsa, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujorím, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umáthāti, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ulífāyi.

eng_Latn: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek God.
idu_Latn: Óndú pīyeyī má alɛɛcɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō, kóō má ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā yɔ̄ noō jééyī gā ɛjī nōo í tíne ō gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā glá.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē je gā um ká n̄ lɛ ibīyājɛ yá tū Ujísɔ̄si lɛ aá ā? Anɔ́ɔ é le ikpīje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofucigwó ka lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
idu_Latn: Alɔ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ aá kpɔ́, ayínɛ́, kú aá pi ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ kpó wú agada, nēe dɔɔ̄kā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā ahɔ̄. Aá tá ācoyúúfi ɔtū kwu ɔtū, aá tá ācɛ nēe cɛgbá ō tábɔ̄ ā abɔ̄. Aá gbēyīcíí mla ācɛ dóódu.

eng_Latn: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;
idu_Latn: Óndú, eko nāa géē ményinyi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, blakwu um dúú. Eko nāa géē nya uwá tá ā, tá um abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ i yɛ gaá le ɔyí ijakī ā mā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nōó da uwá lɛ ā yíílí.

eng_Latn: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo kē lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ā, géē na īlī kú nū klla í gwīiyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē í tēelihɔ jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ̄cɛ o pɛ́ úgbɔ́nya ā kɔ́ɔ̄ māháyi. Anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu mla udá kú Itiyópīya ā le hīlatá ga ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ Ufílīpu lɛ Ubatísim yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, a gbonɛnɛ lɛ alɔ. Lɛ úklɔ́ abɔ̄ kú alɔ bu tū lɛ alɔ, cɛ̄ ká alɔ jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate.
idu_Latn: A géē fúlá ɔ́ŋgbá ɛpa kú ugóolu ā playi aéliká ā.

eng_Latn: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
idu_Latn: Ó ŋmá ɔfú kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka ā, ó le uwá hɛ́tá ŋmá ōcē. Ó le uwá nyatá ŋmá ipú ikwū mɛ́mla ífi.

eng_Latn: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ lɛ otrɛ̄yí nɛ̄hi kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nōo le tá ɔkpáncō iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā, Ujísɔ̄si Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, alɔ lɛ abɔ̄ fúlá tū ɔtū nɛ̄ alɔ kpóce ɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ lɔfú lɔfú ā.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
idu_Latn: Ujosíya yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū. Ó yɛce ɔwɛ olɔhi dóódu kú aádáádā nū Udéfīdi ā. Ó klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne dóódu kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
idu_Latn: Ɛlíhu klla kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n blakwu agīje kú uwɔ̄ nɛ̄, eyī gē tū um nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú um lɛ uwɔ má, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō le he um.

eng_Latn: And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ nyatá ŋmá ɛ́kɛma kú nū dóódu á. Ó je íjééyī lɛ ɔ́, klla yá ká ɔtū nū kóō he Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti. Anɔ́ɔ Uféro lɛ ɔ́ yá igbómína kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
idu_Latn: Le da ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā nēe kpó áfū plla ɔdɔ ā ka ɔdɔ ā géē catāajɛ. Ɔwɔ nɛhi géē wúla, ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ yā í klá ɔ́, owu nɛ̄hi kē í tá klá anú.

eng_Latn: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ alɔ gē tíne ká ālɔ̄ pó ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ ɔdā nāa bī ɔtū ā, ohígbū ka alɔ jé ka ācɛ gē ka obɔ̄bí kú ɔ́wá nāa wɛ anú nyā ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
idu_Latn: Olíla gē yá ucē kú íla kú nū igbo ɔhá kpɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka ewō nōo le gba bá ajɛ klla gē je kpó lé ā.

eng_Latn: These are the things that ye shall do; Speak ye every man the truth to his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá ā yɔ̄ á. Aá kɛlā ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi lɛ iyī aá. Aá kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa únɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nōo géē bī ɛbɔ́ wā.

eng_Latn: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē tū aá mu mla ɔfú eko nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā wā gaá ce aá ɛyí. Aá kē í wɛ ijáalí kú um ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujudíya dóódu mɛ́mla Usamérīya klla jāā ga oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó tɛ́ɛgba ga ipú ɔtū kú uwā lipú ŋ́. É kē lɔtū eko kpií. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ unwalu gā ámāŋ nēé gbɔ́ɔ́ ō yá uwā ōwē ohígbū ɛlā ɔ́ɔmā a, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā é kwúcē igbīhi.

eng_Latn: Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā ka ipú ɔtū kú nū kahíníī, Ɔkpani um gáā nū ŋmá úklɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá ā? Ń kē lɔfú hɛ́hɔ̄ glá ŋ́. O nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō ba ɔdā ā í tū um uwēyī.

eng_Latn: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō yɔ̄ mla odúúdú aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú nū ā. Aá géē pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ga Ujerúsālɛm, kú aá gaá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túgwó. Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm nēé gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā, kóō yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwā kéē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ká ɔ́ɔ lɔhi klla le kpaakpa ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ í lɔhi lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ é í lɔfú mīyɛ ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ cokónu nū lɛ ádáádā uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
idu_Latn: É gáā je iyī uwā tēelihɔ mla aɛ́cī mɛ́mla aójibó otīīhilɛ mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí oyá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. N géē hɛ́ uwā tá ŋmá ipú odúúdú ɔwɛ nēé kwúcē hī um tá klla bī ɔ́bíipú ā. N géē yá uwá yēŋēē. É géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá.

eng_Latn: As soon as ye be come into the city, ye shall straightway find him, before he go up to the high place to eat: for the people will not eat until he come, because he doth bless the sacrifice; and afterwards they eat that be bidden. Now therefore get you up; for about this time ye shall find him.
idu_Latn: Ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ā klla da uwá ka obōōbū nɛ́ɛ le tá igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, ɛ́ɛ géē má ɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu gaá lé ucɛ kú ɛya nēé gwó ā. Ohígbū ka, ācɛ í gáā lé ucɛ kú ɛya nēé gwó ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ́ ga, gaá lɛ ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́. Igbīhi ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ nɔ́ɔ hīgwú wā ɔnū ucɛ kú ɛya ā géē gbɔɔ́ ō lé kllɔ́dɔ́ á. É da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ ga ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, ɛ́ɛ géē má ɔ̄ bōōbū.

eng_Latn: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ í je uwá tēelihɔ eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
idu_Latn: N tɔ́kpa nyā fu Utayitɔsi ɔyí um ɔkwɛyi ohígbū ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla anú cɛ̄ tɔ̄há āa. Ɔwɔicō ádā mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, nōo hɛ́ alɔ tá ā je ɛbɔ́, ɛhi nɛ̄hi ga awɔ.

eng_Latn: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí olɔhi dóódu gē gwá īkpō olɔhi, ɔcí obɔ̄bí dóódu kē ī gwá īkpō obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:
idu_Latn: Ébrahām yɔ̄ gē kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō lɔfú lɔfú kpɔ́ nááná nōó lɛbɛ̄ɛka iháyí ofɛ̄hɔ̄, nōó kōō le jé ka ɔkpíyē kú anúɔ í je ɔnyā ipú glá gɛ ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ Usára í kē gáā ma ɔyí glá gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáncō géē cījáalí tū ɔ̄ kóō lɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú yá. Ɛcɛ kē í cījáalí tū ɔ̄ lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Then the king said unto me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā tá um ohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ā cɛgbá āa? Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō á.

eng_Latn: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔkpá kú ɔ̄cɛ o lúgwū nyā í wɛ ɔdā dúú ŋ́ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tɔ́kpá ā yēeyī ā. Amáŋ ɔkpá ī gbɔɔ́ ō tīile eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tá ɔ̄ ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; let thy glory be above all the earth.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a nwuné lɛ ā mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú uwɔ mafú ɔkpáncō, ká ā lɛ ɛgahi kú uwɔ mafú lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And the fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth: and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ ā lɛ opo kú nū tá. N má ínyílɔ́ɔwɔ éyi nōo míya ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ipú ɛcɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔyíigodo kú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōó lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́ mā í lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: O Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee, and no secret troubleth thee, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and the interpretation thereof.
idu_Latn: Kóocōō, Ubɛtessása, otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyímabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācojɔ́dā dóódu, ohígbū ka n jé ka alelékwū kú aɔ́wɔ otīihɔ ā yɔ̄ mla uwɔ á. Ɔdā dúúmā ī tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí íjééyī kú uwɔ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ ɔ̄na nɛ̄ n nā á. Lɛ ɛyí nū ka gā um.

eng_Latn: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ otɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le yɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ dóódu ga ɔhá. O ŋmá Ɛ́frem, mɛ́mla Umanásɛ, jāā ga Usébulɔn, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē cɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda. Amáŋ é bá ī yɛhɛ tū uwā klla bá ī yá uwā ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ mla anú. Ācɛ alɛwa yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ mla Ujísɔ̄si. É le pɛ́ klá anú ŋmá ɔkíkā dóódu.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
idu_Latn: ó géē kpó abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɔ́ ɛyí, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó okómpīinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē mī oyī kú nū klá ɔ́kíka ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ plla ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā tū ipú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi ō bī nōo kōō fíyɛ́ ákú aéwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā hīla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdí yɔ̄ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ó da um ka ómbilí nɛ. Ó kē kwɛyí ínoōbīya kú odúúdú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
idu_Latn: A kwú um ú tá ga ipú únóji, ga ɛga odobū nɛ̄hi mla ɔkɛkɛlɛ kú únóji ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
idu_Latn: Blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a nwū ācɛ alɛwa lɛ, klla lɛ ɔfú tū ācɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ le gbobú lɛ uwá iyē klla je uwá abɔ̄ gicō lɛ ā āā.

eng_Latn: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ɛga o ligbó ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó má Ujísɔ̄si á, anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu wā í le okwúukwu kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
idu_Latn: Éba, Upélegi, Uríyu.

eng_Latn: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urécɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ gā um ɛɛ́. Ó le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gba ā pó, le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ je gā um. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó hī iyē kú nū ka Udáni.

eng_Latn: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ̄cɛhɔ̄ kú Óndú ā í cíkā o yíkpɛ́lā ŋ́. Ó cíkā ō gbonɛnɛ lɛ odúúdú ācɛ. Ó cíkā ō wɛ itíca olɔhi nōo í lɛ lɔtulé glá.

eng_Latn: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
idu_Latn: Igbeéyi ámāŋ ka igbɛɛpa ācɛ o tá ɔ́sú nēe gē je ɛdɔ iyó dóódu lá ā, le gbo iyɛ̄cɛ kú igá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ajúmā gbéeko nɛ̄ Usábāti mɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nōó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá okómpīinu ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ā, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā ɔhá le ɔ́ má, klla da ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ ā yɔ̄ pī Ujísɔ̄si kú Unásārēti dúú.

eng_Latn: The posts of the temple were squared, and the face of the sanctuary; the appearance of the one as the appearance of the other.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cí kú okónɔɔwɛ kú ɛga otīihɔ ā lɛ ɔ́gɔgɔ́ ɛnɛ nēe jōnjīlɛ̄. Iyɔ̄bū okómpinu kú ɛga otīihɔ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, odée yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka n géē je ɔda ohɔ́nɔ lɛ uwá lé. N klla gē je éŋkpɔ̄ ōŋmɔ́cɛ lɛ uwá gwá. N géē yá uwá lɛ ā ohígbū ka, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā yá nɛ̄ ācɛ bá ī yá ucē ɔ́bíipú ā ɛbɛɛbɛ ipú ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.
idu_Latn: É gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm ɔwɛ ékpónú nēé gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ ɔhá nēe wɛ íkpékwūja nɛ̄ ācɛ bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá ā.

eng_Latn: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
idu_Latn: Ācɛ bá ī pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá igelī éyi ga ɔhá, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɛwa nɛ̄hi le jīla ā, Ujísɔ̄si le ācīije nyā tá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gē cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, ɔyí ā le tá ɛhɔ̄ mla ádā nū ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī éyi gaá cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side: and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ um bī ga inu nōo kwu okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ó lɛ Okónpinu ā mīya. Olipú kú nū wɛ umíta ɛpa ce āyā. Ɔwá kú nū wɛ umíta ahāapa. Ocɔkpɛ́nú kú ɔdɔ kú nū ā wɛ umíta éyi ce āyā, abɔ̄ kú nū dóódu.

eng_Latn: The LORD forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the LORD's anointed: but, I pray thee, take thou now the spear that is at his bolster, and the cruse of water, and let us go.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi ka Ɔwɔicō kóō ŋmɔ́wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú anúɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kú anúɔ kwu ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le fu kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Abíssāyi ka áa kóō kwú óbō mla ɔjá kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū ú kpó kú aá nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ kú Ámɔn le ujɔ̄ tū, tū ɔ́ kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó tá ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest's office unto the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ̄ɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ajɛ nɛ̄ aálá kú uwā ī má ácí lé glá ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ wā Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm á, ohígbū ka Ujérobōwam mɛ́mla ayí nū le uwá kpó nū ŋmá úklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
idu_Latn: N géē je ajɛ kú aá yíífi dúúdú nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā nōo gáā lā anú ā géē hídáagó ohígbū ɛdɔ ífi nēé í má ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after three days, that the officers went through the host;
idu_Latn: É bá abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɛtá. Oŋmɛ́yí kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá ā, aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā bá í yɛ ipú ɔlɛ́ ā bilíbilí.

eng_Latn: Egypt riseth up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he saith, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
idu_Latn: Íjīpiti yɔ̄ ī cāŋjɛ í wā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka ísu kú Unáyilu á, bɛ̄ɛka ísu nōo kwú cēenyi klá ɛcɛ ā. Íjīpiti ka, anúɔ ɔɔ́ géē cāŋjɛ gaá klá odúúdú ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka éŋ́kpɔ̄ nōo ī cēenyi ā. N géē kpó aígelī mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lā ipú uwā ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔ́ɔ gáā je lɛ uwá ā, ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī yá ucē ɛbí nɛ̄ ācɛ kú aéwɔhá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā gē yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́nɛ́ ágábá, nōo lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā. Ó lā ipú aɔ́bá ágábá lɛ ayí nū bī jɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, eyī kú nū kwú pīya ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí, úwé kú nū kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ gbɔɔ́ ō ceyī ŋmaáŋmaá.

eng_Latn: And he left all that he had in Joseph's hand; and he knew not ought he had, save the bread which he did eat. And Joseph was a goodly person, and well favoured.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́tīfa kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōó lɛ ā ú kpó tū Ujósɛ̄fu abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā dúúmā í wɛ ɛlā nū gɛ ŋ́, ń táafú ɔdōlé ōfōōfūnū. Ujósɛ̄fu jōklóbīya klla héyīfuú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó tá iyī nū wā ajɛ ŋ́, é gáā lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ ŋ́. Ācɛ o yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ bá ī yɛ ɔwɛ nōo í bī uwā ga ífi.

eng_Latn: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
idu_Latn: Ádā dúúmā nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yí klla ī yá ucē okpaakpa, ɔtū géē he ayí nū nēe ī wā igbīhi nū ā.

eng_Latn: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú ɔ́bíipú nyā ā í ka iŋini tū um gaá kwu ā? N le iŋini nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ge ka tú um ā pó ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
idu_Latn: Wā ɛgiyí um ká ā lɛ um nyatá lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ ká aólɛlā kú um.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da odúúdú uwā kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gbō iyī aá ŋmá ɛdɔ kú únwū ɔdā ō yá dóódu. Ohígbū kéē gē miya oyēēyī ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá agbénú nōó lɛ ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́ dúú nōó lɛ agbénú lɛ nááná.

eng_Latn: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of the LORD. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn le úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yá kwɛyí ā, odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā nū Udéfīdi kpó le Óndú ā, kwu oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔdɔ, oje udɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́dɔ̄há ohile kpɛ́ɛ́m ā, Usólōmɔn kwú uwā ú kpó tū ɛga o kpó ɔdā tū kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
idu_Latn: Ɛgbá kú odée gē ce ayí kú ágábá. ɛmiyɛ klla ī ŋmó uwā dúú, amáŋ ācɛ nēe gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, ɔdā olɔhi dóódu í gē ŋá uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi éyi le Ujísɔ̄si hīgwú kóō wā í lɛ ɔdōlé lé mla anú. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nū gáā cīce kóō lé ɔdōlé á.

eng_Latn: And this shall be the priest's due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko dúú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛna ámāŋ álá kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́ɛ géē kpó ácábɔ̄, agba mɛ́mla ubu kú nū lɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: Only acknowledge thine iniquity, that thou hast transgressed against the LORD thy God, and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree, and ye have not obeyed my voice, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄ ofōōfūnū ka aá le ɛpɔ̄bí lé. Ka aá klla lɛ īkpɛ̄yí olɔfu yá tá ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā. Aá le okónu cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ka aá bá ī gbā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá ɛ̄gbā ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu. Ka aá ɔ́ɔ klla lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all men which are here present with us, ye see this man, about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me, both at Jerusalem, and also here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.
idu_Latn: Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si kahíníī, Ágirīpa, Ɔcɛ́, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá amānyā mla alɔ ā, aá má ɔ̄cɛ ā, anú nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá amānyā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá Ujerúsālɛm gē dɔɔ̄kā ikwū kú nū á.

eng_Latn: From men which are thy hand, O LORD, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé tíne ipú oyēeyī nyā ā. Lɛ italā nāa tútū gbēyī uwā ā yá uwā cabá cabá, kóō le hile nōo í jɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā.

eng_Latn: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú nū ī cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā, ó lɛ ukata kú ɔcɛ́ alɛwa kwɛyí. Ó lɛ iyē éyi nēe tá tū ɔ̄ iyē nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í jé ɛyí nū ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ anú abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni da uwá kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔdōplayi ahɔ̄ kú ugóolu kú anyā aá, mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā kú aá kpó plla wā.

eng_Latn: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī plla ɔ́mpa nū ga ɔdōbɔ̄bí, nōo gē ka anúɔ gē hija nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and, behold, it was a dream.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛyí kú igwu nōo wɛ igbóngbō ā kwú ɛyí kú igwu o cɛyí nɛ̄hi ā í kpó mlɛ ŋmá ajɛ á. Uféro le héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā anɔ́ɔ ó le jé ka ɔ̄na nɛ̄ anúɔ hímáyī nā á.

eng_Latn: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ɛna kú uwɔ hɛ́ ɔkɔ okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú éŋkpɔ̄ dóódu. Kwú ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́na í klla gáā yɔ̄ ɛɛ́, nēe gē je éŋkpɔ̄ ā bū igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And then he built chambers against all the house, five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ inīīcō gwó kwu áklō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā dúúdú. Olicō kú uwá wɛ ikpó ɛpa. Ó bī ɔcí nēé hī usɛ́da ā le fula inu ā kwɔhá.

eng_Latn: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
idu_Latn: N gaá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā obɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. Ācɛ nēé lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, ī wú um ɔtū. Ń gaá lé tɔ̄há mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, ó yɔ̄ ī wā ipú ojuja! Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ géē má ɔ̄, kwu ācɛ nēe gwū ɔ̄ odée ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā géē jikwū nū. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó gáā wɛ á. Aamí.

eng_Latn: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔkɔ nɛ̄ Ulɛ́ya gbā ā pó á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ klla le ɔyí ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́mɛɛhɔ̄ ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu á.

eng_Latn: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā je íne ā kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē je ukpɛ̄ kú ɛya ɔ́ɔmā lɛ uwā, ɛ̄cī nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí ā. Ɛ̄nyā géē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwá gbóóbgóō nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gé je lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have taken no bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī ka mɛ́mla īyī uwā kahíníī, Ó ka ɛ̄nyā abɔ̄ alɔ í bī igbō ŋ́ mā nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
idu_Latn: N tá Óndú ahínyá ohígbū ucē okpaakpa kú nū. N géē gwíijē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Óndú, Ɔwɔicō nōo fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā, aá cɛ̄tra anú. Aínyílɔ́wɔ nēe gē fíyajɛ ā, aá cɛ̄tra anú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
idu_Latn: Odūngwɔ̄wɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ géē nwūla tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kú aéwo ā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā kéē kpó agbénú kú uwá gé lɛ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā, ācɛ kú éwo dóódu géē wā í gbā um ɛ̄gbā Ujerúsālɛm amānyā.

eng_Latn: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um gē tíne kéē kwú um ú ŋmó. É le ɛlā um tóokónu gē ka eko dóódu, anɔ́ɔ é bá gē tūujɔ̄ obɔ̄bí tū um á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Bethaven, on the east side of Bethel, and spake unto them, saying, Go up and view the country. And the men went up and viewed Ai.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋmá Ujérīko ga Ái, nōo kwu Ubɛtáfɛ́n ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ubɛ́tɛlu ajaajɛ ā, kahíníi, Aá nyɔ̄ kú aá lɛ ajɛ ā jila tayínū. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le yɛ gaá le ajɛ ā jila wɛɛlɛ.

eng_Latn: And they came unto the children of Reuben, and to the children of Gad, and to the half tribe of Manasseh, unto the land of Gilead, and they spake with them, saying,
idu_Latn: É le táajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá gāajɛ ipú ācɛ nēe yɛce uwá ā gaá kwú ācobɔ̄bíipú a ú kpó yi.

eng_Latn: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ubásilutu mɛ́mla Uméhīda mɛ́mla Uhássa.

eng_Latn: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē fu ācɛ nɛ̄ é jé ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, nēe klla ī plla ācɛ ā ga ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí ā, pīya ɔcɛ́ kéē gbō aéwo.

eng_Latn: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ aá kōō lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛ̄nyā jé ā, n tíne ō tū aá ɛlā kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú nyā ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā, amáŋ igbīhāajɛ ā Ɔwɔicō lɛ ācɛ nēé kpɔ́tūce ŋ́ mā kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And Abraham drew near, and said, Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām túblā Óndú ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, A géē je ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú ā yíífi tɔ̄há nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē kpó ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ŋmó ipú úláyi kú nū. É kē géē kpó odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū yíífi ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nōo yɛ jīla Utápūwa tá ā wɛ ákú Umanásɛ, amáŋ ɔlɛ́ kú Utápūwa nōo yɔ̄ ɛjī ā wɛ ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem.

eng_Latn: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
idu_Latn: N géē da uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā italā, mɛ́mla ulé nōó gē cílá ācɛ nēe ī lɔnɔɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā aá gbonɛnɛ kú aá klla ményinyi iyī aá. Aá je obɔ̄bí yá iyī aá ɛhi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je obɔ̄bí kú aá yá aá ɛhi ipú opīyatɔha kú aá mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: And I will cast thee out, and thy mother that bare thee, into another country, where ye were not born; and there shall ye die.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó awɔ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ ga ajɛ éwɔhá ɛga nēé ma odúúmā kú aá ŋ́ mā. Aá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa kē í kwú abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And when they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, and cast out the wheat into the sea.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ā le ɔdōlé lé lɛ je uwā ā, é le ohile kú nū ā kpó pīya tá ipú ísu.

eng_Latn: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
idu_Latn: odúúdú uwá ba ī ka ɔnɔ ɔtu tū ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn a kahíníī, Á i kwú v bɛ̄ɛka éyi kú alɔ a ɛɛ́, á kwú pīya éyi kú alɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye eat the fat, and ye clothe you with the wool, ye kill them that are fed: but ye feed not the flock.
idu_Latn: Aá gē gwá enyi amɛ̄ álá, ī yá īlī ŋmá ɔnwū kú uwā le wu iyē, klla í ŋmó aálá nēe jɔ̄kwū fíyɛ́ dúú ā lé. Amáŋ aá gē leyīkwu aálá a ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
