idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ ipú inu ā mīyɛ aá, ɛbɔ́ kú aá géē yɔ̄ lɛ uwá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ keé wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ŋ́, ɛbɔ́ kú aá géē kwúcē igbīhi gé lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshean,
idu_Latn: Árābu, Udúma, Ɛ́ssan.

eng_Latn: For they have taken of their daughters for themselves, and for their sons: so that the holy seed have mingled themselves with the people of those lands: yea, the hand of the princes and rulers hath been chief in this trespass.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu bā í lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá éwɔhá, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā le ucē elihɔ yá ɛɛ́. Aótrɛ̄yí mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā, yá ucē nyā fíyɛ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD's house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú um ú ga ɔwɛ kú ɛhícō kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi a, anɔ́ɔ n má ācɛnyā bá ī jikwū kú ikwū kú ɛcí, nɛ̄ hī ka Utamúsu ā.

eng_Latn: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Bethjeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdothpisgah:
idu_Latn: É mīyɛ Arába ga ísu kú cínɛ̄rɔtu lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísu kú ɔmā ā. Ó klla yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛháajɛ ga ɔkwu kú ɛfu kú Upísiga.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the LORD charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne mɛ́mla ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bū abɔ̄ kú Umósīsi ā, ó géē lɔhi ga awɔ. Lɛ ɔfú tīiyē, ká ā lɔtūlɛ. Ā yúúfi ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē gbenyi gā awɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā cɛ̄ ɛlā kú uwá nyā, le uwá jámá ɛ̄cī igwó á.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɔdā nōo yá nyā, Ábsālɔm lɛ úgbɔ́ɔnya nɛ̄ aɔ́nya gē pi lā. Ó klla lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ ofɛpa cigwó nēe gē bá ī kwínya tū iyɔ̄bū úgbɔ́ɔnya kú nú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā bī ɛlā ōtɔ́tūlé le ohi tá Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄wɔ gā um ā á.

eng_Latn: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī le gla yɛɛ ā, Ujísɔ̄si kwúcē ga Ukapánɔm kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ le pó ka ó yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
idu_Latn: Ojuju ō yá lɔɔlɔhi dilii ā, gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi. Ágágā ō hɛ́, í gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ odée ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē dɔɔ̄kā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
idu_Latn: Ítēbulu nyā kē lɛ oje oplákátá ōce ɛyí nū. Oje oplátáká ā klla wu ɛplá oje nēé yá ikpó kú nū ɛnɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
idu_Latn: Aá le jīla ka aá yá ojuju, aéwo nēé lɛ uwēyī īkpɛ̄yí ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ í má um bɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā gɛ ŋ́, n lɛbɛ̄ɛka inyílɔ́ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ń wɛ ɔdā dúú ɛɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ācɛ í je um ka n wɛ ɔdā dúú ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é bá ī leyī gwō um bónū á.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā yá uwā lé. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē bá í nuunu tá aólɛlā kú uwá ŋmá ɛga éyi, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ géē kwinya ŋmá iyɔ̄bū aólɛlā ā ga ābɔ̄ dóódu ahāapa. Ó ka odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā ɛ́ɛ í yúúfi nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ yɔ̄ ī yá uwā ā má ā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Utáhati gaá lā Utɛ́ra.

eng_Latn: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔlɛ́ ā géē nyɔ̄ í ka lɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya lɛyíkwu ɔda nōó má ipú inu ɔlɛ́ nū ā.

eng_Latn: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya klla le ɔkpá tá wā í cá Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛcá gē kahíníī, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔwɔ kú aéwo ɔhá ī nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú um glá ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú Uhɛsɛkíya í gáā nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú um glá ŋ́ dúú á.

eng_Latn: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
idu_Latn: Éeyē mɛ ŋmá ipú oyēeyī kú alɔ ɛɛ́. Ɔtūnōbí mīyɛ ɔkwu kú ijē nɛ̄ alɔ ī gwó ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɛdɔ kú okónu o hɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ā le hokónu tū iyī aá.

eng_Latn: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē le gbla ipɔ́ɔma nyā āa? Ó gbla ayípɛ̄ nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe báajɛ ɔ́ɔpu ā. É gē hī aɔ́mpa uwā igwú kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́mahāapa ā lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ocíbú kú nū ā cē tū ipú owu. Anɔ́ɔ ɔkɔ éyi dɛ̄gba nɛ̄hi ŋmá akpa ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yɔ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Ó le yá mɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi nōo ī yá ucē okpaakpa ā, gē habɔ̄ ɔdúgwū tá lɛ ayí nū mɛ́mla ayááyí nū, amáŋ agbénú kú ɔ̄cɛ obīyíne dóódu, í ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: So also made he for the door of the temple posts of olive tree, a fourth part of the wall.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí kú ólīifu nēé bī le gbā ɔwɛ le ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú inu ɛga otīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā á.

eng_Latn: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔwɔ ɔhá dúú í lɛ bɛ̄ɛka Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā gɛ ŋ́. Anú, nōó yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú ɛgahi kú nū ɔkpáncō, nōó yɔ̄ ī bū ipú ojuja wā í tá aá abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting: neither were instruments of musick brought before him: and his sleep went from him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā le tá agbla kú nū, le okónu gwū ohígbū Udánīyɛlu á. É kpó ɛdɔ ijā dúúmā nyɔ̄ í he lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, ó kē gbiyɔ̄lā ŋ́ otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kɛlā lɛ owu. Lɛ ka lɛ owu ka, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ɔ́da je gā uwɔ ka ā wā ŋmá ɛga dóódu, gáā fu tū ipú aókwū nēe bá nyā kā a lɛ uwá kpó héyī ká ē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Yea, thou shalt go forth from him, and thine hands upon thine head: for the LORD hath rejected thy confidences, and thou shalt not prosper in them.
idu_Latn: Aá géē kwúcē ŋmá abɔ́ɔ lɛyí playi ajɛ ipú uwēyī, ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tá ācɛ nɛ̄ aá kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́. Aá kē gáā lɛ ile dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So he came to the king. And the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go against Ramothgilead to battle, or shall we forbear? And he answered him, Go, and prosper: for the LORD shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó gā iyɔ̄bū Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā, Áhābu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Umikáya, ami mɛ́mla Ujɛhóssāfāti, ɔcɛ́ ā, ká alɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá Urámɔtu kú ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di kɛ̄ɛ ka ālɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ŋ́? Anɔ́ɔ Umikáya tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, aá géē yá uwā lé gbóó.

eng_Latn: Every raven after his kind;
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ɔtágláma dóódu.

eng_Latn: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú Ubílha ú lɛ ɔbá nū, anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le gbo mla anú á.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, saith the LORD, him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.
idu_Latn: N géē je ācɛ kú Umówābu nēe ī gwɛ́ɛya, aíkpɛ́cí lɛ aɛ́cí kú uwá ā kpó yíífi. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka á.

eng_Latn: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ má, amáŋ é jé ɔ̄ éjúuma ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
idu_Latn: Unwalu nōó je lɛ ācɛ ɔhá piíí ā gē kwúcē wā í yá ɔ̄. Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó yá ācɛ ɔhá ɔdā olɔnɔ abɔ̄fú ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā yá anú abɔ̄yīnū á.

eng_Latn: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Israel,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn kpó le yúklɔ́ abɔ̄fú ā wɛ ācɛ kú ajɛ kú Ukénan abɔ̄yī uwā, nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í je kpó ŋmó eko nēé mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel arose, and went up to the house of God, and asked counsel of God, and said, Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin? And the LORD said, Judah shall go up first.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le tá Ubɛ́tɛlu ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ ī gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō ka ipɔ́ɔma nyá géē cíkā ō kpɛ́fú tá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn aflɛ́yí āa?.

eng_Latn: Therefore the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah from the LORD, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da Ujeremíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔtū ka anúɔ í yá olɔhi mɛ́mla ucē okpaakpa géē yēeyī. Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ nōo ka anúɔ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā, géē mīyɛ ulé nū.

eng_Latn: And the damsel's father shall say unto the elders, I gave my daughter unto this man to wife, and he hateth her;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ádā ɔnyā ā ɔ́ɔ géē ka ka anúɔ je ɔyí anúɔ ā lɛ ɔbá ā á, amáŋ abālɔbányā, ɔ́ɔ dɔɔ̄kā ka ɔyí anúɔ ā kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; David shall never want a man to sit upon the throne of the house of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi géē ce ɔcɛ́ Ísrɛ̄lu piyóó.

eng_Latn: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ kɛlā lɛ anúɔ ka.

eng_Latn: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n mɛ́mla Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ, lɛ ajɛ kú uwā lɛ, klla lɛ ɔ́ kɔ̄ lɛ iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell among them.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ ga ágēnégēne kú ɛfu ā, le aálagbá kú ɛfú alɛwa kpó nyɔ̄ mla iyī nū. Ó mīyɛ aɔ́dā ɛhi ŋmá abɔ̄ ācɛ nēe bɛ́yí kwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó klla le da ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm kéē lɛ ɛhi kú uwá nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā kpó wā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē má ɛga, lɛ ɔtú tá úklɔ́ kú uwā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ bī ukɔ́ nɛ̄ n tū uwɔ ā lɔfú lɔfú kóō wɛ ocābɔ̄ kú ɔna kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nāa géē tá kpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔdā okpaakpa nāa géē nwū ācɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā yɔ̄ ipú ɔtōoce ā mɛ́mla ihɔtū nēe wɛ ákú alɔ ipú opiyatɔha mɛ́mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
idu_Latn: Ujɔ́ktan kwú pīya ádā kú Alumódādi mɛ́mla Ussélēf mɛ́mla Uhasamāfɛ́ti mɛ́mla Ujɛ́ra mɛ́mla.

eng_Latn: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which the LORD commanded.
idu_Latn: Anú klla je ɔ́da lɛ ɔ́ kóō híī gbā ɔwɔ amáŋ ɛcí kú aéwɔhá dúúmā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́ má. Usólōmɔn í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ka ā ŋ́, amáŋ ó kwú ɔtū kú nū ú pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
idu_Latn: Ɔnū ō cɛ̄ ká ɔcɛ́ lɛbɛ̄ɛka oji nɛ̄ ágábá gē tū ā nɛ̄ n. Eyī olɔhi kú ɔcɛ́ ō pīya kwu ɔ̄cɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Which say, It is not near; let us build houses: this city is the caldron, and we be the flesh.
idu_Latn: É gē ka ka, Alɔ klla í gbɔɔ́ ō gwó ɔlɛ́ igbɔhá ānāānā. Igelī nyā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ̄hī nɛ̄ é le ce ɔlá ā, alɔ kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛbɛ́ nēé kpó tū ɔ̄. Amáŋ nááná ó kē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔlá ā fu alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the uncircumcised man child whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken my covenant.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔnyīlɔ dóódu nēé hɛ́ ɔ̄ apī ŋ́, é gaá je ɔ́ ka ó wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋ́, ohígbū koó lɛ ɛka kú um ā tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi. Ɛwa kú ācɛ kú uwā nēe wɛ aícɔ́ɔ́ja glá ā wɛ úlā ofɛpa cɛtá .

eng_Latn: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ n gē kwinya kpaakpa ga ɛga o ŋmɛyí kú ɔgbɔ inya āá. Ɔ́ɔmā kē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cotákwū nōo gē lɛ akwū tū ɔ̄cɛ eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n tákwū á.

eng_Latn: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin, nēé hí tū odúúdú ajɛ nōo fíyɛ́ úlá igwó ā í gáā gwá ikpo ufáyin nēé gē yá ejé kú nū, mu ɔjá ɛtá ŋ́. Okoolo kú ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ofu ahāanɛ nēé nyi ā, í gáā gwá īkpō nēé gē ce ga okoolo igwáahātá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē híī cījáalí ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ tū ɔ́mpā uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
idu_Latn: N gbɛlá ka a lɛ um nū, klá lɛ um gwū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, ka ń gáā má Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā ɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uhɔ́bābu tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ń gáā nyɔ̄ mla aá ŋ́, n géē ga ɔlɛ́ um, mɛ́mla ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um.

eng_Latn: Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
idu_Latn: Kócōō, Ɔwɔicō, ā lɛ okónu klá gɛ ŋ́, ā klla yɔ̄ cíí gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka alɔ lɔtūkpóce ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nyā ā, alɔ lɔtū ī kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta mɛ́mla Ujɔ́ni tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ó cíkā iyɔ̄bū kú Ɔwɔicō ká ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aá ikɔkɔ ōlɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, aá géē hɛ́pɔ̄ nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu le ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ, anú wɛ ede kú aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu gwó á.

eng_Latn: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwá pīya ɔdā ufi mɛ́mla ɔdā ihilɛ ipú eyī kú odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔyí kú Uhesekáya ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Umanásɛ yá Ujerúsālɛm eko nōó wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: And Abram went up out of Egypt, he, and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the south.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébram mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū mɛ́mla Ulɔ́tu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā, le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, le pɛ́ ga Unégēbu á.

eng_Latn: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings, and the wheels beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́bɛ́ ɛnɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō wu nyɔ̄ mla aákā kú uwá ā. Ofíyáajɛ kú ɛgahi nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā klá uwá.

eng_Latn: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
idu_Latn: Kwú íne nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ bīya ā í yá uwā ɛhi Óndú, n géē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ ohígbū ihɔtū kú uwɔ nɛ̄ó ī pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē méyīnyinyi uwā klla je ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwā yá uwā ɛhi ŋmífī nēé ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will perform this.
idu_Latn: Oōnyīla kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ mla igɛ́mɛ́nti kú nū gē wɛ ɛbɔ́, ó gāa lɛ ooŋmɛ́yí ŋ́. Ó kē í ce úgāda ɔcɛ́ kú ádā nū, Udɛ́fīdi. Ó gē lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū kwu ajɛ klá í bī ɔ̄ yēŋēē mla ookpaakpa, ŋmá eko nya jāa gbéeko dóódu. Ɔfú kú Óndú a, ɔcɛ́ kú ɛfú ā gáā yá ɛ̄nyā á.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:
idu_Latn: É tá ohi ka, aá yá glá. Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aá géē má ōwē nɛ̄ n géē má piíí ā ɔkwɛ̄yi, aá kē í kwú ɛdɔ ikwū nɛ̄ n géē kwú piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto them, But now, he that hath a purse, let him take it, and likewise his scrip: and he that hath no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Amáŋ abālɔbányā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ alítā ámāŋ ka ɛkpa kóō kwú ɔ̄ piíí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōó lɛ okpacaŋgelī ŋ́ kóō kwu úwé kú nū ú kpó lá kóō lɛ éyi lá piíí.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the LORD, and the king's house, and all Solomon's desire which he was pleased to do,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla agbla kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu ɔhá nōó tíne ō gwó ā gwó mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it was far from me.
idu_Latn: N bī íjééyī kú um lɛ odúúdú nū jámá ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ n le abɔ̄ gbɔtū ka n géē jéeyī. Amáŋ ɔ́ɔmā le ligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le italā yá ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bí nōo ī gɔ̄ ka anúɔ jɔ́ɔdā nɛ̄hi ā, olíla nááná ā gē kllɔ̄cɛ́ ŋmá italā ɔ́ɔmā dúú. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī gē jé odée ŋmá ɔdā nēé nwū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But rather give alms of such things as ye have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá je ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú ikókwū mɛ́mla ocíbú ā yá ācogbɛhá ɛhi, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu kú aá le kpó yá yēŋēe lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
idu_Latn: Ó ka amáŋ, kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā piíí, klla í lɛ odúúdú aíne kú nū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú íne ā tū. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ cíkā ō cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the king put Benaiah the son of Jehoiada in his room over the host: and Zadok the priest did the king put in the room of Abiathar.
idu_Latn: Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, kwú Ubenáya ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kwɛyí Ujówābu, anɔ́ɔ ó klla kwú Usádɔ̄ku ú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kwɛyí Abíyāta, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā á.

eng_Latn: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
idu_Latn: É géē pīya īlī nɛ̄hɛ́, ɔkpɛ́ɛwu mɛ́mla īlī odufā ā klá anú, kwú ogbló ō lɛ bī ikpati ā ú wu áklō kú nū.

eng_Latn: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlā ka gā uwɔ, n géē je uwɔ okónu nwūla, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā da uwá ɛlā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka ā. Ācɛ ōhī kú ipú uwā géē pó, ācɛ ōhī í kē gáā pó ŋ́, ohígbū ka é wɛ ācɛ oyíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú.

eng_Latn: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
idu_Latn: Ā tá um tonú eko ókplícī kú um nyā gɛ ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nāa gē mabɔ̄ um tá eko nyā nɛ̄ ń lɔfú gɛ ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ aéwo alɛwa géē bá ī ka kahíníī, Aá wā kú ālɔ̄ ga ɛfu kú Ɔwɔicō, kú ālɔ̄ ga Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā. Ó géē nwū alɔ ɔdá nōó tíne kú alɔ yɔ̄ ī yá ā. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ohígbū ka ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō géē wā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā géē gwó ɔlɛ́ uwa ígwíígwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔfú kú uwā jɛ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The word that the LORD spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn wā í kpɛ́fú tú Íjīpiti ā, Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ Ujeremíya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Ahíja ka Óndú ā géē cīgbīhi kwu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, Ohígbū ka Ujérobōwam le íne kú nū bīya klla le ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū íne nōó bīya ā.

eng_Latn: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
idu_Latn: Ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá nyā tá kéē lɛyítáajɛ ga um. É húmáyī yá ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú gē yá ɔdā ɔtūuwā piyóó, É klla nyɔ̄ í bá ī pā aɛ́cí ɔhá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é géē je uwá gbliífi bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īlī ōyɔ́ɔgɔndu nyā je bīya, í lɔhi ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɛ géē kpɛ́lāce um glá ā? Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yá nɛ̄ ɛpɔ̄ lɛ um kwú glá, n géē klá okónu kú um, kú n̄ gekwú cíí.

eng_Latn: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Urútu le yɛ tá ɛhɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō yɛ igbīhi kú ācoyúklɔ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā, yɔ̄ ī yā ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo hɛ́ uwā abɔ̄ wā ajɛ eko nēé bá ī cē ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā. Ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Urútu nyɔ̄ ā klla kwú pīya ɛhɔ̄ kú Ubówāsi, ɔmáapú kú Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ádā ɔbá nū.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that whosoever shall go out of the doors of thy house into the street, his blood shall be upon his head, and we will be guiltless: and whosoever shall be with thee in the house, his blood shall be on our head, if any hand be upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ gā uláyi, oyī kú nū géē ce ɔ́ ɛyí, amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, abɔ̄ má kwu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ inu mla awɔ nɛ̄ ó gekwú, oyī kú nū géē ce alɔ ɛyí.

eng_Latn: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
idu_Latn: A jé íne nōo gē gbō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aɔ́lá nēe bá ɔkpáncō gē yúklɔ́ lɛ āa? A yá ka íne ɔ́ɔmā kóō gbō ɛcɛ glá āa?.

eng_Latn: It was round about eighteen thousand measures: and the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú īkpō kú ɔdɔ ā, abɔ̄ ɛnɛ kú igelī ā, wɛ umíta úlā ofu ce ɛpa ce ofigwó . Iyē kú igelī ā ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā jāā gɔbū ā géē lé ka, Óndú Yɔ̄ Amānyā.

eng_Latn: When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, he walketh through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he saith, I will return unto my house whence I came out.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ alelékwū obɔ̄bí nū ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛɛ, alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā gē yɛ ajɛ ikpākpla gē tíne ɛga kóō nyɔ̄ í lā. Ɔ́dāŋ koó má odúúmā ŋ́, ó da iyī nū kahíníī, N géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ um nɛ̄ n ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdā nēé yá Ugídīyɔn mɛ́mla ayí nū ícɛ nyā ā le kpaakpa, ayíka uwá mɛ́mla Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki géē bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ā, gē mafú péee ka Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, Alɔ lɔfú ka Ɔwɔicō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí eko nōó le alɔ yá italā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what wilt thou have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told thee what thou must do.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ cāŋjɛ ká ā nyɔ̄ igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, abɔ́ɔ ā é kē í da uwɔ ɔdā nāa géē yá piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɛ́bɛ́, kwu aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́, aɛ́bɛ́ ipáácí mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ nēe ī lɛ ɔtū piyaajɛ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó ka nááná nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kōō wɛ ācɛ igwó piyóo hile ipú ajɛ ā á nɛɛ, é klla í je ajɛ ā kpó yɔlá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́. Ó klla ka ka ɔ́ɔ géē hile kwaajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ikpaŋkini ɔcí nōo hile kwaajɛ kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Likewise all the men of Israel which had hid themselves in mount Ephraim, when they heard that the Philistines fled, even they also followed hard after them in the battle.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há nēe húmáyī tayínū ipú ɛfu kú Ɛ́frēm ā, le pó ka ācɛ Ufilístiya ɛ́ɛ bá ī kwinya ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, é klla kwú pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ kwú pīya tɔ̄ɔ̄há mla Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ujonátan. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ācɛ kú Ufilístiya á.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
idu_Latn: Asáya klla bī ācɛ ofigwóléyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umerāri wā.

eng_Latn: And the four angels were loosed, which were prepared for an hour, and a day, and a month, and a year, for to slay the third part of men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛnɛ ā hɛ́tá á. Ohígbū eko nyā piíí kú ɛcɛ nyā piíí kú ɔyā nyā piíí kú iháyí nyā piíí ā nēé tú uwā tū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó āyā éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú odúúdú alɛɛcɛ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ otú ā Alelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā lɛ ɔwɛ kú agbá ā kpó nwūla, klla lɛ uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka.

eng_Latn: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies, and he put a trumpet in every man's hand, with empty pitchers, and lamps within the pitchers.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú nū ā kɔ̄ ígwu ɛtá, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ opo mɛ́mla ɔjá nɛ̄ ɛmu o kwɔlá tá ipú nū ā kpó lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
idu_Latn: Unwalu nɛ̄ aá lɛ ā wɛ ka aá gē má eyīyɛɛcɛɛcɛ kú odée. Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú ipú aá abɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka anúɔ wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá á. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā cíkā ō gbɛlá igbō ɔ́mpa kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē jé ka alɔ kōō wɛ ákú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, hī ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā igwú da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā nū ga ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó pi ɔ́ ahɔ̄ ká ɔ̄ híī kwúcē ga eyīpɔ́lɛ́ ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aádā aá yá eko nɛ̄ n tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá Ukádɛssi Ubánīya nyɔ̄ í jila ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o lɛ ohílīpú ā gē bī íjééyī le kɛlā. Amáŋ, é cíkā ō yá aólíla italā.

eng_Latn: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
idu_Latn: É gē bīya alɔ ɔtū nááná, alɔ kē ī gwéeyē. Alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācogbɛhá ā, amáŋ alɔ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa yá ācɛ olagbénú. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka alɔ í lɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā ā, amáŋ alɔ kē lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu.

eng_Latn: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tíne ō je omlɛ́nyɔ́ mɛ́mla ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá, amáŋ aá tá ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the speech pleased the LORD, that Solomon had asked this thing.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he Óndú ā nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ Usólōmɔn le ɛ̄ba kú íjééyī ba ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ oŋmá íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da lɛyíkwu ipɔ́ɔma ɛga nōó ŋmá ā yá nōó je ɔ́ pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā ŋ́, amáŋ o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú oyēeyī éyi nōó yɔ̄ piyóó ā nōó je pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya á.

eng_Latn: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa cɔcɛ́, ācɛ gē gwéeyē. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú gaá cɔcɛ́, ācɛ gē móōwē í tíifu.

eng_Latn: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ iyī aá tīihɔ, ohígbū ka ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá á tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another, and the noise of the wheels over against them, and a noise of a great rushing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó uya kú acá kú aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ɛnɛ ā yɔ̄ ī fīyɛ̄ klá ɔhá kwūūū mɛ́mla uya kú aákā ā kwūūū bɛ̄ɛka eko nɛ̄ ajɛ gē jíliyē ā.

eng_Latn: We love him, because he first loved us.
idu_Latn: Alɔ yíihɔtū tá Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ka anú yíihɔtū tū alɔ gbɔbū á.

eng_Latn: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē gwɛ́ɛya kú n̄ tá uwɔ ahínyá, n klla í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: For thou art not sent to a people of a strange speech and of an hard language, but to the house of Israel;
idu_Latn: Ń tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu ācɛ éwɔhá nēe gē ka ucē ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ fu ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ŋmá ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó pīyatū ā, lɔfú lɔnyɛ tū ɔ̄ okónu bɛ̄ɛka ɔdōlé ā glá. Amáŋ igbīhāajɛ, ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔjɛ wɛ omōōmu okónu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ú ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ ɛcí kú nū á. Ó gbɔɔ́ ō gwɛ́bā klla gē yíimabɔ̄ dúú. Ó gē nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ācɛ o gwɛ́ɛbā mɛ́mla ācɛ o mɛ́ɛbɛ dúú. Ó bɔ́bíipú nɛ̄hi tū Óndú ā nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: He that hath not given forth upon usury, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true judgment between man and man,
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ije kú nū tū akwunugba ŋ́. Ó ī tā kā o bī ɔ́bíipú klla í trrá ɛlā kpaakpa eko dóódu nɛ̄ áafú yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ɛdɔ ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú alelékwū yɔ̄ á. Amáŋ Alelékwū ékpó ā gē je ɛhi ā á.

eng_Latn: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, ayínɛ́ um, alɔ í wɛ ayí kú ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā ŋ́, amáŋ ákú ɔnyā nōo lɛ iyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ koó nyɛ̄ɛ̄, ó í yɔ̄ ōfōōfūnū, ámāŋ nɛɛ ayíka ó kē le kagwó mla ɔbá nū. Ɔbá kóō tá ɔnyā nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
idu_Latn: N lɔtūce Óndú ā ka ami abɔ̄yī um géē wā í má aá.

eng_Latn: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ okónu ísu ā í lɔhi nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ba eko ofū ŋ́ mā, ācɛ alɛwa cɛ̄ kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá okónu ísu cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yɛ gɔbū ipú ísu gaajɛ Ufínīsi, ɔ́dāŋ ka ótɔ́ɔtɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ bá abɔ́ɔ gbéeko nɛ̄ ofū ā mɛ. Ufínīsi wɛ okónu ísu kú Ukrɛ́ti nōo pīyeyī kwu abɔ̄lúfīyē kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ mɛ́mla abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
idu_Latn: Ó kpó aúgbáajɛ kú ɔbá ɛna ɛpa mɛ́mla ɔbá ɛna ɛnɛ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugɛ́ssɔn.

eng_Latn: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:
idu_Latn: ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ íne kú nū tū klla ī yíhɔtū tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, kē yɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú nū nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ī je lɛ uwá ɛcī ɔ́ɔmā ā ɔ́ɔ ka ā, ayíkā ɛ́ɛ lɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛtá ɔhá fu kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
idu_Latn: E ŋmá Umakélɔ̄tu gaá lā Utáhati.

eng_Latn: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
idu_Latn: Aóhī hábɔ̄ tá ɛplá aújē. Anɔ́ɔ aújē ā le jɛ tɔ̄há mla uwá klla le uwá nyaŋmó á.

eng_Latn: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
idu_Latn: Ódúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ohígbū ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ikpɛ̄yí olɔfú kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nēe wɛ ayááyí kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Usamérīya nōo wɛ igelī kú ɔlɛ́ otrɛyí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā yá nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú á. Ujerúsālɛm nōo wɛ igelī kú ɔlɛ́ otrɛyí kú Ujúda ā yá nɛ̄ Ujúda bī ɔ́bíipú á.

eng_Latn: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, N tɛtɛ le aɔ́dā nēe gáā yá ā ka tɛ́ɛ́cɛ ɛ́ɛ. Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpónú n cɛ̄ le odée ā kwu yá eko nɛ̄ acɛ̄ í leyīce ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, alɔ kwú pīya ɔfiyɛ ipú ajɛ nāa je lɛ alɔ ā ɛɛ́. Ipú ajɛ olɔhi kú ɔdōlé nāa je lɛ alɔ nyā, alɔ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ipú ajɛ kú abɔ̄yī alɔ.

eng_Latn: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gáā yá aá ɔdā dúúmā glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ́ ká aá gē yá ɔtū kpoó kpoó ká aá yá ɔdā olɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Noah, that went forth of the ark, were Shem, and Ham, and Japheth: and Ham is the father of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Unówa, nēe wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ipú úgbéenyi mla anú ā wɛ Ussɛ́m, Uhám mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti. Uhám wɛ ádā kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, ŋmá eko ɔyípɛ̄ kú um nāa nwū um ɛlā á, n géē yɔ̄ gē tɔ́ɔna kú úklɔ́ idáagó kú uwɔ tɛ́ɛcɛ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto thy seed will I give it:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, Awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nāa kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā, kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ō je lɛ Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā, mɛ́mla ayááyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Art thou made of the king's counsel? forbear; why shouldest thou be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that God hath determined to destroy thee, because thou hast done this, and hast not hearkened unto my counsel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ í kɛlā gɔbū ā, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Alɔ le uwɔ yá ɔ̄cɛ o nwū ɔcɛ̄ ɛlā nɛɛ? Lɛ okónu klá cíí. Ɔdíyá nāa tíne kéē lɛ uwɔ ŋmó tónū icííci ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kwú okónu ú klá cíí, amáŋ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, N jé ka Ɔwɔicō kwú abɔ̄ ú kwú ɔtū kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi, ɔ́ɔma yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ á jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú um ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄kā kú úklɔ́ ō hídáagó nyā le yɛ ɛga dóódu kú ajɛ abɔ́ɔ jīla.

eng_Latn: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the LORD would not pardon.
idu_Latn: Ofíyɛ́ dúú ā, ucē kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Umanásɛ yá eko nɛ̄ ó kpó ācɛ nēé yá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā ŋmó Ujerúsālɛm ā. Óndú ā í je ɔdā nɛ̄ Umanásɛ yá ɔ́ɔmā yá ɔ̄ ɛhi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, God forbid; thou shalt not die: behold, my father will do nothing either great or small, but that he will shew it me: and why should my father hide this thing from me? it is not so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan tá ɔ̄ ohi ka Ɔwɔicō ká ɔ̄ ŋmó ɔwɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí, kú ɔ̄ kwú. Ɛ́ɛ́ kú ádā anúɔ ká ɔ̄ yá ɔdā dúúmā, kwu ɔdā nɛ̄hi mla ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́, ɔ́ɔ gē da anúɔ piíí. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ádā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō je ɔdā ɛ̄nyā tayínū ŋmá ɛgiyí anúɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ Ujonátan ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó ɔkɔ ɔhá ŋmá ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Le bɛ̄cɛ, ācɛ ɔlɛ um! Aá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Ubábīlɔn! Cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bīyíne kú Ɔwɔicō ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ Ubábīlɔn gē yá ā ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kē yá aá italā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gáā yá igelī nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé tíne kéē jé ɔdā dóódu jéjéēē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, é klla ī tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech's head, and all to brake his skull.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā éyi le ɛgɔ̄ kú nū tá wā ajɛ í ce Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki ɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ɛgɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔ́ ɛyí ca á.

eng_Latn: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá gē tū aɔ́lɛ́ aá nēe húmáyī tá alácɛ̄ ā gwó. É klla í gwó inu kú uwā ce ɛyí aíkpínū nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nēé tɛtɛ le tá ajɛ ŋmá ikííkée ā. É kē í jé aá, ka aá wɛ ācɛ nēe gwó aínu nēe catāajɛ ā. É klla kē í jé aá ka aá wɛ ācɛ nēe glá úláyi kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā gwó.

eng_Latn: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah, brother to Joab, saying, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? And Abishai said, I will go down with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da, Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔ̄cɛ Uhɛ́ti ā, mɛ́mla Abíssāyi ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ujówābu, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwā wɛ Usɛrúya, ɔ̄kā ka, ɔ̄nyɛ kú uwā ɛpa nēe bá ā lɔfú ga aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú Usɔ́lu mla anúɔ glá ā? Anɔ́ɔ Abíssāyi tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ikpíikpó ɔ́ɔmā agwú ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔ̄ iyē anɔ́ɔ ó kwú yá yēŋēē kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ géē jíliyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ɛga alɛwa, ɔkpɛtā géē ŋmó ācɛ, ōcē obɔ̄bí géē tū ɛga alɛwa, aɔ́dā ōtūufi nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdidáago géē wā ŋmá ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.
idu_Latn: N gē bī odúúdú ɔtū kú um gē lɔfú tīyē kú n̄ gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā. Ā cɛ̄ gā um nyīleyī ŋmá íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nēé yá alɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ kú alɔ ā, alɔ bá ipú ɔtūnōbí.

eng_Latn: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kóō yá ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā nēé ka ā glá āa, ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ofu cigwɛ́ɛpa ā kpó ŋmá ɛga nēé ce ā cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ́ɔ lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja o kpɛ́fú ajɛ ɔlamu kpó kwɛyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Ó klla bī oje ɔdɔ ukílōgram ɛpa nēé ca báajɛ plɛ́kɛ́tɛ́ ā le ma bá aɔ́kplɛ́fú nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ofigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nōó yá ā. Ó kwú odúúdú uwā ú kpó ce Agbla kú Ūpū kú Ulébānɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had set the brands on fire, he let them go into the standing corn of the Philistines, and burnt up both the shocks, and also the standing corn, with the vineyards and olives.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔlá hɛ́ kwu ácí kú ugbé kú uwā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó mā uwá tá i tá ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya. Ó bī ɔwɛ nyā le odúúdú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ufilístiya kpó yɔlá. Kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ é cē bá ɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó tá icō, nēé cē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, kwu ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīifu nēé tū ā kpó wúlatāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā ī wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō le mafú gā um ka amíyɔ wɛ ɔ̄cokɛ̄mgbɛ̄. Kóō le mafú ka ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā wɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said unto him, Take heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō gā ɛgiyí Ulában, ɔ̄cɛ Áram ā ipú ɔ̄na otú gbɔbū kóō gaajɛ ɛgiyí Ujékɔ̄pu ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Le ɛlá kwu ɔ́ ka ā híī fu ɔ́ ɔnū ɔwɛ dóódu fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
idu_Latn: Umáaka, ɔnyā kú Umakíyɛ ā ma ayí ɛpa: Upéressi mɛ́mla Usséress. Upéressi ma ayí ɛpa nēe bá ā: Úlam mɛ́mla Urákem.

eng_Latn: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúú ká ipú aá le nyíleyī ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá lɛ ɔ́ kwúcē igbīhi kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ italā yá ūwā ohígbū ɔdā nēé yá ā.

eng_Latn: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ɛgbá kē ce aá, nēé lɛ nwuné á, é géē tá aá abɔ̄. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā, ógo tá ga ɔlɛ́ apɛ, apɛ tá ga ɔlɛ́ ógo.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
idu_Latn: É le fu ajɛ ŋmá Umára, gā Ɛ́lim. É má lā ajɛ kú Ɛlím ā ohígbū ka njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ igwɛ́pa bá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla ɔcí kú alī ofɛɛtá ce igwó.

eng_Latn: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, aá géē jīla kú aá gbā ɔ́wɔicō ɛ̄gbā. Aá híī yúklɔ́ dúúmā ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ icɔ́ɔci le jīla tɔ̄há anɔ́ɔ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō ka ucē ɔhá á, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlamu ámāŋ ācɛ nēe wɛ ācɛ nēe kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ mā le bēhé wā ipú inu ā, é gáā gbɛlá ka odúúdú aá bá gē jɛɛ́lɛ́ ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ híī kwú anúɔ tū gɛ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ uwá kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í klla gáā blakwu uwá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ anúɔ kwú anúɔ ú pīya ádā kú éwo nēe lɛwa klla lɛ ɔfú fíyɛ́ uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē ce ɛyí inɔ̄ɔda olɔfú, yɔ̄ í gbāajɛ kú Ujésirííli ā le Ujéhu mɛ́mla ígwu kú ācɛ nēe yɛ mla anú ā má abɔ́ é bá yɔ̄ ī wā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka anúɔ má ígwu kú ācɛ éyi bá gē wā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóram da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔ̄cɛ o ce ɔnya éyi ú kóō gaá jīla uwā ɔwɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ wā ɛbɔ́ kɛ̄ɛ.

eng_Latn: Again, think ye that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before God in Christ: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
idu_Latn: Ikōhī ŋ́ mā aá yɔ̄ gē gbɛlá ka alɔ yɔ̄ gē kɔkɔ ká ālɔ̄ lɛpɔhi iyɔ̄bū aá! Ehée! Ó lɛ ā ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō wɛ ijáalí kú alɔ ka alɔ gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi bɛ̄ɛka ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dúú nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ā, ācɛ o he alɔ ɔtū, ó wɛ o yá kú ālɔ̄ tá aá abɔ̄ nɛ n.

eng_Latn: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
idu_Latn: Ojājīlīmā mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú ɔlɛɛcɛ í ci ikwū kú nū glá ŋ́, ó géē kwú piíí ɛ̄cī éyi bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́bɛ́ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: To take a spoil, and to take a prey; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited, and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations, which have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the midst of the land.
idu_Latn: A géē je ācɛ nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe tɛtɛ tá ipú alácɛ̄ ā iyó kpó wu. É kpó ācɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmá ipú aéwo ɔhá ā, amáŋ é lɛ ɔdāajɛ mɛ́mla aíyó lɛ ɛɛ́. É kē lā ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n gā abɔ́ɔ, lɛ eko táajɛ ká ā yɔ̄ ī jé ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā tɛ́ɛcɛ, yɔ̄ ī nwū ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ká ā klla bī ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā tɔ́ɔna lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that God had put in his heart.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā gē wā ī da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kéē má íjééyī mɛ́mla ohílīpú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Barak pursued after the chariots, and after the host, unto Harosheth of the Gentiles: and all the host of Sisera fell upon the edge of the sword; and there was not a man left.
idu_Latn: Ubárāki nū uwā inya jāā ga Uharōssɛt-hagoyím, anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmó á. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī aá klla géē tá aá ɔtū lé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ gē leyīkwu ɔyí nū gē je amɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ gwá jāā gbéeko nōó le ipú nū ā. Aá géē jɔ́ɔnyɛ agbénú kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
idu_Latn: Mā um tá cíí, kú ɔtū kóō he um lígíí, ɛ́ɛ́ ka n géē kwú.

eng_Latn: As every man hath received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kɔ̄ lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú aá, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā aá leyīkwu ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá bī ɛhi ā le tá ɔ́mpa aá abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
idu_Latn: éyééye kú uwá lɛ eyī ɛnɛ mla acá ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joash said unto all that stood against him, Will ye plead for Baal? will ye save him? he that will plead for him, let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning: if he be a god, let him plead for himself, because one hath cast down his altar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówāsi da odúúdú ācɛ ā ɔ̄kā kéē gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ Ubáalu nɛɛ? Ó da uwá kéē gē nuunu lɛ ɔ́ nɛɛ? Ó ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ géē nuunu lɛ Ubáalu, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó gbɔbū lɛ eyōōnyā ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī óócí. Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka Ubáalu ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔwɔ nɛɛ, kéē mā ɔ̄ tá kóō cɛ̄pɔ̄ īyī nū, ohígbū ka ede kú nū nēé je wúlatāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Laban said to Jacob, What hast thou done, that thou hast stolen away unawares to me, and carried away my daughters, as captives taken with the sword?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulában da Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a le um plla le ayínɔ̄nyā kú um kpó kwu bɛ̄ɛka ācɛnyā nēé kwú eko ɛfú ā a?.

eng_Latn: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā nēe bá ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔtūce agbénú kú uwā. É klla gē gwō ohígbū agbénú nɛ̄hi nēé lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees' excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn kē lɔhi fíyɛ́ Odúúdú éwɔhá dóódu a, O kē wɛ ikpó ɔlɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ gēe yá ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ kú nū á, amáŋ, ami nōo wɛ Óndú a, gēe je Ubábīlɔn wúla tū ajɛ, je ɔɔ yá ífi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n yá Usɔ́dɔm mla Ugomóra a.

eng_Latn: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Ó kē í yɔ̄ ī yi ɔlá kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ. Ódūdū kú ajɛ Ɛ́dɔm gē yɔ̄ ī tá piyóó. Ajɛ ā géē tá alácɛ̄ iháyí alɛwa, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gāa lɛ ɔtū bū ipú nū ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Repent, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so iniquity shall not be your ruin.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē da aá, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ka n géē ka ɛpɔ̄ tū ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nōo yá ā lɛ a. Aá le pīyabɔ̄ ká aá kwúcē ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā. Aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá gē yá ā ká ō je aá yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
idu_Latn: É kē le ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú yá glá ā má ɛɛ́, mɛ́mla owu nɛ̄hi nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ tá ipú ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And he coupled the five curtains one unto another: and the other five curtains he coupled one unto another.
idu_Latn: É le ohí ɛhɔ̄ kú īlī ā gɔ́ kwɔhá kóō le pīya ígwu éékpó, ɔdā éékpó ɔ́ɔmā nēé yá mla ohí ɛhɔ̄ o hile ā dúú á.

eng_Latn: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, íjééyī lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄gba ipú úláyi gbōō ā. Ɔdōōjé klla yɔ̄ ī hīgwú gbōmgbōm bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛnyā ā dúú.

eng_Latn: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: ācɛ úlā ofɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛnɛ ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó .

eng_Latn: Then the Jews sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu lɛyītáajɛ nū ɔnū ucɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Iní nōó yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Jacob loved Rachel; and said, I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter.
idu_Latn: Urécɛ̄lu le he Ujékɔ̄pu ɔtū, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, N géē kwɛ̄hɔ̄cī gā uwɔ iháyí ahāapa ohígbū Urécɛ̄lu kóō kwú pīya ɔnyā um.

eng_Latn: Also unto thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū kú nū yɔ̄ eko dóódu. Óndú, awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ gē cíla ɔ̄cɛ ulé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē yá ucē lɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up:
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā n géē kwúcē, n kē í gwó inu kú Udéfīdi nōo ca ā. N géē je ɛga nēe yíífi ā túgwó. N kē í gwó ɔ̄ gicō.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
idu_Latn: Ujɛríya, Amárīya, Ujɛhásīyɛlu mɛ́mla Ujɛkaméyam wɛ ayí kú Uhɛ́brɔn nēé ma ce īyī uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá iyē kú uwá ɔgbɔɔgba lɛ ā ā.

eng_Latn: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother's brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother's father, saying,
idu_Latn: Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔyí kú Ugídīyɔn ā le tá Usɛ́kɛm, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɛ́nɛ́ nū bá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó gāá da uwá ka.

eng_Latn: And he will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your oliveyards, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je ajɛ kú aá nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā, mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin, mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu ā, kpó lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible unto thee; take away this cup from me: nevertheless not what I will, but what thou wilt.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kahíníī, Ádā, Ádā um! A lɔfú yá ɔdā dóódu glá, kwú ikókwū kú ōwē nyā ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Náána ā híī yá ɔdā nōo he um ɔtū ā ŋ́, amáŋ yá ɔdā nōo he uwɔ ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: At the same time spake the LORD by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā óndū a lɛ ɛlā ka la Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Émɔ̄si a, lɛbɛ̄ɛka iháyí ɛtá nēe gāa yɛ ɛɛ́ ma kahíníī, nyɔ̄ gāa lɛ īlī ekwu nɛ̄ a le wiyē a plá ŋmá iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ka á lɛ áblákpá kú uwɔ plá ŋmá ikpó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yá lɛ a, táohiɛwa, lɛ ikpó bá ajɛ ipu ɔlɛ a, yɔ̄ ī yɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of my master Abraham, who hath not left destitute my master of his mercy and his truth: I being in the way, the LORD led me to the house of my master's brethren.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, N tá uwɔ ahínyá, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpani um, Ébrahām. A le okónu nɛ̄ a ce lɛ ɔkpani um ā yá kpaakpa gaajɛ ɛɛ́. Óndú, ā le um bī kpaakpa wā ɔlɛ́ kú aɔ́máapú ɔkpani um.

eng_Latn: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ōcɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú nēé gē dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɛyí ō táajɛ lɛ ɔkpani kú nū eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And they said unto them, We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach unto us:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē da uwā kahíníī, Alɔ í gáā je ɔyínɛ́ alɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōó hɛ́ apī ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā ā géē wɛ ɔdā uwēyī lɛ alɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
idu_Latn: Ujóbu lɛ aóklóbīya ɛtá éyi nɛ̄ iyē uwā lé ka, Ɛlífāasi, ɔ̄cɛ Utéman, mɛ́mla Ubíldāadi, ɔ̄cɛ Ussúwa, mɛ́mla Usófa, ɔ̄cɛ Unáama ā. Eko nēé lɛ odúúdú unwalu nēe klá Ujóbu ā pó ā, é le pɛ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwá tɔ̄há, klla le okónu ce ka aá nyɔ̄ í tá Ujóbu ɔtū lé.

eng_Latn: Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala,
idu_Latn: ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usérūgu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Uréyu, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Upélegi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Éba, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ussɛlá.

eng_Latn: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi, aícɔ́ɔja kú Uhɛ́ssbɔn Aícɔ́ɔja kú Usíhɔn bɛ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā ŋmá ipú igelī nɛ̄hi nyā. É kwú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Áru kú Umówābu ú yíífi. É kwu ɛfu kú āyā ɛhícō kú ísu kú Ánɔn ā í kpó yíífi dúú.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commandeth, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kahíníī, Óndú ā le da alɔ ka ālɔ̄ lɛ umaná ōhī tū, kú alɔ géē mafú lɛ ayí alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má ɔdōlé nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ alɔ ipú ígbíli, eko nɛ̄ ó kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
idu_Latn: Ɔdí mɛ́ɛ̄ ā? Alɔ nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu bá lɔhi fíyɛ́ ācɛ ɔhá nɛɛ? Ó lɛ ā fúlufúlu ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n tɛtɛ lɛ ɛlā kpóce ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá ka ínoōbīya kwu odúúdú uwa ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And Ben-hadad said unto him, The cities, which my father took from thy father, I will restore; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send thee away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him, and sent him away.
idu_Latn: Ubenhádādi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ádā um mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā uwɔ ā, n géē je uwá kpó kwúcē igbīhi gā uwɔ. Alɔ kwú Udamáskɔ̄si ú pīya ɔlɛ́ o yúklɔ́ mla ɔ́sú kú uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ádā um yá Usamérīya ā. Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu da ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ a gáā yá ā, ń gáā ŋmó uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le Ubenhádādi hɛ́tá á.

eng_Latn: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of God in his state, and strengthened it.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācoyúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā yúklɔ́ nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é le Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gílayá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ eko nɛ̄ Usólōmɔn gwó ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: So shall ye say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil: and now, we pray thee, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, kwú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ uwɔ yá uwɔ ā í yá uwā ɛhi. Abālɔbányā kóocōō kwú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ, nēe wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ ā, í yá alɔ ɛhi. Ujósɛ̄fu le ikwū je eko nōó mīyɛ olɛhɔ̄ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
idu_Latn: N gē cē ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā abɔ̄, klla ī mīyɛ ācɛ nēé kwú ā ŋmá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Then I said unto them, What is the high place whereunto ye go? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day.
idu_Latn: N da uwá ɔ̄kā ka, Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí aɛ́ga olicō nɛ̄ aá ge nyɔ̄ nyā a? Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é hī aíkpɛ́cí ā kahíníī, aɛ́ga olicō jāā kwu ícɛ.

eng_Latn: Six days thou shalt do thy work, and on the seventh day thou shalt rest: that thine ox and thine ass may rest, and the son of thy handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī ā, a géē yúklɔ́ kú uwɔ̄ ā, amáŋ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, ā géē mlɛ́nyɔ́. Ɛna mɛ́mla ijakī kú aá, mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá mɛ́mla aéwɔhá nēe gē yúklɔ́ lɛ aá géē mlɛ́nyɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le lūgwū.

eng_Latn: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Atálīya, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ahasíya le pó ka é le ɔyí anúɔ ŋmó ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le odúúdú ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā kóō kwú pīya ulé nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē cílá ācɛ nēe gē kpó ɛlā ce um ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē ka obɔ̄bí kú um ā.

eng_Latn: Because ye have said, The LORD hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;
idu_Latn: Aá gē ka ka amíyɔ̄ lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ je lɛ aá ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said unto all Israel, Behold, I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me, and have made a king over you.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, N le ɔdā nɛ̄ aá da um ka ami ɔ́ɔ̄ yá ā, yá lɛ aá ɛɛ́. N lɛ ɔcɛ́ fu lɛ aá kóō gbō aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
idu_Latn: Ā híī je ɛga lɛ unwalu amáŋ ɔnū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ó gē kpó ɔ̄cɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla unwalu ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
idu_Latn: Aá le jī ɛɛ́! Aá nēe bá ī lá aɔ́lɛ́ mɛ́mla ajɛ alɛwa ɔhá kwu ɛ̄nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lɛ ā jāāā gbēeko nɛ̄ ɛga í yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ɔhá kéē lā gɛ ŋ́ mā. Aá ōfōōfū aá gáā lā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Benhadad, Tell my lord the king, All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.
idu_Latn: Náaná, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ācɛ nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi tū wā a kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ í da óndú um, ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ɔdā dóódu nōó tɛ̄hɔ̄ nū wā aflɛ́yí aā, n géē yá ɔ̄, amáŋ ákú igbo ɔ́mpa nyā, ń gáā yá ɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá le ohi kpó lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya á.

eng_Latn: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
idu_Latn: Aá gáā mā ɛbɛ́ kú nū dóódu tá gbó oŋmɔ́ɔci nū ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá géē ca ikpokwu kú ɛbɛ ā dúúmā ŋ́. Aá lé ucɛ ā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú nū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: For our God is a consuming fire.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo gē yi ɔdā dóódu tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ ohígbū ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā, alɔ kē bá ɛbɔ́ mla anú ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Óndú alɔ yá lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā le gbagbafú cɛ́ɛ́ n kē le gbagbafú dúú. Eko nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā plla nōo lɛ íne bīya, ɔtū gē bīya gā um nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujósɛ̄fu le ayí ā kpó ŋmá átákwū kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó túkpɛɛ́ lɛ eyī pīya kláajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū á.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the LORD with thee: notwithstanding, if there be in me iniquity, slay me thyself; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father?
idu_Latn: Kócōō, lɛ ɔdā olɔhi nyā yá ga um, ká ā nyíla ɛka nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla awɔ gbo ā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, n le yá bɔ̄bí, lɛ um ŋmó abɔ̄yī uwɔ. Ɔdíyá nāa gé bī um, gé lɛ ádā uwɔ kóō ŋmó um ā.

eng_Latn: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
idu_Latn: É le yɛ um jīla tá ābɔ̄ dóódu, amáŋ oŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Óndú ā, n le uwá kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ágrīpa Ɔcɛ́, ń yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɛgiyí ɔdā nɛ̄ n má ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then hear thou from the heavens, even from thy dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for; that all people of the earth may know thy name, and fear thee, as doth thy people Israel, and may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name.
idu_Latn: Kócōō lɛ ahɔ̄ jē lɛ ɔkɔ nēé í gbā gā awɔ ā pó ɔkpáncō ɛga nāa lā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɔdā nēé ba ŋmá abɔ̄ uwɔ ā yá lɛ uwá. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká odúúdú ācɛ kú ɛcɛ kéē lɛ uwɔ jé, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛyí táajɛ gā awɔ. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu gē yá ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ é géē jé ka, Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, nɛ̄ n gwó nyā wɛ ɛga nɛ̄ iyē kú uwɔ yɔ̄ nēé klla gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā á.

eng_Latn: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the stairs thereof, and measured the threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad; and the other threshold of the gate, which was one reed broad.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá okómpinu nōo pīyeyī kwú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā. Ó lɛ ikpó ce agidigbé kú nū gicō ga okónu nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okómpinu ā mīya abɔ́ɔ á. Olipú kú nū wɛ umíta ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ géē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā nū mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū kóō gaá bɔ́há mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū, ká uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa kéē le pīya ɔkpíye ékpó.

eng_Latn: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n le íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ gā uwɔ á. Ń kē je ɔ́ tayínū gā uwɔ ŋ́. N kahíníī, N géē lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ n yá ā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ gā uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ a kē kwú yá um ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ā, í nwū alɔ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ mabɔ̄ īnyīlɛyí kú nū tá kóō le gwā līkpō wāajɛ ó wɛ ɔdūwēyī lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And David said unto Jonathan, Behold, to morrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to sit with the king at meat: but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field unto the third day at even.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Óócí wɛ ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ á, n kē cíkā ó lé ɔdōlé mla ɔcɛ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó he uwɔ ɔtū, n géē nyɔ̄ í tayínū ipácí jāā gbó ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cīhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɛbéenyi lígíí dúú. Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ɛbéenyi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ayíkpó kú nū kéē lɛ uwá kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udárīyɔs, ɔcɛ́ kú Uméde, wā gaá mīyɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū á. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Udárīyɔsi wɛ iháyí ofɛtá.

eng_Latn: And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not straightway pull him out on the sabbath day?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ éyi ká aá lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔbá ɛna nōo le míya tá ipú obugā, ɔdí nɛ̄ aá í yá ā? Aá géē gwōtū ipú obugā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ pi wɛ̄ɛcɛ nááná nōó wɛ ɛ̄cī usábāti ā.

eng_Latn: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ā. Abɔ̄ alelékwū obɔ̄bí ā lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má ā, ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔyínɔnyīlɔ ā gbɔɔ́ ō fīyégbúlú, cɛ́ɛ́ ó fīyaajɛ gbɔɔ́ ō miyaajɛ, ūwū gbɔɔ́ ō cē ɔ̄ okónu.

eng_Latn: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
idu_Latn: Nááná ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú ā, ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē nā ɔ̄na nōo gē cɛ̄ lɛ uwā gē je iyē kú uwā tēelihɔ. É gē leyī gwu íkwu kú Ɔwɔicō bónū, é klla gē kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ o lɔfú nēe bá ɔkpáncō ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, N géē ŋmó uwā ɛpɔ̄bí, í yá uwá italā. É géē kpó ayípōklóbīya kú uwa ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú. Ɛmiyɛ í je ayí uwā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
idu_Latn: Aá nēe lā ɔkpáncō ā, ɔtū kóō he aá, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō kwú Ubábīlɔn yíífi ɛɛ́! Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō, ɔtū kóō he aá! Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō lɛ Ubábīlɔn ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ohígbū aɔ́dā nōó yá aá ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka íjééyī ā fíyɛ́ ɛdɔ ɔtángbédē dóódu á. Odúúdú agbénú nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ tíne ā, í gáā lɛbɛ̄ɛka, íjééyī ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he entreated Abram well for her sake: and he had sheep, and oxen, and he asses, and menservants, and maidservants, and she asses, and camels.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔnyā ā, Uféro yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ Ébram. Ó kpó aálá alɛwa mɛ́mla aɛ́na mɛ́mla aíjakī mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aínyānkwūlūmī alɛwa lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Ipú opīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó yɔ̄ gē kpó aá tɔ̄há mla ācɛ ɔhá ga ipú ɛga nɛ̄ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō lā ā.

eng_Latn: And there went a man of the house of Levi, and took to wife a daughter of Levi.
idu_Latn: Ɛplé eko nyā, ɔ̄cɛnyílɔ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi gaá lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi éyi lɛ ɔnyā.

eng_Latn: There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cɛ olagbénú éyi yɔ̄ nōo ī lɛ otóŋ́gwō ahilíki kú otumbíyē wiiyē. Ó klla gē lé ɔdōlé kú abahi ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē ga ipú ɔ́kɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ aálelékwū obɔ̄bí tɛtɛ ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ nyɔ̄ mla anú.

eng_Latn: And thou saidst, I will surely do thee good, and make thy seed as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ cokónu ka, anúɔ géē yá kú ɔdā dóódu kóō yɛ lɔhi gā um má. A klla ka anúɔ géē yá kú ipɔ́ɔma kú um kéē lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ikpɔ̄ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í lɔfú gbo uwá áluka glá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
idu_Latn: Ikwū gē je ɔ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū nōó lā ɛbɔ́ ā, klla ī bī ɔ̄ gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Now therefore up by night, thou and the people that is with thee, and lie in wait in the field:
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ ka anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, kéē gbɔɔ́ ō wā otú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gaá le pɛ́ tayínū ipácí.

eng_Latn: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē bla keé tɛtɛ wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā nā abɔ̄ olɔfú kú nū daa, le uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ á. Ó klla da uwá ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā je íne lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɛ̄cī nēé cíká ō yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā tū lɛ anúɔ á.

eng_Latn: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
idu_Latn: Ádā ā yíihɔtū tū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔdā dóódu kpó tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
idu_Latn: Ulɛ́ya klla le ipú yɔ̄ igbɔhá le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔ́mɛhīlī ma lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu.

eng_Latn: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka eko nɛ̄ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tíne ō yá ā yá ɔkpáncō kwɛ́yí, anúɔ géē pīya ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā kwu Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́ɛnɛ. Ó ka ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ uwá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ō jē kpó yíífi piií ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ayí kú Ulífāyi gbaáluka. Gbɔɔ́ ŋmá iyē kú ádā uwā mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú uwā. Ɔ̄cɛnyilɔ kú uwā dóódu nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū, a géē gbā ɔ́ áluka.

eng_Latn: And one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the fat pastures of Israel; for a meat offering, and for a burnt offering, and for peace offerings, to make reconciliation for them, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je álá éyi ŋmá ipú aálá ofigwó dóódu kú ajɛ ácí olɔhi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Aá géē bī ɔdā nyā gwɛ́ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ɛhɔ̄, ɛya oyɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya ole yá ɛbɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú ɔbíipú kú aá í kpó yá aá ɛhi. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ɔ́da je ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē pó ikwū ō je ŋmá ɔwɛ nēé hī ka ɔwɛ kú ɛbéenyi kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Aá klla géē pó ikwū ō je ŋmá ɛga nēé gwó ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Aá klla í pó uya kú o wúla tāajɛ ipú aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi ā wuuuu.

eng_Latn: And the sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the people had avenged themselves upon their enemies. Is not this written in the book of Jasher? So the sun stood still in the midst of heaven, and hasted not to go down about a whole day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛnɔ ā má háyi cíí á. Ɔyā í kē ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā kpó yálé. É le ɔdā nōo yá nyá tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú Ujássa ka ɛnɔ māháyi cíí ɔkpáncō. Ó kē ga ajɛ ŋ́ ɛ̄cī odumkulu.

eng_Latn: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
idu_Latn: Aéwɔhá ā géē yɛ í bá ī fīyɛ̄gbúlú abɔ̄ a géē yɔ̄ ī wā ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔlá gē yi ɛfú gē yá ká éŋkpɔ̄ kóō wú á. Wā ká ā gaá lɛ ɔfú kú uwɔ mafú lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Now the men of Israel had sworn in Mizpeh, saying, There shall not any of us give his daughter unto Benjamin to wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le jīla Umíspa ā. É le okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā ce lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn dúúmā lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú aá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē cē lɛ uwá lɛ ayí alɔ nɔ̄nyā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
idu_Latn: Olɛlā nōo nyi uwá ā wɛ ebilíi. Eko nēé í ce ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ ā wɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ í mɛ ā. Ācocɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ā wɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But when Herod's birthday was kept, the daughter of Herodias danced before them, and pleased Herod.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé gē blakwu ɛ̄cī nēé ma Uhérɔ̄du gā ā, adá kú Uherodíyas le ijē jē iyɔ̄bū aúgbɔga ā, nɛ̄ ɔtū kē le he Uhérɔ̄du nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, We are come down to bind thee, that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines. And Samson said unto them, Swear unto me, that ye will not fall upon me yourselves.
idu_Latn: É da Usámsin ka aá wā abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔ́ gbō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ uwá. Usámsin tá uwā ohi ka, kéē le okónu ce lɛ anúɔ ka uwá abɔ̄yī uwā í gáā ŋmó anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beerelim.
idu_Latn: Ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Umówābu dóódu a, ācɛ ba i dɛ̄ íbá. É ba í pó íbá mla eléélelé kú uwá a ga ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Églem mla Ubéerēlim.

eng_Latn: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da Ujísɔ̄si kóō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of thy mercy.
idu_Latn: N le ɔ́da je lɛ ācɛ kú Ulífāyi kéē lɛ īyī uwā gwu yēŋēē kéē nyɔ̄ í gbō ɔwɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē má ka ācɛ ā le ɛ̄cī Usábāti tīihɔ. Ɔwɔicō, Óndú um, ményinyi um, ká ā lɛ um nyatá ohígbū ihɔtū nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Le eyí kú uwɔ nwūla ká ā má ɔ̄ ícííci mɛ́ɛnɛ, ká ā má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā italā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
idu_Latn: Ufi kú Óndú ā mla ɛyí ō táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga oyēeyī olīkpō. Ɔdā dóódu géē jɛ̄ ɔ̄, ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā í gáā yá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si je eyī gicō má ɔkpáncō lɛ owuhīlatá, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Efufáta nɛ̄ ɛyí nū wɛ, Le nwūla.

eng_Latn: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí ā, é lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī Usábāti ɔhá ā, ɛyínɛ̄hi ācɛ kú ipú igelī ā le jīla tɔ̄há kéē pó ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Jacob, Return unto the land of thy fathers, and to thy kindred; and I will be with thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Kwúcē gaajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ, ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ. N géē yɔ̄ mla uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Israel, singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi yɔ̄ í pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́, eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ Ugolíyāti ŋmó ā, ācɛnyā kú odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ í jīla Usɔ́lu ɔwɛ. É bā yɔ̄ ī gwííjē kú éeye, bá gē jīījē klla bá ī tá opo, klla bá yɔ̄ ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū mɛ́mla ɔdā ō bī gwííjē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka unwalu alɛwa wā í klá um, nōo gáā ŋmó um ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú ohile kú anɔ̄ nēé ī le fu ɔ̄cɛ ā ú, mɛ́mla oyī ōhī kú ɛyí ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ mī klá īlī kú Árɔ̄ni, mɛ́mla īlī kú ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ á. Ɔwɛ nyā nōó je Árɔ̄n mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū, mɛ́mla īlī kú uwā kpó tū Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú tīihɔ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbo iyɔ̄bū uwā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ bɛ̄ɛka ojuja kpúm ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō ma ɔwɛ fú lɛ uwá. Otú ā, ó gē gbɔbū lɛ uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpá ɔlá ōfíyajɛ nɛ̄hi ā, o yá kéē mɛ́ɛbɛ otú glá. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɔfú yɛ otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ glá.

eng_Latn: And the foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
idu_Latn: Aígbɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōo likpō kú aóhī kú uwā lɔfú lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, ámāŋ ka ikpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā, nēé bī le táajɛ kú aíkpínu ā á.

eng_Latn: And every plant of the field before it was in the earth, and every herb of the field before it grew: for the LORD God had not caused it to rain upon the earth, and there was not a man to till the ground.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí mɛ́mla ácí mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā í bū ipú ɛcɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō í yá kú ɔwɔ kóō yā tū ajɛ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo í hí ajɛ ā ɛhɔ̄ í kē yɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ alɔ jé ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu géē je kpó yíífi ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā ā ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī nyá nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ō lā ā. Ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka aá cíkā ō la oyēeyī otīihɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō dɔɔ̄kā ā.

eng_Latn: And Pilate asked him, Art thou the King of the Jews? And he answering said unto him, Thou sayest it.
idu_Latn: Upáyílēti da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu áā? Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Awɔ ka lɛ a á n.

eng_Latn: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.
idu_Latn: Ísāka ma ayí ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, Utóla, Upúwa, Ujássūbu mɛ́mla Ussímrɔn.

eng_Latn: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi fu ŋmá ipú odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó fu uwá kéē wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ úlúúlā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛɛhɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ofɛpa cigwó ofɛpa cigwó mɛ́mla ācɛ igwíígwó.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
idu_Latn: A géē je utébulu ā háyi iyɔ̄bū kú ikpati kú Okónu ō ce ā. Igbō otīihɔ kú um ā kóō cɛyí utébulu ā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: for I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, N le Ɔwɔicō má ikpēyī abɔ̄yī um, anɔ́ɔ n yēeyī kpɔ́ áā. anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce abɔ́ɔ ka Upɛ́nīyɛl.

eng_Latn: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Aɔ́wɔ ā kéē lɛ um ŋmó, ɔ́dāŋ ka eko ɛ́gɛ́nyā oócí nɛ̄ ń yá uwɔ ɔdā nɛ̄ a yá ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ubáalu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
