idu_Latn: Aipɔ́ɔma kú Ujósɛ̄fu da Ujóssuwa ka ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ kwú āyā kú ajɛ ékpónú ú lɛ aá kóō wɛ ɔdā úgwū kú aá ā? Ka aá ɔ́ɔ kē lɛwa nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔhā hɛ́ ce aá.

eng_Latn: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ gbɔbū lɛ eko nyā ā, ōcē ā lɛ ācɛ úlā ofɛɛtá ŋmó ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ayí kú Udéfīdi nēé ma lɛ ɔ́ Uhɛ́brɔn ogbace ɔgbace á. Ámnɔn nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Ahínōwam nōo ŋmá Ujɛ́siríili ā. Udánīyɛlu, nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū wɛ Abígɛ̄ɛlu nōo ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ á, Ɔkpá nōo je ŋmó nyā, n klla géē je ɔ́ mu mla éŋkpɔ̄ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Áa lɛ ɔgɔ bū tá ɔtū ɔkpá nōo je ŋmó ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: Yea, they spake against God; they said, Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?
idu_Latn: É ka iŋini tá Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō je ɔdōlé lɛ alɔ ipú ígbíli nyā glá āa?.

eng_Latn: Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
idu_Latn: Umáta da ɔ́ kahíníī, N jé kóō géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ámōōmɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that he took a thick cloth, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, Uhasɛ́lu kwú áto o klíiyē ú, le ɔ́ wu éŋkpɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya klla ɔcɛ́ eyī jāā gbéeko nōó gekwú. Anɔ́ɔ Uhasɛ́lu kwu pīya ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋ́má abɔ̄ ācɛ nōo gē pīya um tū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā tɛtɛ yɔ̄ pi um, odúúdú ayí um kē yɛ um jīla tá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
idu_Latn: Ukpɛ̄ kú Óndú ā ŋmá ipú álá ā wɛ úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛtá ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
idu_Latn: Aá je ɛbɛ́ dúúmā nɛ̄ aá lá ŋmá ɛgiyí aéwɔhá ā le gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdōlé lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́. Ɛbɛ́ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɛnyá iyē, n̄ kē gáā mīyɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé pó abɔ̄ é bá ī ka ucē ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, klla bá ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o fíyɛ́ aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ā dúú ā wɛ ka aá lɛ ihɔtū, nōo gē gbō ɔdā dóódu tɔ̄há lɔfúlɔfú ā, lɛ lɛ iyī aá.

eng_Latn: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh him families like a flock.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó géē nya aógbɛhá tá ŋmá ipú ákanya kú uwā. Ó klla í nyīla aípɔ́ɔnū kú uwā bɛ̄ɛka aálá ā.

eng_Latn: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahātá ā, é géē hɛ́ ɔyí ā apī.

eng_Latn: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá bá gē yɛ ā, aá tɔ́ɔna ka, ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔkpáncō le bá ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si wɛ Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Upɛ́sīya ā, Óndú ā le yá kú ɛlā nōó ka bū okónu kú Ujeremíya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā kóō le yá jīla. Óndú a yá ka Usáyírɔ̄si kóō lɛ ɔ́da je, kóō klla lɛ ɔ́da ā tá tū ɔkpá, lɛ ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga odúúdú kú ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Abraham stood up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, even to the children of Heth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ébrahām cāŋjɛ, túkpɛɛ́ le ahínyá tá ācɛ kú Uhɛ́ti nēe wɛ ācɛ kú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā ā á.

eng_Latn: Son of man, speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude; Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, le ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ka: N lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbla awɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a lɔfú lɛ a glá ŋ.

eng_Latn: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́wá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú aókóome bá abɔ́ɔ, é bá gē lé ɔdolé ɛháajɛ ɛfu éyi abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
idu_Latn: A tū ɔcɔ́ɔkɔ gené-gené nōo lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka inu olɔfú kú Udéfīdi ā. Agbá ō tɔ̄ɔkɔ nōo playi awɔ ɔkɔ ā, le uwɔ yá héyīfuú bɛ̄ɛka ohéyīfuú kú aɔ́kplɛ́fú mɛ́mla aóbō alɛwa nēé kpó playi anú ā.

eng_Latn: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.
idu_Latn: N lɛ uwá ŋmó báajɛ, le ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gwū uwā béhé, é kē cāŋjɛ glá gɛ ŋ́. N le uwá yálé, é kē bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú um.

eng_Latn: And Israel journeyed, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le fu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī yɛ gɔbū, anɔ́ɔ ó le áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū cē kwu ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú inɔ̄ɔda kú Ɛ́da.

eng_Latn: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and the chapiter upon it was brass: and the height of the chapiter three cubits; and the wreathen work, and pomegranates upon the chapiter round about, all of brass: and like unto these had the second pillar with wreathen work.
idu_Latn: Aúpíla ɛpa ā gbla iyī uwā nɛ̄hi. Éyééye kú uwā wɛ ikpó ofu ce ahāapa, é kē le ogbló kú oje udɔ nēe wɛ ikpó ɛnɛ ce āyā kpó ce uwá. É klla kē le ijā kú ohépú kú ɔcí nēé hī ka upomégranēeti ā he tū aógbló ā kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá ɔda nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ í jɛ́yí nū glá ŋ́, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā idáagó alɛwa nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í gbo uwá áluka glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen, a great people, that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude.
idu_Latn: Ami klá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ ɛwa kú uwā í tōō gbaáluka ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛwa ā nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi lɛ ā cɛ̄ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si le ka lɛ ayíkpó kú nū kéē lɛ ɔ́kɔ éyi tútū lɛ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē lɔfú mɛ́ɛga wā ɛgiyí nū ajaajɛ ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé kōō ī lɛ ikpó da ɔ́ tāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē nya aá tá ā ma lɛ aá ícɛ nyā, ipú igelī nɛ̄ Udéfīdi ŋmá ā ɛɛ́! Anú ā wɛ Ohɔ́ɔnyɛtá, nōo wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon, even all these words that are written against Babylon.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔkpá tá lɛyíkwu ɛdɔ ífi ámíyā nōo gáā yá Ubábīlɔn ā, mla aɔ́dā ohile ɔhá ā lɛyíkwu Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
idu_Latn: Íne nōó bīya ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam bīya ā í jē ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ó klla nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gaá lɛ Ujésɛ̄bɛlu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Etibáalu, ɔcɛ́ kú Usídɔn lɛ. Ó klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɔwɔ nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
idu_Latn: Aá má igbō kú alɔ, ó kwɔ́lá gbɔɔgbɔ eko nɛ̄ alɔ gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ī wā ɛgiyí aá ā, amáŋ abālɔbányā ó kwū blínyī klla í témúká ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And said to the judges, Take heed what ye do: for ye judge not for man, but for the LORD, who is with you in the judgment.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ukɔ́ tū uwā kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá hɛ́pɔ̄. Aá gáā yúklɔ́ mla ɔfú mɛ́mla íkwu kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ íkwu kú Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū nɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kē í yɔ̄ mla aá eko nɛ̄ aá gē hɛ́pɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: So Jacob came to Luz, which is in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel, he and all the people that were with him.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá mla anú ā gā ajɛ Ulús nēé gē hī ka Ubɛ́tɛlu abālɔbányā, nōo yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan ā.

eng_Latn: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ á, Olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicɔ̄ kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ, ó yɔ̄ ipú okónu kú uwɔ mɛ́mla ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ. Ɔ́ɔmā wɛ olɛhɔ kú ɔtōōkpóce Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ tɔ́ɔna nū lɛ aá ā á.

eng_Latn: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah, though thou be little among the thousands of Judah, yet out of thee shall he come forth unto me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth have been from of old, from everlasting.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníí, Awɔ, Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m Éfrāta ipú ajɛ kú Ujudíya, nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú á ipú ajɛ kú Juda á, amáŋ anúɔ géē bī otrɛ̄yí ŋmá ipú uwɔ wā nōo géē leyīkwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Anú nɛ̄ ohútu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū gbɔɔ́ ŋmá eko nɛncɛ̄ kú íkííkée ā.

eng_Latn: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.
idu_Latn: ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm, ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄hi kú Idúmēya, ŋmá ajɛ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo yɔ̄ áklō kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan ā, é klla ŋmá ajɛ kú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Utáyi mɛ́mla Usidɔn. Odúúdú ācɛ nēé bá nyā pɛ̄ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si ohígbū ɔdā nēé pó ka ó yɔ̄ í yá ā.

eng_Latn: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ akpáabana tɛ̄hɔ̄ wāajɛ kóō lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ kpó fíyátátā. Lɛ ɔyī kú uwɔ tá kátáá lɛ uwá kóō lɛ uwá tɔ́ɔbīnya.

eng_Latn: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father; and he perceived not when she lay down, nor when she arose.
idu_Latn: Otú ɔ́ɔmā ā, é le yá ká ádā uwā kóō lɛ ejé gwá, anɔ́ɔ ɔyínɔ̄nyā aflɛ́yí kú nū ā gaá le gwutá mla anú á. Ulɔ́tu í jé eko nōó wā gaá gwutá mla anú klla cāŋjɛ ā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ejé lɛ ɔ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔcɛ́ kú Usólōmɔn ā, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ kpɔ Ujerúsālɛm bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā. Ɔcí kú usɛ́da klla kpɔ ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí nēé hī ka usíkāmɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya kwú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā ga ajɛ kú Asírīya dúúdú. Ó kwú uwá ú kpó gaá lā Uhála, Uhábɔ mɛ́mla okónu isú kú Ugósan mɛ́mla ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Umédesi.

eng_Latn: But now thy kingdom shall not continue: the LORD hath sought him a man after his own heart, and the LORD hath commanded him to be captain over his people, because thou hast not kept that which the LORD commanded thee.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ í gáā gɔbū piyóó ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, a tá kóō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō. Ó géē tíne ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōó dɔɔ̄kā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē tá ūwā bónū, ohígbū ka é jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Ó ka é géē pīya ācɛ o bɔ́lɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ ipú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Samuel also said unto Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint thee to be king over his people, over Israel: now therefore hearken thou unto the voice of the words of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usámūwɛ̄lu da Usɔ́lu ka, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ gāá lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ ɛyí kú ɔ̄ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu á. Ó klla da ɔ́ eko ɔ́ɔmā kú ɔ̄ jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mount: and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mount of Gilead.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu le áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū cē kwu ɛyí ɛfu éyi, Ulában mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū kē le ákú uwā cē kwu ɔlɛ́ ɛfu kú Ugílɛ̄di.

eng_Latn: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka é kōō lɛ okónu gwū nááná, ń gáā pó ikwū ō je kú otábɔ̄ kú uwā a ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē gwɛ́ɛya ō pá ɔlá dúúdú mɛ́mla ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dā ga um nááná, ó gáā he um ɔtū ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, n géē kpó uwá yíífi ɔgbɛ́fú mɛ́mla ōcē mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtā.

eng_Latn: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abɔ̄ íne nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú bīya ā le odúúdú ācɛ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā é le odúúdú ācɛ hɛ́tá ohígbū ka Ohɔ́nyɛtá le ucē okpaakpa yá, nōo yá ká ācɛ kéē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as if that were a very little thing, thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.
idu_Latn: Ucē ɛbí nɛ̄hi kú uwá nāa kpó abɔ̄ uwá ā í jɛ̄ uwɔ ŋ má. Amáŋ eko kpií awɔ ā klla gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ odúúdú uwā mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and speak unto them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ujeremíya, nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Urécābu ā hīgwú. Lɛ uwá bī wā ipú inu éyi kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú a lɛ ejé je lɛ uwá kéē gwá.

eng_Latn: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, ye see the man is mad: wherefore then have ye brought him to me?
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Ákisi gē da aígabɔ̄ kú nū ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ojɛɛ́lɛ́, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá bī ɔ̄ wā ɛgiyí um ā?.

eng_Latn: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
idu_Latn: Ulában da Ujékɔ̄pu kahíníī, Ɛcɔ̄ nēé tīkwū bá nyā géē wɛ ɔdōblatū alɔ ɛplɛ́ɛpa. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé hī iyē kú abɔ́ɔ ka Ugáliid á.

eng_Latn: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
idu_Latn: Ami yá onɔwá nōo gē yá ojúgā, ī nā aíyɛ́fú nɛ̄ ācɛ gē bī le kpɛ́fú ā á. Ami kē yá aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē bī aíyɛ́fú ā lɛ ŋmó ācɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: And Judah acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujúda le ɔdōcabɔ̄ ā jé á, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ó le um ɛpɔ̄hi lé nwuné nwuné, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń je ɔyí um, Usséla lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔbá nū ŋ́ mā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda í klla cikpó nū igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: What? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, saith he, shall be one flesh.
idu_Latn: Kɛɛ ka aá jé ŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōo kwú ɔkpíyē kú nū ú bɔ́há mla akwuna, le pīya ɔkpíyē ékpónú mla anú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔkpíihɔ ā ka péélúú kahíníī, Uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa géē je pīya ɔkpíyē ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
idu_Latn: Aá je eyī gicō má ɔkpáncō, ka aá klla pīyeyī má ɛcɛ. Ɔkpáncō géē mɛ tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ódūdū ā. Ɛcɛ kē ī je lé híla bɛ̄ɛka īlī ā. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú ɛcɛ ā í pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka iju ā. Amáŋ, n géē nya aá tá, ɔdā dúú í gáā yá aá gɛ ŋ́ piyōō. Okpaakpa kú um ī kē gáā mɛ gbogboō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach, both he, and Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.
idu_Latn: Ó klla je ɔfú lɛ anú mɛ́mla Oholíyābu, ɔyí kú Ahísamāki nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udán ā.

eng_Latn: Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.
idu_Latn: Ohépu ā mla abɔ̄ kú uwā, géē wɛ ugóolu ékpónú, nēé bī omútāgā na tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Ask ye now among the heathen, who hath heard such things: the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ̄kā da odúúdú aéwo ā, ɔ́dāŋ ka é pó ka éwo dóódu ɔ́ɔ yá ɛdɔ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ yá nyā jéjée ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
idu_Latn: abɔ̄ aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā bá ī gwííjē bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe ī gwíjē tɔ̄ɔhá āa, nɛ̄ odúúdú aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā klla bá ī tɔ́ɔga ohígbū éeyē ā?.

eng_Latn: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á. Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā le pɛ́ wā, amáŋ é má abɔ̄ igodó kwu ɔwɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɛlá ka Églɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī mlɛ́nyɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw thy sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔyípōklóbīya nōo bī iyɛ́fú kú nū ā koó le ɛ̄wā kú nū pi fíyaa kóō lɛ anúɔ ŋmó á. Ó ka anúɔ í tíne ka ācɛ kóō ka ka ɔ̄cɛnyā ɔ́ɔ ŋmó anúɔ ā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyípōklóbīya lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī gwū ó bēé, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éŋkpɔ̄ ā kwú yá yēŋēē ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā jāā kwu ícɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa ka, ka ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā ā le pīya ɔlɛɛcɛ, ó kē gā gaá lā mla alɔ. Ó yíihɔtū klla gbonɛnɛ nɛ̄hi. Anú kē ma Ɔwɔicō fú ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á. Alɔ má ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā. Ádā je ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi nyā lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū ka anú wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And now when the even was come, because it was the preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
idu_Latn: Ɛplá nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɛ̄cī Otútū ā, nōó klla wɛ ɛ̄cī nōo gbɔbū lɛ ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā.

eng_Latn: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude: her graves are round about him: all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword, though they caused their terror in the land of the living.
idu_Latn: Umɛ́sɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Utúbalu bá abɔ́ɔ, aúnóji kú odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ uwā yɛ uwá jīla abɔ́ɔ. É wɛ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, é kē kpó uwā ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú dúú. Amáŋ é tɛtɛ ī tū ācɛ nēe yēeyī ɛcɛ ā ufi.

eng_Latn: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔ́ɔmā ōfūnū ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō gē yá ká ālɔ̄ gwéeyē, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo yɔ̄ ī lɛ alɔ pīya aóklóbīya Ɔwɔicō ā yá ā.

eng_Latn: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
idu_Latn: N pó abɔ̄ aólɛlā kú um bá ī kɛlā lɛ īyī uwā ŋiniŋini. Aɔ́dā ōtūufi le yɛ um jīla tá ɛɛ́. É bā í yá ojuju klla ī tū ujɔ tū um, kéē kwú um ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Lɛ uwá nū inya ipú ícɔ̄nū kú uwɔ káā lɛ uwá kpó yíífi, ŋmá ajɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō wā í kpó aá tɔ̄ɔkwu ga ɔgbɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ámɔn.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
idu_Latn: Uféro da Ujékɔ̄pu ɔ̄kā kahíníī, A wɛ iháyí ɛmulá.

eng_Latn: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
idu_Latn: Ó gē pi owu kú nū, klla gē tá īlī kú nū abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the LORD God of Israel with all his heart: for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam, which made Israel to sin.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujéhu í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu mla odúúdú ɔtū kú nū ŋ́, ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ó gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Ujérobōwam bī nɛ̄ ó klla kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
idu_Latn: Oholibáma, Ɛ́la, Upínɔn.

eng_Latn: For my name's sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gē yá ɔdā okpaakpa ā, yá nɛ̄ ń cɔ̄nū tū aá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ má. N klla kē yɔ̄ ī yá kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra um ā nɛ̄ um gē kwú ícɔ̄nū kú um tū cíí, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú n kpó aá yífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le ucɛ yá lɛ uwá le Lé, le gwá.

eng_Latn: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled: I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú aá géē yēkwu, ɔcɛ́ ogbāajɛ ā í gáā lɛ eyīōce gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ ā géē bá ī fīyégbúlú ipú ufi. N géē je ōwē lɛ aá kú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá yá a. N géē kɛpɔ̄ tū aá, ɔwɛ ékpónú nɛ̄ aá kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ɔhá ā. Ɛ̄nyā géē mafú lɛ aá ka ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Óndú ā wā gaá kwú Asárīya, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Óbɛ́di ú.

eng_Latn: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ā, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tá tū ɔkpá gé um lɛyíkwu ije ō da gé lɛ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nēe bá Ujudíya ā. Aá kóō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da aícɔ́ɔci kú Ugalésīya kéē yá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he behold the good that I will do for my people, saith the LORD; because he hath taught rebellion against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka n géē yá Ussɛmáya ɔ̄cɛ Unehɛ́lam mɛ́mla ugbɛ kú nū italā pííí. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū í gáā wi ŋ́. Anú abɔ̄yī nū í gáā yēeyī má ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā nɛ̄ n géē yá lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā ŋ́. Ó í lɛ ā ohígbū koó lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ aá kú aá kóō yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá um.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and thou shalt bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
idu_Latn: Kwú utébulu ā ú wā inū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwu iyó kú nū ú kpó ce ɛyí nū. A géē je ɔdā ō lɛ agege ce ɔ́ ā wā inū, cɛ́ɛ́ aá klla kwú agege ā ú kpó ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá, alɔ lɔfú ga ajɛ éwɔhá iyɔ̄bū Ukɔ́rīnti gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā abɔ́ɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ híīī bī úklɔ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá yá ā gwō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king's princes, which have heard of the deed of the queen. Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ anyā kú aígabɔ̄ kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya ā lɛ ucē kú ɔcányā nyā pó, é géē bī ɔ̄ le yá aɔ́bá uwá okónu ŋmá ɔcɔ̄ɔ̄cī jāā gbótú eko dóódu. Anyā ā í klla gáā le ojīlīmā ce aɔ́bá uwá ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
idu_Latn: Icɛ̄bɔ̄ nēé gē yá ā, le um yá cɔ̄nū ɛɛ́. É le um yá ɔ̄cɛ o yɔ́bɔ́nyā ohígbū aɔ́wɔ kú uwā, aɔ́wɔ neé wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē bī éwo nōó lɔfú ŋ́ mā le yá uwā cɔ̄nū. N géē bī éwo kú aólíla le yá kéē má ímálānyī uwā.

eng_Latn: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
idu_Latn: Le ɔtū kú uwɔ pīyabɔ̄ ká ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ tíne eyōolɔhi kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Usámla ŋmá Umásréka le ɔcɛ́ lé gboce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
idu_Latn: A gē yíihɔtū ācɛ eko dóodu ga ayááyí uwā ɔ́muúlúúlā, amáŋ a cɛ̄ lɛ ayí gē móōwē ohígbū ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ aádā mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ́ uwā bī ā. Awɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo gbɛ klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi á. Iyē uwɔ kē le ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Joshua, Stretch out the spear that is in thy hand toward Ai; for I will give it into thine hand. And Joshua stretched out the spear that he had in his hand toward the city.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da Ujóssuwa kahíníi, Lɛ óbō kú uwɔ miya kwu Ái. N géē je ɔ́ ga uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ leyī gwō íne ā bónū ohígbū ka alɔ cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā mɛ́ɛnɛɛ? Ó lɛ ɔwɛ ŋ́! Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā alɔ í tū íne ā háyi.

eng_Latn: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
idu_Latn: Ó klla le da ɔ́ dúú, ɛdɔ kú oje ɔdɔ mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ̄, ugóolu mɛ́mla udɔ, nōó géē bī le yá iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla iyó kú ɛyí ede ā.

eng_Latn: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá yíhɔtū tá aólɛlā kú aá, aá yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ uwá. Aá lɛ ije kplá ācɛ, aá leyice kéē gbā ije ā cīgbīhi lɛ aá ŋ́. Ɔwɔicō géē gbā ulé nɛ̄hi lɛ aá. Aá kē géē je pīya ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ó gē yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ ācɛ nēé kōo gē tá ahínyá ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ācobɔ̄bíipú dúú.

eng_Latn: There is no straw given unto thy servants, and they say to us, Make brick: and, behold, thy servants are beaten; but the fault is in thine own people.
idu_Latn: É je ácí ihili lɛ alɔ gɛ ŋ́, nááná, é gē pi alɔ kú ālɔ̄ ma ubulɔ́kwu kpɔ́. É klla gē ŋmó alɔ ijē, unwalu nyā kē ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: About forty thousand prepared for war passed over before the LORD unto battle, to the plains of Jericho.
idu_Latn: Ipéyī Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ lɛ bɛ̄ɛka, úlā ofɛ̄hɔ ā, le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan mɛ́mla iyɔ́fú kú uwā ga ɔpɛ́ kú Ujérīko.

eng_Latn: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify God in the day of visitation.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ucē olɔhi ɛgiyí ācɛ nē é pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nēe lɛ ije ce bá aá, ka aá wɛ ācɛ ō yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, amáŋ eko nēé lɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ aá yá ā má, é géē mīyɛ cɛ̄ ka aá wɛ ācɛ olɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ é géē tá Ɔwɔicō ahínyá ɛ̄cī nōó géē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gēe hī anúɔ ka ɔbá nū, igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ó gáā hī anúɔ ka ubáal kú anúɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɛpla oje igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛnɔ í fíyajɛ gɛ ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ kwú dobū kpímm klá odúúdú ɛga dóódu jāā gbó oje ɛtá kú ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
idu_Latn: Ísu kwu cēenyi klá Ubábīlɔn ɛɛ́. Úgbagwú kú ísu ā kwú ɔ̄ u mulɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The Jews therefore strove among themselves, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka nyā, ācɛ Ujíyu gbɔɔ́ ō táafú mla iyī uwā kahíníī, Abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā ka anúɔ géē je ɔkpíyē kú nū lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ lé glá ā.

eng_Latn: He built Eloth, and restored it to Judah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
idu_Latn: Usíya mīyɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɛ́lāti ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe mīyɛ ɔ́ gbɔbū ā, le ɔ́ tú gwó ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kwúcē lɛ ācɛ kú Ujúda igbīhi ikwū kú Amásīya, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And at this house, which is high, every one that passeth by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why hath the LORD done thus unto this land, and to this house?
idu_Latn: Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā, gē je wúlatāajɛ klla í je tá alácɛ̄. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wā í yɛ, lɛ ɔ́ má géē tɔ́cɔ́ɔ, géē mī ɛyí jigijigi ka, Ɔdí yá nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ɛ̄nyā lɛyíkwu ajɛ nyā mɛ́mla Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā ā?.

eng_Latn: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú éwɔhá o pɔ́há ipú géē lā Ássidɔ̄du. Óndú ā kahíníī, N géē yá kú ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya gē yá ā kóō mɛ.

eng_Latn: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kē yɔ̄ mla ācocɛ̄lɔ̄wɔicō ā abɔ́ɔ ɔyā alɛwa.

eng_Latn: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
idu_Latn: N má gwutá agōdō kú n̄ mlɛ́nyɔ́, klla gbɛlá ka ɔnɔ kú um géē dē cē tū.

eng_Latn: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ iyē kú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Udéfīdi, nēe tá odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Udéfīdi abɔ̄ ipu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū, nēe klla le okwúukwu kwu ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā igbīhi ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā á.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísāka ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa ā géē bá ī gwéeyē, eko nēé má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú italā lɛ ā. É géē na ikpó kú uwā ipū oyī kú ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú nōo yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the fear of God was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that the LORD fought against the enemies of Israel.
idu_Latn: Éwo ɔhá dóódu nēe lɛ ɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá aólɛlā kú uwā lé lɛ ā pó, ufi gbo uwá ipú.

eng_Latn: God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō má cīce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū iyɔ̄bū kú ójīla kú aɔ́wɔ ā ɔkpáncō. Ipú ójīla kú aɔ́wɔ ā nɛ̄ ó gē hɛ́pɔ̄ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú kpɔ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ōcē ā le nyīla tū ɔ̄ ɔkpíyē. ó le lɛ ā, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya a géē ka ka ɔ́ le tēelihɔ ohígbū ka ipí ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ agwú.

eng_Latn: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a kwú eko kú uwɔ ú táajɛ lɛ iyɔ̄lā ō gbo, a géē gbɛhá. Yúklɔ́ eko dóódu, a géē lɛ ɔdōlé nɛ̄hi nāa í yɔ̄ ī lé.

eng_Latn: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
idu_Latn: Ujóbu, ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ a wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē bī ɛlā áncā mɛmla ɛlā ogwuda kú uwɔ le da um ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu íjééyī kú um āa?.

eng_Latn: And he shall set engines of war against thy walls, and with his axes he shall break down thy towers.
idu_Latn: Uwá géē je ɔdɔ kú aá ā ca tāajɛ mla oje, klla í je inɔ̄ɔda kú ɔlɛ́ ā wúla tāajɛ mla ogbló oje kú uwá a.

eng_Latn: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
idu_Latn: Ujéyuss mɛ́mla Ubérīya í ma ayí lɛwa ŋ́ ma, é lɛ uwá ka tɔ̄há ipɔ́ɔma ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, I cannot speak: for I am a child.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kahíníī, Woó Óndú ā! Awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, leyī yɛ ɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā má ɔ̄, a kē jé ka n wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nōó jé ō kɛlā dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, a lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nāa gē bī le tá ɔ́mpa uwɔ abɔ̄, ā da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ kɔ́ɔ̄ wā ɛ̄cī ɔhá, ka anúɔ je lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́. Kwú ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā ú lɛ ɔ́ bōōbū.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwa ohi kahíníī, E lɛ yá kú aá lɛyí ɔdā otayínū kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā jé. Amáŋ ācɛ o hile nēe bá iyɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, Ita nēé gē bī le jé ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aípɔ́ɔma nēe bá ā ŋmá iyē kú Ísɔ.

eng_Latn: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army, and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent, and with earth upon his head.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn, kwinya ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā jāā ga Ussílo ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ō ma ɔtūnōbí kú nū fú ā, ó lɛ úmúlá gwu klá ɛyí, lɛ īlī kú nū híla.

eng_Latn: And David was greatly distressed; for the people spake of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters: but David encouraged himself in the LORD his God.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi yɔ̄ ipú ákanya nɛ̄hi. Ohígbū ka ɔtū yɔ̄ í wú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū nɛ̄hi ohígbū ayí uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwā nēé je kpó ā. É le tútū kéē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá Udéfīdi. Amáŋ, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū le ɔ́ ɔtū tú kwu ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Then I sent unto him, saying, There are no such things done as thou sayest, but thou feignest them out of thine own heart.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unehemíya ka anúɔ da ɔ́ ka odúúmā kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī ka ā í wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ŋ́. Ka anú yɔ̄ ī kɛlā ā abɔ̄yī nū á.

eng_Latn: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ, é géē wā í kwú um bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā, é géē je um ga ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í yɔ̄ ŋ́ mā, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú um yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ágábá gē je ɛbɛ́ fā lé ā.

eng_Latn: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá kwu Ujísɔ̄si ojigóógó, anú nōo yá ɔ̄ tɔ́ɔtɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla o yɔ̄ ī kpɔ́tūce ɔ́ ŋmá eko nɛ̄ alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ā jāā gaajaajɛ. Ó cɔ̄nyā ohígbū ikwū kú ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá nōó gáā kwú ā ŋ́. Ikoko ɔ́ɔmā ohígbū éeyē nōó gáā gwó ā, ó gbɛlá kóō wɛ ɔdūwēyī kú anúɔ gekwú ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā ó cīce abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Joseph of Arimathaea, an honourable counsellor, which also waited for the kingdom of God, came, and went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu ɔ̄cɛ Arimatéya gā. Ó wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ipú ācohɛ́pɔ̄, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yīnū gē leyīce oōwā kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ó leyī hɔ́lá le yɛ tá ɛgiyí Upáyílēti gaá da ɔ́ kóō kwú okwū kú Ujísɔ̄si ú lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
idu_Latn: Aá géē jé ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nēe wɛ ɛ́béelihɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ o le yēŋēē. Aá kóō híī lé aɛ́bɛ́ ámāŋ ka aígbáanɔ nēe wɛ ɛ́béelihɔ lɛ aá ŋ́. N le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka é wɛ ɛ́béelihɔ lɛ aá. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le odóódu kú uwā lé géē je tēelihɔ.

eng_Latn: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tíne ɛlā ɔ́mpā nū ā cē ɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ gbɔɔ́ gɛcɛ, ka, Ɔ̄nyɛ yá uwɔ otrɛ̄yí ámāŋ ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ kú alɔ ā?.

eng_Latn: But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth, which I have heard of God: this did not Abraham.
idu_Latn: N gē da aá ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n pó ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā, amáŋ aá gē tíne ká aá lɛ um ŋmó. Ébrahām í gáā yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í miya ɔwá kú ɔkpáncō glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó í bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í jīla etikpa kú ɛcɛ glá ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā í gáā tá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́ má, nááná nēé le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá ā.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. N da iyī um ka n̄ cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka oŋmífī nɛ̄ anúɔ nya ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá klla kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā, ka anúɔ í lā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ó klla ka ka abɔ̄ anúɔ húmāyī ī yɛ ŋmá ɛga éyi ga ɛga ɔhá ā, ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ nɛ̄ anɔ́ɔ húmāyī lā á.

eng_Latn: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the LORD by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of the LORD, to offer the burnt offerings of the LORD, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóyāda kwú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla ayí kú Ulífāyi ú kpó tū úklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. É gē bá ī yúklɔ́ nɛ̄ Udéfīdi je lɛ uwá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É klla bá gē gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā ō yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka lɛ ā. É klla géē wɛ ācogwíijē mɛ́mla ācɛ o gwō ɔdā ō bī gwííjē lɛ Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: But I am poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n yɔ̄ ipú ɔnɔ mla ákanya nɛ̄hi, kwú um ú gicō Ɔwɔicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Umósīsi le cɔ̄nū mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā.

eng_Latn: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
idu_Latn: Kú aá bī ɔtū ɔ̄mɔ́tū kú ihɔtū le hokónu tū iyī aá. Odúúdú icɔ́ɔci kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ī hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔnɛ̄ ā, ígwu kú ɛwá ɔkpá nɛ̄hi le wu wā gáā klá ajɛ, le mu ɛga dóódu kú ɛga nēé cē áklɔ̄kpɛ ce ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā, ébú nɛ̄hi le ce le uwá yɛ jīla tá.

eng_Latn: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēé lɔfú ipú ɔtū nēé kpóce ā ŋ́ mā, aá híī táafú mla uwá lɛyíkwu ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ é cíkā ō yá ŋ́ mā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā í je éyi kú uwā gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya, ɔhá ā wɛ ɛya o yɔlá ā. Ó kē í je ɔhá gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó bī ɔwɛ nyā le uculo kú iyē ō gwu ā yá kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko gē wā, nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu kú ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aádáádā uwɔ tɛtɛ kpó tū ā, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé bī eyī kú uwá má ā, é géē je uwa kpó ga ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē gbɛlá ka uwá ɔ́ɔ lɔhi fíyɛ́ Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ, ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu ā á nɛɛ? Ó je unwalu lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́. Ó je unwalu lɛ uwá kóō jé ēē?.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the men of Succoth, Give, I pray you, loaves of bread unto the people that follow me; for they be faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā Usúkɔ̄tu ā, ó da ācɛ abɔ́ɔ kéē kócōō lɛ igbō je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ kéē lé. Ka ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ uwā, anúɔ yɔ̄ ī nū Usɛ́ba mɛ́mla Usálumúna, aɔ́cɛ́ kú Umídiya ā inya.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto the man of God, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give thee a reward.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ka ɔ́ɔ wā ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla anúɔ kóō gaá lɛ ɔdōlé lé, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ géē lɛ ulé kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā cíla anú.

eng_Latn: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Uhɛ́brɔn ā, ó le anyā nōo ī cikpó uwā mɛ́mla anyā ɔhá lɛ tū aɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ lɛ ā Ujerúsālɛm. É kē ma ayí alɛwa ɔhá lɛ Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And all the people of Judah took Azariah, which was sixteen years old, and made him king instead of his father Amaziah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū nōo wɛ iháyí igwɛ́ɛhīlī ā ú lé ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.
idu_Latn: Óbɛ̄di wɛ ádā kú Ujɛ́si, Ujɛ́si wɛ ádā kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD's house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ā, é géē tá tū áma nōo playi ɔŋgbá kú aɔ́nya ā kahíníī, É le ɛ̄nyā yá tīihɔ lɛ Óndú ā. Aɛ́tɛ́ kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā géē tīihɔ bɛ̄ɛka ocíbú kú ɛyí ede kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā dúú.

eng_Latn: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ je ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ glá ā? N táafú ŋ́ ayíka alelékwū kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ. Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ōfōōfūnū jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā nēe háyi pī ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá kú Ujísɔ̄si ā wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú ɛ́nɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā, Umerí nōo wɛ ɔnyā Uklópāsi, mɛ́mla Umerí Umagidalíni.

eng_Latn: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ayíkpó kú nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, ācɛ Ujíyu tíne kéē tá ɛcɔ̄ klá uwɔ eko kpiíí nōo yɛ ā, a klla tíne ká ā nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɔ̄ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ í cíkā ō lɛ odée klá ɛyí ŋ́, ohígbū keé yá ɔ̄ gbla Ɔwɔicō, ó klla kē í ma ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō fú.

eng_Latn: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of the LORD: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of the LORD, to repair the breaches of the house,
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kóō le da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ kwú ije ā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ kú oōgllayá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī le gbā ulé lɛ.

eng_Latn: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph's house; for he was yet there: and they fell before him on the ground.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujúda mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū wā ɔlɛ́ Ujósɛ̄fu ā, ó yɔ̄ inu kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ nū, Oholíba, má ɔdā nōo yá Ohóla ā, ó yɛce ucē obɔ̄bí kú nū ɔ́ɔmā kpɔ́. Anū klla bɔ̄bí ipú únwū ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla akwuna oōyá fíyɛ́ Ohóla á.

eng_Latn: A just weight and balance are the LORD's: all the weights of the bag are his work.
idu_Latn: Óndú dɔɔ̄kā kú ɔdā o le miya odée mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé miya ā kóō le kpaakpa, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō híī pīya ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tū ipú ɔ́hí ō tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, and in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet, which was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of the LORD, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ipú iháyí ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā nōo wɛ iháyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nɛ̄ Usedekíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Uhananíya, ɔyí kú Ássɔ, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ́ nōo ŋmá Ugíbeyɔn ā, lɛ ɛlā da um ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Ipééyī ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ ā, ó da um kahíníī.

eng_Latn: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā gē yá kú ɔwɔ kóō límanya.

eng_Latn: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi ōhī wā ɛgiyí nū gaá já ɔ̄ má kahíníī, Íne kú alɔ jɛga lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔdā dúúmā tá ɔnyā nū ū.

eng_Latn: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
idu_Latn: Awɔ a yá ɔdā dóódu nōo yēeyī á, ofíyajɛ kú uwɔ gē cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ gē mɛ́ɛbɛ á.

eng_Latn: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔyíkpó nōo gē cījáalí kú ɔdā nēe bá á, nōo klla tá ɔdā nēe bá ā tāajɛ á. Alɔ jé ka ijáalí kú nū wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ odúúdú ɔdā ōhídáagó nēe bá nyā kpó yá ipéyī Uféro, amáŋ Óndú ā le ɔtū kú Uféro yá lɔfú kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ ā ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And she, being before instructed of her mother, said, Give me here John Baptist's head in a charger.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū lɛ ɔ́ tokónu ā, ɔyípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ikpɛ̄yí kú Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim ú tá ɔkplá ká ā kwú gā um amānyā ā.

eng_Latn: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā lɔfú da iyī nū ka ɔkpani anúɔ í gáā kwúcē wā fíya ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmá ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā ohile ijē á. Ó lé ɔdōlé, gwá ejé, ejé kē kwú ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Also we made ordinances for us, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí dóódu, ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú alɔ géē cíla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ tū ipú ɛgbá kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear not:
idu_Latn: Aá jāhɔ̄, aólíla mɛ́mla aɔ́dāhá. Aá nēe lɛ eyī nááná, nēé mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́ mā. Aá nēé lɛ ahɔ̄ nááná nēé pó ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And our hope of you is stedfast, knowing, that as ye are partakers of the sufferings, so shall ye be also of the consolation.
idu_Latn: Alɔ lɔtūce aá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, alɔ jé ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá má ɛdɔ ōwē ékpó nɛ̄ alɔ má ā, Ɔwɔicō kē í tú aá ɔtūlé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tú alɔ ɔtūlé ā dúú.

eng_Latn: So the Philistines were subdued, and they came no more into the coast of Israel: and the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines all the days of Samuel.
idu_Latn: É le ācɛ kú Ufílīstiya yálé, anɔ́ɔ é klla lɛ ɔtū nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tū ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu igbɔhá gɛ ŋ́, odúúdú eko nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu yēeyī ā, ohígbū ka Óndú í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ka, Ɔwɔicō kóō cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le yálé ŋmá Usáyɔn. Ɔtū géē he ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē je odúúdú agbénú kú uwā kwúcē igbīhi lɛ uwá kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
idu_Latn: Ubɛ́njamīn ma ayí ɛtá. É wɛ, Ubéla, Ubéka mɛ́mla Ujedíyɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: He offered for his offering one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ocíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ ogbɛnú kú nū géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofu ɛhīlī ce igwó ā. Ogbānjɛ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ogbɛ́nú kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú usɛ́kɛlu ofɛtá ce igwó á. odúúdu nū wɛ oōmu mla umu nēé lɛ anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
idu_Latn: Ujúda, Ubénjamīn, Ussɛmáya mɛ́mla Ujeremíya.

eng_Latn: And six branches going out of the sides thereof; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ābɔ̄ ɛhīlī nēe nyīla ŋmá áklō kú nū, ɛtá ŋmá ābɔ̄ éyééye ā.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Óndú cāŋjɛ, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ ō nōo héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā, ó klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ejé le ɔ́ kwú amáŋ nɛ̄ ejé gbɔɔ́ ō cá ŋmá ɔ́ eyī ā.

eng_Latn: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
idu_Latn: Aá le jí ɛɛ́, aítíca kú íne mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi, aá nēe leyīɛpa, aá yɛ gla ísu ipú ajɛ áncā kú aá lɛ ɔyíkpó éyi lɛ, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā, aá lɛ ɔ́ yá kóō le pīya ɔyí kú ɔlíkɔtɔ ɔ́klɛ́ɛpa fíyɛ́ aá ā.

eng_Latn: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Alelékwū Ihɔ ā wā gaá gbɔɔ́ ō bī aá tá eko nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō āā? Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ehée, alɔ í kōō pó ka ɔdée lé ka Alelékwū Ihɔ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
idu_Latn: Ojéeyī gē kɛlā kú íjééyī, amáŋ aólíla gē kɛlā nɛ̄ ó lɛyí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Jesus answered them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whosoever committeth sin is the servant of sin.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi n da aá ka, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ íne kú Ɔwicō bīya, wɛ ɔfiyɛ kú ínoōbīya.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú uwɔ kwú aɛ́nɛ́ alɛwa í pīya ɔdɔma ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ géē je pīya ɔdɔma lɛ dúú á. Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu le Ágāgi ŋmó, le ɔ́ hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́ ipéyī Óndú ā Ugíligalu á.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
idu_Latn: É tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ipú Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m kú Ujudíya. Ohígbū ka ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā tá tāajɛ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n géē bī ɛ̄ngwū le gwíijē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
idu_Latn: Ó klla í kpó īlī kú uwá flēflē nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē má iyē kú uwā bū ɔ̄ɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla adíko o le bī abɔ̄ kú uwá, mɛ́mla īlī o le gbō onyígōgōlō mɛ́mla adíko ōlīkpō kú uwá nēé gē le klá eyī ā.

eng_Latn: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God, and without a teaching priest, and without law.
idu_Latn: Iháyí alɛwa nyā Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi ā ŋ. Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya í yɔ̄ ɛɛ́ nōo gē nwū uwá odée ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nēé gē le íne kú Ɔwɔicō tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Draw ye near hither, all the chief of the people: and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē wā kú aá lɛ ɔkwu íne kú Óndú ā nēé bīya ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā bu.

eng_Latn: Let his heart be changed from man's, and let a beast's heart be given unto him; and let seven times pass over him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka iháyí ahāapa ā, ó gáā lɛ ohílīpú kú ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́, amáŋ ákú ɛbɛ́ kú ipácí nɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
idu_Latn: A yɛ bū ipú ɛcɛ mla ícɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, a le ikpó da aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā tāajɛ kwɛɛ́kwɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, From a very far country thy servants are come because of the name of the LORD thy God: for we have heard the fame of him, and all that he did in Egypt,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ē da Ujóssuwa kahíníī, Alɔ ŋmá ɛga oligbó nɛ̄hi éyi. Alɔ kē pɛ́ wā ohígbū ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ lóofu lɛ ā. Alɔ kē klla pó ɔdā dóódu nɛ́ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwā yá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
idu_Latn: É géē yɔ̄ gē kahíníī, Ujísɔ̄si cokónu ka anúɔ géē kwúcē wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā. Iní nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā. O ŋmífi ɔ́ɔmā aádáádā alɔ le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā dóódu lɛ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ā, nēé kē lɛ kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ má.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, eko nōó le pīya iháyí úlā ɛpa ce ofɛhɔ̄ ce igwɛ́ɛpa ā á.

eng_Latn: So David went up thither, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le tá abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla anyā nū ɛpa ā. Iyē anyā ā wɛ Ahínōwam nōo ŋmá Ujɛsiríli ā, mɛ́mla Abígɛ̄ɛlu, ɔnyā ōkwūma Unábalu nōo ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
idu_Latn: Alɔ alɛɛcɛ gē miya aɔ́dā nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá ā táajɛ ipú ɔtū kú alɔ, amáŋ ɛlā okpaakpa nōo ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá okónu kú ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā nɛɛ n.

eng_Latn: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā bī ɔtābɔ̄ kú nū le miya odúúdú éŋkpɔ̄ kú itekwú glá āa? Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ī lɛ ayíkābɔ̄ kú nū miya ɔkpáncō glá āa? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā je umla kú odúúdú ajɛ kú ɛcɛ nyā kpó tū ipú íkókwū ékpónú glá ā. Ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā je aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛnɛ̄hi kpó ce ɔdā ole mīya ɔdā le miya ogbɛnú kú uwā glá āā?.

eng_Latn: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels, and the Ammonites a couching place for flocks: and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je igelī nēé hī ka Urába ā kpó pīya ɛga o kpó aínyankwūlūmī gaá lúlé, klla í je odúúdú ajɛ kú Ámɔn pīya ɛga o kpó aálá gaá lúlé. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges, but they went a whoring after other gods, and bowed themselves unto them: they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in, obeying the commandments of the LORD; but they did not so.
idu_Latn: Nááná ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā ŋ́ kpɔ́. É klla gbā Óndú ā kpaakpa ŋ́ kpɔ́. É klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā kpɔ́. Ádáádā uwā lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā, amáŋ uwá nēe wɛ ayááyí uwā igbīhi uwā ā, tá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē je iyī nū tá ipú ikpɛ́la nɛ̄ ó wɛ ɛlā nū ŋ́, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē nyɔ̄ í kwú ewō nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ úláyi ahɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And ye shall do as I have done: ye shall not cover your lips, nor eat the bread of men.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ohígbū ikwū kú ɔnyā um ā. Aá gáā lɛ īlī klá okónu, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lé ɔdōlé nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe yēkwu gē lé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
idu_Latn: Osíya ma Ujɔ́tam, Ujɔ́tam ma Áhāsi, Áhāsi kē ma Uhesekíya.

eng_Latn: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gwó ɔlɛ́ nū ce ɛyí ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nōo licó fíyɛ́ dúú ā. Ó klla ī lɛ ogéné kú ɛfu ā yá ɛga nōó ī tayínū.

eng_Latn: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō í gáā pó ɔkɔ kú nū eko nɛ̄ unwalu ga nōó gē jikwū kú otábɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú éŋkpɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ ɔjá ā ú pīya tū ipú ɔdā ō lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ gwá fíyaa. Ó klla le inya kwu ga obugā ā kpɔ́ gaá le éŋkpɔ̄ hɛ́ le bī wā í pīya tū ɔ̄ lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ ā kpɔ́. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nōó le kpó éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú aínyankwūlūmī ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō híī yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋmá amu ga ánū ŋ́. Aá cīījáalí nōo géē nya ɔ̄cɛ nēé yɔ̄ gē kɛpɔ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ō ŋmó tū ɔ̄ ā tá. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́mɔfu céyi ā wɛ Ujakín, ɔ́mofu cɛpa wɛ Ugámulu.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when the judge was dead, that they returned, and corrupted themselves more than their fathers, in following other gods to serve them, and to bow down unto them; they ceased not from their own doings, nor from their stubborn way.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí ā gekwú, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā gē kwúcē ga ɔwɛ nɛ̄ńcɛ̄ kú uwā ā kpɔ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ é klla gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ otɛtɛ nēé yá ā. É gē bá ī pā aɛ́cí kú aéwɔhá. É gē mā ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú uwā tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā mīyɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā, ó kwú pīya ɔ̄cɛ nēé yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄. Ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā le yɛ, ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ga ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because the LORD hath loved his people, he hath made thee king over them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya le ɔkpá tá fu Usólōmɔn kahíníī, Ohígbū abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú uwɔ ú ce ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee, knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say.
idu_Latn: N cɛ̄ ka a géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ n da awɔ ā, abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tɔ́kpá nyā fu uwɔ ā. N kōō jé ka a kē í yá fíyɛ́ ɛ̄nɛ̄ n ka gā awɔ āa.

eng_Latn: So that none of the remnant of Judah, which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall escape or remain, that they should return into the land of Judah, to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return but such as shall escape.
idu_Latn: Odúúmā kú ācɛ Ujúda nēe hile, nēe kwu gā Íjīpiti í lā ā í gáā wi ŋ́. Odúúmā kú uwá í gáā hile oyēeyī nōo géē kwúcē ga ajɛ kú Ujúda ŋ́. Ajɛ Ujúda nōo ŋmó uwá unwū ō nyɔ̄ í lā ɔ́ɔmā, é gáā nyɔ̄ ŋ́, ayíka olígíí kú uwá nēe í wi ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nāa géē gwutá bobóó gaá kwu ā, oyújulu? Eko nyá nɛ̄ aá géē héyī ŋmá iyɔ̄lā ā?.

eng_Latn: For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not.
idu_Latn: Ó gbɛlá ka ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ géē bī anúɔ le hɛ́ uwā tá nɛ̄, amáŋ uwá í jé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of Tahtimhodshi; and they came to Danjaan, and about to Zidon,
idu_Latn: É yɛ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla Ukádess ipú ajɛ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti Anɔ́ɔ é le tá Udáni á. É ŋmá Udáni yɛ biílí ga Usídɔn.

eng_Latn: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ a le má ka Umósīsi ɔ́ɔ le gbojī kóō wāajɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ā, é le iyí uwā túbá ɛgiyí Árɔ̄ni. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ í jé ɔdā nōo yá Umósīsi nyā, nōo kpó alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā lɛ ɔwɔ éyi yá lɛ alɔ kóō gbō alɔ. Canjɛ ka a lɛ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá yá lɛ alɔ. Ohígbū ka Umósīsi nōo bī alɔ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti a, alɔ i je ɛga nōo yɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul unto his servants, Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, that I may go to her, and enquire of her. And his servants said to him, Behold, there is a woman that hath a familiar spirit at Endor.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da aígabɔ̄ kú nū kéē lɛ ɔnyā nōo ī gwɛ́ɛbā éyi tíne lɛ anúɔ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ka ɔnyā éyi yɔ̄ ajɛ kú Ɛ́ndɔ.

eng_Latn: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Eko okpaakpa ā le yá ɛɛ́, eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē cɔɔcɛ́ ipú ɛcɛ nyā dúúdú ā le yá ɛɛ́! Aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī bīya ā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá cɛ̄ ɔkōōlɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū géē je aá tóohɛ́ɛwa klá í kpó uwēyī tū aá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
idu_Latn: Ami je ɔ́da lɛ ísu nɛ̄hi kóō je ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ, ka n klla í je aísu nēe ī pɛ́ tū ɔ̄ ā ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
idu_Latn: eko nēé tayínū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ kú uwá bā ī gbēyī āa?.

eng_Latn: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdú nū ga iyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā, ɛga oyēŋēē nēé gē pīya ewo bónū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó yɔlá ɛyí ɛfɔ́lá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ nāŋ́daa kwú ɔdā dóódu nōó lɛ ā yíífi ka á má ɔ̄. Ó géē ka atufú ga uwɔ ipéyī uwɔ cāā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
idu_Latn: Ɔdí ī yá ā? Ohígbū kéē kwú ɔtū kú uwā í kpó ce ɔdā nēe í yɔ̄ ī yá ā ikɔkɔ ō kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō. É le ikpó gbo ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nōo tá ɔwɛ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ācɛ ajɛ ā nēe tɛtɛ lā ajɛ ā nū bɛ̄cɛ, abɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū bá ī wā ā, ó lɛ ajɛ kú uwā ā kɔ́ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu, klla kwú ɔlɛ́ uwā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: For I am the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami, Óndú ā, géē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n tíne ā. Ó kē í yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ n ka ā bōōbū. Ó lɛ eko ō kpó bónū gɛ ŋ. Da ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú ɔ́ɔmā ka eko kú uwā nēé yēeyī nyā, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ami Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka ā, n géē yá ɔ̄. Abɔ̄ ami Óndú ā ka lɛ á.

eng_Latn: The men of Bethel and Ai, an hundred twenty and three.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla ayí uwā wɛ, ofɛhīlī ce ɛtá.

eng_Latn: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ɔtū he uwá. Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Udéfīdi nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā yá ā he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó odúúdu ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nyā lɛ Óndú ā klla í gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya mɛ́mla ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
idu_Latn: a lɛ ɔwɔ tū klá ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, a le ɔgba ɛhɔ̄ mu mla éŋkpɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi. A klla le yá ka ɔwɔ kóō le yā fū ajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ajɛ kóō le wī, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō jɛ̄ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
idu_Latn: A tá odúúdú ācɛ nēe tá kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne kú uwɔ ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá jé lɛ ā, ula kú uwā dóódu ā wɛ áncā nɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ alɔ le pɛ́ tá ipú úgbéenyi kú Adramítiyɔm nōo gáā nyɔ̄ okónu ísu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí nēe bá ɔ́kɔŋgɔ̄ kú Ésīya ā, alɔ gbɔɔ́ mɛ́mla Arístākɔsi, ɔ̄cɛ Umasɛdónīya nōo ŋmá Utesalónīka.

eng_Latn: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́mɛtá ā kē kwú ɔnyā ā ɔnyōkwū dúú. Ɔdā ékpónú ā yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ayínɛ́ ahāhílahāapa ā á. É le pɛ́ gekwú dúúdú í ma ayí dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu le túbá jīla anú tá. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Eko nyá nāa géē bī ɔtū kú alɔ plicō gaá kwu ā? Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá á nɛɛ, da alɔ pélúú.

eng_Latn: And they ran and fetched him thence: and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
idu_Latn: É le inya kwu gaá le Usɔ́lu bī wɛ̄ɛcɛ gé lɛ ācɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é má ka anú ɔ́ɔ jɛ̄ fíyɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ nēe jīla abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó lɛ iyī nū tū cíí lɛ ɔbá nū glá ŋ́ mā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo klla leyī gwō ɛka nɛ̄ ó gbo iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ā bónū ā.

eng_Latn: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um géē nyɔ̄ gbɔbū uwɔ ká n̄ yɔ̄ ī bī uwɔ jé ɔwɛ. N géē cīla aɛ́fu dóódu tū mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū uwɔ. N géē ca aódūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ kú oje udɔ ā bónū. N klla í je oje ogblógbló nēé le gwū aódūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ ā kpó hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́ bónū.

eng_Latn: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram's wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
idu_Latn: Utéra kwú Ébram, ɔyí nū mɛ́mla Ulɔ́tu, ɔyí kú Uháran, ɔyí nū, mɛ́mla Usárāyi, ɔnyā ɔyí nū, ú. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ tɔ̄há ŋmá Ɔ́ɔru kú ācɛ Ucáldii, kéē ga ajɛ kú Ukénan á. Amáŋ eko néē gā Uháran ā, é má lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́lɛ́ kú Udíbɔn a, ísu kú uwá kwú pīya oyī, náaná, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔdā obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi nōo fíyɛ́ ɛnya a tútū yɔ̄ ī gbēyī uwa kpɔ́. Ācɛ dúúmā nēe hile Umówābu a, é gēe je uwá kpó ŋmó bónū.

eng_Latn: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Upihahírɔ̄tu bū ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ísu ā gā ipú ígbíli kú Ussɔ́ru ā eko nēé le iyāwu yɛ ɛ̄cī ɛtá ā, é gaá lā Umára.

eng_Latn: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of God, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Amásīya tá kóō jāhɔ̄, ohígbū ka Óndú ā le tútū kóō kwú ɔ̄ ú yíífi ohígbū ɛcí kú ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm nɛ̄ ó kpó wā ɔlɛ́ gē pā ā.

eng_Latn: Then the Pharisees went out, and held a council against him, how they might destroy him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ufárisīi ā le tá ɛcɛ gaá lɛ ujɔ̄ tū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē ŋmó Ujísɔ̄si ā á.

eng_Latn: Howbeit, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ayíkpó ā le jīla pīya anú tá ā, ó cāŋjɛ, le tá igelī ā. O ŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, anú mla Ubánābasi le yɛ tá Udábi.

eng_Latn: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
idu_Latn: A géē kwú ɛyí ɛfu ɔ́ɔmā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ̄ uwɔ Árɔ̄ni kwú ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Íjīpiti, ācɛ Ujúda, ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm, ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri, ācɛ Umówābu, mɛ́mla ācɛ éwo éyi nēe lā ipú ígbíli, nēe gē wá ákló kú ɛyí kú uwā tāajɛ dúúdú ā, wɛ ɛdɔ̄ ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā. Odúúdú aéwo nēe bá nyā, í hɛ́ apī tū um ohígbū ka é lɛbɛ̄ɛka, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, ɔtū kú uwā í pīyabɔ̄ nēé ī lɛyítāajɛ lɛ ɛka kú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aɛ́cí, aá mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ a gēe yá ā wɛ áncā. Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo ka anúɔ gē gbā aá ā, gē tīihilɛ bɛ̄ɛka aá.

eng_Latn: Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ géē ka ka eyī yá aá kú ɛfu kóō le wúla klá aá! Ká ɛfu kóō lɛ aá kpó tayínū ipú nū.

eng_Latn: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá ā, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā tútū á.

eng_Latn: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ajɛ kú Unáfutāli, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ɛ́frem, Umanásɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ujúda a jāā gaá kwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ísu kú Umeditārénīya ā.

eng_Latn: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá nyā le tá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn klla le tútū ō je ɔ́ cɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú Ísrɛ̄lu. Odúúdú ācɛ ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā cɛ̄ lɛ ā dúú.

eng_Latn: For he that is not against us is on our part.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka, ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɔ́ɔ wɛ olɛlā kú aá ŋ́, kē wɛ ɔya kú aá.

eng_Latn: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ géē je odo kú eyīnyinyi mɛ́mla ákú ɔkɔ ōgbā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔhá kú Ujerúsālɛm ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nēé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé le ɛ̄wā gwō ɔ̄ ŋmó ɔ̄ ga ɔlékwū ā má, nɛ̄ ó géē tū uwā eyīnyinyi. É géē jikwū nū klla í yēkwu kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yēkwu kú ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ékpónú kú nū ā. É géē jikwū klla í tɛ̄gíkwū nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔyí aflɛ́yí kú nū gekwú ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the LORD: for men abhorred the offering of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ínoōbīya kú ayí kú Ɛ́lāyi ā kwú nwuné ɛgiyí Óndú ā ɛɛ́. É le ojīlīmā ce ɛya nēé gē gwó lɛ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said, Who made thee a prince and a judge over us? intendest thou to kill me, as thou killedst the Egyptian? And Moses feared, and said, Surely this thing is known.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ je uwɔ yá ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ō kɛpɔ̄ kú alɔ āa? A dɔɔ̄kā ō ŋmó um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ Íjīpiti ā dúú nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi gbɔɔ́ ō yúufi klla gbɔɔ́ ō da iyī nū kahíníī, Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá ā, ācɛ lɛ ɔ́ jé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
idu_Latn: Nwū uwā aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā a, tú uwā ɔtū kwu ɔtū kú ā bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ikwu kú uwɔ lɛ dɛ̄gba tū uwā. Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā leyi gwó uwɔ bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he said unto the elders, Tarry ye here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá gbēyī alɔ amanyā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ pīyɛyí. Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Uhɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ amanyā mla aá, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ ɛpɔ̄ dúúmā kóō nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí uwā.

eng_Latn: And the angel of God, which went before the camp of Israel, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā, nōo húmáyī gbɔbū lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, le yɛ gaá yɔ̄ igbīhi uwā. Ɔ́kpa kú ɔlá ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá iyɔ̄bū le tá igbīhi.

eng_Latn: Then the king's countenance was changed, and his thoughts troubled him, so that the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees smote one against another.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ɔcɛ́ ā kwú pīya ɔhá, ɔtū kú nū kwú gbogodo nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nōo cɛ̄ le okwúukwu kú nū gbɔɔ́ ō fiyégbúlú kpáákpá.

eng_Latn: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.
idu_Latn: N kwú abɔ̄ kú um nāndaa gicō yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, n cɛgbá uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ajɛ oŋmókókó cɛgbá éŋkpɔ̄ ɔwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si le jé ka ula nēé yɔ̄ ī yá á, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā, ɔnyɛ jé ɔtū kú Óndú ā, Ɔnyɛ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī gbɛlá? Ɔ̄nyɛ jé odée jɛ̄ nōo nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā ā.

eng_Latn: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī nwū ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī tá ɔ̄ tónū ŋmá ipú ɔtū kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and smote off his ear.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā éyi kú ipú ācɛ nēe bá mla Ujísɔ̄si ā lɛ ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú nū pi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ gɔ́ ɔfiyɛ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɔ́ ahɔ̄ éyi hɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also, neither would he let the people go.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Uféro le ɔtū kú nū yá lɔfú kpɔ́. Ó cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nyɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And seekest thou great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, saith the LORD: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, a yɔ̄ í tíne ɔ̄dā nɛ̄hi lɛ īyī uwɔ kpɔ́ nɛɛ? Ā yá lɛ ā ŋ́. N géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ yíífi. Amáŋ awɔ ā, ɛga dóódu nɛ̄ a nyɔ̄, ń gáā cɛ̄ kéē ŋmó uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
idu_Latn: Anú je aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ayí aflɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ́ kpó ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
idu_Latn: O ŋmá lɛ ɔtōōce ó lā bɛ̄ɛka ugbɔga ā ajɛ nēé cokónu lɛ ɔ́ kóō lā ā. Ó lā ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ mɛ́mla Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu, ācɛ nēe wɛ aólúgwū mla anú ipú okónu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ce lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations?
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ge ka lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka lɛ uwá. Da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá géē bá ī bī ɔ́bíipú ékpónú nɛ̄ aádáádā aá bī, klla bá ī kwinya ce aɛ́cí otīihilɛ kú uwā ā ɔkwu āa?.

eng_Latn: For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from thee, and they have believed that thou didst send me.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nāa je gā um ā, n le cɛ̄ lɛ uwá, uwá kē mīyɛ ɛlā ā ɛɛ́, é le jé ɔkwɛ̄yi ka n ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ, é kē cɛ̄ ka awɔ tū um ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá híīī túbla ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā fúlufúlu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu, Apólɔsi mɛ́mla Upíta, ɛcɛ nyā, oyēeyī mɛ́mla ikwū, ícɛ nyā mɛ́mla ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā wɛ ákú aá nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá nɛ̄hi nōo fíyajɛ nyaá nyaá ɛgiyí um mā í cɛ̄ gā um mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ aɔ́mpa um le abɔ̄ tū um abɔ̄ ga ipú Udamásikɔ̄si á.

eng_Latn: Saying to a stock, Thou art my father; and to a stone, Thou hast brought me forth: for they have turned their back unto me, and not their face: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Arise, and save us.
idu_Latn: Uwēyī géē kwú odúúdú aá nēe gē da ɔcí ka anúɔ ɔ́ɔ wɛ ádā aá, klla ī da ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ aá ā. Uwēyī nyā géē kwú aá ohígbū ka aá le igbīhi cē kwu um, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá géē wā ɛgiyí um ā. Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ aá bá ipú unwalu nɛɛ, aá ī hī um igwú ka amíyɔ̄ kócōō wā í nya aá tá.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred, and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time that their iniquity had an end:
idu_Latn: Aá húmáyī wɛ olɛlā kú Ísrɛ̄lu eko dóódu. Aá kē leyīkwu kpɔ́ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó ŋmó eko kú ífi kú uwā, nēé móōwē fíyɛ́ dúú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í kōō jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je īkpɔ̄dā, ejé, anɔ̄, mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ lɛ uwá nēé gē bī lɛ gbā ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ɛ̄gbā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ipú icɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ánya, n géē gwō aéwo dóódu nɛ̄ ó lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́ mā ɔ́ci.

eng_Latn: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē yúwēyī um mɛ́mla ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē nwū ā, eko kú ācobɔ̄bíipú nēé je Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nyā ā, ami Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē híhó ka ń jé ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ n géē wā mla ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ádā um mla aálelékwū otɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: So now it was not you that sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó wɛ aá tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā amānyā ŋ́, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄. Ó lɛ um pīya igabɔ̄ nōo fíyɛ́ dúú kú Uféro, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ádā lɛ Uféro, mɛ́mla ɔkpani kú odúúdú ɔlɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ ācɛ alɛwa, alɔ kē wɛ ācɛ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Ācɛ ōhī wɛ Ujíyu, ācɛ ɔhá wɛ aílɔ́wá. Ācɛ ōhī wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ, ācɛ ōhī kē lɛ iyī uwā. Amáŋ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ékpónú nēé le kpó ɛka Ɔwɔicō tū alɔ ɛyí á, nɛ̄ alɔ le pīya iyē ékpónú á. Odúúdú alɔ kē mīyɛ Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ékpónu ā.

eng_Latn: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
idu_Latn: Ā híī ligbō ŋmá ɛgīyí um ŋ́ Óndú, ohígbū ka unwalu má kwu um ajaajɛ ɛɛ́. ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ nōo gē tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the king's ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ a úgbéenyi alɛwa nēe gē ga iyāwu mɛ́mla aúgbéenyi kú ɔcɛ́, Uhíram ā. Iháyí ɛtá dóódu aúgbéenyi kú nū a gē pīyɛyí gē bī ugóolu , oje udɔ, mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́, aáfūlɔ, mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka okokońkofí ā gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da Ujóssuwa kóō lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú nū yá aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa, Usíhɔn mɛ́mla Ɔ́gu ā má ɛɛ́. Ka Óndú ā géē yá ācɛ ohile nēe bá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ ā ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ayínɛ́ um hɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ n jé kpɛ́mm ā í klla jé um gɛ ŋ́.
