eng_Latn: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá kéē géē yá ācɛ nōo leyī gwū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō bónū ā? Ācɛ nōo je oyī kú ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō nōo gwu uwá iyē ŋmá íne nēé bīya ā kóō wɛ ɔdā icííci ā. Ācɛ nēe le ɛcá cá Alelékwū Ihɔ nōo bī eyīnyinyi kú Ɔwɔicō gé lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā. Aá gbɛlá kwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ italā nōo cíkā lɛ ɔdā nēé yá ā géē bɔ̄bí lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the trumpet, and warn the people;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā lɛ olɛlā má ī wā, nōo le opo tá lɛ ācɛ lɛ ācɛ ā ahɔ̄ pī.

eng_Latn: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Udánīyɛlu, n wā amānyā gaá yá ká n̄ tá uwɔ abɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā géē jɛ́yí kú ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́, n géē nwū ācɛ nēe gē bīya íne kú uwɔ ā ɛlā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla kwúcē wā ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, Óndú ā lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbō ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwá. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, Ujóssuwa le hīla nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ um yá ɔ̄cɛ o tá icɔ́ɔci ā abɔ̄, ó lɛ um fu ká n̄ yúklɔ́ nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ tá aá abɔ̄ ká n̄ ka odúúdú ɛlā nōó ka ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.
idu_Latn: N kwú ɛlā kú uwɔ ú tá ipú ɔtū kú um cɛ́ɛ́ kú n̄ híī bīya íne kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the servant told Isaac all things that he had done.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le odúúdú ɔdā nēe yá ɛga nōó ŋmá kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ Áyísīki.

eng_Latn: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
idu_Latn: Aá híī jɛ īyī aá tēelihɔ ŋmá o yá odóódu kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācopɛ̄cí nēe tɛtɛ lā ajɛ nyā gbɔbū lɛ aá ā, nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yɔ̄ gē nū hī lɛ aá, yá lɛ nēé je iyī uwā tēelihɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, and the princes, returned from the children of Reuben, and from the children of Gad, out of the land of Gilead, unto the land of Canaan, to the children of Israel, and brought them word again.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ufínēhasi mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ ācɛ kú Urúbɛn, mɛ́mla Ugádi, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Umanásɛ nēe bá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā tá ipú ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, anɔ́ɔ é le cīgbīhi ga Ukɛ́nan gaá lɛ ohi kú iyāwu kú uwā kpó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
idu_Latn: Ó kōō ŋmífī nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ ā, ācɛ le ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́dā nōó yá kpɛ́mm ā má ɛɛ́. O bū ipú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, alɛɛcɛ lɔfú má péee ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wɛ ā, ɔfú kú nū nōó mɛ glá ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tīihɔ lɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é lɛ ɔdā ō lɛ abɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ka aá jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
idu_Latn: Oholíba, a tíne ō gbajá ɛ́dɔ obɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tɛtɛ yá ajɛ Íjīpiti ā. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ lɛ abɔ̄ ma uwɔ amɛ̄ klla je uwɔ ɔnyā ā.

eng_Latn: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔ́da je, ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛnyā gbɔɔ́ ō kɔ̄ɔ̄kā ā tɛ́ɛcɛ bá yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the LORD, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ mābɔ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá lɛ ācɛ nēé ī kpó odée abɔ̄fú ā āa? Óndú ā abɔ̄yī nū, nɛ̄ alɔ bɔ̄bíipú tū ɔ̄ɔ̄ ā nɛ. Alɔ tá ka alɔ í gáā lā ɛdɔ kú oyēeyī nōó dɔ̄ɔ̄kā kú alɔ lā ŋ́ ámāŋ cɛ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē nwū alɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
idu_Latn: Oyī kú Ɔyí álá ā mɛ́mla olɛhɔ̄ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nēé ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le ebilíi ā yálé ɛɛ́. Ohígbū keé kóō yúufi ikwū ŋ́, amáŋ é le tútū ō kwú.

eng_Latn: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu má iyīnū ajɛ kú Asɔ́tɔ̄si! Ó tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā abɔ́ɔ mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī igelī nēe bá ɔwɛ ā jāā gbéeko nōó gāājɛ Usísarīya.

eng_Latn: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú um kwɛcɛ otú gbó ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ leyī yɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou, even thou, art to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
idu_Latn: Óndú, odúúdú ācɛ gē yúufi uwɔ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í háyi iyɔ̄bū uwɔ glá ŋ́ eko nɛ̄ ā le cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ogbló kú ɔcí kú akésiya gbā, ká ā lɛ ugóólu ma plla anú.

eng_Latn: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ aá géē kɔ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma ahāanɛ ce āyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu, oŋmá lɛ ūlī ō tá īkpɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma dóódu á.

eng_Latn: O thou that dwellest upon many waters, abundant in treasures, thine end is come, and the measure of thy covetousness.
idu_Latn: Ubábīlɔn, aá lɛ ísu alɛwa mɛ́mla agbénú nɛ̄hi, amáŋ eko ō kwú kú aá ga ɛɛ́. Ɔ́ŋgbá nōo bī oyēeyī kú aá kwú hɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ itene kú ɔtulalī nēé gē bī ŋmá Uséba gé um ā mɛ́mla aɔ́dōōkpóocu ɔhá nēé ī kpó wā ŋmá aájɛ ɛga oligbó āa? Ń gáā mīyɛ ɛhi nēé ī kpó gé um ā ŋ́. Ɛya nēé ī gwó gā um ā í kē he um ɔtū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú uwā kpó ŋmó mla ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: And afterward Joshua smote them, and slew them, and hanged them on five trees: and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ ā kpó tū olī playi ɔcí ɛhɔ̄, ɛga nɛ̄ okwū kú uwá playi jāā gbō ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
idu_Latn: Okpaakpa gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó jíikpó odée ŋ́ má. Amáŋ, ɔ́bíipú gē ŋmó ɔ̄cobīyíne á.

eng_Latn: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
idu_Latn: Klla ka lɛ uwá ka, Ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē kpó odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ŋmá ipú aéwɔhá ɛga nēé nyɔ̄ ā, géē tá uwā bá tɔ̄há, géē kpó uwá cīgbīhi wā ipú ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded them, saying, Behold, ye shall lie in wait against the city, even behind the city: go not very far from the city, but be ye all ready:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá má tayínū āyā ɔhá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, amáŋ aá tayínū ligbó nɛ̄hi hɛ̄ igelī nɛ̄hi ā tá ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá le tútū kú aá kpɛ́fú.

eng_Latn: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā, géē má um klla í gwéeyē, ohígbū ka n lɔtūce ɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ɔmálɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā le ɛwa ā tllá, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi! ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ jé ka igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi wɛ ɛga nēé gē leyīkwu agbla kú Átɛ̄misi nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ elihɔ nōo míya wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō nɛ̄ ācɛ gē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: In that day will I make the governors of Judah like an hearth of fire among the wood, and like a torch of fire in a sheaf; and they shall devour all the people round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, anúɔ géē yá ācɛ kú Ujúda bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá, nōo ī yi ipú ūpū, mɛ́mla ahɔ̄lá nōo hɛ́ í tá ipú ɛfú ōŋmókókó ā. Ka é géē je aéwo ɔhá nēe lā jīla uwá tá ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ga abɔ̄ ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa. Ó ka ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ɔ́ɔ géē lā ɛbɔ́ ipú ɔlɛ́ uwā Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ aá hí ajɛ ā ŋ́ eko kú omlɛ́nyɔ́ ā, ó géē yá ɔdōlé lɛ aá, aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá, ācɛ olufa kú aá, aéwɔhá nēe lā mla aá.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kóō je ayí lɛ aá mɛ́mla ayí aá nwuné nwuné.

eng_Latn: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
idu_Latn: Da ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, kéē lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā tū eko kú nū.

eng_Latn: The adversaries of the LORD shall be broken to pieces; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them: the LORD shall judge the ends of the earth; and he shall give strength unto his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú Óndú ā géē je kpó yíífi. Ó géē gbo akpáabana ŋmá ɔkpáncō klá uwá. Óndú ā géē kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ó klla géē je ɔfú lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Ó géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu ā kóō le yálé.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla ka kpɔ́ ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le cɔ̄nū mla Árɔ̄ni tíne kóō je ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ anúɔ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, ohígbū nū eko ɔ́ɔmā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu í bī wā í je gwɛ́ɛya ā wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēé gē kpó aɔ́dā ā tū uwā abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ Utáyítɔ̄si kpɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ ā, nwū ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔdā nōo le kpakpa kú ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ɔdā dúú í tōō le gbla ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Aá lɛ eyī gwū ɛlā kú um bónū, anɔ́ɔ aá bá ī lɔnɔɔtū lɛ ācɛ klla ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ī plla ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
idu_Latn: Ujē mɛ́mla ácí gē je bū tū odúúdú aágblɔ̄cɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ olɔfú kú uwá ā. Aéwō ipácí mɛ́mla aógwugwu gáā lā ipú aágblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɛ́dɔm á.

eng_Latn: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
idu_Latn: A lɛ odó ce um ikpó, klla yɔ̄ í gbō ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ um yá ā gɛɛ. A klla yɔ̄ ī lɛ eyī tá ína kú ɛga nɛ̄ n le ikpó da ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
idu_Latn: Owu nōo ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ́ kpó nyɔ̄. Ó lɛ ɔ́ kpó ŋmá ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Alɔ géē bá ī yɛ ɔwɛ ā ōfōōfū nū, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ le éŋkpɔ̄ kú aá gwá, alɔ géē cíla ulé nū. Alɔ dɔ̄ɔ̄kā ká alɔ yɛ ɔwɛ ā ōfōōfū nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD sent thee on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū uwɔ kā nyɔ̄ káā gaá lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔmā kpó yíífi. Ó da uwɔ ka ā nuunu tá ācɛ kú Ámālēki, jāā gbéeko nāa lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Therefore the king said unto Shimei, Thou shalt not die. And the king sware unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔkpá gbo lɛ Ussímēyi ka ɔcɛ́ dúú í gáā ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kóō ce ébú kú ɔkpāncō kú nū klá ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ kú uwɔ kóō le pīya ajɛ olɔhi! Kóō lɛ īkpō kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ejé kpó gā uwɔ!.

eng_Latn: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í gáā nwū ɔ̄cɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ámāŋ ɔyínɛ́ nū ka, Jé Óndú alɔ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī uwā géē jé um, o ŋmá ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú kú uwā ga ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē tū aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛhɔ̄. É géē tū odúúdú ācɛ nēe yá ká ācɛ kéē bīya íne ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe ī yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ā bá ŋmá ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.
idu_Latn: Upíta da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka odúúdú uwā kōō le kwu hī uwɔ tá nááná, ń gáā kwu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um lɛ ukpa kpla tá ajɛ gē gbo eyī um kóō kwú um ɛɛ́. Ákanya le fíyɛ́ odo kú um abɔ̄, é le ɔ̄gɔ̄ bū tá ɔwɛ kú um, amáŋ, uwá abɔ̄yī uwā má gwōnū tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nēé bu táajɛ gā um piíí ā.

eng_Latn: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma kú Ássa í nū ācɛ nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ákoo, Usídɔn, Áhīlābu, Ákīsibu, Uhɛ́lāba, Áfɛ̄ki mɛ́mla Uréhɔ̄bu ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le íne je lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yá ícɛ̄ nyā yá, o yá kéē kwú íne nɛ̄ aá bīya ā í yá aá ɛhi.

eng_Latn: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo wɛ oligwū, ámāŋ ima, ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ eyī éyi, ámāŋ ōcē kú ɔkpíyē, ámāŋ okwápī í gáā gwɛ́ɛya kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɔdōlé gā um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
idu_Latn: Jāā kwu ipɔ́ɔma kú ɛhícō kú Ísāka, Usébūlɔn mɛ́mla Unáfutāli ā, ācɛ gē wā bī iyó ɔdōlé ɛyí aíjakī, aínyankwūlūmī, aɔ́nya mɛ́mla aɛ́na. É bī ɔdōlé bɛ̄ɛka umu ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, aíkpɔ́cí ufíg, aíkpɔ̄cí kú ufáyin nēe le ŋmó, ejé mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú ólīifu. É klla bī aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá wā kéē ŋmó lé kéē cābɔ̄ omafú kú éeyē kú uwā ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: How fair is thy love, my sister, my spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū kú uwɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū gē he um nɛ̄hi, ákú abɔ̄yī um, ɔnyā um. Ihɔtū kú uwɔ lɛ um ɔnyɛ klla lɛ ɔhi fíyɛ́ ejé á. Ɔtulaiī kú uwɔ kpóocū fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́tulalī ɔhá á.

eng_Latn: And the Horites in their mount_Seir, unto Elparan, which is by the wilderness.
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Uhɔ́ ipú ājɛ ɛfu kú Uséyɛ jāā ga Ɛl-parán nōo yɔ̄ ɛjī kú ígbíli ā.

eng_Latn: And they left the house of the LORD God of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā lɛ Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā uwā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má. Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō pā ɛcí klla gbɔɔ́ ō gbā ɛcí nēé hī ka Ássɛ̄ra ā ɛ̄gbā. Ɔ́bíipú nēé bī ā le wú Óndú ā ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lɛ ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ipú ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ koó le yá lɛ ā, ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā géē yíla cɛ́ɛ́ ejé ā kwú pɛ́ bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ā kē í bīya. Amáŋ é gē lɛ ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ tū ipú ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa í gáā bīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kɛlā bɛ̄ɛka akpáabana ō gbo ā, aéwɔhá gbɔɔ́ ō hútú ipú ufi. Aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā bá ī jíliyē, anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā kwú gbenyi á.

eng_Latn: These discovered her nakedness: they took her sons and her daughters, and slew her with the sword: and she became famous among women; for they had executed judgment upon her.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ohɛ́ɛwa, bī ɔkpacaŋ́gelī lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, klla kwú ayí nū í kpó kwú. Ɛga dóódu ācɛnyā bá ī kɛlā kú nū lɛyíkwu ɔdā nōo yá ɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɛpɔ̄ nēé ka tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
idu_Latn: Ucē olɔhi lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nōo bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá aíkpō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ-o-yɛ́bɔ́ nyí ipú ɛbɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ úmúlá nōo bá uwā ikpó ā gwō bónū kóō wɛ ijáalí kú uwā. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ tá Ikónīyɔm.

eng_Latn: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ anyākwɔ́cɛ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ o hile ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka aá wɛ ijáalí. É ka Óndú ā kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔnyā nōo gē wā ɔlɛ́ nū ā yá bɛ̄ɛka Urécɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ulɛ́ya, nēe ma ayí alɛwa lɛ Ujékɔ̄pu ā. Kóō le gbagbénú ipú ipɔ́ɔma kú Éfrāti, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ ɔ̄ klla fāajɛ Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m.

eng_Latn: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɛpɔ̄ ā gē yúklɔ́ á, ofíyajɛ gā ipú ɛcɛ, amáŋ obū ā he ācɛ ɔtū fíyɛ́ ofíyajɛ á, ohígbū ka ɔdā nēé gē yá ā bɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit: but the Pharisees confess both.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ācɛ Usádusīi ā í cɛ̄ ka ɔ̄cɛ ī héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ámāŋ ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ámāŋ alelékwū éyi yɔ̄ ŋ́. Amáŋ ācɛ Ufárisīi ā kē cɛ̄ ka odúúdú uwā kē lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Judah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nēe gē yúklɔ́ lɛ Ujɛhósāfati, Ujerúsālɛm, mɛ́mla aóhile kú aícɔ́ɔja nēé kpó bá aígelī nɛ̄hi o hile kú Ujúda, nēé hɛ́ igá nɛ̄ ɔdɔ kú nu lɔfú nɛ̄hi tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But the LORD is the true God, he is the living God, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā wɛ Ɔwɔicō abāābɔ̄yī nū á. Anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī á. Anú kē wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóo klla ŋmá eko tá eko á. Eko dúúmā nōó le cɔ̄nū, odúúdú ɛcɛ gē jíliyē. Aéwo ā í kē lɔtū bī ícɔ̄nū kú nū háyi glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
idu_Latn: Ń yúufi kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gē ka ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē lɛ okónu klá, tayínū ipú inu, ohígbū ka n gē yúufi kéē ī yá um ɛbɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the Father himself loveth you, because ye have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God.
idu_Latn: ohígbū ka Ádā ā abɔ̄yī nū yíihɔtū tū aá. Ó yíihɔtū tá aá ohígbū ka aá yíihɔtū tū um, aá klla cɛ̄ ka n ŋmá ɛgiyí anú nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nóō jāhɔ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ mā a, é géē lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ ŋmá ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ yíífi.

eng_Latn: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá um italā ā, n gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋmá íne kú uwɔ á le tū ŋ́, amáŋ, abālɔbányā ā, n kwú ɛyí ú táajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo má gwōnū klá ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ā géē ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛcɔ̄ ā le míya ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, ó géē gbā ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tāajɛ munumunu.

eng_Latn: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
idu_Latn: N da ɔ́ kahíníī, Amānyā nɛ̄ ɔfú mɛ́mla úgbagwú kú uwɔ géē kwu ɛjī ā. A híī gla anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛga ékpónú nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ fu kú ɛ̄gbā ō gbā Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē bī ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā mɛ́mla iyó kú ɛya ká uwā dóódu nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
idu_Latn: Ó le ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū igwó ā hīgwú anɔ́ɔ le ikpīije kú ugóolu kpó kɔ̄ lɛ éyééye kú uwā, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá bī ɛ̄nyā le tɔ́hí gbéeko nɛ̄ n pīyɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Peter followed him afar off, even into the palace of the high priest: and he sat with the servants, and warmed himself at the fire.
idu_Latn: Upíta tá uwā ɔkwu ɛcɛɛcɛ anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ódúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā. Ó gaá cīce mla ācogbāājɛ abɔ́ɔ, yɔ̄ gē jɛ̄ ɔlá.

eng_Latn: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɛplɛ̄ɛ̄pa kú ɔkpá nyā ú lɛ Ubárūku, ɔyí kú Uneríya, ɔyí kú Umaséya ipéyī ɔyínɛ̄ɛpa kú um, Uhanámɛlu, mɛ́mla ipééyī kú aíjáalí nēe lɛ abɔ̄ tū ɔkpá ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu nēé cīce inu nɛ̄ ācogbāajɛ gē bá ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā mɛ́mla alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Upúnɔn ā, é gaá lā Óbōtu.

eng_Latn: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
idu_Latn: Ísɔ he Áyísīki ɔtū fíyɛ́ á ohígbū ɛbɛ́ nōó gē ŋmó gé lɛ̄ ɔ́ kóō lé ā. Amáŋ Ujékɔ̄pu he Urebéka ɔtū fíyɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔni ā wɛ.

eng_Latn: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God, and do it.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ um wɛ ācɛ nēe le ɛlā Ɔwɔicō pó klla bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
idu_Latn: Aá ī bla ka, é tū íne ā ohígbū ācɛ o yá ɔdā olɔhi ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū ācɛ nɛ̄ ē ī lɛ íne tū ŋ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ o yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfu, ācɛ nēé ī yúufi Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ o bīyíne, ācɛ nēé gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Ɔwɔicō ámáŋ ka ɔdā ō tīihɔ ŋ́. É yá íne a lɛ ācɛ o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And every man went unto his own house.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ le kābɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujɔ́ni yá kóō ci ɔ́ anú. Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni kahíníī, Awɔ ā cíkā ō yá um Ubaptísim á, a klla ī wā ɛgiyí um.

eng_Latn: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto the LORD; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́mɛtá ā wɛ Amásīya, ɔyí kú Usíkiri, ó le aícɔ́ɔja úlā ba ɛga úlā, ce úlā ofɛhɔ̄ . Amásīya, kwú īyī nū ú tɛ́ɛcɛ ka anúɔ géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā klla í yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aúgbɔga géē kpó odúúdú agbénú kú uwɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā nāa húmáyī ī yúklɔ́ nū ā kwú pīya ákú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó aólɛlā kú nū ca tāajɛ klla í kpó odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī wɔ́tū nū ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, while the ark abode in Kirjathjearim, that the time was long; for it was twenty years: and all the house of Israel lamented after the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ Ukɛriyati Ujéyarím iháyí ofu. Eko nyā odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū klá Óndú ā kóō tá uwā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be the LORD thy God, which hath delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
idu_Latn: Ahímāasi le ɛgba dɛ̄ hī ɔcɛ́, ka ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ le yɛ lɔhi. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá gbo klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́, lɛ ágbá tá ɔ̄, da ɔ́ kahíníī, N tá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā ahínyá, o cɛ̄ ga uwɔ lɛ ācɛ nēe cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
idu_Latn: Ujɛ́yɛlu wɛ ádā kú Ugíbiyɔn á. Ɔnyā nū lé ka Umaáka.

eng_Latn: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jāhɔ̄ gā um, ɔtū géē he ɔ́. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo bayi ɔwɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um eko dóódu, nɛ̄ ó klla ī gbō okómpíinu ɔlɛ́ um géē gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passeth away.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē bī aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ nya í le yá odée ā, kéē bá bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́da nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā í tá ɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū ka ɛcɛ nyā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó lɛ nyā géē mɛ eko kpiíí nōo ī wā ā.

eng_Latn: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
idu_Latn: Aá tū iyī aá wāajɛ eko nɛ̄ aá i gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obededom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umatitíya, Ɛlífɛ̄lɛ̄hu, Umíknēya, Obɛdɛ̄dɔm, Ujɛ́yɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Asasíya gē gwo ɛdɔ ɛ̄ngwū nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē ka ka aá wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄, amáŋ é wɛ ŋ́, é wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ō pla ācɛ, ācɛ nēe gē lɛ iyī uwā yá kéē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le pɛ́ gaá le jīla Udéfīdi eyī Uhɛ́brɔn. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ācɛ éékpó mɛ́mla awɔ nɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow,
idu_Latn: Ó nyāŋjɛ ŋmá ɛga nōó yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí ayíkpó ā, anɔ́ɔ ó má uwá bá gē gbiyɔ̄lā. Ɔtūnobí cɛ̄ lɛ uwá le gbagbafú.

eng_Latn: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi le ɔtū lɛ kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ó cɛgbá kéē kɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá gbɔbū, amáŋ abɔ̄ aá kē tá ɛlā ā, anɔ́ɔ aá kē lɛ iyī aá ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ka aá cíkā ō lɛ oyēeyī opiyóó ŋ́ mā. Abālɔbányā alɔ leyī pīya tá aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā da um ka amí ɔ̄ híī yúúfi nū ŋ́. Ka anúɔ géē je ɔcɛ́ ā abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́mla ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā kpó tū alɔ abɔ̄. Ó ka ɔdā ékpónú nɛ̄ alɔ ɔ́ɔ yá Usíhɔn, ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri nōo lā Uhɛ́sbɔn ā, nɛ̄ alɔ ɔ́ɔ géē yá Ógu dúú á.

eng_Latn: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan; and Lot journeyed east: and they separated themselves the one from the other.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɔ́tu kwú ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan nēe yɛ lɛyíkwu ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā ú á. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa je kɔ̄ hī ūwā tá á.

eng_Latn: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē bū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā géē je míya tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó bū ɔ́ɔmā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē míya ɛcɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ gē míya wā ī ca ɔ́ ikpó á.

eng_Latn: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū he aá nɛ̄hi! Ɔdí yá mɛ́ɛ̄ āa? Ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ aá ijáalí ka, ɔ́dāŋ koó tɔ́ɔtɛ́ nɛɛ, aá géē yɛ í lɛ eyī kú aá ŋwúla cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú kpó gā um.

eng_Latn: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
idu_Latn: Ó le aákwuna kú ɛga ō pɛ̄cí dóódu nēe hile ŋmá eko kú ádā nū, Ása ā, kpónū ā, kwu ācɛnyā kwu ācɛnyīlɔ ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, lɛ anyā mɛ́mla ayí kú ācɛ kú Umídīyan ā kpó kwú, lɛ ɛna mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdu agbénú kú uwā kpó.

eng_Latn: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu í mā ɛcí ō pā tā ŋ́, ɔwɛ éékpó ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ ɔnyā ā, í kē habɔ̄ ajā ō gbo mla akwuna ō yá tá ŋ́, n géē je ajɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá áncā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē je ɔnyā ōgbajā tá ohɛ́ɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ eko nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ nū ma ɔ́ ā. N géē yá ɔ̄ kóō kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka ajɛ o ŋmókókó mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúú glá gɛ ŋ́ mā. Ijēēnyi géē je uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ pɛ́ wāajɛ ŋmá ɔkpáncō tū ipú ɛcɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nēé nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā jāā gbō ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, kwu otú kwu ɛnɔ.

eng_Latn: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the LORD abhorreth.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipū ā, yɔ̄ ī ka ɔbɔ́cɛ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo kwu ɔ́ ɔtū kóō yá ā. Ācɛ oyúnwū ɔdā ā, gē wɔ́tū Óndú ā klla gē ka atufú lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ gē yā lɛ uwā cabá-cabá eko dóódu. É klla í nyi īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā, ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔwɔ le yā tū ɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi. Ɔcɛ́ kú uwā géē nwuné fíyɛ́ Ágāgi, ɔcɛ́ á, Ajɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū géē nyīla ga ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā lɛ uwá tīkwū klá ɔhá gídígbóó á.

eng_Latn: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu le tá Udábi mɛ́mla Ulístra dúú. Ɔyíkpó éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nēé hī ka Utímōti, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ɔnyā Ujíyu éyi nōo wɛ ɔyíkpó, amáŋ ádā nū wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ugríisi.

eng_Latn: Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.
idu_Latn: Ágrīpa da Upɔ́lu kahíníī, Ɛpléeko kpií nyā a dɔɔ̄kā ká ā je um pīya ɔ̄cɔ̄lohɔ́nyɛtá nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa le uya kú ɛgba kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēé bá ī dē ā pó ā, ó da Umósīsi kahíníī, N pó ɛgba kú ɛfu ō kpó ipú ɔlɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē lɛ da ayí uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā kɛlā lɛ uwá ŋmá ipú ɔlá lɛ, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ pó abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ má ɔ̄ ɔwɛ dúú ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a pleasant child? for since I spake against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my bowels are troubled for him; I will surely have mercy upon him, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá wɛ ayí um okpóocu. Aá kē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Nááná nɛ̄ n gē fu aá ɔnū ā, abɔ̄ aá ī kwú um kpɔ́. N kē ī tíne kú aá bá pi um. Ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā géē ményinyi aá.

eng_Latn: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ ī tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n kwú. N géē kpó abɔ̄ kú um kwu icō í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lodebar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka iní nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ Usíba tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ Umákīyɛ, ɔyí kú Ámmīyēlu, ipú ajɛ kú Ulódéba.

eng_Latn: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n dɔɔ̄kā ka, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ujíyu tígagá ā, é má gwōnū nɛɛ? Ó lɔwɛ ŋ́! Amáŋ ohígbū ka abɔ̄ é le íne bīya ā, aílɔ́wá ā gbɔɔ́ ō má ɔdā nɛ̄ onyatá wɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu kéē kpópú aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
idu_Latn: Ó le ómbili tá gicō, māháyi klla gbɔɔ́ ō yāwu. Anɔ́ɔ ó le bēé tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā mla uwá. Ó yɔ̄ ī yāwu klla ī tó ómbili klla yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ŋ́ māāā, é kē má aá tá ipú ahɔ̄ ɔfiyɛ ŋ́. Nááná aólɛlā kú aá gē tɔ́ɔtɛ́ aá kéē kpó aá kwú.

eng_Latn: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n̄ géē má ohi tá ācɛ nēe gē cá um ɛcá ā, ohígbū ka n lɔtūce ɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
idu_Latn: Ó le wu wāajɛ fíyaa cɛɛyí ucérūbu kú nū. Owu je ɔ́ wāajɛ fíyaa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ acá kú ígbáanɔ ī bī ɔ̄ wu ā.

eng_Latn: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, unto the church of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints which are in all Achaia:
idu_Latn: Ami Upɔ́lu, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si tɛ̄hɔ̄ gɛcɛ ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ɔ̄ lɛ ā. Ami mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ́ alɔ, Utímōti gē tɔ́kpá nyā gé lɛ icɔ́ɔci kú Ɔwɔicō nōo bá ipú igelī kú Ukrɔ́rīnti á. Mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ɔhá nēe bá odúúdú aígelī kú Akáya.

eng_Latn: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó ka ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ, Umósīsi ā, anúɔ̄ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mla anú. Ó ka anúɔ í kpó odúúdú aíne ā mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú anúɔ ā lɛ anúɔ, nōo wɛ Óndú ā lɛ anúɔ, Umósīsi. Ó ka anúɔ lɛ nwū ācɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá tū, ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔtū kú uwā jé anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄cɛ ā kahíníī, Cāŋjɛ ká ā wā í háyi iyɔ̄bū amānyā. Ɔnyīlɔ ā cāŋjɛ wā í háyi abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú um, Ɔwɔicō. Gbō um ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ nēe ī kpɛ́fú tá um ā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord GOD of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je ahɔ̄ nɛ̄ n gē pi aá anú nyā yá ɔdā ɛhɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá kwú ɛlā ú yɛhɛ, unwalu nɛ̄ aá bá anú ā klla í nwuné tū aá iyē fíyɛ́. N pó abɔ̄ Óndú ā je ɔ́da kéē je odúúdú ajɛ ā yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, Thou hast spoken well, I will see thy face again no more.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kahíníī, Kó ō lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka ā mɛ́ɛnɛ. N gáā má eyī kú uwɔ igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usɔ́dɔm bɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄hi, klla wɛ ācɛ ō bīyíne kú Óndú ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kéē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um, n géē tá uwā ohi. Abɔ̄ uwá bī ɛla okónu bá ī ka gā um ā, n géē pó ɔkɔ kú uwā í tú uwā ohi.

eng_Latn: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujése kwú Udéfīdi ú tɛ̄hɔ̄ gé lɛ Usɔ́lu mla ɛwū éyi, mɛ́mla ijakī nōo bī igbō omōōmu odée, mɛ́mla ɔjá ɔkpɛ́bɛ́ nɛ̄ ejé wɛ omōōmu nū.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king: only the spoil thereof, and the cattle thereof, shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves: lay thee an ambush for the city behind it.
idu_Latn: A géē yá Ái, ɔdā nɛ̄ aá yá Ujérīko mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú uwā a. Amáŋ, igbɛ́nyā ā, aá géē kpó aɔ́dā olɔhi dóódu kú ipú ɔlɛ́ ā tū lɛ īyī aá. Kwu aɛ́na kú uwá. Lɛ tútū káā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔfú kpó kwu igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā igbledū ŋmá igbīhi.

eng_Latn: Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é lɛ uya nyā pó ā, ɛwa ā gaá le jīla tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ ó le yá uwā eyījii ohígbū ka éyééye kú uwā pó abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācocɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā bá ī kɛlā ucē kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
idu_Latn: Ó ka odúúdú uwā ɔ́ɔ le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí anúɔ gaá da anúɔ ka aá ɔ́ɔ lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gbɔbū lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ajɛ ā jila tayínū lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ohi bī gé lɛ aá, ɔwɛ nɛ̄ o lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú nɛ̄ aá géē ga ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá géē nyɔ̄ aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi kwú odúúdú ijē nōo klá iyíipú kú nū ā, mɛ́mla ɛga olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú anyī ā, mɛ́mla íkplí kú nū ɛpa ā mɛ́mla ijē kú íkplí ā ú kpó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó yɔlá ɛyí ede á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kpɔ́ ka Óndú ā géē kpó ayí alɛwa, aɛ́na alɛwa, mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄hi lɛ uwá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ cokónu lɛ aádáádā uwā ka anúɔ géē je lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujessúwa ɔyí kú Ujehósādaki mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ɔ́mpa nū, Userúbābɛlu ɔyí kú Ussɛ́litīyɛlu mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú nū le ede kú Ɔwɔ́icō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā túgwó. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí nū, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ tāajɛ ipú ɔkpá kú íne kú Umósīsi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit suffered them not.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ocojōnjīlɛ̄ kú Umísīya ā, é yá kéē ga Ubitiníya, amáŋ Alelékwū kú Ujísɔ̄si í cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death; and found none.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mla aúkánsulu ā, tíne ācɛ nēe géē cē ijáalí tū ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó, amáŋ é lɛ ijáalí dóódu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
idu_Latn: Anyōkwū alɛwa nēe bá ipú ajɛ ká aá ā lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɔjɛ kú ísu á. N lɛ ayípōklóbīya kú ɔlɛ́ aá kpo ŋmó eko kú ɔyipɛ aóklóbīya kú uwā, klá yá ka uwá ká é móōwē. N lɛ uwá kpó ŋ́mó igbledū ipú ufí, ámíyā mɛ́mla ɔnɔ ō jé.

eng_Latn: Wait on the LORD: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɔtūce Óndú ā. Aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū, aá lɔtūlé, aá lɔtūce Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ācɛ ohɛ́julúgwu ɛpa nyɔ́kpá mla anú. Éyi yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná, ɔhá yɔ̄ abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū.

eng_Latn: (It was that Mary which anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.)
idu_Latn: Umerí nyā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ anɔ̄ nya Óndú ā iyē, klla nya ikpó kú Óndú ā mla īnyīlɛ̄yí kú nū á. Anú nɛ̄ ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, Ulásārɔ̄si, yɔ̄ gē doōcē á.

eng_Latn: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth,
idu_Latn: Usífu, Utélem, Ubeyálɔtu.

eng_Latn: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, ɔ́dāŋ ka a le jééyī, ɔtū gē he um nɛ̄hi, n klla í gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: Therefore, brethren, stand fast, and hold the traditions which ye have been taught, whether by word, or our epistle.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ayínɛ́ alɔ, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúú pīya ɔtū kú aá abɔ̄ ŋ́, aá lɛ abɔ̄ fúlá tū ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ nwū aá ā eko nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ aá ámāŋ ka ipú ɔkpá nɛ̄ alɔ tá fu aá gbɔbū ā.

eng_Latn: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
idu_Latn: Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si tóohi ka Upɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ijaló ajɛ Usísarīya, ka anú ɔ tíne ō nyɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ eko kpií.

eng_Latn: Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm igbɔhá, anɔ́ɔ ó mā owu á.

eng_Latn: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kpákli bī um ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú, lɛ um kwú, klla lɛ um ɔkpíyē nya nukwunukwu. Ɔkpíyē kú um bá um iyē bɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú úwé kú um ā.

eng_Latn: And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ géē tá áncā yɛ igelī ā jīla tá biílí. Ajɛ nōo géē tá áncā ābɔ̄ dóódu kú igelī ā géē wɛ umita ofu ɛhīlī cɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.
idu_Latn: N le mafú le aá ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ n gē yá ā ká n̄ le pīya ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō má gbla ká ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá í yúklɔ́ lɔfú lɛ ā, kú ālɔ̄ tá ācɛ ogbɛhá abɔ̄ piíí. Aá kē blakwu ɛlā kú Óndú ā, Ujísɔ̄si ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kahíníī, Aɔ́dā olɔhi kóō yɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē je ā fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē mīyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
idu_Latn: Náaná, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo gē jɛ́ ɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúdú ɔkpáncō nááná í bī Óndú ā glá ŋ́. Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ n wɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē gwó ɔlɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ kóō lā anú glá ā? Amáŋ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ n gáā gwó lɛ ɔ́ ā wɛ ɛga ō gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔtulalī o yɔlá lɛ anú Óndú ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó pi ayíkpó kú nū ahɔ̄ kéē da ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ka anúɔ ɔ́ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
idu_Latn: Anú nēé hī ka ɛlā ā yɔ̄ gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɛcɛ á. Ó húmáyī ī yɔ̄ mla Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ɛlā ā kē wɛ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi á.

eng_Latn: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
idu_Latn: ɔdí kē gbo ákú ɔlɛɛcɛ, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛkɔ̄ mɛ́mla inyílɔ́ tū ɔ̄ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē le yēŋēē ipéyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: And I, and all the people that are with me, will approach unto the city: and it shall come to pass, when they come out against us, as at the first, that we will flee before them,
idu_Latn: Ami mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja o hile ā géē bá i wā ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ái lɛ pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ gáā nuunu tá alɔ, alɔ géē kwúcē igbīhi géē gbɔɔ́ ō kwinya, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ yá aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ó lɛ, ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu ā lɛ dúú á.

eng_Latn: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ okónu ce lɛ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a géē je ācɛ nēe bá nyā tá ipú abɔ̄ kú alɔ, alɔ géē je aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā ā yíífi dúúdú.

eng_Latn: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Aá géē ŋmó ayí omlede kú ucɛ kú onyatá ā mɛ́mla aɛ́wū kú onyatá ā. Aá lɛ īyī aá tū yēŋēē ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē gwɛ́ɛya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ayínɛ́ aá Ísrɛ̄lu ā kéē yɛce íne kú Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ó je lɛ aá bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salcah:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ugádi ā lā ɛhícō kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n ipú ajɛ kú Ubássan jāā ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Usaléka ā.

eng_Latn: And the night following the Lord stood by him, and said, Be of good cheer, Paul: for as thou hast testified of me in Jerusalem, so must thou bear witness also at Rome.
idu_Latn: Otú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā māháyi pī Upɔ́lu anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Lɛ ɔtūlé, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ā cɛ̄ ijáalí kú um ajɛ Ujerúsālɛm ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nāa géē cɛ̄ ijáalí ajɛ Uróm dúú á.

eng_Latn: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
idu_Latn: Ogwuda gē mīyɛ ɔdā nōo cíkā lɛ íla kú nū ā, amáŋ é gē je ɔdā ō jé lɛ ojéeyī ā.

eng_Latn: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
idu_Latn: Aá le nyā ce ɔlɛ́ aólíla mɛ́mla ogwuda. Ó gē da aólíla ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá blakwu ɔdā nōo tɛtɛ le yá gaá le yɛ ɛɛ́ mā ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē gbohílīpú tū ɔdā nōo yá íkée ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācɛ nōo háyi kpaakpa lɛ Óndú ā jāā gbéeko, nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī úlā ɛtá cofɛhīlī cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā gáā le yɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man taketh away dung, till it be all gone.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ɛ̄nyā, ɛ́ɛ géē bī ɔdōbɔ̄bí wā í klá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gēe je odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam ā kpó ŋmó, kwu aɔ́fiyɛ kwu ayí ajɛ. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē je ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Ujérobōwam yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē je emī ɛna kpó yɔlá ŋmá ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
idu_Latn: Aá klla gē ka, alɔ géē fú ígbóngbō ŋmá ajɛ tū ipú īkpɔ̄dā kú alɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ālɔ̄ je lá ígbɔ́lá nɛ̄hi lɛ ācɛ. Alɔ géē má ɔ̄cogbɛhá éyi nɛ̄ ó má ije gbá ulé nɛ̄ ó bī ā glá ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ alɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔfiyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ kwɛyí ije kú ɔ́lá kú áblákpá ékpónú nɛ̄ ó cílá glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá ā? Ɔdí nɛ́ aá gbɛlá ka n̄ da ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā, ācɛ nēe gaá da um ka n̄ lɛ ōwē nɛ̄ ádā um ya uwā ā tú wāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú aéwɔhá kwú ajɛ olɔhi kú ɔlɛ́ um ā ú tá alácɛ bɛ̄ɛka ígbíli ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācogbāálá gē kpó aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā gaá je ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin da tū ajɛ mla ikpó, ī je ɔɔ́ yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā gē wú Óndú ā ɔtū, amáŋ ó gē yíihɔtū tá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā olɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
idu_Latn: É cílá Usólōmɔn īkpīije kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ɛpa cofigwó, aɔ́glɛ́ɛjí ā kē le īkpīije kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ofigwó nōo wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ūwā. Amáŋ n lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin nōo wɛ ákú abɔ̄yī um.

eng_Latn: Of this there shall be for the sanctuary five hundred in length, with five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits round about for the suburbs thereof.
idu_Latn: Ipú ajɛ kú um ɔ́ɔmā, é géē je āyā éyi nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū dóódu géē wɛ umíta ofigwɛ́ɛpa cigwó tá ajɛ kú ō wɛ ɛga nēé ī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Ajɛ áncā ɔhá géē tá kwú ɔ́ yɛ jīla tá, wó í ɛ umíta ofu cɛ̄hɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadrezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty and five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mofu cɛtá nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, Unebusárādan, otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ubábīlɔn ā kē kpó ācɛ ulá ce ofigwáahāapa nyɔ̄. Odúúdú áluka kú ɛwa kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujúda nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa kpó ga Ubábīlɔn ā wɛ úlā igwóléyi ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
idu_Latn: Áluka kú ācɛnyīlɔ nēe lé ɔdōlé ā wɛ ulá igwɛ́ɛpa ce ofigwó.

eng_Latn: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
idu_Latn: Ulámɛ̄ki da anyā ɔlɛ́ nū, Adá mɛ́mla Usílla kahíníī, Anyā um, aá jāhɔ̄ gā um. N lɛ Le ɔyípōklóbīya éyi ŋmó, ohígbū koó le ágbe yá um.

eng_Latn: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
idu_Latn: Ɛcí kú ōcē dúúmā í yɔ̄ Ugílɛ̄di ŋ́ nɛɛ? Óbócí kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́ dúú nɛɛ? Ɔdíyá nēé hɛ́ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tá ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu da Ulífāyi mɛ́mla Usímīyɔn kahíníī, Aá lɛ unwalu hɛ́ gē um ɛɛ́ n. Abālɔbányā ācɛ Ukénan, ācɛ Upɛ́ris mɛ́mla ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ɔhá dóódu géē wɔ́tū um. Ń kē lɛ ācɛnyīlɔ alɛwa ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka é lɛ ujɔ̄ tū lɛ ɔfú kpó kwu um, é géē je odúúdú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um kpó yíífi glá.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ íne kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá, nōo kpó aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, nōo je ajɛ kú Ukénan lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā á nɛ.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will command, saith the LORD, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n géē je ɔ́da lɛ uwá, kéē klla kwúcē wā igelī nyā. É géē kpɛ́fú tá ɔ̄, í yá ɔ̄ lé, klla í je ɔ́ yɔɔlá tāajɛ. N géē je aígelī kú Ujúda ā pīya alácɛ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lā ipú uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for the LORD our God hath put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda da īyī uwā kahíníī, Alɔ í cíkā ō cīce icííci kpɔ́ ŋ́. Aá wā ka ālɔ̄ kwinya ga aígelī nɛ̄hi nēé cē igá olɔfú tū uwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká alɔ gáā gbēyī ō pɛ́ kwú abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ̄ alɔ lɛ ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ alɔ ī gbā ā, ó lɛ alɔ ŋmɛ́pɔ̄bí ká ālɔ̄ pɛ́ kwú ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ó le ɛnɛ̄ tū alɔ kú ālɔ̄ le pɛ́kwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
idu_Latn: Ó géē he um ɔtū ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ nēe ī junwalu lɛ aá ā, lɛ iyī uwá nū ŋmá ɛgiyí aá!.

eng_Latn: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.
idu_Latn: Aítíca ōhī nēe pɛ́ wā ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ā bá gē kahíníī, Ubéésībulu yɔ̄ ipú nū! Anú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú aébilíi nōo je ɔfú lɛ ɔ́ kóō nū uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ á.

eng_Latn: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́nɛ́ nū da ɔ́ kahíníī, Okónu nōó í tá gā uwɔ ā kóō lɛ um kwú. Lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ ā bī yúklɔ́ ōfōōfūnū, ká ā nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛbɛ́ ā bī gé um.

eng_Latn: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá jé ɛ̄nyā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ádɔ̄lɛ́ ā je ɛplá otú nɛ̄ uwī ā géē wā ā nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í leyī kwɛcɛ ī gbāājɛ, ó gáā cɛ̄ ká uwī kóō ca ɔwɛ klá anú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
idu_Latn: Usɔ́ɔlu kwú ohígbū koó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā ŋ́. Ó klla gē ga ɛgiyí aɔ́hɛ gaá dɔɔ̄kā ŋmá ɛgiyí alelékwū kú ācɛ nēe gekwú ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, aá lɛlá kwu iyī aá ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tíne ká aá yá ācɛ nēe bá ā.

eng_Latn: And the guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, round about the king, from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple, along by the altar and the temple.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā kpó kwu ajɛ le ɔkpacaŋgelī kpó pi wu abɔ̄ Okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, kéē gbō ɔcɛ́ ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Ubiyɛssɛ́ba, yɛ lɛyíkwu Uháran.

eng_Latn: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, ó le lɛ ā, ɔdí yá nɛ̄ aá gē ka iŋini ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ jé ɛgbá mɛ́mla unwalu kú aá ŋ́ māa? Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē lɛ ɛlá wu aá eko nēé gē pīya aá tū ī yá aá ōwē áncā ŋ́ māa?.

eng_Latn: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
idu_Latn: Ɛlíhu klla kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó má háyi ɔtāhɛ kú ācɛ nēe pɛ́kwú ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nōo yēeyī ā, anɔ́ɔ ōcē obɔ̄bí ā mɛ á.

eng_Latn: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē yá aólɛhá ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōo cɛ̄ lɛ uwá dɛ̄ hī Ɔwɔicō kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ abɔ̄fú ā. Ó kē lɛ ikwū kú otabɔ̄ nɛ̄ uwá je ā pó.

eng_Latn: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ mla ācɛ Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ é mīyɛ ajɛ kú ɛyí ɛfu ā á. Amáŋ, é nū ācɛ nēe lā okónu ísu ā glá ŋ́ ohígbū ka ācɛ abɔ́ɔ lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya o kpɛ́fú kú oje.

eng_Latn: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
idu_Latn: Ɛka nɛ̄ aá gwá mɛ́mla ikwū ā géē je bīya. Okónu nɛ̄ aá mɛ́mla ɔlékwū ce ā í je ŋmónyí. Eko nɛ̄ ámíyā nōo ī yíífi nɛ̄hi ā géē wā í yɛ ā, ó géē fīyɛ̄ aá bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore pray not thou for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, Ujeremíya, ā gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um ohígbū ācɛ nēe bá ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē jikwū, ī yeyīnyinyi tá um ohígbū uwā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko dúú nēé bá ipú unwalu, nēé lɛ um hīgwú, ń gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá, Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē fā īlī ŋmá úwé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ gē je ɔ́ gɔ́ bá úwé nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ nōó le yá lɛ ā, ó géē híla úwé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā,īlī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ í kē gáā kwu úwé nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le lé géē lɛ́pɔ̄bí kú o je ɔdā nēé kwú kwɛ́ɛya ga um ā tēelihɔ. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é gáā je ɔ́ ka éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ádā kú Usámsin le tá ɔlɛ́ ádā kú ɔnyā ā á. Usámsin le ucɛ yá abɔ́ɔ, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ucē kú ayípōklóbīya á.

eng_Latn: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD, and the coffer that was with it, wherein the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Bethshemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ulífāyi kwú ikpati okónu ōce kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ikpati nɛ̄ aójibó kú ugóolu bá ipú nū ā ú kpó ce ɛyí Ápátɛ́cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi le ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú gwó abɔ́ɔ lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the LORD, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ a bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō í ka ka Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā ɔ́ɔ géē je yíífi lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ussílo ā? Ka igelī nɛ̄hi nyā ɔ́ɔ klla í tá alácɛ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ ā kwú jīla tū Ujeremíya ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā á.

eng_Latn: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ, Ussɛmáya ɔyí kú Asríkam, Uhásbābīya mɛ́mla Ubúni.

eng_Latn: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá má uwā mɛ́ɛ̄, ufi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ ɛdɔ nū í kwú uwā jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, le uwá kwú ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gēe jé ikpokwú kú ācɛ nēe gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā fíyákátā. Ɔwɔicō tá uwā ɛɛ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Ísrɛ̄lu géē yá uwā lé dúúdú.

eng_Latn: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí yá nāa da um ɔ̄kā ā? Da ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā kú um ā ɔ̄kā. Da uwá ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwá ā, é jé ɔdā nɛ̄ n da uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And if one man's ox hurt another's, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɛna éyi lɛ ajī gwu ɛna ɔ́mpā nū, nɛ̄ ɔ́mpā nū ā gekwú, é géē je ɛna oyēeyī ā lá, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ije kú nū kɔ̄. É kē í kɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ kú ɛna nōo kwú ā lɛ óndú ɛna nōo yēeyī mɛ́mla óndú ɛna nōo kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Now Jericho was straitly shut up because of the children of Israel: none went out, and none came in.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔwɛ kú Ujérīko gwū, klla bá gē gbō ɔ̄, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í wā ipú nū ā glá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē ga ɛcɛ ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi ā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ábsālɔm yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ Ágábáidu ɔcɛ́ ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ cɛ̄ kú Ámnɔn ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla ayí anúɔ ohile ā mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm lɛ ucɛ nōo cíkā lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā yá lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
idu_Latn: O gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí ā, aá gáā lé igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́, jāā gbó ɔnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī ofu cɛ éyi kú ɔyā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē wɔ́tū um ā, gē lɛ ahɔ̄ bá īyī uwā ahɔ̄, gē gbɛlá obɔ̄bí lɛyíkwu um eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: So all the people that Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah cast about and returned, and went unto Johanan the son of Kareah.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīyeyī kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ujohánan, ɔyí kú Ukaréya á.

eng_Latn: A GOOD name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
idu_Latn: Iyē olɔhi ō lé mla ojīlīmā cɛgbá nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ agbénú nɛ̄hi ō lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēé dɔɔ̄kā ō lé ā lɛ, anɔ́ɔ é klla le aínu olɔhi gwó kéē lā anú.

eng_Latn: Every man also to whom God hath given riches and wealth, and hath given him power to eat thereof, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labour; this is the gift of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō kwú agbénú mɛ́mla ɔdu ú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ, nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ɔnyɛ nū jé, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā cíkā ō tá ɔ̄ ahínyá, kóō klla jɔ́ɔnyɛ ɔdā nōó yúklɔ́ nū ā. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
idu_Latn: eko nɛ̄ aéwo mla ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ géē pīya tɔ̄há wā í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú.

eng_Latn: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
idu_Latn: Unówa lɛ ayínɔ̄yīlɔ ɛtá, nēe lé ka Ussɛ́m mɛ́mla Uhám mɛ́mla Ujáfɛ̄ti.

eng_Latn: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
idu_Latn: Alɔ má ācɛ kú Unefilím nēe wɛ ayí kú Ánāki nēe wɛ aɔ́báagwu nɛ̄hi ā abɔ́ɔ. Alɔ nyɛ́ lígíí bɛ̄ɛka aíkpaŋgā ā ɛgiyí uwā. Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé kōō má alɔ lɛ á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka Óndú ā géē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, klla í ményinyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū.

eng_Latn: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: N géē je aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ajɛ kú aá yíífi, klla í je uwá tá ipú alácɛ̄. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá géē jé ka ami ɔɔ́ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Now concerning the things whereof ye wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n tínē o tá ohi ɛlā nɛ̄ aá tá tū ipú ɔkpá gé um ā. Ó lɔhi ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ka anúɔ í lɛ ɔnyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu le tá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti á. Abɔ́ɔ ā nɛ̄ anú mɛ́mla aádā alɔ ɔhá ā pɛ́ kwú dúú á.

eng_Latn: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛka nɛ̄ncɛ̄ nōo mɛ ɛ́ɛ́ mā lɛ ɛgahi nɛ̄hi, ayíbɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɛgahi kú ɛka ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo ī yɔ̄ piyóó ā í lɔhi lɛ ā!.

eng_Latn: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni wɛ iháyí ofɛhīlī ce ɛtá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó kwú, ɛyí ɛfu kú Uhɔ́ru á.

eng_Latn: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufilístiya ā le bɛ̄cɛ mɛ́mla aígwu ofu ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ulá ɛpa ce ofu igwó kú uwā. Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū hɔ́ɔgba yɔ̄ ī yɛce Ákisi, ɔcɛ́ ā igbīhi.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
idu_Latn: Ussímēyi ma ayí ɛnɛ: Ujáhāti, Usína, Ujéyuss mɛ́mla Ubérīya.

eng_Latn: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ohi kpó lɛ Udéfīdi ka odúúdú ɛwa kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe gē kpó ícɔ́ɔ́ja glá ā wɛ úlā bá ɛga úlā igbíngbídi, ce úlā ofu igwáahāpa cigwó . Ákú Ujúda ā wɛ úla bá ɛgiyí úlā ɛpa cuúlā ofahātá cuúlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́tángbédē nēe lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú ā í tīile bá lɛ íjéeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And she brought up one of her whelps: it became a young lion, and it learned to catch the prey; it devoured men.
idu_Latn: O lɛ ɔyí nū éyi bī jɛ le nwū ɔ̄ kóō tɔ́tɛ́. Ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā kē lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ō lé kllɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
idu_Latn: Awɔ abɔ̄yi uwɔ gē gbɛlá ka abɔ̄ ɔ kwu anúɔ glá ŋ́, nááná nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā. A kē gbɛlá ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔ́ɔ má anúɔ glá ŋ́. Ɔdōōjé mɛ́mla íjééyī kú uwɔ ā lɛ uwɔ bī nyɔ̄ í gebí ɛɛ́. A gē da īyī uwɔ kahíníī, Ami lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú á. Ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔwɔ ohɛ́ɛnɔ tū klá ajɛ mla ɛfu, ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpɔ̄dā, mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ɔ́līfu ā mɛ́mla ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dóódu nēe gē jɛ̄ ajɛ ā. N klla tū ɔwɔ ohɛ́ɛnɔ klá ācɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá gē yúklɔ́ kú aá hí ā.

eng_Latn: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it, and shall environ us round, and cut off our name from the earth: and what wilt thou do unto thy great name?
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, odúúdú ācɛ kú Ukénan, mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ajɛ ā géē pó, é kē í cē íbɔm tū alɔ, klla í je alɔ kpó yíífi ŋmá ɛcɛ. É klla í je iyē kú alɔ hɛ́ ŋmá ɛcɛ. Olɔhi nyá nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā í yá lɛ iyē nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And for them, even for the priests, shall be this holy oblation; toward the north five and twenty thousand in length, and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length: and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē lɛ āyā kú ajɛ nēé hɛ́ tá lɛ Ɔwɔicō nyā dúú. Ajɛ kú uwá gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɔnɔ̄ɔnɛ̄. Ó géē wɛ ukilómīta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā, ɔwá kú nū ŋmá ɛhícō ga ɛháajɛ géē wɛ ukilómīta ɛhɔ̄. Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā géē kwu ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú ācɛ nɛ̄ Umósīsi fu klla tɛ̄hɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ā bá yɔ̄ á: Ussámmuwa, ɔyí kú Usákɔ̄ ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n.

eng_Latn: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usámla gekwú ā, Ussɔ́lu nōo ŋmá Uréhōbɔtu nōo yɔ̄ kwu ísu kú Uyúfarētīisi ā le ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aa géē ka, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ aa gbɛlá ka ɛ́ɛ wɛ oklóbīya aá ā, lɛ ɛfú kpó gwū aá, lɛ aá yálé kllá kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú aá. Aá géē bá ī jé ɔnɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tá ɔyī kú nū lɛ uwá. Ó klla í yá kéē kwinya ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
idu_Latn: Ákú aá nēé lɔtūce ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī aá ŋ́ mā ā lɔhi nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō géē kpó odúúdú aɔ́dā olɔhi nōó cokónu kú nū ā lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
idu_Latn: Upíta lɛ abɔ̄ gbo ɔwɛ kú eyīyɛ̄ce ā, ɔyínɔ̄nyā éyi nēé hī ka Uróda ā gaá tá ɔ̄ ohi á.

eng_Latn: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi lɛ Umíssɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ɛlsáfan, ayí kú Ússíyɛlu, ɔmáapu ádā kú Árɔ̄ni ā, kpó hīīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá wā í lɛ okwū kú ayínɛ́ɛpa aá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ uwá kpó bá eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ lá ā.

eng_Latn: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.
idu_Latn: Aá má ɔ̄ ɛɛ́, ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā tū aá nēe wā ī yɛ ā ŋ́ nɛ̄ɛ? Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɛdɔ ɔnɔ kú um nyā ŋ́. Ɔnɔ nɛ̄ óndū ā bī wā í kllá um, eko nɛ̄ ó le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ īkpēyī kú nū le kplá yōō bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ákpa ā.

eng_Latn: And he turned unto her by the way, and said, Go to, I pray thee, let me come in unto thee; (for he knew not that she was his daughter in law.) And she said, What wilt thou give me, that thou mayest come in unto me?
idu_Latn: Ujúda le tá ɛgiyí nū, ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú ɔwɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Wā ka n gwutá mɛ́mla uwɔ. Ó jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔnyā kú ɔyí anúɔ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ a géē je gā um ɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ gwutá mɛ́mla uwɔ āa.

eng_Latn: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, even thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo lɔhi ā í he uwɔ ɔtū ō yá, ɔdōbɔ̄bí kē í wú uwɔ ɔtū ō yá. Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā fu uwɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ n lɛ ojīlīmā je ga awɔ nōo cɛ̄ gā awɔ gwéeyē nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aɔ́mpa uwɔ kɔ́ɔ́ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
idu_Latn: Iháyí dóódu Usólōmɔn gē mīyɛ ígbó ugóolu úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛtá ce ɛhīlī .

eng_Latn: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ áaklɔ̄kpɛ kú aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó gwó ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm gaá bá ɛháajɛ nū klla gbɔɔ́ ō téélí lɛ ɔ́ á. Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ Udéfīdi lɛ aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé ɛga dóódu nōó nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: In that day shall there be an altar to the LORD in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko, nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ga, é gēe gwó ede oogba ɔkɔ la Óndú āipú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti; klá í lɛ ɛcɔ̄ kú Óndú ākwu ajɛ ɛyí ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of the LORD:
idu_Latn: Uhúram klla le aɛ́tɛ́, aúsóbɛ̄lu o bī fɔ́ɔlá mɛ́mla aócíbú kpó yá. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ oŋmɛ́yí kú uklɔ́ nōó yá lɛ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú nōó gwó ā á.

eng_Latn: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tū ipú ɔ́kɔ ōfōōfūwā le pɛ́ tá ɛga éyi nōo le hɛ́fu hī ācɛ tá.

eng_Latn: Therefore Saul removed him from him, and made him his captain over a thousand; and he went out and came in before the people.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu kwú Udéfīdi ú yá otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja úlā ɛpa ce ofigwó kú ɔlɛ́ nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ ga ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu lɛ ācɛ ā kpó, anɔ́ɔ oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ó lɛ anú mɛ́mla uwá iyē gwu. Anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gaá ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ uwá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ iyē nēé yɔ̄ ī gwu ā í mɛ ā mɛ́mla eko nēé géē gwɛ́ɛya ohígbū ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā a.

eng_Latn: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó klla kē le Ógu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubássan ŋmó dúú, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
idu_Latn: Ikɔkɔ nēé gē gbā Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó ī kwú ŋ́ mā ɛ̄gbā ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō gbā íkpékwūja nɛ̄ ācɛ bī abɔ̄ kú uwā yá gbla ɔlɛɛcɛ nōo ī kwú ā, ámāŋ ka ɛbɛ́ ámāŋ ka ígbáanɔ ámāŋ ka ɔdāpīyajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā géē wā ɛ̄cī mɛ́mla eko nōó leyī ce ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
idu_Latn: É géē je aótrɛ̄yí o jéeyī ōhī ā kpó ŋmó, amáŋ ɛ̄nyā ā géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ géē je iyē gwu yēŋēē lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Ɛ̄nyā géē yɔ̄ ī yá jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko kú oŋmɛ́yí nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō le tū ā gā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went unto the city where the man of God was.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi, ó wā kú aá nyɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é le yɛ tá ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul, and to let him have liberty, and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́da je lɛ otrɛ̄yí aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ ā kóō kwú Upɔ́lu ú tá ijaló, amáŋ kɔ́ɔ̄ kē bēē je ɛga lɛ ɔ́, ká ɔ̄ kē lɛ ɛga je lɛ aóklóbīya nū kéē bēē nyɔ̄ í tá ɔ́ abɔ̄ ɔwɛ dúú nōo he uwá ɔtū.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ n le ɛgba dɛ̄ gbōmgbōm ā, ó mā úwé kú nū tá wu um abɔ̄ le kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu.

eng_Latn: Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places; thus saith the LORD of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the LORD hath indignation for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ísɔ ā kahíníī, É le aígelī nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ kú alɔ catāajɛ, amáŋ alɔ klla í tū ɔ̄ gwó igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́. Óndú ā í tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Kéē lɛ uwá tū gwó igbɔhá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, amáŋ n géē kpó uwā wúla tāajɛ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ aéwɔhá gbɔɔ́ ō hī uwā ka ācobɔ̄bíipú, mla éwo nɛ̄ Óndú ā le cɔ̄nū mla uwá piyóó.

eng_Latn: O my dove, that art in the clefts of the rock, in the secret places of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet is thy voice, and thy countenance is comely.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, A lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóhō nōo tayínū ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ká n̄ lɛ eyī ō héyīfuú kú uwɔ ā má. Ká n lɛ ɔkɔ ólɔnyɛ kú uwɔ ā pó.

eng_Latn: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ujísɔ̄si ā lɛ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um tɛ̄hɔ̄ kóō gaá lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá nēe bá ipú aícɔ́ɔci ā. N wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú ipɔ́ɔmā kú Udɛ́fīdi. Ami wɛ ínyílɔɔ́ɔwɔ ofíyajɛ nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī á.

eng_Latn: Then came all the tribes of Israel to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ísrɛ̄lu gā ɛgiyí Udéfīdi Uhɛ́brɔn gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Alɔ mɛ́mla uwɔ wɛ ācɛ ékpónú.

eng_Latn: Say, I pray thee, thou art my sister: that it may be well with me for thy sake; and my soul shall live because of thee.
idu_Latn: Da uwá ka anúɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ohígbū uwɔ ā, é géē cɛ̄ ga um yēeyī klla í yá alɔ lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le gbagbénú klla le lɛ tōōtū ɔ̄ jāā gbéeko nōó le gbagbénú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
idu_Latn: Alɔ yɔ̄ ī tū ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá kóō nyɔ̄ mla uwá. Ó húmáyī mafú lɛ alɔ igbalɛwa koó le tútū kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄ eko dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā nōó lɔtūce aá ā, ó le tútū fíyɛ́ kóō tá alɔ abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
idu_Latn: É géē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya nyā ɛhícō kú ede ā, ɛga nēé gē ŋmó aɛ́bɛ́ kú ɛya ō yɔlá dúúdú ā. Cɛ́ɛ é kwú oyī kú nū í cē klá odúúdú ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ede ā.

eng_Latn: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
idu_Latn: aá híī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā aá yá eko nēé bɛ́yí kwu Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ipú ígbíli ā eko nēé já Ɔwɔicō má ā.

eng_Latn: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kwu igbō ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi ɛpa ā ú, je eyī gicō má ɔkpáncō, lɛ ahínyá tá Ɔwɔicō. Ó lɛ igbō ā cē anɔ́ɔ ó kwú kpó lɛ ayíkpó ā kéē kɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā. Ó klla kē lɛ ɛbéenyi ɛpa ā kɔ̄ lɛ odúúdú uwá.

eng_Latn: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, anɔ́ɔ ohígbū ɛpɔ̄bí kú aá ā aá wɛ ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū gɛ ŋ́. Aá wɛ ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācokɛ̄kɛ̄gbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
idu_Latn: Opīyatɔ̄há kú áluka kú ɛwa kú odúúdu ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā wɛ, úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛtá, ce úlā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce úlā ɛnɛ, ce ofu cigwó .

eng_Latn: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa ɛpa ā yá ɔdā ékpónú ā dúú, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛkpa ɛpa ɔhá lɛ á.

eng_Latn: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
idu_Latn: Alɔ jé ka alɔ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ikwū i tá oyēeyī, alɔ jé ɔ̄ lɛ ā ohígbū ka alɔ yíihɔtū tū ayínɛ́ alɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ihɔtū ipú ɔtū kú nū ŋ́, yɔ̄ ipú abɔ̄ kú ikwū kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kwú eliká kú nū, nɛ̄ ó gē le bá ɔkpá ā, nɛ̄ ó mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Uháman ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú lɛ Umɔ́dɛkāyi á. Ɛ́sta klla kwú agbénú kú Uháman ā ú kpó tū Umɔ́dɛkāyi abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: The LORD will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē yá kú ɔtū kú uwā kóō gbenyi nɛ̄hi. Ó géē je aɔ́wɔ kú ɛcɛ nyā kpó ca bónū ŋmá ipú ɛcɛ nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aéwo ā géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ipú ajɛ kú ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!
