idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú nū le kpó hídáagó kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka nyā a, Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō ka kahíníī, Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ um, ó lɔnɔ nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō ga ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō!.

eng_Latn: And he overlaid it with pure gold within and without, and made a crown of gold to it round about.
idu_Latn: Ó le ugóolu ma plá anú eyīpú mla eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ. Ó klla le ugóolu ma cíla ɔ́ okónu biílí.

eng_Latn: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him, then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly, and hated him not beforetime.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ nōó dɔɔ̄kā ō ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ o kwinya ɔ́ci nōo kwu ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā, ka ācɛ abɔ́ɔ kéē híī je ɔ́ tū ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ka ɛ́ɛ géē gbō ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɛyí, ohígbū kōó jégēdē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́. Ó klla ka kōó wɛ ipú ánya nɔ́ɔ ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē kwú mlanyī Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. Ó ka anúɔ lɛ uwá ahɔ̄ pi ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā kéē géē kpó uwā yíífi piíí.

eng_Latn: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
idu_Latn: aá gē nyɔ̄ ɔbā kú īkpɔ̄dā kú aá gē leyīce ka aá géē má okoolo ofu kú īkpɔ̄dā ā, amáŋ igwó ōfōōfūnū hile á. Aá gē nyɔ̄ ī hɛ́ ɔjá ofɛpacigwó kú ejé, amáŋ ɔjá ofu ōfōōfūnū hile á.

eng_Latn: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles,
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nyā, ami, Upɔ́lu wɛ olagbá ohígbū ka n cɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɛhɔ̄, yɔ̄ gē tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi lɛ aá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
idu_Latn: É gē nwúleyīkwū kéē nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ nēe gbɛlá ka aá í gē yá ɔdōōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ínoōbīya le hɛ́ kwu úwé kú uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anɔ̄ ō lé gē hɛ́kwú īlī ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é le yēŋēe ipéyī kú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō yálé le uwēyī je lɛ uwá ŋmá lɛ abɔ̄ ō le da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ kwú Ugílɛ̄di ú lɛ inu kú Umácīyɛ, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be: there shall they lie in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ lɛ uwá nyɔ̄ í lúlé ɛbɔ́ ipácí kú ɛyí aɛ́fú ā mɛ́mla aɔ́pɛ́, klla í yɔ̄ ī lé odúúdú ácí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: I have given them thy word; and the world hath hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
idu_Latn: N le olɛhɔ̄ kú uwɔ cɛ̄ lɛ uwá ɛɛ́. Ācɛ kú ɛcɛ gē wɔ́tū uwā ohígbū kéē wɛ ákú ɛcɛ gɛ ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ń wɛ ákú ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Moreover he said, I am the God of thy father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses hid his face; for he was afraid to look upon God.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádā uwɔ á, Ɔwɔicō kú Ébrahām, mla Ɔwɔicō kú Áyísīki, mla Ɔwɔicō kú Ujékɔ̄pu á. Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwú eyī í tayínū. Ohígbū ka ó yɔ̄ ī yúufi kóō má eyī kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛyí Ucérōbim le wu fíyaa wā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ígbáanɔ ī ceyi owu ī wu fíyaa ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Iyē kú uwɔ í gáā lé ka Ujékɔ̄pu ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, amáŋ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ ó wɛ méɛ̄ á. Ohígbū ka a le unu nu tú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ācɛ, a kē le yálé.

eng_Latn: As for me, behold, my covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations.
idu_Latn: Ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo ga uwɔ ā yɔ̄ á. N cokónu ka a géē wɛ ádā kú aéwo alɛwa.

eng_Latn: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá yá ɔtū kpoókpoó gē lɛ ɔtū tá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē lé ámāŋ ka ɔdā nɛ̄ aá géē gwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá, ó kē mɛ́ɛbɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ɛplá eko nyā ó lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ māa ó kē gwá ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD; We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Alɔ pó abɔ̄ ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī jikwū ā, ohígbū ka é bá ī yúufi nɛ̄hi. Ó wɛ ɔga kú ɛbɔ́ nēé bá ī tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
idu_Latn: É bá ī yá ihilɛ um, klla lɛ ɔkwu tū ɔ́nɔ́ɔ́nú. É kōō ī wā í tá ahɛ klá um eyī dúú.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto the woman, Go to thine house, and I will give charge concerning thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágábáidu, ɔcɛ́ da ɔnyā ā ka ɔ́ɔ nyɔ̄ ga ɔlɛ́ nū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ. Ka anúɔ géē yá odée lɛyíkwu unwalu kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí kú Ulífāyi nēe wɛ iháyí ofu cigwó gɔbū ā, ó lɛ uwá gbaáluka. Ɛwa kú odúúdú uwá wɛ úlā ofɛnɛ cuúlā igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā kú uwɔ ā, wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, okpótɔ̄há kú íne kú uwɔ ā, wɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, odúúdú ɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi ó da ɛ́nɛ́ ɔlɛ́ nū ā kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔkpáni um le tá ɛgiyí ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ éyi, nōo yɔ̄ Usamérīya ā nɛɛ, ó géē lɛ agwú kú nū nyā yá kóō mɛ.

eng_Latn: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
idu_Latn: N jé ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ucē nɛ̄ aá nēe wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá abɔ́ɔ ā yá ā. N jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá cēyītīkwū yúklɔ́ kú ɛlā kú um lɛ āa, mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄ aá lé eko nēé yá aá ōwē ohígbū um ā ā. N jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē jɛɛga lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú ŋ́, amáŋ aá lɛ ācɛ nēe ka aá wɛ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nááná nēe kē wɛ ŋ́ mā jámá, aá kē le má keé wɛ ācokɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
idu_Latn: Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā gē je olɛhɔ̄ nōo le mu mla íjééyī nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi. Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ékpó ɔ́ɔmā kē je olɛhɔ̄ nōo le mu mla ɔdōōjé lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pound of silver, and threescore and seven priests' garments.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile ā je īkpō ije úlā ofɛpacigwó kú īkpō ije ugóolu , īkpō ije nɛ̄hɛ́ kē wɛ úlā ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla awulú kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ofɛtá ce ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Now Rachel had taken the images, and put them in the camel's furniture, and sat upon them. And Laban searched all the tent, but found them not.
idu_Latn: Urécɛ̄lu kwú ɛka ocɛyí ā ú, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú tá ipú ɛkpa kú ɔdōcīce o cɛyí inyankwūlūmī nōó cīce ɛyí nū āa. Ulában le odúúdú ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā jila amáŋ ó má ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
idu_Latn: Ɛlam, Ujɛhóhānan, mɛ́mla Ɛliyɛhoyénāyi.

eng_Latn: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
idu_Latn: A géē gbā ogbló ofu kóō kwu ābɔ̄ ɛhíícō kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in those days, that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare, to fight with Israel. And Achish said unto David, Know thou assuredly, that thou shalt go out with me to battle, thou and thy men.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā, ācɛ kú Ufilístiya le jīla kéē gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Anɔ́ɔ Ákisi da Udéfīdi ka anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū géē nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú mla aá ābɔ̄ kú aá.

eng_Latn: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
idu_Latn: Aá gē lɛ eyī gwō aɛ́ga otīihɔ kú um bónū klla ī yá aɔ́dā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá aɛ́cī nɛ̄ n tū ka aá yúklɔ́ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.
idu_Latn: A lɔfú bī ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ dúúmā nēe hile ā lɛ yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo he awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔtū, o ŋmá lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will make my covenant between me and thee, and will multiply thee exceedingly.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ a le yá lɛ ā, n géē cokónu mla awɔ, géē yá ká ā le nyīla nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
idu_Latn: Uhilkíya, Utébálīya mɛ́mla Usekaríya. Uwá nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Uhósa nōo ī gbō ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā ā wɛ igwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the LORD shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
idu_Latn: Ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā í gáā wɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ a ī bī le mɛ́ɛbɛ ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ mɛ́mla otú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā gáā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ofíyajɛ nɛ̄ a géē bī le mɛ́ɛbɛ piyóó á. Ami kē gáā wɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīma kú uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And one of his servants answered and said, Let some take, I pray thee, five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city, (behold, they are as all the multitude of Israel that are left in it: behold, I say, they are even as all the multitude of the Israelites that are consumed:) and let us send and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ kū ɔlɛ́ nū ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ kéē lɛ aɔ́nya ɛhɔ̄ nēe hile ā kpó ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe hile ipú igelī nɛ̄hi amānyā ā, géē pɛ́ kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɛwa nōo je pɛ́ yíífi ɛɛ́ mā ā. Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdā nēé ka ā má eyī abɔ̄yī alɔ.

eng_Latn: He maketh my feet like hinds' feet: and setteth me upon my high places.
idu_Latn: Ó le ikpó kú um yá kóō lɔfú inya ō kwu bɛ̄ɛka ákú īkpɛ̄ɛnu ā. Ó lɛ um tū ɛbɔ́ abɔ̄ n gē yɛ icō kú aɛ́fu ā.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Consider ye, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā klla ka gɔbū kahíníī, Aá leyī yɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā. Aá lɛ ācɛnyā nēe jé ō yɔ́tūnōbí nɛ̄hi ɛyíkwū ā kpó hīkwú wā.

eng_Latn: The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered;
idu_Latn: é lɛ ɔcí pla bá ɔdɔ kú odúúdú uwā ŋmá ajɛ kwu aúwíndo. É lɔfú je odée klá aúwíndo ɔ́ɔmā glá.

eng_Latn: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka Ujóssuwa, ɔyí kú Unɔ́n nōo ī cɛ̄ anúɔ nōo wɛ Umósīsi ā ɛhɔ̄ ā, gáā kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu trɛ̄yí ga ipú ajɛ ā á. Ka anúɔ le ɔfú tū ɔ̄ īyē, ohígbū ka anú géē yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gaá lā ajɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gbɛlá ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ámāŋ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛhi kú alelékwū nɛɛ, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kóō le jé ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tá fu aá nyā wɛ ɔ́da kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá ā gekwú ipú ɔtōōce, nááná é mīyɛ ɔdā nēé cokónu lɛ uwá ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, amáŋ é má ɔ̄ ŋmá ɛga oligbó, é kē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi, é klla cɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ ka aá wɛ aílɔ́wá mɛ́mla aúgbɔga ipú ɛcɛ nyā.

eng_Latn: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ádā um mla ɛ́nɛ́ um le kwu hɛ̄ um tá nááná Ɔwɔicō géē leyīkwu um.

eng_Latn: And these were the chief of king Solomon's officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
idu_Latn: Aígabɔ̄ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú kú Usólōmɔn ā wɛ ofu igwóléyi ce igwó. É bá gē jīla úklɔ́ ɔlɛ́ kú nū eko dóódu mla ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: Pour out thy wrath upon the heathen that have not known thee, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.
idu_Latn: Le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi mla aéwo nēé jé uwɔ ŋ́, nēé klla gē gbā uwɔ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.
idu_Latn: Ó tú um abɔ̄, cɛ̄ ká n le aólɛla kú um kpó yálé. Ó lɛ odúúdú aéwo ā kwú bá ɛháajɛ kú um.

eng_Latn: Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word of God.
idu_Latn: Ó ī yɔ̄ mla Usájīyɔ̄si Upɔ́lɔ̄si, Igbómína kú ɔlíidɔ ā, ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ojéyi. Igbómína ā le Ubánābasi mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu hīgwú, ohígbū koó tíne kóō pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.
idu_Latn: A géē gwá ŋmá okoolo kú ɔdā ufi mɛ́mla ocatāajɛ kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ, Usamérīya, ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
idu_Latn: Pó ikwū nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī je ā, Ɔwɔicō, ká ā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā.

eng_Latn: Now the LORD had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛbéenyi nɛ̄hi éyi fu kóō kwú Ujóna ú mulɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Ujóna yɔ̄ ipú kú ɛbéenyi ā ɛ̄cī ɛtá á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramothgilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔnyɛ géē nyɔ̄ gaá plla Áhābu ga Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ā. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ōhī kú uwā kɛlā éyi, ācɛ ɔhá ā kē kɛlā ɔhá dúúdú.

eng_Latn: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
idu_Latn: Aá híī gbla ucē kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti, ɛga nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lá gbɔbū ā ŋ́, ámāŋ ákú ācɛ Ukénan, ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī kpó aá nyɔ̄ abālɔbányā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the LORD, Gideon said, Alas, O LORD God! for because I have seen an angel of the LORD face to face.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn le jé ka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā nɛ̄ anúɔ má á. Anɔ́ɔ ó ka ipú ufi ka anúɔ le alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúú ā, má eyī ɔgābɔɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Asárīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, nōo ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usádɔ̄ku ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ŋmífī nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɔ́ɔ ō bī ɛhi kú uwá wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ɔdōlé yɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ alɔ gē lé, nōo klla í hile nɛ̄hi. Alɔ le odúúdú aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá nyā ohígbū ka Óndú ā lɛ ɔhá hɛ́ ce ācɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é jɛ́yí kú ɛlā nōo ka nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdōlé olɔfú wɛ ákú ācɛ nēe le jɛ̄, é lɛ ɔtū kú uwā nwū jé ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ɔdā nōo lɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo bɔ̄bí.

eng_Latn: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi mɛ́mla ocɛ̄tra kú Óndú ā kóō yɔ̄ piyóó, ka ɔtū kóō he Óndú, mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta le ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlā ā yá lɛ kpɛ́mm ŋmá ajaajɛ ā, kpó ka lɛ uwá. Ó kahíníī.

eng_Latn: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka, ɛ́ɛ wɛ ācɛ kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē gbā ɛ̄gbā ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ le uwá fu kéē wɛ ācɛ kú nū ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔhá dóódu nēe bá ipú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: So there was a division among the people because of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa ā le kɔ̄ ohígbū nū á.

eng_Latn: And all the mingled people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Azzah, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod,
idu_Latn: N klla le je lɛ odúúdú ācɛ aéwɔhá nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā le gwá dúú. N le je lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Úus mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ufílístiya , Ugása, Ɛ́krɔn mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Assdɔ́ɔduu nēe hile ā le gwá.

eng_Latn: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú ā le hɔ́lá tū Usɔ́ɔlu iyē, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya éyi lɛ ɔyī tá cē ɔ́, le ágbe yá ɔ̄ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ gē yá ucē bɛ̄ɛka olíla ā, amáŋ aá yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yá lɛ ā á. Aá wɛ ācɛ nēe cíkā ō cɛ̄tra um á. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ŋ́ kōō wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́ nááná, ó lɔwɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ aá ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There is another that beareth witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesseth of me is true.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄, nōo gē cījáalí kú um. N jé ka ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōó ka ohígbū um ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
idu_Latn: É géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ olɔhi mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ okpaakpa, amáŋ ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gē bī ɛlā okónu kú nū le kpó ucē ɔbíipú kú nū tayínū.

eng_Latn: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá le ede kú ɛcɔ̄ gwó gā um, Aa híī gwó ɔ̄ mla ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá gbā ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá kwú ɔdu o gbɛ̄cɔ̄ ú kwu ɛcɔ̄ ā, ɛcɔ̄ ā kwú tēlihɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
idu_Latn: Ó yēeyī iháyí ofigwáahātá ce ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔcí gbā ce okónu nū biílí nɛ̄ olɔwá kú nū géē wɛ ayíkābɔ̄ éyi. Ó klla le ugóolu ma plá ɔcí ā jīla tá.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, who made Israel sin, but walked therein: and there remained the grove also in Samaria.)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú ō bī tū Óndú ā o ŋmá ō yɛce ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú kú ɛcí ō pā kú Ujérobōwam mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú nū, mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó klla kpó ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ikpó tū ɔ̄ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.
idu_Latn: Anú klla ma Ussááfu nōo wɛ ádā kú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Umádmana. Uséfa nōo wɛ ádā kú Umakbéna mɛ́mla Ugíbɛ̄ya ɔ́. Ukálɛ̄bu klla lɛ ɔyínɔnyā éyi, nōo le ka Áksa.

eng_Latn: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
idu_Latn: É klla lā ipú aípɔ́lɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā, jāā ga ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ɛháajɛ mɛ́mla ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ubáalāti ā. Ɛnyā wɛ ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ ohígbū ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwā mɛ́mla ɛga nēé lā ā á. Aɛ́nyā wɛ ɛga nēé lā mɛ́mla ɛma kú ádáádā uwā nēé tá tāajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le íne kú Óndú ā bīya kpɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó cɛ̄ le ācɛ kú Umídiya lɛ uwá yálé klla gbō uwā iháyí ahāapa á.

eng_Latn: And I have oxen, and asses, flocks, and menservants, and womenservants: and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find grace in thy sight.
idu_Latn: N lɛ aɛ́na, aɔ́nya, aɛ́wū, aínyankwūlūmī, aálá, aíjakī, aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā. N tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu uwɔ̄ ɔkpani um o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kú uwɔ kóó gaajɛ lɛyíkwu um.

eng_Latn: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
idu_Latn: Aútébulu igwó ā, aófulēnjē igwó ā.

eng_Latn: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú kóō kpó ācogwɛ́bā kú nū, kéē le pīya aólíla. Ɛfú kóō kpó aícɔ́ɔja kú nū, ufi géē kwú uwā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛgɔ̄ ú ká ā gbɔɔ́ ō gbā umu mɛ́ɛnɛ. Kwú īlī ōkléeyī mɛ́mla īlī ifa kú uwɔ lɔhilɔhi ā ú kpó plla ŋmá iyē. Lɛ áca kpó ká ā bēhé aísu ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Caesar.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ágrīpa da Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si kahíníī, Alɔ í yɛ í lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā hɛ́tá ɔ́dāŋ kóō hɔ́būtá pi ɛpɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí Usísa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt be blessed; for they cannot recompense thee: for thou shalt be recompensed at the resurrection of the just.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē je ācɛ nēe lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā héyī ŋmá olekwu, ó géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ ohígbū ka aá lɛ óluma tū ācɛ nēé má ɔdā dúúmā le cíla óluma nɛ̄ aá tū uwā ā ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you, and ye in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gē yá ɛnyā ā, odúúdú ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra iyē kú Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si ohígbū aá. Ó kē ī je ojīlīmā lɛ aá ŋmá lɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ mɛ́mla Óndú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ge je ŋmá eyīnyinyi ā.

eng_Latn: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyīlɔ dúúmā nōo gē cikpó ɔnyā ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá í lɛ ohílīpú ŋ́. Iyī nū nɛ̄ ó gē je yíífi ŋmá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah his father's brother king in his stead, and changed his name to Zedekiah.
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa kwú ɔmáapu ádā kú Ujɛhóyākin, Umataníya ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē kú nū ú pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá Umataníya ga Usedekíya á.

eng_Latn: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkpá kú iyē kú aádáádā kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Udéfīdi, nōo kē wɛ ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ébrahām ā.

eng_Latn: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá ɔfú kú ɔdōcābɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔdōhídáagó, o ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ n yɛ ga ɛga dóódu, o ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Iliríkúm ā, n lɛ Ɔ̄kōōlɔhi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā bī tɔ́ɔna gaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Joshua smote them from Kadeshbarnea even unto Gaza, and all the country of Goshen, even unto Gibeon.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa yá ācɛ lé ŋmá Ukádɛssi Ubanéya ɛháajɛ, ga Ugása mɛ́mla odúúdú ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn jāā ga ɛhícō kú Ugíbeyɔn.

eng_Latn: There failed not ought of any good thing which the LORD had spoken unto the house of Israel; all came to pass.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ odúúdú okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tū kpɛ́mm.

eng_Latn: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.
idu_Latn: A gē nya ācɛ nēe gē tá īyī uwā wāajɛ ā tá. Amáŋ, a gē tá ācɛ oyɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ́ ā wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: What manner of saying is this that he said, Ye shall seek me, and shall not find me: and where I am, thither ye cannot come?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí wɛ ɛyí ɛlā nyā ā nōó ka, Aá géē dɔɔ̄kā um, amáŋ aá gáā má um glá ŋ́. Ɛga nɛ̄ n kē í yɔ̄ ā, aá gáā lɔfú wā abɔ́ɔ glá ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
idu_Latn: Ká ō miya ɔdīifa, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō yá uwā ŋmá ugóolu , oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā, géē kɛpɔ̄ tū odúúdú aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ ā, le kwa ajaajɛ ɛɛ́. Ɛ́dɔm, ɛ́gɛ́ ɔdā nāa yá ācɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nēé gáā yá uwɔ á. Okoolo nāa le miya igwu lɛ ācɛ ā, nēé géē le miya ɔ́ gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōó le yēŋēē ŋ́ le ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ nēé gwó ā lé, Óndú ā géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ táajɛ ŋmá ipú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē gbō ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔhi ā á. Amáŋ ó géē je ācobɔ̄bíipú yíífi ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
idu_Latn: Ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ uwɔ gwéeyē ohígbū ka a wɛ ɔyipɛ ŋ́, amáŋ lɛ iyi uwɔ yá ɔdōcāabɔ̄ lɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ipú ɛlā nɛ̄ ī ka ā, ipú ucē kú uwɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ í he uwɔ ɔtū lɛ, ɛlā ō cɛ̄ kú uwɔ mɛ́mla oyēeyī o yéŋēē ō lā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: To the one we are the savour of death unto death; and to the other the savour of life unto life. And who is sufficient for these things?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ kú alɔ ā wɛ ikwū lɛ ācɛ nēe yɔ̄ gē bí ā, ó kē wɛ oyēeyī lɛ ācɛ nēé yɔ̄ gē nyatá ā. Ɔ̄nyɛ yá jɛ̄ ō yúklɔ́ ocɛgbá nyā glá ā?.

eng_Latn: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ ogbājɛ kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ tɛtɛ le yēŋēē, í klla lɛ ɛcá dúúmā ŋ́. É tɛ́ɛ́hɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka áfū ā, klla le kplákplá iyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
idu_Latn: Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū í bīyíne dóódu ŋ́, amáŋ ohígbū alɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔ́ pīya ɔ̄cobīyíne. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā alɔ nēe mīyɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā le pīya ācɛ nēe yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā.

eng_Latn: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
idu_Latn: É ya ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdōpiɔ́ŋgbá kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kwajɛ ā mla oje udɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
idu_Latn: Aá gee mīyɛ onyata mla éeyē, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aa ge lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ ŋmá obugā kú Ujerúsālɛm a.

eng_Latn: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ nēé hīgwú ā í lɛlá wu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā le pɛ́ ga ɔnū odée kú abɔ̄yī ūwā. Aóhī le tá ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā, aóhī kē le pɛ́ tá ōlihī.

eng_Latn: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē kwu ɔ̄cɛ nōo yá ɔ̄ ā ɔkɔ géē je yíífi Aá má ɛ̄nyā mla um ɛ́ɛ́, ó lɛ ɛga dúú nɛ̄ ɛtɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ bī abɔ̄ kú nū ma ā gē kwu ɔ́ ɔkɔ jéjéē ɛɛ́? Ɛtɛ́ ā lɔfú da ɔ̄cɛ nōo ma ɔ́ ā ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā glá āā? Ámāŋ ka ɔ́ jé ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gē ma ā ŋ́. Ámāŋ ka ɔdíya nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ ma ɛga nēé gē lɛ abɔ̄ bī anúɔ kwu anúɔ ŋ́ mā ā a?.

eng_Latn: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
idu_Latn: Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō jé, ó ī kpó aɛ́fú hɛ́ wulú. Ó gē pīya uwá eyī klá ajɛ ohígbū kóō le cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: And Samuel called the people together unto the LORD to Mizpeh;
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu lɛ ācɛ ā kpó hīgwú wā í le jīla iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā Umísipa.

eng_Latn: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
idu_Latn: Ká aéwo kéē cɛ̄tra uwɔ, Óndú, kú odúúdú aéwo ā kéē cɛ̄tra uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ gā um leyī kwɛcɛ otú gbó ɔ̄cī. Ɔtū kú um le wuklíicō nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ n kōō kɛlā glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwá pīyɛ abɔ̄ nēé yɔ̄ ī yɛ ipú ígbíli, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú í lā ŋ́, ɛga nɛ̄ owu yɔ̄ ī kpó úmúlá kpɛmm ā. Ó gbō uwā ɛyí klla lɛ ɛlá kwu uwá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó gē gbō iyīnū ā.

eng_Latn: Depart not hence, I pray thee, until I come unto thee, and bring forth my present, and set it before thee. And he said, I will tarry until thou come again.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ kóō híī nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɛ̄gbā kú ɔdōlé gbā ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nōó gā.

eng_Latn: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ewo dóódu, ɛ́gɛ́dúú nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ nwuné lɛ í lɛ aíne nēe le kpaakpa bɛ̄ɛka aɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ nwū uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel, saying, If ye do return unto the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth from among you, and prepare your hearts unto the LORD, and serve him only: and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka, aá géē kwúcē igbīhi wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú aá, ayíka aá kwu aɔ́wɔ kú éwɔhá mɛ́mla ojibó kú ɛcí nēé hī ka Ásitārɔtu nɛ̄ aá bá ī gbɛ̄ɛgbā ā ú kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá kwú ɔtū kú aá ú pīya kwu Óndú ā, ka aá gbā anú ōfōōfūnū ɛ̄gbā. Ó í hɛ́ aá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ olɔfú kú ācɛ Ufílīstiya.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when they saw that there was much money in the chest, that the king's scribe and the high priest came up, and they put up in bags, and told the money that was found in the house of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko dúú nēé má ka ije nōo yɔ̄ ipú ikpati ā ɔ́ɔ le nwuné ɛɛ́, ɔmálɛ o tɔ́kpá kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā géē wā í lɛ ije ā gba áluka cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɔ́ gbō ipú ɛkpa.

eng_Latn: If it please the king, let there go a royal commandment from him, and let it be written among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, that it be not altered, That Vashti come no more before king Ahasuerus; and let the king give her royal estate unto another that is better than she.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ koó he ɔcɛ́ ɔtú nɛɛ, ayíka ó lɛ íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da kú ɔcɛ́ je, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔcányā, Ufássiti kóō híī wā iyɔ̄bū Ágábáidu gbóógbóō ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔ́ tá tū ipú íne kú Upɛ́sīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya nōó gē pīyabɔ̄ gbóógbóō ŋ́ mā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú āhɔ̄ kú nū ú lɛ ɔnyā ɔhá kóō lɛ ɔcányā lé.

eng_Latn: Destruction upon destruction is cried; for the whole land is spoiled: suddenly are my tents spoiled, and my curtains in a moment.
idu_Latn: Ámíyā éyi kwu ce amíyā ɔhá jāā gbéeko nōo odúúdú éwo ā má tá alácɛ̄ ɛɛ́. Acígilí é kwú aɔ́lɛ́ kú alɔ ú kpó yíífi dúúdú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi pīyɛyí wā ɔlɛ́ kóō wā í hɔ́hā ce ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū á. Umáyíkalu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usɔ́ɔlu ā, wā í jīla Udéfīdi ɔwɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ojīlīmā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu je lɛ īyī nū ícɛ dúú áā! Ó lɛ īyī nū tóohɛ́ɛwa iyɔ̄bū ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ icííci, nōó lɛ uwēyī ɛyí ŋ, gē tóohɛ́ɛwa ā.

eng_Latn: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, imabɔ̄ nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a ī yá ā géē je nyílá ɛ̄cī éyi. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko kpiíí, ipú ɛ̄cī ékpónú, a kwú pīya ɔnyōkwū, ayí uwɔ kē í pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
idu_Latn: Ágábá dúúmā í gāa yɔ̄ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí dúúmā géē yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā le nyatá ɛɛ́ mā ōfōōfūnū géē yɛ ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā ga ɔlɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, which shall not visit those that be cut off, neither shall seek the young one, nor heal that that is broken, nor feed that that standeth still: but he shall eat the flesh of the fat, and tear their claws in pieces.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka anúɔ yɔ̄ ī fu ɔ̄cogbāálá éyi ipú ajɛ ā nɛ̄ ɔ́ gáā leyīkwu aálá nēe bá ī pɛ́kwú ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ gē dɔɔ̄ka aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ī bí ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ gē tá ágbe kú aɛ́nɛ̄ é yá uwā ágbe ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɔ́ɔ ī je ɔdōlé lɛ aɛ́nɛ̄ é lɛ ɔfú iyē ŋ́ mā ŋ́. Amáŋ ó gē je ɛbɛ́ kú aálá ojɔ̄kwū fíyɛ́ dúú ā lé klla gē plá uwá āpīice.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the whole congregation of the LORD, What trespass is this that ye have committed against the God of Israel, to turn away this day from following the LORD, in that ye have builded you an altar, that ye might rebel this day against the LORD?
idu_Latn: É kɛlā kwɛyí odúúdú ācɛ kú Óndú ā ka ɔdíyá nēé yá Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɔ́ɔmā ā? É klla da uwá keé le íne kú Óndú ā bīya, klla le īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú yá tá Óndú ā dúú, o ŋmá lɛ ede nēé gwó abɔ̄yī uwā ā. É keé klla yɛ ce Óndú ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ajɛ le dobū kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, ɔ̄coŋmɔ́ɔcɛ ā gē cāŋjɛ, kóō nyɔ̄ gaá ŋmó olɛhá, nōo lɛ ɔdā dóódu ŋ́ mā. Eko nɛ̄ otú le bī, ó kē nyɔ̄ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō wūwī.

eng_Latn: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ā, ālɔ̄ lɔfú tīyē ká ālɔ̄ mīyɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú alɔ kóō híī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú nōo géē ci ɔ́ ō mīyɛ omlɛ́nyɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ci aádáádā alɔ ohígbū ɔtū á kpóce ŋ́ kú uwā ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: So he took him, and brought him to the chief captain, and said, Paul the prisoner called me unto him, and prayed me to bring this young man unto thee, who hath something to say unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ ɔ́ bī wā gé lɛ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Upɔ́lu, nōo wɛ olagbá ā hī um igwú bā um kā n̄ lɛ ɔyípóklóbīya nyā bī gé lɛ uwɔ ohígbū kóō lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó gáā da uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God, even our Father, which hath loved us, and hath given us everlasting consolation and good hope through grace,
idu_Latn: Alɔ í gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Óndú alɔ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá abɔ̄yī nū mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō Ádā alɔ nɛ̄ alɔ he uwā ɔtū, nōo ohígbū eyīnyinyi kú nū, tá alɔ ɔtū kwu ɔtū klla je eyīyōce kú olɔhi kpɔ́cíí lɛ alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Paul dwelt two whole years in his own hired house, and received all that came in unto him,
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu lā ɛga nōó ī gbā ije nū ā iháyí ɛpa odunkwulu. Ó gē mīyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá kéē híī gbā Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɛ̄gbā ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā ɔ́ɔ ī gbā aɔ́wɔ kú uwā ɛ̄gbā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the kinsman said, I cannot redeem it for myself, lest I mar mine own inheritance: redeem thou my right to thyself; for I cannot redeem it.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ā nɛɛ, ayíka anúɔ géē habɔ̄ íkwu ō lá ajɛ ā tá. Ohígbū nɛ̄ úgwū kú ayí anúɔ ɔ́ɔ géē cē nyɛ́ fíyɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ubówāsi kóō lɛ ajɛ ā lá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, ka anúɔ í gáā lá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe pó ɛlā nɛ̄ ó nwū ā le kpó hídáagó nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū koó nwū ɛlā Ɔwɔicō bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ íkwu nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ onwū íne ā ŋ.

eng_Latn: For when I had brought them into the land, for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them, then they saw every high hill, and all the thick trees, and they offered there their sacrifices, and there they presented the provocation of their offering: there also they made their sweet savour, and poured out there their drink offerings.
idu_Latn: N lɛ uwá kpó wā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n cokónu ka n géē je lɛ uwá ā. Eko nēé gáā lɛ aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi mla aɔ́cí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ kú ajɛ ā má ā, é gbo ɛya oōgwo ɛgiyí odúúdú uwā. É yá um cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi mla ɛya nēé ī yɔlá mɛ́mla ejé nēé ge le fu ajɛ lɛ ɛcí ā.

eng_Latn: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo nyi īkpō olɔhi ā wɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Of a truth, LORD, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi gbóó, Óndú, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā le aéwo dóódu kpó yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī kɛlā nwuné lɛ ā, ó cíkā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē tá ɔ̄ ohi. Ɛlā alɛwa ō ka í gē hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These were thy merchants in all sorts of things, in blue clothes, and broidered work, and in chests of rich apparel, bound with cords, and made of cedar, among thy merchandise.
idu_Latn: É kpó īlī ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄, īlī ohéyīfuú, īlī nēé lɛ ijā he tū ɔ̄, īlī tukpɔɔ ole tá ajɛ nēé lɛ ɛwɔ́ ohéyīfuú nya ɔ́, mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ́ŋgbá lá gā uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
idu_Latn: Áíjālɔn mɛ́mla Ugáti Urímɔn lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō ohɔ́nyɛtá lɛ ogbonɛnɛ kú nū mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ he ɔ́ ɔtū lɛ ā mafú.

eng_Latn: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa le pɛ́ wā Ujerúsālɛm bī ɛhi gé lɛ Óndú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. É klla bī gé lɛ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ ā dúú. Anɔ́ɔ o ŋméeko ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú aéwo kú ɛcɛ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Uhɛsɛkíya á.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā géē wɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópi ɛhɔ̄, aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Ahiyésa, ɔyí kú Ammíssadāyi ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Micah, Now know I that the LORD will do me good, seeing I have a Levite to my priest.
idu_Latn: Umíka ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ anúɔ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi lɛ, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú anúɔ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, anúɔ jé ka Óndú ā géē yá ká ɔdā dóódu kóō lɔhi lɛ anúɔ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, go, get thee unto the house of Israel, and speak with my words unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ká a gaá kɛlā dúúmā nɛ̄ n da uwɔ lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujíyu ōhī bá amānyā, nɛ̄ a fu kéē leyīkwu ɛlā kú ajɛ kú odúúdú Ubábīlɔn, nēe lé ka Usádrāki, Uméssaki, mɛ́mla Abɛ́dinēgo. Ɔcɛ́, ācɛ nēe bá nyā í jāhɔ̄ gā uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú uwɔ ā ŋ́. É ī gbā ojibó kú oje ɔdɔ nɛ̄ a le kwaajɛ ā ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
idu_Latn: Ó kéē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, oŋmá lɛ ō lé ucɛ ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ɛga éyi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā. Ó klla da uwá kéē gwéeyē ohígbū ka Óndú ā le ɔhā hɛ́ ce uwá, ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā mɛ́mla úklɔ́ kú uwá.

eng_Latn: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
idu_Latn: Umeyonótāyi wɛ ádā kú Ɔ́fra ā. Usérāya ma Ujówābu nōo wɛ ádā kú ācoyúklábɔ̄ kú ɔpɛ́, ɛga nɛ̄ odúúdú ācoyúklábɔ̄ ā lā ā á.

eng_Latn: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
idu_Latn: N lɛ italā yá aígelī kú Umówābu nēe bá ɛyí ɛfu pátáá ā, nēé hī ka Uhólon, mɛ́mla Ujása, mɛ́mla Uméfāati.

eng_Latn: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū nōo māháyi ipú ɔ́cí ā, kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá ā wɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē gaá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ ā jila ga ajɛ gicō ā nɛ.

eng_Latn: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me, and bow down themselves unto me, saying, Get thee out, and all the people that follow thee: and after that I will go out. And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɛlā kú nū ŋmɛ́yí o ŋmá ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka kahíníī, Odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā géē wā ɛgiyí um, klla í gbɔ̄kɔ gā um klla í da um ka um lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kpó kú ālɔ̄ lɛ pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄. Igbīhi ɛlā ā, Umósīsi le cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: The LORD render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness; for the LORD delivered thee into my hand to day, but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the LORD's anointed.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē cíla ācɛ okpaakpa mɛ́mla ācɛ o lɛ́pɔ̄hi ulé á. Ícɛ ā, ó kwú uwɔ ú tá ipú abɔ̄ kú um, amáŋ, ń ŋmó awɔ, nēé le anɔ̄ tū uwɔ̄ ɛyí, je uwɔ pīya ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But he said, As the LORD liveth, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā yēeyī ā, ń gáā mīyɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ŋ́. Ó gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ɔ́ kóō mīyɛ. Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa tá.

eng_Latn: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ayí kú Ussɛlá, ɔyí kú Ujúda ā wɛ Asáya.

eng_Latn: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā kú élí nɛ̄ ācotɔ́hí gē tá lɛ ɔ́ ā wɛ ipú agbénú kú nū dúú. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú Árābu mɛ́mla aígbómína kú ɛyí ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu ā gē bī oje ɔdɔ mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ gé lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
idu_Latn: Aá kɛlā lɛ ayí aá lɛyíkwu ɔ́, kú ayí aá kéē ka lɛ ayí uwā, nɛ̄ ayí uwā klla géē ka lɛ ipɔ́ɔma ɔhá nēe gboce uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usólōmɔn le ɔ́ tū gwó á. Ó bī úklábɔ̄fú nyā klla le igelī ā mɛ́mla Ubɛti Uhórɔn nōo yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā túgwó dúú.

eng_Latn: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall, the terrible of the nations, all of them: and they shall spoil the pomp of Egypt, and all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
idu_Latn: N géē cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja ŋmá aéwo olɔnɔɔtū, wā í pi aɔ́kpacaŋ́gelī kú uwā í kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋmó dúúdú. Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá nāa gē yá ɔbɔ́cɛ uwā ā géē je kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ ísu kú énkpɔ̄ nōo ī je oyēeyī ā mafú ga um. Ó le yēŋēē nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī má ɛháajɛ nū bɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā. Ó pɛ́ ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla Ɔyí álá ā.

eng_Latn: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ágábá, nɛ̄ ɔgwú gē jila anú ɔwɛ ā, ámāŋ ka, ɔ̄cɛ nōo gā ɔlɛ́ gaá kwú abɔ̄ ú bayi ɔdɔ nɛ̄ ɛgwā le ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
idu_Latn: Ɔcí-afa-kú-ɔyí yɔ̄ ī kpóocu kwūūū, Ɛdɔ īkpɔ̄cí olɔhi ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, kwu ɛnɛ̄ncɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛ̄yīpɛ̄, bá okómpīinu kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ. Ohumɔtū, ami kpó uwā gā uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.
idu_Latn: Anú mɛ́mla Umerí, ɔyípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā nōó cokónu ka anúɔ í lɛ ā, nyɔ̄ gaá tá iyē tāajɛ á. Umerí kē yīīpú.

eng_Latn: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
idu_Latn: ka eko ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ í méyīnyinyi uwā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē kpó uwā cīgbīhi ŋmá ipú aéwo nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā nyɔ̄ ā. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ í cē agbénú klá uwá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá gē lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka ijā ō he ā, tū aólíla. Amáŋ ucē kú íjééyī wɛ ɔdā o lɔnyɛ tū ɔ̄cɛ o jɛ́yí odée.

eng_Latn: Now these are the priests and the Levites that went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
idu_Latn: Aíyē kú ācogwɛ́ɛya mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi nēe pīyɛyí ŋmá Ubábīlɔn wā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Userúbābɛlu, ɔyí kú Ussɛ́ltīyɛlu, mɛ́mla Ujessúwa, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, bá yɔ̄ á: Useráya, Ujeremíya, Ɛ́sra.

eng_Latn: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujémīsi mla Ujɔ́ni, ayí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itíca, ó lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ tíne ká ā yá lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
idu_Latn: Uréyáya, Urésin, Unekóda.

eng_Latn: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of the LORD your God; and the LORD will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ aá ī lā oyēeyī ā mɛ́mla ucē nɛ̄ aá ī yá ā pīyabɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ aá ī gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ aá le yá lɛ ā, Ɔwɔīcō géē je ɔtū kú nū pīyabɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ ó gáā yá aá ífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka anúɔ géē yá ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Curse not the king, no not in thy thought; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber: for a bird of the air shall carry the voice, and that which hath wings shall tell the matter.
idu_Latn: A híī ŋmó ɔcɛ́ okónu ŋ́, ó kōō ipú ɛlā nɛ̄ a ī gbo, ɛ́ɛ́ nāa ī ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ ojīlīma okónu ipú inu eyīpú, ɛga ō gbɔlā kú uwɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛyilɔ éyi, ámāŋ ka ɔdɔ lɔfú je ɛlā nāa ka ā, nyɔ̄ í ka lɛ uwá glá.

eng_Latn: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá túblá wā amānyā, aá nēe wɛ ayí kú ācogwɛ́ɛbā, ācɛ ō cikpó ɔnyā nōó wɛ ɔnyā uwā ŋ́ mā mɛ́mla ayí kú aákwuna.

eng_Latn: And while he lingered, the men laid hold upon his hand, and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hand of his two daughters; the LORD being merciful unto him: and they brought him forth, and set him without the city.
idu_Latn: Ulɔ́tu yɔ̄ ī pīyɔkwajɛ, amáŋ Óndú ā le eyīnyinyi nū má, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā le abɔ̄ tū anú mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ɛpa ā, le uwá kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú igelī ā á.

eng_Latn: The beauty of Israel is slain upon thy high places: how are the mighty fallen!
idu_Latn: Woó Ísrɛ̄lu, é lɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ ɛgahi mɛ́mla ojīlīmā kú aá ŋmó ɛyí ɛfu kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá ɛɛ́. Ācokpɛ́fú kú ɔlɛ́ aá nēe lɔfú nɛ̄hi ā le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́!.

eng_Latn: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give thee counsel, and God shall be with thee: Be thou for the people to God-ward, that thou mayest bring the causes unto God:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ahɔ̄ jē gā um abālɔbányā ká n̄ lɛ ɛlā olɔhi nwū uwɔ, Ɔwɔicō kē í yɔ̄ mla awɔ. Ó le kpaakpa kú ā kwɛyí ācɛ ā iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō klla ī bī ɛpɔ̄ kú uwā wā ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ anú abɔ̄yīnū í lɔfú ipú ɔtū ŋ́ ɔwɛ dóódu ā, ó gē gbonɛnɛ lɛ aógwuda nēé je ka ɔdā nɛ̄ áa yá ā óo wɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́daŋ nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ó yēeyī ā, nɛ̄ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā, nū ɔ̄ ipú nɛ̄hi nááná, ācɛ kē í cɛ̄tra anú ka ó kwú lɔhi lɛ ɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, kwu ācɛnyā kwu ācɛnyīlɔ ú nū bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú aá, ohígbū nēé géē je ɛga nɛ̄ n lā ipú aá yá tēelihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
idu_Latn: Odo mɛ́mla ɔtū nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ alɔ ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege kú nū nōo yɔ̄ ī jila klla ī mafú ɛlá olipú nɛ̄hi kú odo kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Israel, being seven thousand.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔdúúdú aótrɛ̄yí kú ayípōklóbīya nēe wɛ áícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú aígbómína kú ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí kú ajɛ kú nū ā kpó hīgwú. Odúúdú uwá wɛ ofu igwóléyi, cigwɛ́ɛpa . Ó klla le ɔdúúdú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú, okatɔ̄há kú odúúdú uwā wɛ úlā igwáahāapa cofigwó .

eng_Latn: And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost.
idu_Latn: cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ú bī wā í tá ipú aɔ́mpānū ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó le tá ɔlɛ́ gaá lɛ aóklóbīya nū mɛ́mla aóladógbe kú nū hīgwú tɔ̄há. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi, n le álá kú um nōo bī ā pīyɛ̄. Aá gwéeyē mla um!.

eng_Latn: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
idu_Latn: O yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kéē lɛ tɔ́ɔtɛ́ ā, n bī ɔfú nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá le tū um iyē ā yúklɔ́ lɔfu nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ gɛcɛ nyɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ kéē le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne kú Ɔwɔicō nēé gē bīya ā.

eng_Latn: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows: the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
idu_Latn: Aúwíndo bá ipú aínu okómpinu nyā bɛ̄ɛka aókómpinu ɔhá ā. Īkpō kú ɔwɛ nyā dúúdú ā wɛ umíta ofu ce ɛhɔ̄, ɔwá kú nū kē wɛ umíta igwɛ́ɛpa ce āyā.

eng_Latn: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú um bá ī je unwalu gā um ɛ̄cī odunkwulu. Eko dóódu, é bá ī yá ojuju kéē yá um ɔdōōbɔ̄bī.

eng_Latn: Now therefore know certainly that ye shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place whither ye desire to go and to sojourn.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, aá le jé pélúú ka aá géē pɛ́ kwú ipú ɛfú mɛ́mla ɔkpɛtā, mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí, ɛga nōo kwu aá ɔtū ká aá nyɔ̄ í lā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō le ɔdā dóódu yá lɔhi tá eko okpaakpa kú nū. Ó kwú ɛlá kú ɔdā ō yɔ̄ piyóó í tá ipú ɔtū kú alɛɛcɛ, nááná é lɔfú jé ɛjī kú úklɔ́ kú Ɔwɔicō o ŋmá ohútū ga oŋmɛ́yí kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He seeing this before spake of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi jé ka ɔdā nyā géē yá, anɔ́ɔ ó kɛlā kéē géē je Ohɔ́nyɛtá héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū. Ó klla kahíníī, É gáā habɔ̄ ɔ̄ tá ɔlékwū ŋ́, é kē gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔkpíyē kú nū wa tāajɛ ipú únóji ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔnyā kú Ulɔ́tu le eyī pīya le igbīhi má, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɛcɔ̄ kú ɔmā nōo kwaajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kpá ā.

eng_Latn: All the sons of Perez that dwelt at Jerusalem were four hundred threescore and eight valiant men.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Upɛrɛ́si nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ úlā ce ofɛtá ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ̄ kú Ujése nēe wɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ fíyɛ́ dúú ā le pɛ́ gá ɔgbɛ́fú mla Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ā. Ɔ́kplá kú nū ā lé ka Ɛlíyābu, ɛ̄nɛ̄ o gbo ce ɔ́ nōo kē wɛ edegbánya ā, wɛ Abínādabu, ɔ́mɛɛtá nōo kē wɛ ɔkpáacú ā, wɛ Ussáma.

eng_Latn: Ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss, that ye may consume it upon your lusts.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ aá le ba, aá kē mīyɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá bī ɔtū gē le bā á. Aá gē ba ɔdā nāa géē bī le yá abahi lɛ iyī aá ofunu.

eng_Latn: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
idu_Latn: Alɔ géē bá ī cɛ̄tra uwɔ eko dóódu, klla í bá ī tá uwɔ ahínyá piyóó.

eng_Latn: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ géē bī ɛdɔ ōcē nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ tū klá ācɛ Íjīpiti ā klá uwá. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ gáā wi ŋmá anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ipɔ́ɔnū dúú le nyɛ́ nē é je ɔyí álá éyi lé ōfōōfū ūwā glá ŋ́, anú mɛ́mla oladógbe kú nū géē báana tū ɔyí álá éyi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ áluka kú ācɛ ā lɛ ā, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē lé glá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I have lifted up mine hand, Surely the heathen that are about you, they shall bear their shame.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē cokónu ka, é géē je uwēyī lɛ aéwɔhá dóódu ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa má uwá abɔ̄ nēe pɛ́ gē nyɔ̄ ā, é kē lɛ uwá jéjúuma bōōbū, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ācɛ ā le inya kwu ŋmá odúúdú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ gbɔbū le yɛ ajɛ ɔlamu le tá abɔ́ɔ gbɔbū lɛ Ujísɔ̄si mla ayíkpó kú nū.

eng_Latn: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
idu_Latn: É le ayí uwā nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwā nɔ̄nyā kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ o pā ɛcí. É klla gē nyɔ̄ ī gwɛ́bā ī ga ɛgiyí aólobócí kéē má uwā ɛbɛ. É klla kwú eko kú uwā ú táajɛ dúú lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá piyóó. Anɔ́ɔ é cɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kwú cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath: and he sought no more again for him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu le pó ka Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ le kwu ga Ugáti ā, ó mā mlɛ́nyɔ́ ō tíne nū.

eng_Latn: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi géē wā, nɛ̄ ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ɔlɛ́ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ ádā uwɔ ā, nēé géē je uwá kpó ga Ubábīlɔn. Ɔdā dúúmā í gáā hile tá ajɛ ŋ́. Ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ɔkpɛtā, ó géē lɛ uwɔ tū oyēeyī. Eko ɛfú ō kpó, ó gē nya uwɔ tá ŋmá ikwū.

eng_Latn: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
idu_Latn: Uhíram, ɔcɛ́ kú Utáya, lɛ aígbɔ́cí kú usɛ́da mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄cí mɛ́mla ācohɔ́ɔdɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fú Udéfīdi kéē wā í lɛ agblɔ́cɛ́ gwó lɛ Udéfīdi.

eng_Latn: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
idu_Latn: Ó le uwā kpó wā ipú ajɛ otīihɔ kú nū, wā ɛyí ɛfú nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū yálé ā.

eng_Latn: And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le ejé ɔcí nēé hī ka ufáyin ā gwá á. Ejé ā le ɔ́ kwú, anɔ́ɔ ó mā tóohɛ́ɛwa gwutá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū á.

eng_Latn: The righteous cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ okpaakpa gē jikwū kú otábɔ̄ ā Óndú gē pó. Ó kē ī nya uwá tá ŋmá ipú unwalu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ɛ́frem ā wɛ, úlā ofɛpa cigwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: So the altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns.
idu_Latn: Olicō kú ɛhícō kú nū ɔ́ɔmā nēé gē yi aɔ́dā ɛya ɔlá anú ā, wɛ umíta ɛpa. Aábɔ̄ kú ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú nū nēe hɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā licō fíyɛ́ ɛhícō kú ede ā á.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
idu_Latn: Ákú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ ā, aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄, aálá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú Ahíra, ɔyí kú Ɛ́nan á.

eng_Latn: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ ó lɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō ōfūnū nōó yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo tɔ́ɔkwu ŋ́ dúú á, ɛlā Ɔwɔicō nōó cɛ̄ ɔ́ɔmā gekwú.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
idu_Latn: É le aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe bá ā mɛ́mla ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā kpó ŋmá ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn: Ugɛ́ba, Aleméti, mɛ́mla Ánatɔ̄ɔtu. Odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā kwú pīya igwɛ́ɛtá.

eng_Latn: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us, so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ.
idu_Latn: Ɛgɛ́nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá móōwē ā, nɛ̄ alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ móōwē á, ó lɛ ā, abɔ̄ Ɔwɔicō tú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ɔtūlé ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó tú alɔ ɔtūlé ohígbū Ohɔ́nyɛtá dúú á.

eng_Latn: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyīlɔ nēe wɛ iháyí ofu gɔbū ā, nēe lɔfú ga ɔgbɛ́fú glá ā, aá lɛ iyē kú uwā tá ígwíígwu.

eng_Latn: If thou at all take thy neighbour's raiment to pledge, thou shalt deliver it unto him by that the sun goeth down:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka a lɛ īlī kú ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kpó kóō wɛ ɔdōcabɔ̄, aá géē je ɔ́ kpó lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛnɔ kóō gaajɛ.

eng_Latn: And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, Óndú, má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē tū alɔ ufi lɛ ā, lɛ ɔfú tū alɔ iyē, alɔ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ, ká ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú uwɔ pāālā mla ɔtōōlɛ.

eng_Latn: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū kéē tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ébrahām kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, é kē lɛ ɔ́ katú ipú ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash,
idu_Latn: Ubenáya nōo ŋmá Upírātɔn ā. Uhíddāyi nōo ŋmá ɔpɛ́ nōo kwu Ugáássi ā.

eng_Latn: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī má ɔkpáncō ká ā má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ojuja licō ŋmá ajɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
idu_Latn: É bá ī ka lɛ ācɛ nēe tá ō lɛyítáajɛ gā um ā ka ɔdā dóódu ɔ́ɔ géē lɔhi lɛ uwá. É klla ī da odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē yá īkpɛ̄yí ōlɔfú ā ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā í gáā yá uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Urámēsisi, ɔlɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā, ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí ā, igbīhi ucɛ kú onyatá kú aflɛ́yí ipéyī kú odúúdú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yɛ mla ācɛ ojéeyī ā, géē jééyī, amáŋ, aóklóbīya kú aólíla géē je gbilífi.

eng_Latn: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac, to thee I will give it, and to thy seed after thee will I give the land.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki ā, n géē je ɔ́ gā uwɔ, n klla géē je ajɛ ā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ nēe ī wā igbīhi uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ eko yá gɔbū yɛɛ ā, Ukéni le ōhī kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū nōó cē ā bī gaá gbā Óndú ɛ̄gbá.

eng_Latn: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa ɛpa kú īkpīije ɔdɔ ā wā í kahíníī, Óndú, a je ɛkpa ɛpa kú īkpīije gā um, mɔ́ɔ̄, n klla lɛ ɛkpa ɛpa ɔhá lɛ tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā géē cālɛ́ klla í gaá lā ɛga ɔhá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā. Ɛ́gɛ́ nɛ̄ ojuja ā gbojī ɛyí kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā lɛ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ācɛ ā klá abɔ́ɔ gbojī lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
idu_Latn: Ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ yɔ̄ piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā, íkwu kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ kē í yɔ̄ piyóó, o ŋmá eko tá eko. Óndú kē ī yá odúúdú okónu nɛ̄ ó ce ā kpɛ́mm, ó klla gē méyīnyinyi klla gē gbonɛnɛ ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó yá ā.

eng_Latn: That they feared greatly, because Gibeon was a great city, as one of the royal cities, and because it was greater than Ai, and all the men thereof were mighty.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā je unwalu lɛ ācɛ kú Ujɛrúsālɛm nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ka, ācɛ kú Ugíbeyɔn lɛwa nɛ̄hi, bɛ̄ɛka igelī nɛ̄hi dóódu nōo lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā. Ɔlɛ́ ā kē nwuné fíyɛ́ Ái á. Ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kē jé ō kpɛ́fú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which the LORD commanded him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi le táajɛ, gaá lɛ anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó hīgwú tɔ̄há. Anɔ́ɔ ó le odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā kpó ka bá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū uwā á.

eng_Latn: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē gwū uwā ɔ́ci klla í yá uwā italā Eko géē wā nēé géē je kpó yíífi ɛ̄cī kú ífi mɛ́mla ákanya kú uwā le kwu ajaajɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó kwú aɔ́kplá kú Íjīpiti ú kpó ŋmó, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ gē yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛna ā. Ó ka ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ anúɔ í je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá bɛ̄ɛka aálá ipácí glá āā.

eng_Latn: Whom God hath raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be holden of it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō le yá kóō le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, ɔ́ɔmā cābɔ̄ kóō le ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá ɔnɔ kú ikwū, ohígbū kóō tɔ́ɔtɛ́ lɛ ikwū kóō kwú ɔ̄ klá ajɛ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side, Gad a portion.
idu_Latn: Ugádi í lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi nōo ī tū ɛjī mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And Nathan said to David, Thou art the man. Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, I anointed thee king over Israel, and I delivered thee out of the hand of Saul;
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā, Unátan da Udéfīdi ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ agbénú nɛ̄ anúɔ húmáyī kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā á. Óndú ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ le anɔ̄ tū ɔ̄ɔ̄ ɛyí cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ́ɔ kwú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Ka ɔ́ɔ klla ka anúɔ le ɔ́ hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú Usɔ́ɔlu.

eng_Latn: But rise, and stand upon thy feet: for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose, to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen, and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ cāŋjɛ ká ā háyi ikpó abɔ̄yī uwɔ. Ohígbū ka n wā gáā ma iyī um fú gā awɔ ká n̄ lɛ uwɔ yá ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um.

eng_Latn: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
idu_Latn: Aá kóō yɔ̄ gē pi ojigógó ká ákú aá le kpaakpa piíí ā ŋ́. Óndú ā í wā ānāānā ā.

eng_Latn: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon. And she said, Comest thou peaceably? And he said, Peaceably.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cí éyi Adónīja, ɔyí kú Uhágiti le tá ɛgiyí Ubatisséba, ɛ́nɛ́ kú Usólōmɔn. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Adónīja ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́ɔ wā ɛbɔ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ ka anú wā ɛbɔ́ nɛ.

eng_Latn: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
idu_Latn: Unóji kóō lɛ aólɛlā kú um kwú bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īlī gē klá ɔ̄cɛ iyē ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le uwēyī kú uwā wiyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé ā.

eng_Latn: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi í je ajɛ dúúmā lɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ŋ́. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ā, é géē mīyɛ ukpɛ̄ kú uwá ŋmá ipú aɔ́dā kú ɛ̄gbā nēé gē bī wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya ɛyí ede kú Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kɔɔkɔ únɛ́pɔ̄ aflɛ́yí ā, gē gbɛlá ka ɛlā kú anúɔ le kpaakpa á, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɛpɔ̄ mla anú ā gbɔɔ́ ō da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā.

eng_Latn: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ɛdrɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛna kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya ā ú bī wā. Anɔ́ɔ Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ā lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwá kpó ce ɛna ā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: É le ɔ́ tū eko okpaakpa kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú nū ā glá ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe tīihɔ klla le iyē gwu yēŋēē ā í lɛ ɛwa eko ɔ́ɔmā ɛɛ́ ŋ́. Ācɛ nēe jīla Ujerúsālɛm ā í klla lɛwa ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í klla gáā lɛ ajɛ ɔhá dúúmā mla uwá ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan ā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka alɔ lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú alɔ lɛ amānyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy's hand.
idu_Latn: Ó cɛ̄ lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā mīyɛ ikpati kú Ɛka kú Ɔwɔicō ā. Anú wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ mafú ɔfú mɛ́mla ɛgahi kú Ɔwɔicō á.

eng_Latn: And while they looked stedfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé bá ī pléeyī tū ɔkpáncō ā, abɔ̄ ó le ticō ā, igbeékpónú ācɛ ɛpa nēe le otógwō ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ wiiyē le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ɔtāhɛ̄ uwā.

eng_Latn: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
idu_Latn: Ó gáā mīyɛ ije, ámāŋ ka ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā dúúmā ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ nōo ī tá ɔ̄ ɔtū wāajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said some of them of Jerusalem, Is not this he, whom they seek to kill?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ōhī kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā nēé yɔ̄ ī tíne kéē ŋmó ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
idu_Latn: Óndú ka ée gē nyɔ̄ ga Íjīpiti gaá tíne otábɔ̄, ée kē da anúɔ ɔ̄kā ŋ́. Ée klla lɛ ɔtū kpóce ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ka ɔ́ɔ gbō uwá ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And he took away the horses that the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the entering in of the house of the LORD, by the chamber of Nathanmelech the chamberlain, which was in the suburbs, and burned the chariots of the sun with fire.
idu_Latn: Ó le aɔ́nya nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā kpó lɛ ɛ̄gbā ō gbā ɛnɔ ā kpó. Ó klla le aúgbɔ́nya nēé gē bī le gbā ɛnɔ ɛ̄gbā ā kpó tɔ̄lá. É tɛtɛ lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā kpó bá odúdɔ̄lɛ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nōo kwu okómpīinu nɛ̄ ó ligbó lɛ ɔlɛ́ Unátan Uméleki, éyi kú aígabɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔdōlé í yá kú ɔyínɛ um kóō bīyíne, ń gáā lé ɛbɛ́ gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔyínɛ um kóō híīī gwōtū ipú ínoōbīya ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My God hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before thee, O king, have I done no hurt.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kú um lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū tɛ̄hɔ̄ gaá lɛ okónu kú aágábá gwū, aágábá ā ī kē yá um ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka ń lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā iyɔ̄bū nū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā iyɔ̄bū uwɔ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka okónu nōó ce ā wɛ ɛbɛ́ nēé gē le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā glá, ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā je ā tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eyī í gbo uwá gɔɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ é le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ukpa kú ebilíi nōo kwú uwā gbɔbū klla lɛ uwá yá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú nū āa.

eng_Latn: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́na kú alɔ kéē ma ayí lɛwa, amáŋ kéē híī hɛ́ ɔyí ma ŋ́. Ká ālɔ̄ híī pó íbá kú ámíyā ipú úláyi ká alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The watchmen that go about the city found me: to whom I said, Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
idu_Latn: Ācogbāājɛ nēe bá ī yɛ igelī ā lɛ um má. Anɔ́ɔ n da uwá ɔ̄kā ka, Aá má ohumɔtū.

eng_Latn: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kē he um ohígbū Ɔwɔicō nōo hɛ́ um tá ā.

eng_Latn: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā nōo tayínū, é géē je ɔ́ tɛ́ɛcɛ ɛga ogēdēē. Ó lɛ ɔdā dúúmā nēé lɛ ácí ŋmó klá anú nēé gáā pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋ́ nɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: This was the Lord's doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
idu_Latn: Óndú yúklɔ́ nyā á, ó wɛ ɔdā o hídáagó o má.

eng_Latn: And she brought it before Saul, and before his servants; and they did eat. Then they rose up, and went away that night.
idu_Latn: Ó kwu ɔdōlé ā ú kpó ce iyɔ̄bū Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ ɛpa kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā, anɔ́ɔ é le lé, anɔ́ɔ é nyɛ̄ɛ̄ otú ɔ́ɔmā á.

eng_Latn: The leaves thereof were fair, and the fruit thereof much, and in it was meat for all: the beasts of the field had shadow under it, and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs thereof, and all flesh was fed of it.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ēpū olɔhi, ó klla gwá īkpō nɛ̄hi, īkpō ā nwuné jɛ̄ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ kú ipú ɛcɛ ā lé glá. Aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí ī mlɛ́nyɔ́ obobowú kú nū, aígbáanɔ̄ gē gwó ɔlɛ́ ce ābɔ̄ kú nū. Odúúdú aɛ́dɔ kú aɔ́dā ōyēeyī gē lé īkpō kú ɔcí nyā.

eng_Latn: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú tá tū ɛcɛ ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin āa, lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And Samson said, Let me die with the Philistines. And he bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell upon the lords, and upon all the people that were therein. So the dead which he slew at his death were more than they which he slew in his life.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámsin le ɛgba dɛ̄ ka ká anúɔ gekwú mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufilístiya nēe bá āa. Anɔ́ɔ ó bī odúúdu ofú kú nū le abɔ kwu aákanba ā á. Anɔ́ɔ inu ā kwú wúla klá aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ohile ā. Ācɛ nɛ̄ Usámsin ŋmó eko nōó kwū ā, fíyɛ́ ācɛ nōó ŋmó eko nōó yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Art thou the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, Thou sayest.
idu_Latn: É kwú Ujísɔ̄si ú bī nyɔ̄ í háyi iyɔ̄bū Upáyílēti, igbómína ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujísɔ̄si ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ujíyu ā āā? Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Awɔ ka á nɛ.

eng_Latn: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá ōfíyajɛ oceyī o cābɔ̄ ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ɛga éyi ā, gāajɛ ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu má ɔlá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī yi ɛyí ɛfu ā. Ojuja ā klá ɛyí ɛfu ā ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā, Óndú le Umósīsi hīgwú ŋmá ipú ojuja ā.

eng_Latn: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
idu_Latn: Ó gē da ɛcɔ̄ɔwɔ ka ɔ́ɔ pɛ́ klá ajɛ. Ó klla gē da ɔwɔ ka ɔ́ɔ yá klá ɛcɛ nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
idu_Latn: Blakwu okónu nāa ce mla alɔ ā. Ācɛ bá yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛga odobū dóódu kú ajɛ kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: But now when Timotheus came from you unto us, and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity, and that ye have good remembrance of us always, desiring greatly to see us, as we also to see you:
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā Utímōti pīyɛyi ɛɛ́, ó kē lɛ ɔkā ō tá alɔ ɔtū lé bī wā. Ó ka ka aá yɔ̄ ī lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō kpɔ́, ka aá klla gē yíhɔtū tá iyī aá. Ó da alɔ ka ɔtū gē he aá eko dúú nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɛlá gbo kwu alɔ. O klla kē da alɔ dúú ka aá tíne ō má alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ abɔ̄yī alɔ gē tíne kú alɔ má aá ā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
idu_Latn: Aá géē hɛ́ɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa ɛga okɛpɔ̄ kú aá. Aá kóō híī méyīnyinyi ɔ̄cogbɛhá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yúfi ɔ̄colɔdu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
idu_Latn: Ó géē tū aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ɛhɔ̄ mla opo okɛ̄la nɛ̄hi, é kē géē tū ācɛ nēé fu ā bá ŋmá ābɔ̄ ɛnɛ kú ɛcɛ, ŋmá ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú, n jé ka a lɔfú ō yá ɔdā dúúmā glá. A kē lɔfú yá ɔdā dóódu nōo he uwɔ ɔtū glá.

eng_Latn: And the porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length thereof, according to the breadth of the house; and ten cubits was the breadth thereof before the house.
idu_Latn: okómpīinu kú nū ā wɛ ikpó igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄, o lɔwá kú ɔwɛ ā wɛ ikpó ahāanɛ, ó lɔwa bɛ̄ɛka ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi abɔ̄yī nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the LORD, and called it Jehovahshalom: unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn lɛ ede gwó lɛ Óndú ā abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ ó hī ɔ̄ ka, Óndú ā wɛ ɛbɔ́. Ó kē kwu Ɔ́fra, ipú ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Abíyɛ̄sa abɔ́ɔ jāā kwu eko nɛ̄ é tɔ́kpá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú bī ɔcí lɛ ŋmó ɔfiyɛ kú nū ijē, ó kōō wɛ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ɔ̄cɛnyā oo, nɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ ā gekwú abáábɔ́ɔ, é í yá óndú ɔfiyɛ ā italā.

eng_Latn: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
idu_Latn: N géē je ɔcɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka Udéfīdi, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ogbāálá kú uwā, ká ō leyīkwu uwá.

eng_Latn: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the valley:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē bī ɛna ā jāā ga ɔpɛ́ kú ɔkpá nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū í ŋmó ŋ́, nɛ̄ ācɛ í kē hɛ́hɔ̄ ipú ajɛ ā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ɛna ā ɔkɔ cē abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ká aá gaá dɔɔ̄kā ɛyí kú ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka ka, Eyīnyinyi nɛ̄ n tíne á, ó wɛ ɛbɛ́ ō le gwɛ́ɛya ŋ́. Ń wā gaá hī ācɛ olɔhi igwú ŋ́, amáŋ ācobīyíne kéē pīyabɔ̄.

eng_Latn: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī yɛce íne kú uwɔ ɛɛ́, Óndú, ā yá kú uwēyī kóō kwú um gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
idu_Latn: Ó ma ayínɔ̄nyā ɛpa, Userúya mɛ́mla Abígɛ̄ɛlu. Ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ujése, Userúya ā ma ayínɔnyīlɔ ɛtá: Abísāyi, Ujówābu mɛ́mla Ásāhɛlu.

eng_Latn: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
idu_Latn: Usisɛ́ra dɔɔ̄kā éŋkpɔ̄, amáŋ ó le enyāmɛ̄ ɛna je lɛ ɔ́, ó le enyāmɛ̄ ɛna bī gé lɛ ɔ́ ipú ocíbú olɔhi nɛ̄hi éyi.

eng_Latn: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛnyā, eko nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya yɔ̄ í gbā Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kpaakpa ā, Usénākeribu, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya le ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kpó wā gáā kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ujúda. É gaá le íbɔm cē tū aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda nēé cē igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi tū uwā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́da je kéē kwú ɔdɔ ā kpó ca tāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: So Jehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Joram lay there. And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú úgbɔ́ɔnya le tá Ujésiríili, Ujóram yɔ̄ abɔ̄ í tá ágbe kú nū ā kpɔ́. Ahasíya, ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nōo wā í má ɔ̄, kú ágbe kú nū ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ mla anú dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kirheres: because the riches that he hath gotten are perished.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī yá ɔtūnōbí ohígbū Umówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ukɛ́hɛ́rɛs, bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ í tá ɛ́mula kú ijē kú ɛyíkwū ā. Ohígbū ka ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā, le yíífi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he beat down the tower of Penuel, and slew the men of the city.
idu_Latn: Ó klla kwú ínu olɔfú kú Upínūwɛlu ā ú wúlatāajɛ, klla kwú ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā ú kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
idu_Latn: Ami abɔ̄yī um gē yɔ́tū nwula nwula kú n̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú tɛhɔ̄ gé lɛ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtū kóō he aá eko nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ má kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔtūnōbí kú um kóō mɛ tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Neither give place to the devil.
idu_Latn: Aá kē híīī je ɛga dúúmā lɛ ebilíi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
idu_Latn: É le ūlī tá cɛ́ɛ́ kéē jé ācɛ nōo í kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā. É kwú ayípɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ mla ayípɛ̄ nɔ̄nyā ú kpó lá ga ɔfiyɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē bī ije nū lɛ cikpó akwuna mla ō bī lɛ gwá ejé.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ géē héyī.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ede ma lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwá ā, ka ɛ́ɛ híī je ojibó kú ɛcí kú Ássɛ̄ra háyi pī ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And I have given you a land for which ye did not labour, and cities which ye built not, and ye dwell in them; of the vineyards and oliveyards which ye planted not do ye eat.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ajɛ nēé hɛ́hɔ̄ anú jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, mɛ́mla ajɛ nɛ̄ ó wɛ uwá gwó aígelī nɛ̄hi kú nū ā ŋ́ mā ú lɛ uwá. É kē lā anú abālɔbányā, bá ī lé īkpō kú ɔcí Ufáyin nɛ̄ ó wɛ uwá tū ŋ́ mā. É klla bá ī lɛ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu nɛ̄ ó wɛ uwá tū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ó géē gbɔɔ́ ō gwíijē da ācɛ kahíníī, N lɛ íne bīya, n klla gebí ŋmá ɔwɛ okpaakpa ā, amáŋ Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ gā um móōwē ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ um cíkā ō má ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill: yea, my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth, and none did search or seek after them.
