idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aálá kú um bá ī yɛ daála ɛyí aɛ́fu mɛ́mla ɔpɛ́ dóódu. É le pahīla klá ɛcɛ ɛga dóódu. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɛ ɛlá wu uwá, kéē tíne uwá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē pīyɛ̄ uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
idu_Latn: Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū géē lé ohile kú nū. É géē je ɔ́ yá igbō nōó gē nū ŋ́, é kē í je ɔ́ lé ɛga otīihɔ, eyīpú kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, Thou also wast with Jesus of Galilee.
idu_Latn: Upíta yājɛ ɛcɛ ódúdɔ̄lɛ́, anɔ́ɔ éyi kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā ā wā ɛgiyí nū anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Awɔ, a yɔ̄ pī Ujísɔ̄si kú Ugálīli ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And they went every one straight forward: whither the spirit was to go, they went; and they turned not when they went.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aódée ā lɛ eyī pīya kwu ābɔ̄ ɛnɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ígwu kú uwá nyā klla lɔfú ga ɛga dúúmā nōo he uwá ɔtū, nēé gáā pīyeyī ga ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he saith to his disciples, Sit ye here, while I shall pray.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gā ɛga éyi nēé hi ka Ugɛtsɛ́māni ā. Ujísɔ̄si da ayíkpó kú nū kahíníī, Aá yɔ̄ amānyā, kú n̄ gbɔ̄ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lā Íjīpiti iháyí úlā ce ofu cigwó .

eng_Latn: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
idu_Latn: A kwú igá nēe yɛ Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ jīla tá biílí ā kpó kwajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ukɔ́tin kú okómpinu kú nū ā ú playi anú.

eng_Latn: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
idu_Latn: É gē jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, é lɛ abɔ̄ mla oyēeyī ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gē je lɛ ācɛ ā ŋ́. É jé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, é lɛ ɔtū olɔfú.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kē lɛ ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā ahɔ̄ pi. Ó da ɔ́ kéē leyī kwɛcɛ gɛɛ. Ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā yá igbo alɛwa.

eng_Latn: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
idu_Latn: Aá má Usáyɔn, igelī nɛ̄ alɔ gē yá ucɛ nɛ̄hi kú alɔ ā. Ujerúsālɛm kē í wɛ igelī nɛ̄ ācɛ géē lā anú ɛbɔ́. Ujerúsālɛm lɛbɛ̄ɛka áklɔ́kpɛ nēé bī oje pi kwu ajɛ, nɛ̄ ɔdā dúúmā í fu ɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: But Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul's host, took Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
idu_Latn: Ábna, ɔyí kú Unɛ́ɛ, nōo wɛ otrɛyí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ Usɔ́ɔlu ā, le kwu mɛ́mla ɔyí kú Usɔ́ɔlu éyi, nōo lé ka Íssbɔ̄sseti ā, ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā le bēhé Ujɔ́dan ga Umáhāneyim.

eng_Latn: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ufi nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi le odúúdú aúgbɔga kú ɔlɛ́ Adónīja kwú, anɔ́ɔ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwa nyāŋjɛ le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: And the shapes of the locusts were like unto horses prepared unto battle; and on their heads were as it were crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
idu_Latn: Oōmá eyī kú aéfūma ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú aɔ́nya nēé le tútū ō ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā. É lɛ ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ukata kú ugóolu ā kwu ɛyí kú uwā. Eyī kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔlɛɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And I will scatter thee among the heathen, and disperse thee in the countries, and will consume thy filthiness out of thee.
idu_Latn: N géē pa aá hīla ga ipú aéwo ā, cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ eyī gwō aá bónū ɛyí ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla da uwá kéē híī je mlanyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é yá Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ɔdā iwɔ́tū ipú ígbíli ā ŋ́. Ogbɔɔ́ ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú Íjīpiti, jāā gaá kwu ɛ̄cī kú eko ɔ́ɔmā, nēé bá abɔ́ɔ āa. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú uwá nēé gbɛlá kóō ī gbō aá bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā géē kwu ipú ufi. Ufi nɛ̄hi géē kwú aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá ā, nēé géē pɛ́ kwu hɛ̄ otúta kú ɛfú kú uwá, nēé le kwu ajɛ ā tá. Óndú ā nɛ̄ ɔlá kú nū yɔ̄ ī yi ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, nɛ̄ útuló kú nū kē yɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm ā, lɛ ɛlā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó le tá ɛgiyí ɔnyā ā, lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú nyāŋjɛ á. Áganá kú nū ā mɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá á.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É kpó aígelī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ nēe bá ā, ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā lɛ uwá. É wɛ Ugíbiyɔn, Ugɛ́ba.

eng_Latn: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him, Bethel.
idu_Latn: Ujékɔ̄pu kwú iyē í ce ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā lɛ ɔɔ́ ā ka Ubɛ́tɛlu.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the people shall labour in vain, and the folk in the fire, and they shall be weary.
idu_Latn: É géē wúla ɔdɔ kú Ubábīlɔn nɛ̄hi ā tāajɛ, klla í je odūngwɔ̄ɔwɛ nɛ̄hi kú igelī kú nū gɔ̄mm ā yɔɔlá tāajɛ. Odúúdú úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aéwo ā yá ā wɛ áncā. Ɔdā nēe yúklɔ́ kú nū kpɛ́mm ā géē kpó yɔɔlá. Ami, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā ka á.

eng_Latn: But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá gē lɛ ojīlīma ce ācogbɛhá ā ŋ́. Ānyɛ ā gē yá aá ōwē ā? Ó wɛ aólagbénú ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó wɛ uwá gē bī aá ga inɛ̄pɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ulúúlā le jīla, nēé bá ī le ikpó da iyī uwā ikpó báajɛ ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū aflɛ́yí kahíníī, Aá leyī kwɛcɛ ohígbū ɔdōnuīgbō kú ācɛ Ufarísīi. Ɛyí ɔdōnuigbō ɔ́ɔmā wɛ eyī ɛpa nēé lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ká n̄ lā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ piyóó, Óndú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē lā ɛga nāa yɔ̄ ā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē jila anú igbɔhá. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le ɔ́ jila lɔɔlɔhi gɔbū kpɔ́, nōó le má ka ōcē ā mīyɛ odúúdú iyē kú nū tābɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó géē ka k ɔ́ɔ le yēŋēē. Ɔ́dāŋ ka odúúdú ɔkpíyē kú nū ā kwú pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́, ɔ̄cɛ ā í kē tēelihɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you: give me a possession of a buryingplace with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ugbɔga nōo lā ipú aá. Aá lɛ ajɛ je gā um, ká n̄ kwú okwū kú ɔnyā um ú nyi ipú nū.

eng_Latn: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n ŋmó aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā, n kwú aɔ́kplá kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla ákú aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwa ú pīya ákú um.

eng_Latn: Therefore I am full of the fury of the LORD; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwá ā nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī cɔ̄nū lɛyíkwu uwá dúú ā. Ń kōō bī ícɔ̄nū ā háyi glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka amíyɔ̄ cɔ̄nū ká anúɔ da ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu. Kwu ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ nēe bá ī hijā uláyi mɛ́mla aɛ́drɔ́ nēe ī jīla tɔ̄há ā. Kwu aɔ́bá mɛ́mla anyā. Kwu anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aókplícī nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā bī ɔfú kú nū yá ɛcɛ nyā á. Anú bī íjéeyī kú nū je ɛcɛ kwaajɛ kli á. Ó kē bī ɔdōōjé kú nū le ɔkpáncō nāŋ́da klá icō ɛga nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
idu_Latn: Umɔ́dekāyi, ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu ā kpókónu ce ɔcɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū á. Ó he ācɛ Ujíyu, aɔ́mpānū, ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ Ujíyu ā klla gē lɛ ojīlīma ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ó gē yá kóō le lɔhi lɛ odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu, kéē klla bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛlífāasi, ɔ̄cɛ Utéman ā tá Ujóbu ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ā géē jɛ́yí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ufi kú Óndú ō yá wɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ odée jé lɛyíkwu Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
idu_Latn: Upɔ́lu ka ɔ́ɔ cíkā kóō lɛ jé ka eko kú uwalu í yɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ ɛcɛ gáā mɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū ce ɛwū ā ɛyí. Cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ɛhícō kú ede ā, ɛga nēé gē ŋmó ɛbɛ́ ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya ō yɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
idu_Latn: Ussébaníya, Ujosáfati, Unetánɛ̄lu, Amasáyi, Usekaríya, Ubenáya mɛ́mla Ɛlíyēsa, ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bá ī tá opo iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā á. Obɛ́dɛ̄dɔm mɛ́mla Ujehíya í gbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Yea, a man may say, Thou hast faith, and I have works: shew me thy faith without thy works, and I will shew thee my faith by my works.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú kahíníī, Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ōhī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔhá kē ī yúklɔ́ olɔhi. N kahíníī, Le mafú ga um ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ ó tá uwɔ ɔtɛ́, ka ɔ̄cɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá éyi lɔfú cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō anɔ́ɔ ó kē yá ɔdā olɔhi dúúmā ŋ́ glá. Amáŋ ami ā, úklɔ́ olɔhi nɛ̄ n yá ā géē mafú gā uwɔ ka n cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́migwó ā wɛ Ussíméyi.

eng_Latn: And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour.
idu_Latn: Ó yá ɛ̄nyā ɛ̄cī alɛwa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu le cɔ̄nū, anɔ́ɔ ó pīyeyī le ɛlā ka lɛ anjɛnū ā kahíníī, N bī iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá da uwɔ ká ā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú nū! Anɔ́ɔ alelekwū nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ mɛ́ɛbɛ le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú nū eko ɔ́ɔmā piíí ā á.

eng_Latn: Hear me, O LORD, hear me, that this people may know that thou art the LORD God, and that thou hast turned their heart back again.
idu_Latn: Tá um ohi, Óndú, tá um ohi, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ nēe bá nyā kéē jé ka, awɔ, Óndú ā, wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. A kē yɔ̄ ī kpó uwā cīgbīhi wā ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.
idu_Latn: A cɛ̄ lɛ aóklóbīya um nēe kwu um ajaajɛ ā, kwú pɛ́ kwu hɛ um tá ɛɛ́. Obū wɛ aóklóbīya um mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
idu_Latn: Ádām le gwutá mla ɔnyā nū, anɔ́ɔ ó le ipú yɔ̄ le ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhá ma á. Íifu kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Usɛ́ti. Ohígbū koó ka, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔhā je gā um kwɛyí Ébɛ̄lu nɛ̄ Ukéni ŋmó ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the ghost.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́mā, Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā lɛ abɔ̄ gɔ́ klá ajɛ ohígbū kóō cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ó kwú gbɛkɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
idu_Latn: N géē je uwɔ pīya otrɛ̄yí kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ um. Odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um géē mīyɛ ɔ́da ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ. O ka n ce akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā nɛ̄ n bī le fíyɛ́ uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíssa le Ugɛ́hási hīgwú kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɛ́nɛ́ kú ɔyí ā hīgwú wā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ kú ɔyí ā gā inu ā, Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú ɔyí uwɔ ú, anú yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
idu_Latn: Aá le jī ɛɛ́! Aá nēé mā ɔ́bíipú tá ohígbū ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nɛ̄ aá ī ka ā glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá fīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ ká ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó. Ohígbū ka ɛ́ɛ dɔɔ̄kā ō lɛ uwá bī nyíleyī ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti, ajɛ nēé wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore go thou, and read in the roll, which thou hast written from my mouth, the words of the LORD in the ears of the people in the LORD's house upon the fasting day: and also thou shalt read them in the ears of all Judah that come out of their cities.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n tíne kú á le yɛ tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi, eko ɔhá nɛ̄ ācɛ ā gē gwū okónu ā. Nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé tɛ́ɛcɛ gbōmgbōm, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le odúúdú ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kā ga um ā, nɛ̄ n ka gā uwɔ nɛ̄ a tá tāajɛ ā pó. Lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda nēe ŋmá aígelī kú ɔlɛ́ uwá wā ā.

eng_Latn: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Opīyatɔ̄há kú odúúdú ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ipɔ́ɔma ā wɛ úlā ɛnɛ cofahātá . Odúúdú uwā wɛ ɔka kú ācoyúklɔ́ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le yɛ tá ɛyí ɛfu ā. anɔ́ɔ ojuja gaá klá ɛfu ā á.

eng_Latn: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
idu_Latn: Ami Óndú ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ aflɛ́yí nōo da ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Má ɔ̄ɔ̄, ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ī wā ɔlɛ́ ɛɛ́! á. Ami wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ gāá cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ kú ɔdōōlɔhi lɛ Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, which maketh himself a prophet to you?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á yá Ujeremíya, nōo ŋmá Ánatɔ̄ɔtu, yɔ̄ ī ka ɛbɛ tɛ́ɛcɛ, ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā italā ɛ́ ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
idu_Latn: É kwú mlanyī ɔfú kú nū mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ó nya uwá tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aólɛlā kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē ka olɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō tɛ́ɛcɛ ā cíkā ō lɔfú cē ɛlā ō ŋmá okónu kú uwā bī glá.

eng_Latn: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yɔ̄ ī gɔbū, le butū ajɛ kli bɛ̄ɛka ákanaba ɔtāhɛ̄ inu ā, aá cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā jíla aá iyē ŋmá eyī nɛ̄ aá ce eko nɛ̄ aá pó ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā ŋ́, ɛ̄nɛ̄ é tɔ́ɔna kú nū lɛ éwo dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ ā. Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā nɛ̄ ami, Upɔ́lu je pīya ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ nū yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which thou hast said, My name shall be there: that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place.
idu_Latn: ká Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ a je ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛga nēé í gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā ā, ká eyī kú uwɔ kóō kwu ɔ́ otú mɛ́mla ɛnɔ. Eko dúú nɛ̄ n le eyī kú um pīya kwu inu nyā, gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ, lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n géē gbā ā pó, Óndú.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne, having put on their robes, in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóssāfāti mɛ́mla Áhābu, aɔ́cɛ́ ɛpa ā le awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwá wiiyē cīce ɛga nēé gē wú īkpɔ̄dā kú okónu igá kú Usamérīya ā, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ohile ā bá í kacɛ̄ iyɔ̄bū uwā.

eng_Latn: Then said the Lord to him, Put off thy shoes from thy feet: for the place where thou standest is holy ground.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da ɔ́ ka, Lɛ áblákpá kú uwɔ plla ŋmá ikpó, ohígbū ka ajɛ ɛga nāa háyi āa wɛ ajɛ otīihɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ɛhɔ̄ kú ufáyin lɔɔlɔhi nōo tɛtɛ gē gwá īkpō ufáyin úlúúlā nɛ̄ ɔ́lá nū lɔfú gbo ije nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ɛpa cofigwó glá ā, géē je mu ácí ujē mɛ́mla agahāmā trúnyáá.

eng_Latn: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kóō kwú íne nēe bá ā kpó lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kahíníī. Kwú íne nēe bá nyā ú lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
idu_Latn: Ayisáya ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ kahíníī, Ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu kōō lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka īkpō ɔjɛ kú okónu ísu ā nááná, é géē nya ācɛ olígíí kú uwā tá.

eng_Latn: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: É géē wɛ ɔdā nēé géē bī le jé ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu má, ɔ́daŋ́ kéē géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō nōó je lɛ ádáádā uwā bū okónu kú Umósīsi ā.

eng_Latn: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
idu_Latn: É yɔ̄ ī yá Unínīfɛ italā nyā kpɛ́mm ohígbū ka ó kwú pīya bɛ̄ɛka akwuna nōo bī ɛcí kú nū le aéwo já klla le uwá kpó kwú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ukpa ī kwú odée ā. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ á.

eng_Latn: For the children of Judah have done evil in my sight, saith the LORD: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujúda lɛ aɔ́dā nēe bɔ̄bí tū um yá ɛɛ́. É kwú aɛ́cí kú uwā nēe gē wú um ɔtū nɛ̄hi ā ú kpó ce ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú abɔ̄yī um ā ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kē kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā í tɛ̄ɛlihɔ á.

eng_Latn: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúúmā le ikpó kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ɔ́mpānū ce, ɔdēelihɔ nēé yá á. É géē kpó uwá ɛpɛlɛ́ɛpa ŋmó. Ɛfiyɛ kú ikwū kú uwā ce iyī uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: It is God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me,
idu_Latn: Ó gē cɛ̄ gā um yá aólɛlā kú um lé. Ó le aéwo ā kpó bá ɛháajɛ ikpó kú um.

eng_Latn: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, n tíne ō tóóhi ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tá tū ipú ɔkpá lɛyíkwu ɔdōlé nēé je lɛ ɛcí ā. Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi gbóó, kahíníī, Odúúdu alɔ jɔ́ɔda, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ka lɛ ā. Ɛdɔ kú ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ jé ɔ́ɔmā, nááná gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ gē nū pītii mla ɔbɔ́ɔ̄cɛ. Amáŋ ihɔtū gē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ jɛ̄ ipú alelékwū.

eng_Latn: And he answered me and said, Knowest thou not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Á jé ɛyí ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔdā nēe bá nyā wɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ehéee, Óndú um.

eng_Latn: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nēe bá nyā pó ā, ufi le mu um ipú, akpókónu kú um yɔ̄ ī fíyɔ̄há kpáákpá ipú ufi. Iyē kú um le kpó ca tāāpū, ikpó kú um kwú gbájí tɔ̄há, N géē gbēyī cíí gbéeko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō gáā lɛ italā yá ācɛ nēe ī nuunu tá alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim, saying, Come down against the Midianites, and take before them the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan. Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and took the waters unto Bethbarah and Jordan.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu odúúdú ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfú kú Ɛ́frem ā kéē wɛ̄ɛcɛ í kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Umídiya. Ó kéē bū ísu kú Ujɔ́dan mɛ́mla áyɔ́kpá ā jāā ga Ubɛtibára, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kú Umídiya bēhé ɔkpá ā ŋ́. É lɛ ācɛ kú Ɛ́frem ā hīīgwú tɔ̄há, anɔ́ɔ é bū ísu kú Ujɔ́dan mɛ́mla áyɔ́kpá ā jāā kwu Ubɛtibára ā.

eng_Latn: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
idu_Latn: A géē yɔ̄ ī dɛ̄ ka, Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ń gē jé ɛlā ŋ́ mā? Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ń gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nwū um ɛlā, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō klla pi um ahɔ̄ kóō ma ɔwɛ fú gā um ŋ́ mā?.

eng_Latn: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
idu_Latn: Aígbáanɔ gē gwó ɔlɛ́ ce icō aɔ́cí nēe kwu ɔkpá ā ajaajɛ ā, é klla ī gwíijē abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
idu_Latn: Ɛláyíja le ɛfú kpó ce ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛna ā ŋmó, lɛ ɔ́ wā klla kwú ɛbɛ́ nū ú kpó ce ɛyí ɛfú ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kéē lɛ ɔgālā kú éŋkpɔ̄ ɛnɛ kpó wā í cē tū ɔdā kú ɛya ā mɛ́mla ɛfú ā. É le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh; who also was gathered after him: and he sent messengers unto Asher, and unto Zebulun, and unto Naphtali; and they came up to meet them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ga āyā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ dóódu ā, le uwá kpó hīīgwú, kéē yɛce ɔ́. Ó klla le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu ipɔ́ɔma kú Ássa, Usébūlɔn, Unáfutāli, anɔ́ɔ é wā í kwu uwá á.

eng_Latn: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed: then he wrote the dream, and told the sum of the matters.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Ubɛ́lssása wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Udánīyɛlu le ɔ̄na nā klla le ɛbɛ éyi má otú, eko nōó gwutá yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ̄na ɔ́ɔmā tá tāajɛ á. Ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ ɔ̄na kú nū nōó tá tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
idu_Latn: Á gáā lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá tū ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka aígbáanɔ ā, ká ā hijā mɛ́mla anú glá ŋ́. Á kē lɛ ɔ́ŋgbá wū ɔ́ ɔkɔ yɔ̄ ī yɛ ka ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ nɔ̄nyā kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē cōkē nū glá ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them?
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō í gáā hɛ́pɔ̄hi lɛ ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú nū nēe gē jikwū otú mɛ́mla ɛnɔ tū ɔ̄ kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ó géē kpéko bónū kóō tá uwā abɔ̄ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: To subvert a man in his cause, the LORD approveth not.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé le ɛpɔ̄ újí ka únɛ́pɔ̄, Óndú ā jé.

eng_Latn: In that day shall the branch of the LORD be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē yá ka ácí mɛ́mla ɔcí dóódu kóō jɛ̄ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, klla jɛ̄ héyīfuú ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Odúúdú ācɛ nēe hile ā, géē gwéeyē klla í gɔ̄ ohígbu īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ ajɛ kú uwá géē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ n kwú uwā ú kpó pahīla ga ipú aéwɔhá, uwá géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā gē yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí eko dóódu á. É klla le tútū kéē mīyɛ omíci lé eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth ye anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcí olujē tá uwā ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ kéē tíne ka anúɔ lé ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ayíka é wā í mlɛ́nyɔ́ obobowú kú anúɔ. Ɔ́dāŋ kéē wā ŋ́, ɔlá ɔ́ɔ géē yi ŋmá ābɔ̄ ō lɛ ujē kú anúɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú aɔ́cí nēé hī ka aúsɛ́da kú Ulɛ́bānɔn ā ú kpó yi.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan said, Far be it from thee: for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee, then would not I tell it thee?
idu_Latn: Ujonátan tá ohi kahíníī, A gbɛlá ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n le jé péee ka, ádā um gáā yá uwɔ odée nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í le da uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɛ́ɛ géē mīyɛ īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólífu ā mɛ́mla ɔnwū álá kú aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Now all the people that came out were circumcised: but all the people that were born in the wilderness by the way as they came forth out of Egypt, them they had not circumcised.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā nēe bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, le apī kpó hɛ́, amáŋ ācɛnyīlɔ nēé ma eko kú iyāwu kú ígbíli kú uwā ā, é hɛ́ uwā apī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the excellency of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and that which your soul pitieth; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword.
idu_Latn: ami ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛhɔ̄ nyā cɛ̄ lɛ aá ka, Aá bá ī yá ɔbɔ́cɛ kú ɔfú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um ā. Ó he aá ɔtū ō má, kú aá klla ga ipú nū. Amáŋ n gáā je ɔ́ bīya ɛɛ́. Ayí aá nēe hile ipú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, é gē je uwá kpó ŋmó ipú ɛfú.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é géē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛnyā tá ŋmá lɛ ɔyí nɛ̄ ó í ma ā, ɔdāŋ́ ka ó yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ge yíihɔtū tá ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá aɔ́mpa nū. Nɛ̄ ó klla lɛ ɔtu oyēŋēē, ohílīpú mɛ́mla ucē olɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka aíkpokwú nyā ā. É ī ka ka aá ɔ́ɔ kwú ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́, ka aá í kē lɛ eyīyōce kú oócí dúúmā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn lɛ ɔdu klla jéeyī fíyɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo pó ɛlā kú m nyā nōó bī ɔ̄ yúklɔ́ ŋ́, n gē lɛ ɔ́ gbla ɔ̄cɛ olíla nōo gwó inu kú nū ce ɛyí ɔjɛ āa.

eng_Latn: After these things did king Ahasuerus promote Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, and advanced him, and set his seat above all the princes that were with him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ nɛ̄ iyē lé ka Uháman. Ó wɛ ɔyí kú Uhamedáta, ipɔ́ɔma kú Ágāgi, ɔcɛ́ kú Ámālēki. Eko éyi, Ahásɛ̄rɔ̄si, ɔcɛ́ ā le ɔ́ je gicō, kwú ɔ̄ ú yá alápā kú nū.

eng_Latn: Only be thou strong and very courageous, that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law, which Moses my servant commanded thee: turn not from it to the right hand or to the left, that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔtū lɛ ōfōōfūnū, ká ā le lɔfú tīyē, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ īne nɛ̄ Umósīsi je gā uwɔ ā lɛ ā. Ā híī lɛ eyī gwū ɛga dúúmā kú íne ā bónū ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ a kē í yá lɔhi ɛga nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
idu_Latn: Bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí kú alī nēe hɔ́ɔgba likpō-līkpō ā, Amáŋ ka ɛhɔ̄ nōo yɔ̄ okónu ísu ā, Ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú álɔ̄si nɛ̄ Óndú ā tū, ámāŋ bɛ̄ɛka ɔcí kú Usɛ́da kú okónu ísu ā.

eng_Latn: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
idu_Latn: Ákú ipɔ́ɔma kú Íssāka wɛ, Upatíyɛ̄lu, ɔyí kú Ásaan.

eng_Latn: Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
idu_Latn: Unínīfɛ, awɔ ā dúú géē yɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ejé lɛ uwɔ kwú, anɔ́ɔ a yɔ̄ gē túgagá ga ɔwɛ ga ácí ā. A géē dɔɔ̄kā ɛga ō kwu nyɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí aólɛlā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: É géē kpó ūwā tá tū ipú útuló nōo ī cɛ̄ nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ géē jikwū klla géē hīla ayīnu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó nya aá tá ŋmá lɛ ō je Ohɔ́nyɛtá nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka omlede nōó lɛ ɔnyí ámāŋ ka ɛ́kpā dúú ŋ́ mā gwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
idu_Latn: Aá gwó aígelī nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla igá o kpó aálá kú aá tū ɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ, amáŋ, aá lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cokónu nū ā yá jīla.

eng_Latn: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā je ɔkpíyē kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ga ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ onōbí glá āa? Ɛjɛ je ína kú nū nya ŋmá iyī nū iyē glá āa? Ɔ́dāŋ́ kéē yá ɔ́ɔmā glá, ayíka aá nēé gē yá ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá gla ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá glá ŋ́ mā, géē kllɔcɛ́ ká aá yá aɔ́dā nēe le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dóódu géē yá ɛ̄nyā eko nōo géē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, kú ocu kú nū kóō he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
idu_Latn: É wɛ Ótni, Uréfáyēlu, Óbɛ́di, Ɛlsábādi, Ɛlíhu mɛ́mla Usémākíya.

eng_Latn: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ ɔkpá kú íne ā tá pī iyī nū ajaajɛ. Ɔ́ɔ kē í yɔ̄ i jé ɔ̄ eko dóódu cɛ́ɛ́ kóō bī yɔ̄ yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
idu_Latn: Aá géē jé uwā ŋmá ucē kú uwā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ī jé ɔcí ŋmá ikpō kú nū ā. Ācɛ í lɔfú wū alemú ŋmá akwúmba glá ŋ́. É kē wū īkpō ugbánkló ŋmá uwú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?
idu_Latn: É gē kɔ̄kā kú ihɔtū nāa gē mafú eko dóódu ā, ipú únóji nɛɛ? Kɛ̄ɛ ka é ī kɔ̄kā kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a tōō lɔtūce ā áncā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, and spoil them until the morning light, and let us not leave a man of them. And they said, Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee. Then said the priest, Let us draw near hither unto God.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē nyɔ̄ gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya otú, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá ŋmó uwá jāā gbɔ́ɔ̄cī, cɛ́ɛ́ ka aá lɛ odúúdú uwā kpó ŋmó ŋmáajɛ. Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ́ ohi ka ɔdā dúú nɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka ɔ́ lɔhi ā ká ɔ̄ yá mɛ́ɛnɛ. Amáŋ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛyá ā, ka aá lɛ ɔ̄kā da Ɔwɔicō ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gwutá mla ɛbɛ́ ámāŋ, ɔnyā nōo cɛ̄ lɛ ɛbɛ́ lɛ ikpó nū ce. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Gbɛlá kwú um, Ujísɔ̄si, eko nɛ̄ a géē wā í cɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ nááná é kōō jɛ́yí kú ɛlā nē é tá ipú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nēé ka ka ɔ́ɔ géē héyī ŋmá olékwū piíí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
idu_Latn: Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ í yúufi nū á. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɛlá gbo kwu Ɔwɔicō, ufi kóō jīla mɛ́mla anú gē yá um.

eng_Latn: For thou, LORD, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
idu_Latn: Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, awɔ wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ á. Awɔ lɔfú fíyɛ́ ɔwɔ dóódu á.

eng_Latn: Remember what the LORD thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā yá Umíriyam, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
idu_Latn: Ámōōmɛ ɛlā ā wɛ ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ í kwú ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī bī le méyīnyinyi ācɛ ā lɔfú lɛ á, ohígbū kóō le ācɛ kagwó mla iyīnū, nōo ŋmɛ́yí tá oyēeyī nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá Óndú alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ka ka aá le kpaakpa ā le ōwē nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ā má, ó kē le yá uwā eyījii. anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō ka ka amíyɔ í kpɔ́tūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā á.

eng_Latn: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ lɛyíkwu ɔdā nyā ā, amáŋ ɛ̄nyā kóō yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú aá mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō. Ɔtū ī he ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ɔ́dāŋ kóō ŋmó iyī nū ɛpɔ̄bi ŋ́, eko nōó ī lé ɔdā nōó gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi ā.

eng_Latn: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
idu_Latn: Á cíkā ō da ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ kóō wā ká anúɔ kwu ikpɔ̄ɔjɛ ú ŋmá ɔ̄ ikpēyī, nɛ̄ ígbɔ́ɔcí tá uwɔ īkpeyī ā ŋ́. Awɔ oleyīɛpa, kwú ígbɔ́ɔcí nōo tá uwɔ īkpēyī ā ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ gbɔbū cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ ɛbɛ má péee ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a lɔfú je ikpɔ̄ɔjɛ ŋmá ipú ikpēyī kú ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ glá á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, What man shall there be among you, that shall have one sheep, and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day, will he not lay hold on it, and lift it out?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ yɔ̄ ipú aá, nɛ̄ ɔ́dāŋ koó lɛ álá éyi, nɛ̄ álá kú nū ā le tá ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ ɛ̄cī Usábāti, nōó gáā lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ klla kwú ɔ̄ ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋ́ mā āa?.

eng_Latn: And when they were come to the multitude, there came to him a certain man, kneeling down to him, and saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nēé gā ɛgiyí ɛwa āa, ɔ̄cɛ éyi gā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okwúukwu kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū kahíníī.

eng_Latn: I am the LORD: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo wɛ Óndú aá á. Iyē kú um yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ á. N gáā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kɔ̄ ojīlīmā kú um mɛ́mla um ŋ́. Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē cɛ̄ kéē cɛ̄tra aɛ́cí ikoko ami abɔ̄yī um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king's house within.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gēe gbō ɔwɛ ā gaá le ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
idu_Latn: Lɛ anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīifu ā mɛ́mla ɔtulalī umuumu tū ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
idu_Latn: A géē cāŋjɛ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ményinyi Usáyɔn, ohígbū ka eko nāa í tá uwā ɔtūlé ā le yá ɛɛ́. Eko nāa tū ā kē yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
idu_Latn: Ó kpábɔ̄ ɔtā ŋaŋaa lɛyíkwu alɔ bɛ̄ɛka olɛ̄la kú alɔ ā. Ó le odúúdú ācɛ nēe he alɔ ɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā kpó ŋmó. Ujerúsālɛm amānyā a, ícɔ̄nū kú Óndú ā cɛ̄ klá alɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: And Noah did according unto all that the LORD commanded him.
idu_Latn: Unówa lɛ ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ā kpó yá.

eng_Latn: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Aɛ́fu nɛ̄hi gē jíliyē iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā, aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā gē je ja tāajɛ pitoo eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā gā ɛcɛ. Ɛcɛ kpátáá ā le jíliyē, odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā ipú nū ā gē yúufi ī fīyégbúlú.

eng_Latn: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā tóohi kahíníī, Da uwá kée wā fíyaa gaá gwííjē elihɔ kú ikwū lɛ alɔ, jāa gbéeko nɛ̄ alɔ gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū pɛ́ agīje cakpaa.

eng_Latn: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulɔ́du mɛ́mla Uhádīya mɛ́mla ónó wɛ, úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhīlī ce ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya tɛɛtɛ le ujɔ̄ tū gbɔbū kéē lɛ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmó. Abālɔbányā é tínē kéē lɛ Ulásārɔ̄si ŋmó dúú.

eng_Latn: Thou wilt shew me the path of life: in thy presence is fulness of joy; at thy right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
idu_Latn: A gē ma ɔwɛ kú oyēeyī fū ga um. N gē gwéeyē nɛ̄hi eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ɛgiyí uwɔ. Eko nɛ̄ n má kwu uwɔ ajaajɛ, ɔtū gē he um piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan, as the LORD spake unto Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel, and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged, and laid them down there.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa jē ɔ́da lɛ uwá lɛ a. É le ɛcɔ̄ igwɛ́ɛpa kpó ŋmá ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá lɛ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄ kpó nyɔ̄ ɛga nēé gbo ɔtú ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
idu_Latn: Umɔ́dɛkāyi le ɔdā nōo yá nyā tá tāajɛ, klla lɛ ɔkpá kú nū kɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujíyu ɛga dóódu nēé lā ipú ajɛ kú Upɛ́sīya ā.

eng_Latn: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā gē gbo ohílīpú ō bī unwalu gē lɛ ācɛ, klla í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí á. Ɔtū kú uwā kē le mu mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ō plla.

eng_Latn: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Art not thou a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz thy son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā klla da Usádɔ̄ku ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā kahíníī, Má ɔ̄, kwú ɔyí uwɔ Ahímāasi mɛ́mla ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Abíyāta nōo lé ka Ujonátan ā ú ká aá kwúcē ga igelī nɛ̄hi ā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā ā, ó géē kpɛ́fú tá aéwo nēe bá okónu ísu ā. Ó géē yá alɛwa kú ūwā lé. Amáŋ otrɛ̄yí kú éwɔhá éyi, géē wā ī yá ɔ̄ lé, klla í je oōgɔ̄ kú nū pīya áncā. Ó géē je oōgɔ̄ kú ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya ā ŋmó tū ɔ̄ okónu.

eng_Latn: Also I spake to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus saith the LORD; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the LORD's house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon: for they prophesy a lie unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n da ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ā kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō ka aá híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe gē ka ka, eko kpíii é géē kpó iyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā cīgbīhi wā ŋmá Ubábīlɔn ā ŋ́. Ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ nēé bá ī ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá á.

eng_Latn: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
idu_Latn: Ɛgiyí uwā nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ipácí gē wā ī gwá éŋkpɔ̄ á, abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ aíjakī kú ipácí gē gwá éŋkpɔ̄ cɛ́ɛ́ kú ijēēnyi kú uwā kóō mɛ á.

eng_Latn: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new sepulchre, wherein was never man yet laid.
idu_Latn: Ɛhɔ̄ éyi yɔ̄ kwu ɛga nēé nyí Ujísɔ̄si ɔkpá ā. Ipú ɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā únóji ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ éyi yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, nɛ̄ okwū dúúmā í gwutá ipú nū jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka aá gē tá um kwu ɔwɛ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá gē má um bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī kɛlā olíla ohígbu kóō lɛ eyīyōce gɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Thus saith the LORD, Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction, therefore thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā da Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɛlā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ anúɔ ā yɔ̄ á. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ ka ohígbū nɛ̄ awɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ kéē lɛ ɔ́ ŋmó ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le kwu ā, anú géē bī oyēeyī kú nū cíla ulé nū. Ó klla da ɔ́ ka ɛ́ɛ géē je aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū kpó ŋmó ŋmáajɛ dúúdú, ohígbū koó cɛ̄ lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔɔ́mā le pɛ́ kwu dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch the LORD looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
idu_Latn: Ɛ́ɛ́ kú eyī kóō nyā ā, Óndú ā pīyeyī má ajɛ ŋmá ipú ɔ́kpa kú ɔlá mɛ́mla ojuja ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le aícɔ́ɔja kú Íjīpiti ā má. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ígbájí bī wā ipú uwā.

eng_Latn: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
idu_Latn: Aá, ācɛ Ufílipāyi abɔ̄yī aá, jé lɔɔlɔhi ka eko nɛ̄ n yɛ ŋmá Umasɛdónīya ā, aá ōfōōfū aá wɛ ígwu kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe tá um abɔ̄ á, ɛ̄nyā kē wɛ eko nɛ̄ n hútū ō tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi abāābɔ̄ ipú éwo ɔ́ɔmā ā. Aá ōfōōfū aá wɛ ācɛ nēe bī ije le yá um ɛhi á.

eng_Latn: Then I testified against them, and said unto them, Why lodge ye about the wall? if ye do so again, I will lay hands on you. From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath.
idu_Latn: N klla da ācotɔ́hí ā kahíníi, Aá híī gbēyī ɛcɛ kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī Usábāti kóō mɛ ŋ́. Ɔ́dáŋ ka n lɛ aá má abɔ́ɔ igbɔhá, n géē kpɔ́fú kwu aá. Oŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, é bī ɔdā kú ɔ́sí kú uwá wā ɛ̄cī Usábāti ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmāa odúúdú áncɛ́nyā ā cānjɛ, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ agege kú uwā tútū á.

eng_Latn: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
idu_Latn: Ó kē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, nōo kē wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú icɔ́ɔci ā, nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka iyē kú nū ā ŋ́. Ohɔ́nyɛtá gē gbō ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī iyē ā, ī je ɔdōlé lɛ ɔ́, klla ī bī iyē ā bɔ́há mla aéko kú iyē mɛ́mla aíli kú iyē kē jɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ā á.

eng_Latn: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē ka í lɛ eyī yɛ ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, gē lɔfú yá ɔ̄cɛ ágbe bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpacaŋ́gelī ā glá. Ɛlā ō ka ipú íjééyī ɛmɛɛma ā gē gbɔtū nɛɛ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Je eyī gicō ká ā má ɔ̄, odúúdú aópī nēe bá ī ce aɛ́wū aā wɛ ohíkākā mɛ́mla otína cílɛ́cílɛ́ ā. Ohígbū ka n lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Ulában yɔ̄ ī yá uwɔ ā má ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
idu_Latn: Igbō kú aflɛ́yí, nɛ̄ aá géē yá ŋmá īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá ā, aá géē je lɛ Óndú ā, bɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá nɛ̄ aá gē je lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
idu_Latn: É gē lɛ itali fīyɛ ɔnya, é klla gē lɛ anjámī wū ijakī okónu, amáŋ é gē ŋmó olíla ijē.

eng_Latn: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter in law, with her, which returned out of the country of Moab: and they came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ Unaómi mɛ́mla Urútu, ɔncɛ̄nyā kú Umówābu, ɔnyā ɔyí nū ā piyɛyí wā Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm lɛ á. É wā Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm eko nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō cē īkpɔ̄dɛhɔ̄ icō ā.

eng_Latn: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ajɛ lɛ okónu nwūla kwú uwā ú kpó mulɛ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēé lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first; and Benhadad sent out, and they told him, saying, There are men come out of Samaria.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú ayípōklóbīya ā gbɔɔ́ ō ga ɔgbɛ́fú aflɛ́yí. Ācɛ nɛ̄ Ubenhádādi, ɔcɛ́ tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ í jila ajɛ ā, lɛ ohi kpó gē lɛ ɔ́ ka aá má ígwu kú aícɔ́ɔja bá ī pɛ́ wɛɛcɛ ŋmá Usamérīya.

eng_Latn: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yúklɔ́ gē lɛ ɛlá kwu ɛgbá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dóódu. Ó kē ī yúú julu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
idu_Latn: Amárīya, Ahítūbu.

eng_Latn: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ajɛ ā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā lɛ ɛgwā ā ma playi Upɔ́lu abɔ̄, é gbɔɔ́ ō da iyī uwā kahíníī, Ɔtōbɛ́ɛpa í yɔ̄ ɛlā nyā ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔ̄coŋmɔ́cɛ nɛ. Abɔ̄ ó le kwu ŋmá ísu nááná ā, ɛpɔ̄ ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ yēeyī ŋ́ kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
idu_Latn: Aá klla í bī okoolo éyī mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede éyééye.

eng_Latn: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, which should betray him,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujúdasi Iskárīyɔ̄tu, éyi kú ayíkpó kú nū ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe ma ɔ́ ā kahíníī, Ó le jɛ̄ kwɛyí ɛɛ́, aá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā á.

eng_Latn: Neither will I hide my face any more from them: for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: N géē pīya alelékwū kú um klá ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, nɛ̄ ń klla gáā cē igbīhi kwu uwá igbɔhá gbóógbóō gɛ ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: The fierce anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have done it, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it.
idu_Latn: Ɔnū nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄ ā í gáā mɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nōó lɛ ɔdā nōó bī ɔtū ā yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā gaajɛ. Aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā géē jɛ́yí ɔdā nyā igbīhāajɛ.

eng_Latn: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ alɛwa í le yēŋēē ŋ́ mā, é ŋmó ayí omlede kú ɛya kú onyatá ā glá ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ayí kú Ulífāyi klla ŋmó ayí omlede ā lɛ alɛwa kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
idu_Latn: Ujúda kwú pīya ācɛ nēe wɛ ákú Óndú ōfōōfū nū, Ísrɛ̄lu kwu pīya ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
idu_Latn: Uhananíya, Ɛlam, Antotíja.

eng_Latn: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɛ̄yi kú ɛlā ā wɛ ka āyā kú iyē wɛ alɛwa, amáŋ iyē ékpó nēé wɛ á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā, nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu uwá, ayíka ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ wu anúɔ eyī ɛɛ́. Ó ka anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu aéwo nēe ca uwá tā ajɛ, klla kpó uwā yíífi ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
idu_Latn: Aá gā ipú ōjīla kú aɔ́kplá nēé lɛ iyē uwā tá ɔkpáncō ā, ɛgiyí ɔ̄cohɛ́pɔ̄ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ɔdā dóódu ā, ɛgiyí aálelékwū kú ācɛ oyá olɔhi, nēe le yá jīla ā.

eng_Latn: Pharaoh shall see them, and shall be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti í má odúúdú ācɛ nēé kpó ŋmó ipú ɛfú nyā, ó gē tá anú mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā ɔtū lé. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ a á.

eng_Latn: Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our LORD: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the LORD is your strength.
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gaá lɛ ucɛ yá. Aá le ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ejé kú ucɛ kú aá ā, kɔ̄ mla ācɛ nɛ̄ abɔ̄ nyɛ́ lɛ uwá ā. Ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ lɛ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá híī yá ɔtūnōbí ŋ́. Éeyē nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá yá kú aá gwó ā, kóō lɛ ɔfú tū aá iyē.

eng_Latn: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
idu_Latn: N géē je igelī kú aá ā mɛ́mla ikpɛ́cí kú aá yíífi. Ń klla gáā mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gē gwó gā mā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end.
idu_Latn: Jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le tá ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ, abɔ́ɔ ā, nɛ̄ n gáā jé ɔdā nōo géē yá ācobɔ̄bíipú ā á.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
idu_Latn: Ami wɛ Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā. N le ka ɛ́ɛ ka eko kpíi ā, é géē hɛ́ Ubábīlɔn klla ajɛ bɛɛ̄ɛ̄, klla í wú uwá bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é gē wu igwu ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, I will send thee a kid from the flock. And she said, Wilt thou give me a pledge, till thou send it?
idu_Latn: Ujúda tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N géē je ɔyí ɛwū éyi gā uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā cɛ̄, klla kahíníī, A géē je odée gā um ká n̄ lɛ abɔ̄ bī ɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā kú okónu ō ce āa, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ a lɛ ɔyí ɛwū ā bī wā.

eng_Latn: Afterward I came unto the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night will they come to slay thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nyā, n le tá ɔlɛ́ Ussɛmáya, ɔyí kú Udeláya, ɔyí kú ɔyí kú Uméhetābelu nōó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu glá gɛ ŋ́ mā, gāá má ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníi, Ami mɛ́mla awɔ kóō gāá le kwu tayínū ɛga otīīhɔ fíyɛ́ dúú ā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ka ālɔ̄ gāá lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū īyī alɔ, ohígbū kēé gē wā gāá ŋmó uwɔ. Otú dúúdú ŋmá ícɛ é géē wā gāá ŋmó uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?
idu_Latn: Ayíkpó kú Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ̄kā kú ɔdā nōo wɛ ɛyí ita ā da ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
idu_Latn: Blakwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, nāa fu lɛ īyī uwɔ ŋmá ígblé ā. Ācɛ nāa kpo wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ kéē kwú pīya ipɔ́ɔma kú uwɔ ā. Blakwu ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyɔn, ɛga nāa tɛtɛ lā ā.

eng_Latn: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ ōhī kú uwā í kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ŋ́ bɛ́ɛ? Ɔ́ɔmā le ka Ɔwɔicō í tōō lɔtūce ŋ́ kɛ̄ɛ?.

eng_Latn: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa le tá ūlī. É géē tá tū ɛcɔ̄ éyi kahíníī, Akú Óndú ā. É kē í tá tū ɔhá ā kahíníī, Ákú Asásɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes, and took firebrands, and turned tail to tail, and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá le ɛpā ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kwú. Ó le uwá ugbé kpó gbō bá ɔhá ɛpɛɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ó le ácí kwú hílá pla uwá ugbé á.

eng_Latn: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ācɛ ā fu ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma dóódu ā, ɛwa kú uwā wɛ úlā ofu ce igwo .

eng_Latn: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā í jé ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu íne kú uwɔ ŋ́, Amáŋ íne kú uwɔ kē he um ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
idu_Latn: Le uwá eyī kpó pu, ká ā lɛ uwá ikpokwú igbīhi kpó cē.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives, and said unto them, Why have ye done this thing, and have saved the men children alive?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā, le anyōkɔ́ɔma ā kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī yá ɛ̄nyā ā? Nɛ̄ aá cɛ̄ lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā yēeyī ā.

eng_Latn: My bowels, my bowels! I am pained at my very heart; my heart maketh a noise in me; I cannot hold my peace, because thou hast heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.
idu_Latn: Ɔnɔ nɛ̄ um yɔ̄ ī jé ā le fíyɛ́ um abɔ̄. Ɔtū yɔ̄ ī hɛ́ um ko nɛ̄hi. Ń lɛ okónu klá glá ŋ́. N yɔ̄ ī pó abɔ̄ é bá ī tá opo klla bá ī dɛgba ogwú.

eng_Latn: And Moses spake before the LORD, saying, Behold, the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me; how then shall Pharaoh hear me, who am of uncircumcised lips?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Umósīsi tá Óndú ā ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í kōō jāhɔ̄ gā um ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā abɔ̄ ó í lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Uféro géē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ami nōo gē hɔ́ɔ́gwū nyā ā.

eng_Latn: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo mīyɛ ɛkpa éyi kú īkpīije ɔdɔ ā gā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Óndú, n jé uwɔ ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ olɔnɔ nɛ̄hi. A ī cē ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ á nyi ŋ́, klla ī gla ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ á kpó bá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He said moreover, I have somewhat to say unto thee. And she said, Say on.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Adónīja da ɔ́ ka anúɔ lɛ ɛlā éyi nɛ̄ anúɔ gáā ka lɛ ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ Ubatissɛ́ba da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ ka mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
idu_Latn: Igbō nyā wɛ ákú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔma kú nū. É géē lé igbō ā ɛga otīihɔ ā, ohígbū ka ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛga otīihɔ kú ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā, kóō wɛ ákú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ī kpɔ́tūce Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā lɛyá ɛɛ́, íne ā í wɛ ɔkpani kú alɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔ́ bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si. Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔ́ má, ó kahíníī, A wɛ Usáyímɔ̄ni ɔyí kú Ujɔ́ni, é géē hī uwɔ ka Ukífāsi.

eng_Latn: Then Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and warred against Israel, and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you:
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu, Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ kpɛ́fú tá uwā. Ɔcɛ́ ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ubálam, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ kóō lɛ okónu tá lɛ alɔ.

eng_Latn: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔtū kwú gbenyi gā um, ipú kú um kwú gbogodo.

eng_Latn: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá nyā wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔma kú uwā á. É wɛ Éfa, Íssi, Ɛlíyēlu, Ásrīyɛlu, Ujeremíya, Uhódāfiya mɛ́mla Ujádīyɛ̄lu. É klla wɛ aícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi nēé pó ofu uwā ga ɛga dóódu.

eng_Latn: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before the LORD of all the righteous acts of the LORD, which he did to you and to your fathers.
idu_Latn: Ó gɔbū yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Abālɔbányā, aá háyi, ɛga nɛ̄ aá háyi ā, ká n̄ kɛlā klá aá ɛyí ipéyī Óndú. Ká n̄ tá aá ɛlá kwu odúúdú ɔdā idáagó nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó hɛ́ aádáádā aá tá ā.

eng_Latn: Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeketh mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le odúúdú anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kpó hīgwú anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Áá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā gē dɔɔ̄kā ɛlā alɔ ā. Ó le ɛhɔ̄ kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje ɔdɔ anyā ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ayí um tū fu um, ń kē tá glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ubálam pīyɛyí ā, ó má Ubálāki háyi pīyɛ̄ ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kú nū ā mɛ́mla anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umówābu. Ubálāki da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD, and went down to Joppa; and he found a ship going to Tarshish: so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ujóna cāŋjɛ, gbɔɔ́ ō kwu ga Utásīsi ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō. Ó le yɛ tá Ujɔ́pa, anɔ́ɔ ó le úgbéenyi éyi má yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ga Usipéni, ó lɛ ije kú úgbéenyi ā gbā, anɔ́ɔ ó le tá ipú nū kóō ga Utásīsi mla ācɛ ā, ɛga nɛ̄ ó í yɔ̄ ligbó ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
idu_Latn: N le mla ohi ɛlā kú uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ejé nōo le mu ɛtɛ́ yɔ̄ í wú ā. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń má ɛga kɛlā ŋ́, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē je ca bɛ̄ɛka ejé ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nōo gáā je ɔjá ca ohígbū ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ŋmá lɔfú lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā ācɛ nēé pó ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ mā, ó le hɛ́ uwā idáagó abɔ̄ aá gē yɛ mla uwá gē lā oyēeyī obɔ̄bí mla uwá gɛ ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō cá aá ɛcá á.

eng_Latn: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
idu_Latn: Ká ācɛ kú aéwo ā kéē cɛ̄tra awɔ, Óndú, ká odúúdú ācɛ kú aéwo kéē cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ísrɛ̄lu, a wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, ohígbū uwɔ̄ ācɛ í cɛ̄tra um.

eng_Latn: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
idu_Latn: Aá ca um ɛcá igbo alɛwa ɛɛ́. Uwēyī dúúmā í gē yá aá kú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá gē yá um ōwē ā ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language, whose words thou canst not understand. Surely, had I sent thee to them, they would have hearkened unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ń kē tū uwɔ ɛhɔ̄ fu ācɛ kú ewo nɛ̄hi nēe gē ka ucē nōo lɔnɔ ō jé ɛyí nū ŋ. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka n lɛ uwɔ tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í lɛ ɛlā kú uwɔ pó.

eng_Latn: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kahíníī, Yɛce um. Amáŋ ɔnyīlɔ ā kahíníī, Ɔkpani, lɛ ɛga je gā um ká n gaá lɛ ádā um nyī gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Why saidst thou, She is my sister? so I might have taken her to me to wife: now therefore behold thy wife, take her, and go thy way.
idu_Latn: Ɔdīyá, nɛ̄ ā ka ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔyínɛ́ anúɔ nɔ̄nyā āa? Ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je ɔ́ ɔnyā um ā? Abālɔbányā ā, ɔnyā uwɔ yɔ̄ á, kwú ɔ̄ ú kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú aíne kú um ā. Ami wɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā á.

eng_Latn: And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ɔyí dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ka Ɛlísābēti wɛ ɔdɔma, uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa klla le kpó gbo okplící ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ um hɛ́tá klla le um bī wā ɛga nɛ̄ abɔ̄ í kwu um glá gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka ɛlā kú um he ɔ́ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
idu_Latn: Ussállum Amárīya mɛ́mla Ujósɛ̄fu.

eng_Latn: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, n géē tū ɔlá ga ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ugása, cɛ́ɛ́ n kwú igá olɔfú nɛ̄hi kú ɔkplɛ́fú ā ī yɔlá tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
idu_Latn: Ɛpléeko nyā Ɔcɛ́ Uhérɔ̄du gbɔɔ́ ō bɛ́yíkwu ācɛ ōhī kú icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: And, lo, thou art unto them as a very lovely song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument: for they hear thy words, but they do them not.
idu_Latn: Á wɛ ɔdā dúúma ɛgiyí uwa gwū ɔ̄cɛ o gwííjē olɔnyɛ mla ɔkɔ olɔnyɛ, nōo klla jé ō gwō ɔdā oōgwō lɔɔlɔhi tá ŋ́. É ī pó ɛlā nāa gē ka ā, amáŋ é gáā yá odúúmā kú nū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Usiríya wā í hɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu pllaka ā, é kwú ɔyínɔ̄nyā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi kú Ísrɛ̄lu ú ga ɔlɛ́ uwā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gaá kwú pīya ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔnyā kú Unáaman.

eng_Latn: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of the LORD; what should I wait for the LORD any longer?
idu_Latn: Ó kɛlā kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā wā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú ā, abɔ̄yī nū bī unwalu nyā wā í klá alɔ á, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ n cíkā ō gbēyī nū kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ odée yá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ mā ā.

eng_Latn: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔnyōkwu lɛ ayí, amáŋ ka ayááyí, ayí ā cíkā ō nwū úklɔ́ aflɛ́yí kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kú uwā ŋmá lɛ eyī nēe géē lɛ kwu ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔnū kú uwā ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ o bū ɔwɛ ɛ̄nyā a, é lɛ ulé kú oōbī nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ɛ́nɛ́ uwā bī uwā ā cílá uwá. Ɛ̄nya wɛ ɔdā nōo hi Ɔwɔicō ɔtū á.

eng_Latn: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ebilíi nōo plla ācɛ ā tɛ́cɔ̄ ga ipú ókpoó kú ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛcōwō, ɛga nēé tá ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā, mɛ́mla ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ɛcɔ̄ nyɔ̄ gbɔbū ā. É géē yɔ̄ ī móōwē ŋméeko téeko piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
idu_Latn: Ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ ā, Usólōmɔn le yɛ gaá háyi iyɔ̄bū ede ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le eyī pīya kwu ede ā, lɛ abɔ̄ kú nū kpó kwu icō.

eng_Latn: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ lɔfú pó ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā ōhī le íne kú Óndú ā bīya.

eng_Latn: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti le pó ka ācɛ ā le pɛ́ kwu ā, anú mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú nū le ɔtū kú uwā pīyabɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ alɔ yá yɔ̄ āa? Alɔ cɛ̄ le ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ kwu ɛɛ́, alɔ í kē má ācɛ o yúklɔ́ kú ɔfiyɛ lɛ alɔ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thomas saith unto him, Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?
idu_Latn: Utɔ́mɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, alɔ í jé ɛga nāa gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́, abɔ̄ ó yá lɛ nɛ̄ alɔ í jé ɔwɛ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
idu_Latn: É lɛ inu olɔfú kú ɔkplɛ́fú gwó kwu igelī abɔ́ɔ, anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú abɔ́ɔ, kwu ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ, le kwu ga ipú nū, lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū īyī uwā ipú nū, le pɛ́ tá icō nū.

eng_Latn: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta da Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Itíca, ó lɔhi abɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ bá amānyā a! Ālɔ̄ géē ce áklɔ̄kpɛ ɛtá, éyi wɛ ákú uwɔ, éyi wɛ ákú Umósīsi anɔ́ɔ ɔhá wɛ ákú Ɛláyíja.

eng_Latn: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the LORD had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ iháyí kú uwá í jīla ofu ɛɛ́ ŋ́ mā, Udéfīdi í gbo uwá áluka ŋ́, ohígbū ka, Óndú ā cokónu ka, ɛwa kú ayí kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aínyílɔ́ɔwɔ nēe bá icō ā.

eng_Latn: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ŋ́, ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ nēe cíkā ō tīihɔ ā, géē je pīya ācɛ o tēelihɔ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á, n le ɔ́ fō tá céé kóō wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú Ācogwɛ́ɛya.

eng_Latn: And he hardened Pharaoh's heart, that he hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
idu_Latn: Náána ā, ɔtū kú Uféro wɛ ōlɔfú kpɔ́. Ó jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú uwá ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka ā.

eng_Latn: But his wife said unto him, If the LORD were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔnyā nū tá ɔ̄ ohi ka ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā tíne ō kpó aá ŋmó nɛɛ, ɔ́ɔ géē yɛ í mīyɛ ɛya nɛ̄ aá gwó lɛ ɔ́ ā ŋ́, ó klla í yɛ í ma odúúdú ɔ́dā nōo mafú lɛ aá ā fú lɛ aá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē kɛlā nōó ka ā lɛ aá eko ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king's house, and spake to the king, saying,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛbɛdimɛ́lɛ̄ki le tá abɔ́ɔ gáā da ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he said unto her, Thy sins are forgiven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ̄cɛnyā ā kahíníī, N kwú íne nɛ̄ a bīya ā í yá uwɔ ɛhi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
idu_Latn: A kwú ekwu ō yɔ̄ kú um í pīya ijē ōōjē kú éeyē ɛɛ́. A kwú ɔtūnōbí ū ŋmá ɛgiyí um, klla kwú éeyē ú gaá yɛ um jīla tá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
idu_Latn: N mɛ́ɛbɛ kú ɛ̄cɔ̄bū, Anɔ́ɔ n le éwo kú Ísrɛ̄lu má, Ɔcɛ́ nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ínyílɔ́wɔ, ogbɔlɛ́ gbēyī ɔyá ā, géē bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ewo ɔ́ɔmā. Bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́kpa ɔlá kú ínyílɔ́wɔ nōo géē wā, ŋmá Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ó géē ŋmó aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ kú Umówābu, Ó klla í je odúúdu ācɛ kú ajɛ ā wúla tāajɛ, klla í kpó ayí kú Usɛ́ɛ́ti ā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
idu_Latn: Ka ɛ́ɛ bī ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kú uwā gē je ɔtū kú ācɛ okpaakpa nɛ̄ anúɔ í tíne ō bīya uwā ɔtū ŋ́ mā ā gbenyi. Ɛ́ɛ kē ī lɛ ɔfú tū ācobɔ̄bíipú ā iyē nɛ̄ ō ī yá ká e híī pīyabɔ ŋmá ucē obɔ̄bí kú uwá ŋ mā ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ádā um, kwú yá ācɛ nēe bá nyā ɛhi. É jé ɔdā nēé bá yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
idu_Latn: lɛ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa, mɛ́mla odúúdu ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu nēe bá ɔpɛ́ kú Umówābu, okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan kú Ujérīko ā.

eng_Latn: And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nēé le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú éŋkpɔ̄ wɛ ɛcɛ ā, Alelékwū kú Óndú ā kwú Ufílīpu ú, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nēé búdá ā í klla má ɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́ má. Amáŋ ó le yɛ tá ɔwɛ ɔlɛ́ nū yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ umu miya cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ igbō igwɛ́ɛpa yá.

eng_Latn: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo ī bɛ́yíkwu ɔcɛ́ nōó ī gbāājɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō nēé ī bɛ́yíkwu ɔ̄ á. Ɔ̄cɛ nēe kē ī bɛ́yíkwu ɔcɛ́ ā ī dɔ̄ɔkā kéē yá ɔ̄ italā.

eng_Latn: The children of Dishan are these; Uz, and Aran.
idu_Latn: Udíssan wɛ ádā kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Úsi mɛ́mla Áran á.

eng_Latn: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
idu_Latn: É kwú āyā kú ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú Ujɔ́dan ā ú lɛ aípɔ́nū nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ nōo wɛ ɔyí ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ kú Ujófɛ̄fu ā. Umákiri nōo wɛ ádā kú Ugílɛ̄di ā wɛ ɔ́kplá kú Umanásɛ á. Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó klla wɛ ogbēnjūwā mɛ́ɛ̄ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ē kwú Ubássan ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Ujɔ́dan í lɛ ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also bringeth tidings.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī gbāajɛ ā klla le ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá má yɔ̄ ī kwinya wā kpɔ́ á, anɔ́ɔ ó klla da Udéfīdi ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ɔ́ɔ klla yɔ̄ ī kwinya wā kpɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da ɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ klla bī ɔ̄kā olɔhi wā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: If so be they will hearken, and turn every man from his evil way, that I may repent me of the evil, which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings.
idu_Latn: Ekōhī é lɔfú jāhɔ̄ klla pó, nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ í pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ ó bí ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nēé le pīyabɔ̄, n géē pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄, n kē gáā kpó uwā yíífi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n miya lɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí klla gē yi ɔtulalī ɔlá lɛ ɛcí ikpɛ́cí mɛ́mla ɔkwu ɔcí ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ dóódu.

eng_Latn: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gā Ɛ́lim, ɛga nɛ̄ Obuga igwɛ́ɛpa bá ipú alī ofu ɛtá ce igwó ā. Anɔ́ɔ é má bá pi éŋkpɔ̄ ā abɔ́ɔ ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
idu_Latn: Kwú ɛlā kú um ā ú kpó tū ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ, ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwu hɛ̄ uwɔ tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā gbɔbū lɛ éŋkpɔ̄ nōo cēenyi kpɛ́ɛcɛ ā, ācɛ bá ī lé ɔdōlé klla bá ī gwá ā. É bá ī lɛ ɔnyā klla bá ī je ɔnyā lɛ ɔbá, jāā gbó ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Unówa ga ipú Ɔ́wu ā.

eng_Latn: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
idu_Latn: Yá kú odúúdú ācobɔ̄bíipú ā, kéē kwú kpó míya tū ipú ukpa kú uwā ɔ́ɔmā tɔ̄há. Amáŋ ami ā kóō le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ukpa ā.

eng_Latn: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔ o wɛ́ɛcɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔwɔ olímanya, mɛ́mla akpáabana yɔ̄ ī gbo wā ajɛ gblágádáá bū ɔwɔ nōo tū kpúm ā bēhe iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó géē da aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá abɔ̄lúfīyē kú nū ā kahíníī, Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, aá nēé tokónu lɛ aá ā, kú aá nyɔ̄ ipú ɔlíkɔtɔ opiyóó nēé tútū lɛ ebilíi mɛ́mla aálelékwū, ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Why will ye die, thou and thy people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as the LORD hath spoken against the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka á yá lɛ ā ŋ́, ayíka ɛfú ɔkpɛtā mɛ́mla ōcē obɔ̄bí kē í kpó aá ŋmó ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka kóō géē yá éwo dóódu nōo tá ō tɛ́yí wāajɛ lɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá pī um ā ge hokónu tū uwɔ. Hokónu tū ācōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ɔ́mpa alɔ. Ɔwɔicō kó ō hɔ́ɔhā ce aá kpɛ́m. Aamí.

eng_Latn: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ gē kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ́ búdá í gáā wɛ éyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó kōō ī ga ɛga ojīlā kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Óndú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then answered I them, and said unto them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but ye have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kú ɔkpáncō í tá alɔ abɔ̄, nɛ̄ alɔ géē yúklɔ́ ā. Alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄, alɔ í gbo úklɔ́ ā. Amáŋ aá ā, aá lɛ abɔ̄ ipú agbénú dúúmā kú Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē lɛ ukpɛ̄ dúúmā ipú ɔdā úgwū mɛ́mla ucē, mɛ́mla ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla oyēeyī kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm ŋ́.

eng_Latn: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
idu_Latn: Ó í je ígbáanɔ oyēeyī ā, ɔcí kú usɛ́da ā, owú ɔgalúlā ā, mɛ́mla ābɔ̄ kú uháyísɔ̄pu ā í kpó wu ipú oyī kú ígbáanɔ kú aflɛ́yí nēé ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Saul unto the people that were with him, Number now, and see who is gone from us. And when they had numbered, behold, Jonathan and his armourbearer were not there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē lɛ ācɛ gbaáluka, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá jé ācɛ nēe géē héyībí ŋmá ipú uwā a. É le ācɛ ā gbaáluka, anɔ́ɔ é má ka, Ujonátan mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ ō bī iyɔ́fú kú nū ā í bá ipú uwā ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and the LORD blessed him.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā nū ā lɛ ɔyí ā ma, anɔ́ɔ é hī iyē nū ka Usámsin. Ɔyí ā le jɛ̄, Óndú ā kē le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the LORD, choose you this day whom ye will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá kpó kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka aá tíne ō gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā gɛ ŋ́ nɛɛ, aá keé le ɔtū kú aá yéékpónú, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ aá géē gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ā fu ícíícɛ nyā. Ka aɔ́wɔ nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā Umesopotámīya ā kɛ̄ɛ̄ ka aɔ́wɔ kú ācɛ Ámɔn nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā a. Ákú ami mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ um ā, alɔ géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā í cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ ā nū ga ɔlɛ́ kú ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla eyīpɔ́lɛ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ ɔdōlé má le lá lé glá.

eng_Latn: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā Ɔwɔicō lɛ aá hɛ́tá ŋmá ínoōbīya, anɔ́ɔ aá kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú Ɔwɔicō. Ile kú aá wɛ o je oyēeyī kú aá táajɛ lɛ ɔ́ dúúdú, nɛ̄ o ŋmɛ́yí kú nū kē wɛ oyēeyī nōó ī mɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū keé tá ɔ̄ ipu ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ohígbū aá nēe wɛ ācɛ Ujíyu ā, aílɔ́wá ī kɛlā obɔ̄bí kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Ássna mɛ́mla ayí ɔlɛ́ Umeyúnim, Unefísim.

eng_Latn: And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
idu_Latn: É da aɛ́fu ā mɛ́mla aápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā kéē wā í klá aá báajɛ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú aá í kpó tayínū ŋmá eyī kú anú nōo cīīce ɛyí akpa kú ɔcɛ́ ā mɛ́mla ícɔ̄nū kú Ɔyí álá ā.

eng_Latn: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the LORD speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla ka ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ń kɛlā wɛɛlɛ tayínū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē je īyī um tayínū ŋ́. N je ɔ́da lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē wā í dɔɔ̄kā um nēé gáā má um nɛɛ ŋ́. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā gē kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi. N klla ī ka ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him.
idu_Latn: É pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é le cīgbīhi ga Ujerúsālɛm yɔ̄ ī tíne nū.

eng_Latn: But he held his peace, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, and said unto him, Art thou the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si í kōō kɛlā dóódu ŋ́. igbɔhá kpɔ́, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ācɛ ī wóófu nū áā?.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Umósīsi kahíníī, N le ācɛ nēe bá nyā má ɛɛ́, é wɛ ācɛ o yīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú.

eng_Latn: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
idu_Latn: Le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ukpa nyā ā bɛ̄ɛka ígbáanɔ ámāŋ ka īkpɛ̄ɛnū nōo hɛ́ ofitɛ́ abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
idu_Latn: É le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú iyē kú ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tū ipú iyē kú ɔwa kú ókóome ā. Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ɔwá kú ókóome ā wúlatū mla inya ŋmá icō ɛfu ā gwōtū ipú ókpoó ā anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ gebí ipú éŋkpɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
idu_Latn: Igbīhi kú eko nēé lɛ Ujɔ́ni kwú tá ipú agbá ā, Ujísɔ̄si le tá Ugálīli yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And Jesus departed from thence, and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee; and went up into a mountain, and sat down there.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ, le yɛ pī ísu kú Ugálīli. Ó le icō ɛfu éyi tū anɔ́ɔ ó má cīīce á.

eng_Latn: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people?
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwan le ɛlā ā miya mla anyākwɔ́cɛ nēe gē nwū ádā nū, ɛlā ā eko nɛ̄ ádā nū yēeyī ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē ka lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ nēé tíne kéē jé ɔdā dúúmā nɛɛ ayíka é cíkā ō da aɔ́bá uwā ɔ̄kā ɔlɛ́. Ó wɛ ɔdūwēyī nɛ̄hi kú ɔ̄cɛnyā kóō kɛlā ipú ojīlā tɔ̄há kú icɔ́ɔci.

eng_Latn: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be thou of the LORD: I have performed the commandment of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu le tá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu abɔ́ɔ. Usɔ́lu le okónu hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ kahíníī, Óndú ā ká o hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, n le odúúdú ukɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú tū um ā bī yúklɔ́. N kē le ɔdā nɛ̄ ó ka ami ɔ́ɔ yá ā kpó yá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n bī éŋkpɔ̄ opéee nɛ̄hi lɛ iyē gwá, klla lɛ īyī um abɔ̄ na mla ukwɔ-ɔ́cɛ̄ nááná.

eng_Latn: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
