idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ awulú kú īlī ŋmlɛ́ŋmlɛ́ wiiyē mɛ́mla odúúdú ācogwéeya ā, mɛ́mla Ukenaníya, otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwíijē ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ulífāyi nēe bī ikpati kú Óndú ā ā. Udéfīdi klla lɛ īlī kpiíí ɔ́há nɛ̄ ācogwɛ́ɛya í le wiiyē ā wiiyē klá ákú nū icō dúú. Abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ lɛ ācogwíjē ā á.

eng_Latn: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aígelī nɛ̄ ācɛ lā anú lɛwa ā géē je tá alácɛ̄ áncā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, é géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
idu_Latn: A géē gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā klla í yá aíyó kú nū ɔwɛ nɛ̄ n géē mafú gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
idu_Latn: Uhánan, Uhídelu, Ugáha.

eng_Latn: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that ye do? will ye rebel against the king?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usánbālati mɛ́mla Utobíya mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ Árābu éyi nēé hī ka, Ugéssem ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ í tútū ō yá ā pó ā, é le ɛhɛ yɛ tū ācɛ Ujíyu kahíníi, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá ka aá ɔ́ɔ bā í yá ā? Aá gáā yá īkpɛ̄yī olɔfú tá ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
idu_Latn: Ā híīī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kóō je pīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nēé ma ŋmá ipú nōo wɛ okwū, nɛ̄ āyā kú ɔkpíyē kú nū éyi gē je wa ɛɛ́, kóō bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú kú ɛ́nɛ́ nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
idu_Latn: Óndú géē hɔ́hā ce ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē jɛ́lá kú ɔdōlé lɛ aógbɛhá.

eng_Latn: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
idu_Latn: Ihɔtū, eyījii, ímálányī mla ɔdā dóódu kú uwá mɛ ɛɛ́. É lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā dúúmā nōo ī yá ipú ɛcɛ nyā igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
idu_Latn: Uhérɔ̄du mɛ́mla Upáyílēti nēe tɛtɛ wɛ olɛlā ā kwú pīya aóklóbīya ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And he went from year to year in circuit to Bethel, and Gilgal, and Mizpeh, and judged Israel in all those places.
idu_Latn: Ó gē yɛ ajɛ ā bilíbilí iháyí dóódu gē kɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. O ŋmá Ubɛ́tɛlu ga Ugígalu mɛ́mla Umísipa.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban: and Laban ran out unto the man, unto the well.
idu_Latn: Urebéka lɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ éyi nɛ̄ iyē nū lē ka Ulában. Anɔ́ɔ Ulában lɛ inya kwu gɛɛcɛ, ga ɛgiyí ɔ̄cɛ ā, okónu Obugā ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, Hold thy peace, lay thine hand upon thy mouth, and go with us, and be to us a father and a priest: is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man, or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel?
idu_Latn: É da ɔ́ kóō lɛ okónu klá cíí. Kóō híī ka ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú aá mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o nwū aá ɛlā. É da ɔ́ kóō géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ́ fíyɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú odúúdú ipɔ́ɔma éyi kú Ísrɛ̄lu, fíyɛ́ ō wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kú ipú inu ékpónú ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɔ̄ í kwú iyī nū í tá olufa lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ajɛ kú abɔ́ɔ éyi á. Ɔ̄cɛ ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tū ga ɛhɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ nū kóō gē je ɔdōlé lɛ aókóome.

eng_Latn: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.
idu_Latn: Pīyeyī má um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā ményinyi um, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē yá lɛyíkwu ācɛ nāa he uwá ɔtū ā.

eng_Latn: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
idu_Latn: Ámāŋ ń géē yɛ í gwutá únóji yɔ̄ ī gbiyɔ̄lā bɛ̄ɛka, ɔyí nōo gekwú tá ɛ́nɛ́ nū ipú, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē ma ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
idu_Latn: Alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um ā géē gbɔbū lɛ aá, géē bī aá ga ajɛ kú ācɛ Ámɔn, ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, ācɛ Upɛrís, ācɛ Ukénan, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi. N géē je uwá yíífi ŋmá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū aá.

eng_Latn: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ awɔ ā ī leyīkwu ɔdā klla ī lɛ ɔtū kwu itene ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō lé ōfōōfūnū. A gē ŋmó ācɛ nɛ̄ ó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ŋ́. A klla pīya ācɛ tū, ī lɔnɔɔtū lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
idu_Latn: Igbīhāajɛ ā ācɛ nēe yɛce Ómri ā le yálé. Utíbini gekwú anɔ́ɔ Ómri le ɔcɛ́ lé á.

eng_Latn: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ odúúdú aɔ́dā nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ gē yá nɛ̄ n lɔfú ka keé wɛ itene kú um ā, abālɔbányā n le má keé lɛ itene dúúmā ŋ́, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá yá ga um ā.

eng_Latn: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
idu_Latn: Aá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō kóō híīī cɛ̄ lɛ ācobɔ̄bíipú nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ā kéē kpó unwalu nɛ̄hi wā ī ce alɔ ŋ́. Ohígbū koó wɛ ācɛ dóódu cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi nɛ̄ alɔ bī wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hashub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired the other piece, and the tower of the furnaces.
idu_Latn: Umálikīja ɔyí kú Uhárim mɛ́mla Uhássūbu, ɔyí kú Upahamówābu ma āyā ɔhá nōo gboce ɔ́ mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda kú Ófen á.

eng_Latn: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ā híī cɛ̄ gā um kpó uwēyī tū ācɛ nēe lɛ ɔtūce uwɔ ā ɛyí ŋ́, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, awɔ nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú. Ā cɛ̄ ká n̄ bī uwēyī gē lɛ ācɛ nēe gē gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā ā ŋ́, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Upíta lɛ odúúdú uwā nū gɛɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō. Anɔ́ɔ ó le eyī pīya má okwū ā, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Utabíta, cāŋjɛ. Anɔ́ɔ Utabíta lɛ eyī nwūla á, abɔ̄ ó lɛ Upíta má ā, ó má pīya yāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
idu_Latn: A jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tíne ka ā yá ā, anɔ́ɔ a kē le nwū ŋmá ipú íne ā ká ā je ɔdā nōo olɔhi.

eng_Latn: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
idu_Latn: Ka ɔ̄cɛ le apī hɛ́ ámāŋ koó hɛ́ apī ŋ́ ɔ́ɔmā í wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́. Amáŋ ɔdā nōo wɛ odée ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nēé yá ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
idu_Latn: Eko nēé nyi ɔ́ ā, ó bɔ̄bí í klla lɛ ɔfu iyē ŋ́. Amáŋ eko nēé kwú ɔ̄ ú héyī ó géē lɔhi nɛ̄hi klla í lɔfú.

eng_Latn: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
idu_Latn: Ulúk . É tá ɔ̄ ōhī kahíníī, Ācɛ ōhī ka a wɛ Ujɔ́ni oyúbatísim, ācɛ ɔhá ka a wɛ Ɛláyíja, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá kē ka a wɛ éyi kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú eko nɛ̄ncɛ̄ ā nōo héyī ŋmá ɔlékwu ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛlísa kwú agbénú kú ugóolu nyā ú kpó ga ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Óndú ā kóō gbō ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And when it was told David, he gathered all Israel together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le ɔdā nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya yɔ̄ ī yá ā pó ā, ó lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu túbá. Anɔ́ɔ é le bēhé isú kú Ujɔ́dan á. É yɛ le tá Uhálem, ɛga nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya kwāajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛfú ā gbɔɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔyípōklóbīya gē lɛ ɔyípɔ́ncɛ́nyā nōo jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ayí uwɔ géē mīyɛ uwɔ klla leyíkwu uwɔ á. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔbá ɔnyā gē gwéeyē ce ɔnyā nōó lɛ ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ géē gwéeyē ohígbū uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi da uwá kahíníī, Óndú ā ka ka aá yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā á, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔfú kú nū mafú lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é lɛ íkwu nyā je lɛ ɔ́ ā, ó lɛ uwá kpótu ināgbá eyīpú, kē lɛ uwá ikpó kpó wū odó.

eng_Latn: Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da um kahíníī, Ā híīī yá lɛ ā ŋ́! N gē cɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ɛhɔ̄, bɛ̄ɛka awɔ mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ awɔ, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú ɔkpá nyā ā dúú. Gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ Ayisáya, ɔyí kú Ámɔ̄si lɛyíkwu Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm á.

eng_Latn: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
idu_Latn: É kē ī tū ujɔ̄ tū ācɛ olɔhi klla í ŋmó ācɛ nēé lé ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā ɛpɔ̄bí, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: Then fled Moses at this saying, and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he begat two sons.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Umósīsi lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, ó lɛ kwu nyɔ̄ gaá lā ajɛ kú Umídīya. Abɔ́ɔ ā ó le ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ma.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
idu_Latn: Ó yá um eyījii nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ um lɛ eyī yɛ ajɛ nɛ̄ um má ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ō tá um abɔ̄ ŋ́ mā. Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, ícɔ̄nū kú um nōo le ɔfú tū um iyē ā cɛ̄ ga um le yálé ōfōōfū um.

eng_Latn: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
idu_Latn: Aá gwéeyē ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācɛ gē cá aá ɛcá ohígbū ka aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɛ̄nyā cābɔ̄ ka ɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā yɔ̄ mla aá.

eng_Latn: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ géē kwú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō lɛ ā ā. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē yá ibīyājɛ tū Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā le jī ɛɛ́. Ó géē lɔhi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ kéē ma ɔ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
idu_Latn: Ébram wɛ iháyí ofu ɛnɛ ce ɛhīlī eko ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
idu_Latn: É le ɛfú kpó tá ācɛ Umídīyan ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka āa. É le odúúdu ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David's friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, God save the king, God save the king.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Uhússāyi, ɔ̄cɛ kú Ááki, oklóbīya Udéfīdi ā gā ɛgiyí Ábsālɔm ā, ó le ágbá tá ɔ̄ kahíníī, Ágábáidu, ɛyí kú uwɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ tápátɛ́cɔ̄, ɛyí kú uwɔ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ tápátɛ́cɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā, ámāŋ ɔyí ádā nū nɔ̄nyā lɛ ɔnyā, aá géē je uwēyī lɛ uwá ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ uwá kpó nū ŋmá ipú ójīla kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu. Ó í móōwē kú ɔdā nōó yá ā, ohígbū koó le ikpó ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā ce.

eng_Latn: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā géē kwú uwā í kpó uwā, tɔ̄há ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā. Ó géē gwū ɔwɛ tū uwá ipú agbá abɔ́ɔ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ eko nōó ī yá uwā italā ā gā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him, whom Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām kwú iyē ú ce ɔyí nɛ̄ Usára, ɔnyā nū, ma lɛ ɔ́ ā ka Áyísīki.

eng_Latn: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka abɔ̄ ɔ́ɔ le pīya Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, ka ɔ́ɔ gáā habɔ̄ uwā tá ámāŋ kpó uwā yíífi ŋ́. Ó klla ka ɔ́ɔ gáā mlanyī ɛka kú nū mla aádáádā uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ɔ́ɔ kahíníī, Ipú odúúdú éwo kú ɛcɛ ā, aá ōfōōfū aá nɛ̄ n jé, klla le ɛlá kwu aá á. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n géē yá italā piíí ā wɛ, ohígbū íne kú um nɛ̄ aá bīya ā.

eng_Latn: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ italā nēé géē yá ācɛ Íjīpiti mɛ́mla odúúdú aéwɔhá nēe tá kéē nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm gáā lé ucɛ kú áklɔ̄kpɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man's judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.
idu_Latn: Á kú um ā, ń lɛ ɛlá wu ɔ́ nóó ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ tū um, ámāŋ ka únɛ́pɔ̄ kú ācɛ ɔlamu yɔ̄ ī kɛpɔ̄ tū um ŋ́. N kōō ī kɛpɔ̄ tū iyī um ipú ɛlā nyā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɛya nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā géē wā í gwó ā í he Óndú ā ɔtū, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ he ɔ́ ɔtū íkée ā.

eng_Latn: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é kē bá abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī alɛwa ā, Ufɛ́sitɔ̄si kwú ɛlā kú Upɔ́lu ā ú tá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ ā kahíníī, Ó tū olagbá éyi nɛ̄ Ufélīsi mā ɔ̄ tá ipú agbá.

eng_Latn: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant's sake, and for Jerusalem's sake which I have chosen.
idu_Latn: Ń gáā mīyɛ odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā ŋmá abɔ̄ nū dúúdú ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm nōo wɛ igelī nɛ̄hi kú um ā. N géē je ipɔ́ɔma ékpónú lɛ ɔ́ kóō lé ɔcɛ́.

eng_Latn: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
idu_Latn: Ikwū nēé gē je ā wɛ áncā, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā í gē pó ŋ́. Ó kōō ī pīyeyī má uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
idu_Latn: Ó géē yɔ̄ í lɛ ayááyí piyóó, n kē í yɔ̄ í gbō ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū eko dóódu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛnɔ í yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ icō kpɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā lɔhi, ó kē he Ɔwɔicō nōo nya alɔ tá ā ɔtu.

eng_Latn: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā nōo yá ɔkwɛ̄yi ā wɛ ka ɛya nēé gē gwó ŋmá iháyí ga iháyí ā gē tá ācɛ ɛlá kwu íne nēé gē bīya ā.

eng_Latn: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword: and the LORD wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to spoil.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó mahayí, kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufílīstiya jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú nū kwú gɔ́ bá ɔkpacaŋgelī kú nū nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ nwūla abɔ̄ je ɔkpacaŋgelī ā táajɛ glá ŋ́. Óndú ā cɛ̄ le uwá le aólɛlā kú uwā yálé nɛ̄hi ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛfú ā mɛ ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwúcē ga ɛgiyí Ɛlísaa gaá le iyɔ́fú mɛ́mla ɔkplɛ́fú kpó ŋmá iyē kú okwū nēe báajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
idu_Latn: É dɛ̄gba igbɔhá kahíníī, Álɔ̄ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō! Ɔlá nōo je Obábīlɔn, igelī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔmā yi tāajɛ í yɔ̄ ī yi piyóó piyóó.

eng_Latn: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjatharba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
idu_Latn: É yɛ lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ukénan nēe lā Uhɛ́brɔn, nēé tɛtɛ hī iyē kú uwā ka, Ukiriyati Ába ā. É le aípɔ́ɔma kú Ussésāyí, Ahíman mɛ́mla Utálimāyi ā kpó yálé.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ éyi, nɛ̄ iyī nū wɛ Ujáyīrɔsi ā gā, anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ó lɛ Ujísɔ̄si má ā, ó gaá gbo klá ajɛ le okwúukwu kwajɛ iyɔ̄bū nū.

eng_Latn: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
idu_Latn: Kɛlā kwɛyí uwā, ká ā hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa. Lɛlá kwu ɔ́ ká ā je ukpɛ̄ kú aógbɛhá lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ɛcɛ ā, ami wɛ ɔlá-ofíyajɛ kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kéē lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ agwú mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí kú ɔkpíyē nɛ̄ ifu yɔ̄ gē pɛ́ ŋmá anú, mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo kwú iyī nū ú tēelihɔ ŋmá lɛ abɔ̄ ō kwu okwū, ú nū ŋmá ipú kú ɛga nɛ̄ aá lā ā.

eng_Latn: And her father said, I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her; therefore I gave her to thy companion: is not her younger sister fairer than she? take her, I pray thee, instead of her.
idu_Latn: Ó da Úsámsin ka anúɔ gbɛlá ka ɔnyā nū ā ɔ́ he ɔ́ ɔtū gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā anúɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ oklóbīya nū ā. Ó da ɔ́ ka, amāŋ, ɔyínɛ́ ɔnyā ā nɛ̄ŋ́cɛ́ ɔ́ɔ kē jɔ̄ɔ́ncɛ̄nyā fíyɛ́ ɔ̄ á. Ká ɔ̄ kwú ɔ̄ ú kwɛyí nū mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray thee, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow thee. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to thee?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa habɔ̄ aɛ́na ā tá le inya kwu tá Ɛláyíja ɔkwu á. Ó klla da Ɛláyíja kahíníī, Ń nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ úŋmóō tá ɛ́nɛ́ um mɛ́mla ádā um ɛ́ɛ́, ká n̄ géē wā í yɛce uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kahíníī, A lɔfú kwúcē, amáŋ gbɛlá kwu ɔdā nɛ̄ n yá uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
idu_Latn: Yá ka ɔtū kóō he ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, ohígbū ka ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā ā gē gicō ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market: and thou wast replenished, and made very glorious in the midst of the seas.
idu_Latn: Aúgbéényi kú Utássīsi gē kpó iyó kú uwɔ ga ɛga dóódu nāa tíne ō kpó uwā nyɔ̄ á. A lɛbɛ̄ɛka úgbéenyi nōo ce eyī ísu lɛ iyó kpó omōmu ā.

eng_Latn: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
idu_Latn: ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ eko nōó yɔ̄ ī gwó inu kú nū ā, lɛ ɔ̄gɔ̄ ikpíinu ā bū lipú gaá fu ɛcɔ̄ anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ikpíinu kú nū ú táajɛ ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ á. Īsu cēenyi kla inu ɔ́ɔmā, amáŋ ó jila ɔ́ iyē glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
idu_Latn: N má úklɔ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicɔ̄ je lɛ ayí kú ācɛ kéē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And they offered unto the LORD the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
idu_Latn: Ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ó le aɛ́nɛ úlā ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla aálá úlā igwáhāapa ce ofu igwó kpó gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā ŋmá ipú aɛ́nɛ̄ ó kpó ŋmá ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
idu_Latn: Anú nyɛ́ fíyɛ́ īkpō ɔcí dóódu á, amáŋ eko nōó le jɛ̄ kwɛyí, anú nwuné fíyɛ́ ɔcí nɛ̄hi dóódu nɛ̄ ācɛ tū á. Anɔ́ɔ ó le pīya ɔcí nɛ̄hi cɛ́ɛ́ aígbáanɔ kú ɔkpáncō gē wā gaá gwó ɔlɛ́ kú uwā ce ābɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi. Ó dɔɔ̄kā ō ma ícɔ̄nū kú nū fú. Ó klla dɔɔ̄kā ō yá kú ācɛ kéē lɛ ɔfú kú nū jé. Amáŋ ó lɛ ɔtū lé nɛ̄hi mla ācɛ nōó gáā cɔ̄nū kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā ā, ācɛ nōó cíkā ō je kpó yíífi bónū ā.

eng_Latn: When therefore the LORD knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ufárisīi le pó ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī lɛ ayíkpó alɛwa, klla gē yá ācɛ alɛwa ubatísim fíyɛ́ Ujɔ́ni á.

eng_Latn: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā ācɛ ōhī géē bī ugóolu ámāŋ oje nɛ̄hɛ́ ámāŋ ka ɛcɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi le gwó inu cɛyí ikpíinu ā. Ācɛ ɔhá lɔfú bī ɔcí ámāŋ ka ácí amáŋ ka eko kú ácí le gwó inu ā glá.

eng_Latn: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ̄nyā yá nɛ̄ ajɛ ā je ŋmíkpākplā, anɔ́ɔ ɔdā dóódu í yɔ̄ ipú nū gɛ ŋ́ má. Kwu aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aébéenyi le pɛ́ gekwú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
idu_Latn: Aólíla ā kwú agege kú uwā í, amáŋ é bī anɔ̄ ohá dúúmā ipú íkpém mla iyī uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for thee? tell me, what hast thou in the house? And she said, Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nāa tíne ká n yá ga uwɔ ā? Ɔdí nāa lɛ ipú inu ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā? Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā ā tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ń lɛ ɔdā dúúmā inu nóó, ayíka ɔjá kú anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ólīfu ā ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: These things have I spoken unto you, that ye should not be offended.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla da uwá kpɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ ɔdā nēe bá ā kpó ka lɛ aá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá híī kwúcē ŋmá o cɛ̄ ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ayisáya klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ Ubábīlɔn! Aá gwéeyē ká aá tɔ́ɔga gbōōō. Aá tɔ́ɔna gbōōō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá yá ka ācɛ nēe bá ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā kéē le jé, ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ lɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ɔcōcɛ̄hɔ kú nū, nyatá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
idu_Latn: Óndú, ményinyi um, ohígbū ka n yɔ̄ ipú ákanya. Ɛ̄jɛ̄ kū ikwū ō je le jɛ̄ um ɛɛ́. N le gbagbafú nɛ̄hi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī aflɛ́yí kú ɔyā ahāapa ā, aá géē jīla tɔ̄há kú aá gbā Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄gbā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā yúklɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, í wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé í tá opo.

eng_Latn: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ Ámɔ̄n ga ɛcɛ gaá le hɔgba kú ɛfú okónu kú igá kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Urába ā á. Aɔ́cɛ́ nēe wā í tábɔ̄ ā gaá bá odúdɛcɛ ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces, and wash the inwards of him, and his legs, and put them unto his pieces, and unto his head.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ ɛbɛ́ kú omlede a kpó hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́, lɛ iyípú kú nū, īkpɛ̄yí mɛ́mla iklíkpó kú nū kpó na, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú uwā í kpó ce ɛyí ede mɛ́mla ɔdā o hile nēé hɛ́ kpɛɛ́kpɛɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó le aɔ́cɛ́ olɔfú nɛ̄hi ā kpó ŋmó, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: And the seven had her, and left no seed: last of all the woman died also.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ayínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ahāhílahāapa ā kwú ɔnyā ā ú ɔnyōkwú kpɛ́mm á. Ó kē ma ɔyí lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu kú uwā ŋ́ má. Igbīhāajɛ mɛ́ɛ̄ ā, ɔnyā ā klla gekwú.

eng_Latn: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
idu_Latn: Ālɔ̄ lɛ iyí alɔ hɛ́tá, ŋmá ipū abɔ̄ kú Óndú ā mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ó fu ā. É klla kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ agbá kú uwā hɛ́ ŋmá iyī alɔ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, and the daughters of the famous nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, yēekwu kú odúúdú ācɛ Íjīpiti. Lɛ uwá kpó ga ɔlékwū mɛ́mla ācɛ olɔfú kú aéwo ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le ācɛ ā gbaáluka le iyē kú uwā tá tū ɔkpá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā da ɔ́ lɛ ipú ígbíli kú Usáyínāyi ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.
idu_Latn: Ó da ɔ́ Ka, Nyɔ̄ gaá yɛ ipú odúúdú igelī kú Ujerúsālɛm ka á lɛ ína pi tū údɔbū kú odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ucē ɛbí nɛhi nɛ̄ ācɛ gē yá ipú igelī gē kwú uwā iyē klla ī je unwalu lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: And it was told Solomon, saying, Behold, Adonijah feareth king Solomon: for, lo, he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Solomon swear unto me today that he will not slay his servant with the sword.
idu_Latn: É gaá le da Usólōmɔn ka Adónīja ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í yúúfi nū anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ nyɔ̄ í kwú abɔ̄ ú fúlá tū aájī kú ede ā, yɔ̄ ī ka ka anúɔ tíne kú Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā kóō lɛ ɛka gbo lɛ anúɔ kóō gaá ŋmó anúɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And thou his son, O Belshazzar, hast not humbled thine heart, though thou knewest all this;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ awɔ, ɔyínū, Ubɛ́lssása nōo jé ɛ̄nyā nááná ā, í tū ɔtū kú uwɔ wāajɛ ŋ́ kpɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
idu_Latn: n géē yá italā. N géē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá aá. Ōcē nōó lɛ ɛcí ŋ́ mā, mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ o géē je aá eyī kpó pu nōo géē yá kú aá mɛ tāajɛ ā géē yá aá. Aá géē nyi ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá, amáŋ é gáā tīile lɛ aá ŋ́. Ohígbū ka aólɛlā kú aá géē yá aá lé, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú ɔdā nɛ̄ aá nyi ā ú kpó lé.

eng_Latn: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
idu_Latn: N gē cɛ̄tra aá ohígbū ka aá gē blakwu um. Aá klla gē bī ɔdā nɛ̄ n nwū aá ā le yúklɔ́.

eng_Latn: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā kahíníi, Awɔ Óndú ā, awɔ ofōōfū uwɔ wɛ Óndú á. Awɔ yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ kú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū á. Awɔ yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ísu mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōo bá ipú uwā á. Awɔ je oyēeyī lɛ odúúdú uwā klla gē lɛ uwá tū á. Odúúdú aígabɔ̄ nēe lɔfú, klla lɛ íkwu kú ɔkpáncō dóódu gē túkpɛɛ́ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā awɔ.

eng_Latn: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be pulled up out of their land which I have given them, saith the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: N géē bū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um tū ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n je lɛ uwá ā kli, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē bū ɔcí tāajɛ kli ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔdā dúúmā í gáā fu uwá ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ abɔ́ɔ glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
idu_Latn: Ufi le um kwú, n kē yɔ̄ ī fīyégbúlú, Ipú kú um kwú gbogodo ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
idu_Latn: N wɛ ɔdāhá fíyɛ́ ɔdā nēé ī je um ka ɔlɛɛcɛ. Ń kē lɛ ohílīpú nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ gē lɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD the maker thereof, the LORD that formed it, to establish it; the LORD is his name;
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ami wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yá odúúdú ɛcɛ, klla lɛ ɔ́ kwu ajɛ á. Uyáwɛ wɛ iyē um á.

eng_Latn: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
idu_Latn: Oŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ipɔ́ɔmā kú ipú ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ipú ɛcɛ nyā lɛ oyēeyī á.

eng_Latn: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ācɛ nēe lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí yá, ācɛnyīlɔ o cikpɔ́ ācɛnyīlɔ ɔ́mpa uwā ámāŋ́ ka ācɛnyā ō cikpó ācɛnya ɔ́mpa uwā. Ācɛ o kwú ācɛ je lá, ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ ogbɔkpá ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄. E yá íne ā ohígbū ɔdā dúúmā nōo ge bɛ́yí kwu ɔdā okpaakpa nēé gē nwū ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ámāŋ eko ɔ́ɔmā í wā ā ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔkpáncō ámāŋ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ā, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka Ádā ā ōfūnū nɛ.

eng_Latn: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Utáyítɔ̄si kóō nyɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ n klla tū ɔyínɛ́ ɔhá ā mla anú á. Aá géē ka ka Utáyítɔ̄si lɛ aá pīyatū nɛɛ? Ami mɛ́mla anú gē bī ɛdɔ ɔtū ékpó gē le yúklɔ́. Ami mɛ́mla anú gē yúklɔ́ ɔwɛ ékpó.

eng_Latn: Or else let these same here say, if they have found any evil doing in me, while I stood before the council,
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ ācɛ nēe bá ā abɔ̄yī uwā kéē ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā nēé má ɛgiyí um ā tɛ́ɛ́cɛ eko nɛ̄ n háyi iyɔ̄bū Ukánsulu ā.

eng_Latn: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ opo ā tá ɔkɔ okpií okónu ɔ́mpa, ācɛ nēe lā ābɔ̄ ɛháajɛ ā géē cālɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔkɔ kú opo o tá kpií igbɔmpa gē yá kéē cālɛ́.

eng_Latn: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɛlā ka kwɛyí ā, ɔ̄cɛ Ufarísīi éyi lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú kóō wā í le ɔdōlé lé ɔlɛ́ nū. Anɔ́ɔ ó le bēhé ga ipú inu gaá cīce kóō lé ɔdōlé á.

eng_Latn: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
idu_Latn: Aá ga ɛgiyí Óndú kóō tá aá abɔ̄, ká aá yɔ̄ ī gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of God into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of the LORD, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, da Usádɔ̄ku ka ɔ́ɔ kwú Ikpáti kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā ú kwúcē ga ipú igelī nɛ̄hi ā. Ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛlā anúɔ ɔ́ɔ he Óndú ā ɔtū, ó géē je anúɔ kwúcē wā í má Ikpati kú Ɛka ā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɔfú cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ lā ipú ɛbɔ́ eko kpiíí ā glá, amáŋ eyī kú nū kwu ɔ̄ɔ́ mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nōó gē yá ā gɛɛ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he cometh into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
idu_Latn: Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Árɔ̄ni nēé lɛ abɔ̄ ce ɔ́ ɛyí kóō wɛ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kwɛyí ádā nū ā, nōo gē ga Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ gaá cɛ̄ɛhɔ̄ ipú ɛga Otīihɔ ā, Ó géē lɛ ɔ́ wiiye ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō le ɔmɛ cē ŋmá ajɛ, le ɔlɛɛcɛ ma ŋmá anú, anɔ́ɔ ó le owu kú oyēeyī fu tū ɔ̄ ɔ̄gɛ̄nwū anɔ́ɔ ɔlɛɛcɛ má yēeyī á.

eng_Latn: And Moses returned unto the LORD, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō, gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe bá nyā le ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá. É bī ugóolu le aɔ́wɔ ɔhá yá lɛ iyi uwā, klla gbō ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
idu_Latn: Ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce ā mla ihɔtū kú aá nyā ŋmá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá leyīce, nēé kē le tū céé ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ lɛ aá ā. Eko nēé bī ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā gé lɛ aá aflɛ́yí ā, nɛ̄ aá pó lɛyíkwu ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá kpéyīce yɔ̄ ī gbēyī nū nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of the LORD: and Jotham his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
idu_Latn: Usíya kwú gbagwú ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ó kwú. Ohígbū agwú kú nū ā, ó má lā ɛga ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hɛ ācɛ o hile ā tá, ó klla wā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē yúklɔ́ kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ujótām gbɔɔ́ ō gbāājɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Ujerúsālɛm lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Thou shalt drink of thy sister's cup deep and large: thou shalt be laughed to scorn and had in derision; it containeth much.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, A géē gwá ŋmá okoolo kú ōwē kú ɔyínɛ uwɔ ɔ́ɔmā. Okoolo ɔ́ɔmā lɔwá klla lipú. Odúúdú ācɛ géē yá uwɔ okónu klla í yɛhɛ tū uwɔ, ohígbū ka okoolo ā le mu.

eng_Latn: Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka, N géē yá kú ayí aá kóō bá ahɔ̄ olɔhi nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ yɔ̄ íkée ā kpɔ́. N klla géē jē uwá pīya éwo kpɔ́cíí. N kē í yá ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo í pīya uwá tū ā italā.

eng_Latn: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
idu_Latn: Aá wā kú ālɔ̄ túkpɛɛ́ɛ́, kú ālɔ̄ gbā ɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā, ká ālɔ̄ lɛ okwúukwu kwu ajɛ iyɔ̄bū kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yá alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thy teeth are like a flock of sheep that are even shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none is barren among them.
idu_Latn: Ayīnu kú uwɔ wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ kwɛ́mm bɛ̄ɛka aálá nēé lɛ uwá ɔnwū wā, klla le uwá iyē gwá bōōbū á. Odúúmā í fu ŋmá anú ŋ́, odúúdú uwā jōōjīlē kplīgīdī.

eng_Latn: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É je Ussɛ́kɛm, igelī ɛyí ɛfu kú ɛga o kwinya ɔ́ci nyɔ̄ kú Ɛ́frem ā, Ugɛ́sa.

eng_Latn: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king's son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi cāŋjɛ le yɛ mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū gaá lɛ ācɛ Ufilístiya ofu igwó kpó ŋmó, le ikpɛ̄yí kú odúúdú uwā hɛ́ le kpó gé lɛ Usɔ́lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō kwú pīya ohilí kú ɔcɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Usɔ́lu kwú Umáyíka ú lɛ ɔ́ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū.

eng_Latn: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú uwɔ le ɛgba ōgwú dɛ̄ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā ɛɛ́. É kwú otúta kú uwá ú kwu ajɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwá ā, gē mafū ka aá le yálé ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Samuel did that which the LORD spake, and came to Bethlehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Comest thou peaceably?
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ ā yá, anɔ́ɔ ó le yɛ tá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m á. Anyākwɔ́cɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā wā í jīla anú ɔwɛ, bá yɔ̄ ī yúufi, gē fiyégbúlú. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ̄kā ka ɔ́ɔ wā ɛbɔ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē je gā uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdōcabɔ̄ āa? Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ɔdā ō plɔkɔ nɛ̄ iyē kú uwɔ yɔ̄ anú mɛ́mla ɔ́ngbá kú nū, mɛ́mla okwutɛ kú uwɔ nɛ̄ a bī ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujúda le aɔ́dā ā kpó lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó má gwutá mɛ́mla anú á, anɔ́ɔ Utáma le ipú yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ dúú nɛɛ, ó cíkā ō lɛ ɔdōlé lé ŋ́má ɔlɛ́, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kɛpɔ̄ tū aá abɔ̄ aá gē jīla tɔ̄há ā ŋ́. N géē da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá lɛyíkwu aɔ́dā ohile ā eko nɛ̄ n gā.

eng_Latn: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
idu_Latn: Ɔbá nū gē ka kahíníī, Anyā olɔhi alɛwa bá nɛ̄hi dúú ɛ́ɛ́, amáŋ awɔ fíyɛ́ odúúdú uwā á.

eng_Latn: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá íkpa kú ádā nū, Ussíya. Ohígbū ka ó le ɔdā olɔhi yá ɛgiyí Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her, then she left speaking unto her.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Unaómi má ka Urútu ɔ́ɔ lɛ abɔ̄ kwu ɔtū kóō nyɔ̄ mla anúɔ piíí ā, ó klla ka dúúmā ɔhá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
idu_Latn: Ń kē mā ayókwū tá lɛ ɛmiyɛ ŋmó uwā, eko nɛ̄ n lɛ gē lé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
idu_Latn: N cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī gē jikwū klá uwɔ ká ā tá um abɔ̄, eyīyōce kú um yɔ̄ ipú ɛlā nāa í ka ā.

eng_Latn: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shalt thou say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease thee, for the sword devoureth one as well as another: make thy battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage thou him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ujówābu tɛ̄hɔ̄ wā fu ɔ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í tá Ujówābu ɔtū kwɔtū cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kú nū ka ɔ́ɔ̄ híī wu klíicō ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔ́ɔ jé ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛfú ɔ́ɔ ī lé ā ŋ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ da Ujówābu ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔfú kpó kwu igelī ā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ̄ mīyɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄ɔkwu.

eng_Latn: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff, what hast thou found of all thy household stuff? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren, that they may judge betwixt us both.
idu_Latn: A lɛ odúúdú iyó kú um kpó jila ɛɛ́, ɔdí kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ nɛ̄ a má ā? Kwú ɔ̄ ú tá iyɔ̄bū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ, kéē lɛ ɛpɔ̄ kú ami mɛ́mla awɔ hɛ́.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
idu_Latn: Aá klla gáā má aéwɔhá nōo ī yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ klla ī ka ucē nɛ̄ aá pó glá ŋ́ mā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ása, ce ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ubássa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu le ɛfú kpó í gwū ācɛ kú Ujúda klla gbɔɔ́ ō hɛ́ igá tū Uráma, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō ŋmá Ujúda wā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā gē ga ajɛ kú Ujúda glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔdāŋ́ keé lɛyí táajɛ lɛ íne kú Óndú ā ŋ́, nēé gbɔɔ́ ō gbā aɔ́wɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā. Ipú ɔnū nōó í cɛ̄ ā, ɔ́ɔ géē yá uwā italā, nɛ̄ eko kpiií, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í gáā hile ipú ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ uwá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Judah, and made themselves a king.
idu_Latn: Eko kú ɔcɛ́ Ujɛhóram ā, Ɛ́dɔm kwú hɛ́ ŋmá Ujúda, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pīya éwo kú abɔ̄yī uwā á.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, O our God, hear the prayer of thy servant, and his supplications, and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's sake.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú um, pó ɔkɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄ba nɛ̄ n ba uwɔ ā, ohígbū iyē kú uwɔ. Lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ nōo tá alácɛ̄ ā túgwó kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.
idu_Latn: Ujówābu le ɔ́da je ka ɛ́ɛ̄ le opo tá, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɛ́ɛ̄ híī kpɛ́fú gɛ ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū le cīgbīhi ŋmá ō nū ācɛ ā inya tá á.

eng_Latn: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā lé ɔdā ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya, nēé le oyī kú nū bī wā Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ gaá lɛ gwɛ́ɛya ɛga otīihɔ ā ŋ́, é géē je odúúdú nū yɔlá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel's handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ubílha, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Urécɛ̄lu ā wɛ Udáni mɛ́mla Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka aá yēeyī yɔ̄ ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú aá dɔɔ̄kā ā, aá géē kwú, amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ́ ka o ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Alelékwū nɛ̄ aá mā ucē kú ínoōbīya tá, aá géē yēeyī.

eng_Latn: But when Jesus knew it, he withdrew himself from thence: and great multitudes followed him, and he healed them all;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si le ujɔ̄ nēé tū ā jé ā, ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa yɛce ɔ́, ó klla le odúúdú ācɛ nēe gē doōcē kpɛ́ɛ́m ā hɛ́tá.

eng_Latn: Blessed shalt thou be in the city, and blessed shalt thou be in the field.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ géē hɔ́hā ce ipú aígelī mɛ́mla ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For, lo, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
idu_Latn: É le aádā alɔ kpó ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, anɔ́ɔ é le anyā alɔ mɛ́mla ayí alɔ kpó bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ŋmá ɔlɛ́ alɔ á.

eng_Latn: The ransom of a man's life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
idu_Latn: O lɛ ijē ā, gē bī ije kú nū lɛ nya oyēeyī kú nū tá. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ogbɛhá ā í lɛ unwalu kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó gē fu ɔ́ ɔnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka ācɛ ā kéē híī gwéeyē klla yá ucɛ gɛ ŋ́. É gáā lɛ ɔnyā mɛ́mla ɔbá gɛ ŋ́. Ācɛ í kē gáā má aíkpɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ gbā ɛgɔ̄ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī bá ī hɛ́ ɔlá kwu agege ipú ajɛ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; then I could have borne it: neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka olɛlā kú um yɔ̄ ī yá um okónu á nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í lɛ ɛlā wu ɔ́ ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī héyī tū um ā yɔ̄ ī gwō lɛyíkwu um á nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í kwú ɔwɛ kú nū ú tá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē kpó aɔ́cɛ́ bá ajɛ klla ī je uwá pīya áncā.

eng_Latn: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ujísɔ̄si kwú ɔyí ā abɔ̄ ú gicō anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Nyāŋjɛ ɔyí.

eng_Latn: Then it shall come to pass, that the sword, which ye feared, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt, and the famine, whereof ye were afraid, shall follow close after you there in Egypt; and there ye shall die.
idu_Latn: ayíka ɛfú mɛ́mla ɛmiyɛ nɛ̄ aá ī yúúfi uwā í nū aá wā ipú ajɛ Íjīpiti, géē wā í kpó aá ŋmó abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna éyi, omlede éyi mɛ́mla ɔyí omlede éyi nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́, kpó gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, in the place, O LORD, which thou hast made for thee to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O LORD, which thy hands have established.
idu_Latn: A géē bī uwā wā ipú, klla í bī uwā tū ɛyí ɛfu kú uwɔ. Ɛga nɛ̄ awɔ nōo wɛ Óndú ā tútū oōlā ā, Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú uwɔ nāa le kwu ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that were not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā aá géē blakwu ɔdōbɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá ya ā, ó ī kwú aá iyē, aá klla í tū iyī aá uwēyī ohígbū ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ucē obɔ̄bí kú aá ā.

eng_Latn: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ lɛ ipí ikpɛ̄yí ámāŋ agba kú nū.

eng_Latn: My son, keep thy father's commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ádā uwɔ da uwɔ ā. Ā kē mlanyī ɛlā nɛ̄ ɛ́nɛ́ uwɔ nwū uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And all thy children shall be taught of the LORD; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
idu_Latn: Ami, abɔ̄yī um ā gē nwū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ɛlā N klla géē cē abahi klá uwá, klla í yá kú aá bá ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ámāŋ ikpó kú uwɔ yá kú ā bīya íne kú Ɔwɔicō á nɛɛ, lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ ká ā kwú ɔ̄ ú tónū ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ. Ó lɔhi gā uwɔ fíyɛ́ ká ā lā oyēeyī opiyóó mɛ́mla ɔnyí, ámāŋ ikpó o ōcē, ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ a géē lɛ abɔ̄ ɛpa mɛ́mla ikpó ɛpa nēé kē géē kwú uwɔ ú tá ipú ɔlá nōó gē nyí ŋ́ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ, aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ahɔ̄ nēé yɔ̄ ī pi aá anú nyā, Aɔ́cɛ́ ogbāājɛ kú ɛcɛ, aá jéeyī káā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé bá ī nwū aá ā.

eng_Latn: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Óndú da ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ka, éē páápá! kéē kwu ŋmá Ubábīlɔn. Ohígbū ka anúɔ lɛ uwá pahīla ga ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɛcɛ nɛ̄ owu gē tá ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ ó lɛ ɔ́ má, únwū uwā gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu uwá, ajɛ Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?
idu_Latn: Ó le yá uwā eyījii, é klla le kpó hídáagó bá yɔ̄ ī kahíníī, Odúúdú ācɛ nēe bá yɔ̄ ī kɛlā mbá ā é wɛ ācɛ Ugálīli ŋ́ nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo tine kú odúúdú ācɛ kéē lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛyi ā jé, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō géē lɛ uwa nyatá.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, The LORD is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that ye have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.
idu_Latn: Usámūwɛ̄lu tá uwa ohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō mla ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄ ó fu a wɛ ijáalí ka, ń lé ɛpɔ̄bí kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú aá ŋ́. Ka n háyi yēŋēē ipú aá. Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Īī Óndú ā wɛ ijáalí kú alɔ mla uwɔ á.

eng_Latn: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aákpá géē je ɔcí mɛ́mla īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā kpó lé ŋmáajɛ.

eng_Latn: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ nēé pūla aflɛ́yí ā gā a, é leyīce ka aá géē mīyɛ fíyɛ́. Amáŋ é ɔkɔ́bɔ igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā nēé gbā lɛ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā dúú á.

eng_Latn: And, behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said unto the king, Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away, and have brought the king, and his household, and all David's men with him, over Jordan?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ abɔ́ɔ, gaá le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ alɔ, ācɛ kú Ujúda ā, gbɛlá ka uwá ōfōōfū uwā ɔ́ɔ lɛ íkwu kéē bī awɔ mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú uwɔ tá bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan āa?.

eng_Latn: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō wɛ ákú uwɔ. Awɔ yá ɛcɛ mɛ́mla ɔkpáncō mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
idu_Latn: Aólɛ̄la kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm le uwá yálé klla kwú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú ūwā ɛɛ́. Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ uwá móōwē ohígbū íne alɛwa nēé bīya ā. É le ayí uwā kpó kwú abɔ̄fú le kpó nyɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm le íne kú Ɔwɔicō bīya nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é kwú tēelihɔ iyē nɛ̄hi ɛgiyí Óndú ā. Ojīlīmā kú ūwā mɛ dúúdú ɛgiyí odúúdú ācɛ nē e tɛtɛ gē le ojīlīmā ce uwā ā. É kwú eyī í gwo uwā bónū ícɛ ɛɛ́ ohígbū kē é le ohɛ́ɛwa kú ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm má ɛɛ́. Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm abɔ̄yi ūwā yɔ̄ ī tíifu, klla kwú abɔ̄ í klá eyī ipú uwēyī.

eng_Latn: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
idu_Latn: Ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Userūyah ɛtá ā bá abɔ́ɔ. Iyē uwā lé ka Ujówābu, Abíssāyi mɛ́mla Ásāhɛlu. Ásāhɛl ī kwinya nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́wa ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
idu_Latn: É géē bī īkpēyī kú abɔ̄yī uwā má īkpēyī kú Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū. É géē tá iye nū bá uwā udɔ̄bū.

eng_Latn: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ó wɛ ō cɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ɛhɔ̄ nɛɛ, ayíbɛ ālɔ̄ cɛ̄ ācɛ ɔhá ɛhɔ̄. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ó wɛ o nwū ācɛ ɔdā nɛɛ, ayíbɛ ālɔ̄ kwú iyī alɔ í tá ɔdā ō nwū ā.

eng_Latn: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ í gáā mā ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá glá ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ anúɔ ī cīgbīhi kwu Ísrɛ̄lu glá ŋ́. Ó klla ka ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē cīgbīhi kwu Ísrɛ̄lu āā? Ó ka anúɔ géē lɔfú yá ūwā ífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anúɔ yá Ádima āa ámāŋ ka o yá ūwā ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ yá Uséboyim āa? Ó ka ɔtū kú anúɔ ɔ́ gáā cɛ̄ lɛ anúɔ yá ūwā lɛ ā ŋ́, ka ihɔtū mɛ́mla eyīnyinyi ūwā kú anúɔ ɔ́ɔ le anúɔ kwú báajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya a géē nwū ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kú ɔdā nōo wɛ ákú um abɔ̄yī um mā mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ó wɛ ákú ɔlamu ā. kéē ka nwū uwā kéē jé ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí kú ɔdēēlihɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo le yéŋéé ā.

eng_Latn: And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le ɔ̄dā dóodu nēe yēeyī ā kpó yíífi ŋmá ipú kú ɛcɛ. Kwu alɛɛcɛ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ō piyajɛ mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nōo ī wu icō ā. Unówa ōfōōfūnū mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá mɛ́mla anú ipú úgbéenyi ā hile á.

eng_Latn: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe nyíleyī ā, gē miya ɔdōōbɔ̄bí á. Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ nōo dɔɔ̄kā kóō yá ɔdā olɔhi ā, ɔtū kú nū gē he ācɛ. É klla gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē bī agege ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ odobū ā. É gē tíne oje jāā ga ɛga nēé bu nyɔ̄ glá ā, klla bā ī tíne aɛ́cɔ̄ ā ipú obū ā.

eng_Latn: The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:
idu_Latn: Ɔgba kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō nōó yɔ̄ ī jé ā wɛ ɛ̄nyā ā, Lɛbɛ̄ɛka álá nēé bī yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ɛga oŋmɛ́bɛ́ ā, amáŋ omlede nōo dokónu iyɔ̄bu ɔ̄cɛ owá ɔ̄ ɔnwū ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó nwūla okónu kú nū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And he said unto me, Son of man, cause thy belly to eat, and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee. Then did I eat it; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Ɔlɛcɛ, kwú ɔkpá nɛ̄ n gē je gā uwɔ nyā ú lé, kóō le nū uwɔ ipú. Anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɔkpá ú lé á. Ó lɔnyɛ tū um bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā ipú okónu kú um.

eng_Latn: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ aá gē yá ɔtū nwūlanwūla kú aá mīyɛ ɛhi kú Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ā, aá í lɔfú tīiye fíyɛ́ kú aá ba ɛhi nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú nōo géē tá icɔ́ɔci abɔ̄ kóō jɛ̄ gicō ā.

eng_Latn: There is a man in thy kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, was found in him; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father, the king, I say, thy father, made master of the magicians, astrologers, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ipú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú uwɔ amānyā, nɛ̄ alelékwū kú aɔ́wɔ otīihɔ yɔ̄ mla anú. Eko kú ádā uwɔ ā, ɔ̄cɛ ā bī ɛbɛ, íjééyī, mɛ́mla ɔdōōjé bɛ̄ɛka ákú aɔ́wɔ nōo yɔ̄ ipú nū ā lɛ yúklɔ́. Unebúcádinēsa, ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā, ádā uwɔ, kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú ācojɔ́dā mɛ́mla ācoyímabɔ̄, mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kē kwú Ujísɔ̄si piíí nyā ú héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, odúúdú alɔ kē wɛ ijáalí kú ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
idu_Latn: Alɔ í kōō má ɛ́nyɔ́ fu owu gɛ ŋ́. Agīje í cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ má ɔdā dúúmā glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ojuja gē yāwu ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nōó gē jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ akpáabana gē gbo ŋmá ɔkpáncō, ɛga nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicó lá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔtū kú uwā ú táajɛ yɔ̄ ī jé ɔdā nɛ̄ acotɛ̄hɔ̄ yɔ̄ gē nwū ā, é bá ī lé ɔdōlé tɔ̄há klla bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō tɔ̄há.

eng_Latn: And all the army of the Chaldees, that were with the captain of the guard, brake down the walls of Jerusalem round about.
idu_Latn: Aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔlɛ́ nū klla le ɔdɔ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā wúla tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
idu_Latn: Aá yíihɔtū tū ɔ̄ nááná nɛ̄ aá kōō má ɔ̄ jéjéē ŋ́ mā. Aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū nááná nɛ̄ aá kē má ɔ̄ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, anɔ́ɔ aá kē gwéeyē nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ okónu í ka ɔ́ glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I even weighed unto their hand six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels an hundred talents, and of gold an hundred talents;
idu_Latn: N kpó ɛkpa kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ úlā ce ofigwɛ́ɛpa ce igwó mɛ́mla aócíbú kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ́lá nū lɔfú wɛ ígbó ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ofɛhɔ̄ glá, mɛ́mla īkpīje kú ugóolu ofɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
idu_Latn: Ká ālɔ̄ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ucē nōo cíkā ā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe lā ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ péee ā, ká ālɔ̄ habɔ̄ ejé ō gwá nōo í kwú alɔ ká alɔ wīyā ā tá, ká alɔ habɔ̄ ajā ō gbo, ikpó ɔnyā ɔhá ō ce, ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá, unu ō nu mɛ́mla ímálānyī tá.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
idu_Latn: Ukɔ́hāti ma ayí ɛnɛ, Ámram, Ísiha, Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Usíyɛlu.

eng_Latn: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and ye build their sepulchres.
idu_Latn: Ucē kú aá mafú ka aá ce ɔdā nɛ̄ aádáádā aá yá ā. É lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kpó ŋmó, anɔ́ɔ aá ke lɛ únóji kú uwā kpó ma á.

eng_Latn: And all the people went over Jordan. And when the king was come over, the king kissed Barzillai, and blessed him; and he returned unto his own place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā le bēhé ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā á. Ó le Ubasíllāyi kwú bɔ́ɔtū le ɔhá hɛ́ ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ Ubasíllāyi kwúcē le tá ɔlɛ́ nū á.

eng_Latn: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband, and a man find her in the city, and lie with her;
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kwú igelī ɔlɛ́ uwā, yɔ̄ ī gwutá mla ɔyípɔ̄ncɛ́nyā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá lɛ ɛhi nū yá kóō lɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
idu_Latn: Ó gē yá ɛka nɛ̄ ó gbo lɛ Ábrahām, ó kē ī lɛ okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ Áyísīki ā tū.

eng_Latn: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ufilístiya kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɛyí ɛfú kú Ugílibowa. É ŋmó aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu alɛwa abɔ́ɔ. Ohile kú aícɔ́ɔja ā, mɛ́mla Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ayí nū kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɛlā kú ipú Aíjē olɔhi, ijē kú ocɛ̄tra mɛ́mla ijē kú ācɛ o yɛce Ohɔ́nyɛtá yɔ̄ gē le kɛlā lɛ iyī aá, aá gwíijē ocɛ̄tra mɛ́mla ijē owóófu iyē kú Óndú ā ipú ɔtū kú aá.

eng_Latn: Do ye think that the scripture saith in vain, The spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy?
idu_Latn: Aá jé ka ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi ɛga nɛ̄ ó kahíníī, Alelékwū nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ī tá alɔ ipú ā le mu mla ɔtū alɔ ō pī lɔfú lɔfú ā y nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ ó gā ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, ó nwū ācɛ ā ɛ̄lā ipú ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú uwā. Ó le hɛ́ uwā idáagó, anɔ́ɔ é kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ íjééyī mɛ́mla úklɔ́ idáagó nyā ŋmá ā?.

eng_Latn: And Jacob said unto Joseph, God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, wā ɛgiyí um ajɛ kú Ulús, ipú ajɛ kú Ukénan. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce um á.

eng_Latn: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them:
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ujékɔ̄pu le yá lɛ ádā uwā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó je ɔ́da lɛ uwá ā.

eng_Latn: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛwa nēe bá mla anú eko nōó hī Ulásārɔ̄si igwú ŋmá únóji ā, klla je ɔ́ héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, bá yɔ̄ ī cījáalí nū.

eng_Latn: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
idu_Latn: Aógbɛhá ā gē bá mla aá piyóó, eko nōo he aá ɔtū, aá yá ɔdā olɔhi lɛ uwá, amáŋ ń gáā yɔ̄ mla aá piyóó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
idu_Latn: Ó klla gbɛka ɔ́ɔmā mla Ujékɔ̄pu, nōo í yō piyóó dúú.

eng_Latn: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū í gáā hɛ́ aá ko, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gē yúufi kú ámíyā mɛ́mla ufu kú acígilí nōo gē wā ī klá ācobɔ̄bíipú bɛ̄ɛka owu ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
idu_Latn: N hokónu tū ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe pīyatɔ̄há mla Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā. Ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe bá amānyā mla um ā, hokónu tū aá.

eng_Latn: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew, which hath been sold unto thee; and when he hath served thee six years, thou shalt let him go free from thee: but your fathers hearkened not unto me, neither inclined their ear.
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mahāapa dóódu, ɔ̄cɛ Uhíburu dúúmā nēe je lá ɔfiyɛ lɛ aá, eko nōo lɛ úklɔ́ yá lɛ aá iháyí ɛhili, aá kóō lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́tá. Amáŋ aádáádā ā í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then she came and told the man of God. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay thy debt, and live thou and thy children of the rest.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā ā kwúcē le tá ɛgiyí Ɛláyíssa gaá da ɔ́ ɔdā nēé yá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔnyā ā kahíníī, Nyɔ̄ gaá kwú anɔ̄ ā ú kpó lá. A géē má ije ŋmá anú nāa géē le cíla ulé nɛ̄ ɔbá uwɔ bī ā mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ awɔ mɛ́mla ayí uwɔ géē le lá ɔdōlé glá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: In like manner shalt thou do with his ass; and so shalt thou do with his raiment; and with all lost thing of thy brother's, which he hath lost, and thou hast found, shalt thou do likewise: thou mayest not hide thyself.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ géē yá ɔdā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ lɛ ijakī, īlī, ámāŋ ɔdā dóódu kú ɔ́mpa uwā, nōo gebí pīyɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For I will restore health unto thee, and I will heal thee of thy wounds, saith the LORD; because they called thee an Outcast, saying, This is Zion, whom no man seeketh after.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú aá gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu ɔlɛ́ aá Ujerúsālɛm kahíníī, Usáyɔn lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ gē tá tónū ā. Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu í kōō lɛ ɛlā wu ɔ́ ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ n géē yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú iyē kóō lé lɔhi lɛ aá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ lɛ aā. N kē í cɛ̄ lɛ ágbe kú aá kóō kwú jé.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt know that I am the LORD, and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, aá abɔ̄yī aá ā géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ pó okónu nɛ̄ aá yá uwā ka ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā tá alácɛ̄, ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú aá ō nyɔ̄ í je wulé.

eng_Latn: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, īkpēyī kú uwɔ lɛ yēŋēē fíyɛ́ ō má ɔdōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Īkpēyī kú uwɔ tīihɔ fíyɛ́ ō má ɔdōbɔ̄bí. Á gáā leyīkwu ācɛ icííci kéē bá ī yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí lɛ ā glá ŋ́. Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ á tóohi ŋ́, eko nēé bá ī je ācɛ nōo lɔhi klla le kpaakpa fíyɛ́ uwā ā kpó yíífi ā?.

eng_Latn: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, ihɔtū nāa lɛ lɛ alɔ eko dóódu ā kóō yɔ̄ mla alɔ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ leyīce uwɔ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: É klla gwɛ́ɛya ɔlamu nēé gē je ɔdā ɛ̄gbā yɔlá dúúdú ā mɛ́mla ɛya nēé gē gwó eko kú ucɛ kú ɔyā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ mɛ́mla ɛya ɔhá nēé ī gwó eko nēé gē jīla ojigógó kéē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā dúú. É klla í je ɛdɔ ɛhi dóódu ŋmá ɔtū kú uwā eko nēé ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā.

eng_Latn: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī bá abɔ́ɔ cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpɛ́lā ce Ujísɔ̄si koó lɛ íne kú Umósīsi bīya. Anɔ́ɔ é leyī tá ɔ̄ gɛɛ ɔ́dāŋ koó géē hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ā tá ɛ̄cī Usábāti.

eng_Latn: Then they came near, and spake before the king concerning the king's decree; Hast thou not signed a decree, that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days, save of thee, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered and said, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which altereth not.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ tá ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ gaá le ɛlā ka lɛ ɔ́ ohígbū íne ā kahíníī, Ágábáidu, ó wɛ awɔ lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔkpá kú íne ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá, ámāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá, gwū awɔ nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā tá ipú ɛ̄cī ofu cigwó nyā, é géē kwú ɔ̄, í je ɔ́ tá ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ágábá ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ tá uwá ohi kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā gbóó, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ íne kú ācɛ Umédes mɛ́mla Upɛ́sīya lɛ ā, íne dúú nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ le abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄, í tōō pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said unto God, Let not thine anger be hot against me, and I will speak but this once: let me prove, I pray thee, but this once with the fleece; let it now be dry only upon the fleece, and upon all the ground let there be dew.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ugídīyɔn da Ɔwɔicō ka ɔ́ɔ̄ cɔ̄nū mla anúɔ ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ká anúɔ lɛ ɛlā éyi ka kpɔ́. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ éyi yá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́. Ka igbɛ́nyā ā, kóō le yá ka ɔnwū álá ā kóō lɛ ŋmó cɛ́ɛ́ ka éŋkpɔ̄ kú ébú ā kóō le yɛ jīla ajɛ ā tá.

eng_Latn: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ Uréyu wɛ iháyí ofu cigwɛ́ɛpa ā, ó lɛ ɔyí éyi nōó hī ka Usérūgu ma.

eng_Latn: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
idu_Latn: Ó kwu ābɔ̄ jāā ga ísu nēé hī ka Umeditarénīya ā. Ó klla yɛ jāā ga ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi.

eng_Latn: Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto thee: but say in a word, and my servant shall be healed.
idu_Latn: ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n kōō má iyí um ka n wɛ ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nōo cíkā ō wā ɛgiyí uwɔ abɔ̄yī um ŋ́. Lɛ ɛlā ka ŋmá amānyā ōfōōfūnū, ōcē kú ɔfíyɛ kú ɔlɛ́ um géē mɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā lɛ okónu tá lɛ ɛcɛ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā bá ī móōwē kú ɔ̄dā nɛ̄ uwá yá ā. Ācɛ le pɛ́ kwú kwɛyí gaá hile lígíí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal, and kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the month at even in the plains of Jericho.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ce áklɔ̄kpɛ Ugígalu, ɔpɛ́ nōo kwu Ujérīko ajaajɛ ā, é lɛ ucɛ kú onyatá ā lé ɔ̄nɔɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā ā.

eng_Latn: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ aá géē bá ī yɛ ipú ígbíli ā iháyí ofɛpa. É géē bá ī móōwē kú íne nēé bīya mɛ́mla īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú kú aá, gbéeko nɛ̄ ámōōmɛ kú aá ā gekwú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ōhī kú nū wú umuumu, cɛ́ɛ́ a kwú ɔ̄ ú ga Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ ɔ́ mī klá iyɔ̄bū kú ā. A í je ɔtulalí ō fú tū ɔlá bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā ō tīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
idu_Latn: Aá géē gbā ɔcí ogblógbló igwó ɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, ɛhɔ̄ kú nū wɛ ogbló kú ābɔ̄ éyi kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number, I say, of the men of the people of Israel was this;
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā eko ɔ́ɔmā wɛ: Userúbābɛlu, Ujóssuwa, Unehemíya, Asárīya, Uráamíya, Unahamáni, Umɔ́dekāyi, Ubílssan, Umispereti, Ubífāyi, Unéhum, mɛ́mla Ubaána.

eng_Latn: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
idu_Latn: N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdɔ ā, amɛ̄ kú um kē lɛbɛ̄ɛka inɔɔ̄da kú ɔdɔ ɔ́ɔmā ā. Ipú um nɛ̄ ohumɔtū ā lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo ce ɔ́ ɛgbá ā á.

eng_Latn: And when it was evening, his disciples came to him, saying, This is a desert place, and the time is now past; send the multitude away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves victuals.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ le gbo ā, ayíkpó kú nū wā ɛgiyí nū gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Amānyā le hɛ́fu ŋmá ɔlɛ́, ɛnɔ kē le yɛ táajɛ ɛɛ́, da ācɛ ā kéē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga aípɔ́lɛ́ ā gaá lá ɔdōlé lé abɔ̄yī uwā.

eng_Latn: And the first born bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
idu_Latn: Adá ā le ɔyí ma, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē ú ce ɔ́ ka Umówābu á. Anú wɛ ádáádā kú ācɛ Umówābu nēe bá jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā á.

eng_Latn: And the child grew, and she brought him unto Pharaoh's daughter, and he became her son. And she called his name Moses: and she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le ɔyí ā bī jɛ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ bī gé lɛ adá kú Uféro ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú pīya ɔyí kú adá kú Uféro á. Ó hī iyē kú ɔyí ā ka Umósīsi. ohígbū ka, ó kahíníī, N pi ɔ́ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú éŋkpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
idu_Latn: Ipú ofɛ̄fú kú aá eko nɛ̄ ācobīyíne lɛ ɔfú kpó í gwu aá, é kē kpó aá ŋmó eko nɛ̄ aá yɔ̄ ī fɛ̄fú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him, saying, Behold now, the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth: let thy word, I pray thee, be like the word of one of them, and speak that which is good.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ éyi kú aígabɔ̄, nōo nyɔ̄ í hī Umikáya igwú wā ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Odúúdú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ohile ā le ɛlā olɔhi kú ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɛɛ́ n. Ó kē cíkā ká ā ka ɛlā ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
idu_Latn: Udébiri, Ugɛ́da.

eng_Latn: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ayínɛ́ nū ohile ā le má ka ádā aá ɔ́ɔ yíhɔtū tú Ujósɛ̄fu fíyɛ́ aá ā, é gbɔɔ́ ō wɔ́tū ɔyínɛ́ uwā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nōo yá kéē gbɔɔ́ ō tū Ujósɛ̄fu eyījii nɛ̄hi. É klla kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ ɔkɔ ogbonɛnɛ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And Shelemiah, and Nathan, and Adaiah,
idu_Latn: Unátan, Adáya, Umakinadébāyi.

eng_Latn: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name's sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ ɔtūlé lɛ ōwē má ohígbū um nɛ̄hi, nááná ɛ̄jɛ̄ í kē jɛ̄ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And say ye to Amasa, Art thou not of my bone, and of my flesh? God do so to me, and more also, if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ da Amása ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔmáapú anúɔ nɛ. Ka oŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā, anúɔ kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú anúɔ kwɛyí Ujówābu ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó le Ɔwɔicō gbo tū iyīnū ka ɔ́dāŋ ka anúɔ ɔ́ yá ɔdā nɛ̄ anúɔ ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
idu_Latn: N géē bī aá jɔ́ɔwɛ eko dóódu, klla í kpó aɔ́dōlɔhi le yá ɛgbá kú aá eko dóódu. N géē yá kú aá lɛ ɔbɔ́lā cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɔfú iyē. Aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ í ŋmó ŋmá anú ŋ́ mā ā. Aá klla í lɛbɛ̄ɛka njɔɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ nōó gē ŋmó ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.
idu_Latn: Aá gē hɛ́pɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɛɛcɛ gē hɛ́pɔ̄ lɛ ā, ami ā ń ge hɛ́pɔ̄ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And in the morning, It will be foul weather to day: for the sky is red and lowring. O ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky; but can ye not discern the signs of the times?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔcī ā, aá kē ī ka ka, Ɔwɔ o tówu nɛ̄hi géē yā ícɛ, ohígbū ka ɔkpáncō wɛ ɔnɔ̄wá, ojuja klla gē túbá. Aá jɛ́yí ɛ́gɛ́ dóódu nɛ̄ oōmá kú ɔkpáncō lɛ ā, amáŋ aá jɛ́yí ocābɔ̄ kú eko nēe bá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, N da aá ɔ̄kā, Ɔdí nɛ̄ íne kú alɔ ká ā? Ka ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā olɔhi ɛ̄cī usábāti kɛ̄ɛ ka ālɔ̄ ya ɔdōōbɔ̄bí? Ká ālɔ̄ nya oyēeyī kú ɔ̄cɛ tá kɛ̄ɛ ka ālɔ̄ nya oyēeyī tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Alɔ wɛ ayínɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú ádā ékpónú, éyi kú alɔ gekwú ɛɛ́, ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ fíyɛ́ dúú ámōōmɛ ā yɔ̄ mɛ́mla ádā alɔ ícɛ nyā ajɛ kú Ukénan.

eng_Latn: Moreover as for me, God forbid that I should sin against the LORD in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
idu_Latn: Ó klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ ami nɛ̄ɛ̄, Ɔwɔicō kóō ŋmó ɔwɛ tū um, ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ íne kú nū bīya, o ŋmá lɛ o tá ka ń gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū aá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā, n géē nwū aá kú aá yá ɔdā nōo lɔhi mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa lɛ aá.

eng_Latn: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē tíne kéē lɛ um ŋmó ā, géē pɛ́ kwú.

eng_Latn: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ayí Ulífāyi ā wɛ Ɛlísa, ɔyí kú Árɔ̄ni ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā. Anú leyīkwu ācɛ nēe gē yúklɔ́ kú ɛga o tīihɔ ā á.

eng_Latn: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
idu_Latn: Ikpó kú uwā ī kwinya nyɔ̄ í yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí. É klla le tútū kéē nyɔ̄ í ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
idu_Latn: É le ihɔtū yá kóō le jɛ̄ jīla ipú ɔtū ká alɔ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú alɔ géē lɔtū ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā, ohígbū ka alɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka Ohɔ́nyɛtá ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew thee; for thou art greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ a gbɔɔ́ ō gbɔ̄ɔkɔ, ī ba Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄ba ā, ó lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā pó. A he ɔ́ ɔtū nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, n wā gaá tá uwɔ ohi kú ɔkɔ nɛ̄ a gbā ā. Jāhɔ̄ abɔ̄ nɛ̄ n géē ka ɛyí ɛbɛ nɛ̄ a má ā gā uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
idu_Latn: É gē yɛhɛ tū ācɛ ɔhá klla ī kɛlā obɔ̄bí. É gē yɔ́bɔ́ɔ̄cɛ́ klla gē tū ujɔ kú aá pīya ācɛ tū.

eng_Latn: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
idu_Latn: Ajɛ nyā gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu, ga ikpó kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ kú ɛfu ā. Ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan jāā ga ikpó ɛfu ā. Mɛ́mla owúlatū ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú nū, mɛ́mla o yɛ ga ígbíli kú ɛháajɛ ā. Ajɛ nyā kē tɛtɛ wɛ ipɔ́lɛ́ kú ācɛ Uhɛ́ti, Ámɔn, Ukénan, Upɛ́risi, ācɛ Uhám, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ujébūsi.

eng_Latn: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa le bēé wā ipú inu ā, ó má okwū kú ɔyí ā gwutá agōdō.

eng_Latn: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ā géē gwó Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ gā um, nɛ̄ n géē lā mla uwá.

eng_Latn: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ lɔfú pó ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē ka ā glá, N le eyī kwɛcɛ cɔɔ, ipú obócí ádēde, n gē mɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do ye see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ hile ipú aá nōo má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā lɔhi klla tɛ̄ɛgahi lɛ tɛtɛ ā? Ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá má ɔ̄ abālɔbányā ā? Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ó wɛ ɔdā dúúmā ikpēyī kú aá gɛ ŋ́ mā ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ odúúdú aíne ā nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ uwá ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gáā mīyɛ kéē lā ā nwū uwā.

eng_Latn: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
idu_Latn: Leyī yɛ ōwē mɛ́mla ákanya kú um, ká ā kwú íne nɛ̄ n bīya ā í yá um ɛhi.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal, the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá í bī Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā wā igelī nɛ̄hi ā, Umáyíkalu, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Usɔ́ɔlu, nōo wɛ ɔnyā kú Udéfīdi ā lɛ eyī bū uwíndo lɛ ɔbá nū má, yɔ̄ í jijē klla lɛ īlī fu bónū gaá hile ákpá kwɔkwu, yɔ̄ í tómbili gicō. Anɔ́ɔ Umáyíkalu lɛ eyī gwū ɔcɛ́ bónū ipɔ́tū kú nū á.

eng_Latn: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
idu_Latn: Mɔ́ɔ̄, ɔ́ncɛ́nyā éyi nōó jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ŋ́ géē yɔ̄ ipú í ma ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ. É géē hī iyē nū ka Imánūwɛ̄lu, .

eng_Latn: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sta tá ɔ́ ohi kahíníī, Uháman nyā wɛ olɛlā kú alɔ mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ obɔ̄bíipú tú alɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ufi nɛ̄hi le Uháman kwú iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla Ɛ́sta, ɔcányā ā.

eng_Latn: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aípɔ́ɔma nēe bá ā géē háyi ɛyí ɛfu kú Ébalu, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē tá okónu ā á. É wɛ, aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, Ássa, Usébūlɔn, Udáni, mɛ́mla Unáfutāli.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt came not again any more out of his land: for the king of Babylon had taken from the river of Egypt unto the river Euphrates all that pertained to the king of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti í klla lɔfú ga ɛcɛ gaá kpɛ́fú mla aícɔ́ɔja kú nū glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn mīyɛ odúúdú ajɛ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti, klla leyī hɛ́ kwu odúúdú ajɛ kú uwá nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá ísu kú Uyúfarétīisi jāā ga ɛhícō kú ajɛ Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: For thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are thrown down by the mounts, and by the sword;
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ, Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu í gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kɛ̄lā lɛyíkwu aɔ́lɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ujúda, nēé é géē wúlatāajɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó aɛ́cɔ̄ kú uwā le tū ɔdɔ kú igelī ā kwaajɛ ohígbū íbɔ́m nēé cē tū ɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā le abɔ́ɔ jila, nɛ̄ ɔnwū kú abɔ́ɔ í je pīya ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ ŋ́, nōó lipú fíyɛ́ ɛga ohile kú ɔkpíyē ā ŋ́, ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā géē gwū ɔwɛ tū ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.
idu_Latn: A tɛtɛ wɛ akwuna kú ācɛ kú Ubábīlɔn nēe wɛ ewo kú ācɛ ō yá obé ije nɛ̄hi ā dúú. Amáŋ ó jɛ̄ uwɔ ŋ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
idu_Latn: Aéwo ɔhá nēe lā ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn a, gēe ba ī kwu inya ga ɔlɛ uwá ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā; ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛbɛ gē kwu inya ŋmá ɛga īyī ɔ̄cɛ ootáɔtɛ́ a; é ba, le fíyákátā túuu klá ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka álá nēé lɛ Óndú ŋ ma, ba ī dɛ̄, Ɛnɛm oo, Ádām éyi, ɔyí um oo.

eng_Latn: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ ā ŋ́. É kē yá um ŋmá oje ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
idu_Latn: É je Urámɔtu kú Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla Umáhānéyim ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi ā.

eng_Latn: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujéhu gā Ujésirííli ā, Ujésɛ̄bɛlu le pó. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ɛwɔ́ mɛ́mla úbi mɛ́mla áfū mɛ́mla odo mɛ́mla odufā, hɛ́ eyī kú nū. Ó le ɛyí yá lɔɔlɔhi klla lɛ ɔ́ gbō. Anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ eyī bū uwíndo ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā yɔ̄ í má ɔdā nōo gē yá Úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
idu_Latn: Usára wɛ ɛdɔ ɔnyā ɔ́ɔmā, ó lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Ébrahām ɔbá nū gē yá ɔdā nōó da ɔ́ kóō yá ā. Ó klla gē hī ɔ̄ ka ɔkpani um. Aá géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka ayínɔ̄nyā kú nū abālɔbányā ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ aá kē yúufi ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If one be found slain in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath slain him:
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ í jé ŋ́, ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɔfú lɛ okwū kú ɔ̄cɛ nēé ŋmó tá ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ í lā ŋ́ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, gáā je lɛ uwā ā, nēé kē jé ɔ̄cɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo ŋmó ɔ̄ ā ŋ́ glá.
