eng_Latn: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the LORD, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ okplícī ā le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ kā lɛ ɔ́ ka anúɔ abɔ̄yī anúɔ ā kōō wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Óndú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ anú abɔ̄yī nū ɔ́ɔ kē wɛ ā dúú. Ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le ɔ́da je lɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kóō da anúɔ ka anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ bī ga ɔlɛ́ anúɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō lɛ ɔdōlé lé mɛ́mla anúɔ.

eng_Latn: But the king spared Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan the son of Saul, because of the LORD's oath that was between them, between David and Jonathan the son of Saul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ Umɛfíbōssɛ̄ti, ɔyɔ́ɔ́yí kú Usɔ́ɔlu hɛ́tá, ohígbū ɛka nɛ̄ Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ádā nū, Ujonátan gbo ā.

eng_Latn: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka aɔ́dā nyā géē wɛ ijáalí kú ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō géē ka tū uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā piyóó á.

eng_Latn: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
idu_Latn: Bī odúúdú ɔtū kú uwɔ lɔtūce Óndú ā. Ā híī gboló ce ɔdā nāa gbɛlá ka anúɔ jé ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá le mafú lɛ alɔ ka aá gbɔɔ́ ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́, alɔ le tútū ō yá ācɛ nēé lɛyítáajɛ ŋ́ mā italā.

eng_Latn: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔ́nū éyééye géē bī igbō ɛpɛɛpa wā gé lɛ Óndú ā kóō wɛ ɛya nēé jíleyē ipéyī nū. É géē yá éyééye kú igbō ā ŋmá okoolo ɛpa kú umu mɛ́mla ɔdōnīgbō, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē kpó uwā lɛ Óndú ā bɛ̄ɛka ɛya kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aflɛ́yí kú uwā nēé cē ā.

eng_Latn: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā léka ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka otú mɛ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, eyī kē gáā nyā ɛɛ́ mā. Ká ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ācɛ ī yá ajɛ odobū ā kpó bónū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ī kɛlā, lɛ iyɔ́fú ō bī nunu ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ kpó tū iyē.

eng_Latn: Thy substance and thy treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all thy sins, even in all thy borders.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da um kahíníī, N géē tū aólɛlā wā í je agbénú kú odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ lɛ italā yá uwā ohígbū íne nēé bīya ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé gā, gaá lɛ Usáyɔn má ā, é kwú hɛ́ idáagó, ufi le uwá kwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú pɛ́ kwu á.

eng_Latn: But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ ā í he ācɛ kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ɔtū ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ é le olɛhɔ̄ tū ce ɔ́ ɔkwu kahíníī, Alɔ í dɔɔ̄kā kú ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ nyā kóō wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú alɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú odúúdú ɛcɛ. Eko ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ géē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ka anú ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō á. É klla í jé ɔ́ mla iyē ékpónú nɛ̄ ó lé ā.

eng_Latn: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ā wɛ ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdā ō gwá mɛ́mla uculo kú iyē ō gwu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí. Aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā wɛ aíne kú uculo kú iyɛ̄cɛ kú ɔkpíyē ō gwu nɛ̄ n, ó kē ī yúklɔ́ kwɛjī eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō kwú ɔ́da ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ú kwaajɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ opi ā yɔ̄ ī mupītī mla ɔbɔ́ɔ́cɛ nɛ̄hi. Amáŋ ɛpléeko nōó lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, é lɛ ɔ́ ajī cē. Anɔ́ɔ aájī nɛ̄hi ɛnɛ ɔhá le bū kwɛyí éyi ā. Éyééye kú uwā le eyī pīya kwu ɔ́kíkā ɛnɛ kú ɛcɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he that betrayed him had given them a token, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he; take him, and lead him away safely.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄coyíbiyājɛ ā tɛtɛ lɛ ɔdācabɔ̄ éyi je lɛ uwá ka, ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ anúɔ géē lɛ okónu kwu ɔ́ okónu ā, wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā á. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ kwú kéē kwú ɔ̄ ú nyɔ̄, kéē leyīkwu ɔ́ lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gāá bū ígbíli kwú pīya bá ajɛ kú Ɛ́dɔm mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Umówābu jāā gbéeko nēé gaá bɛ̄cɛ ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Umówābu, āyā ɔhá kú ísu kú Ánɔn ā. Ó kéē kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ abɔ́ɔ, amáŋ é bēhé ísu kú Ánɔn ŋ́, ohígbū koó kwu ɛjī kú ajɛ kú Umówābu.

eng_Latn: But fear not thou, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Israel: for, behold, I will save thee from afar off, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Ujékɔ́pu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, aá yúúfi ŋ́. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, ufi kóō yá aá ŋ́. N géē nya aá tá ŋmá ajɛ ɛga oligbó ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ aá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ klla wɛ alagbá ā. Aá mɛ́mla ayí aá géē kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́, wā í lā ɛbɔ́, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā tū aá ufi ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answered him, The first of all the commandments is, Hear, O Israel; The Lord our God is one Lord:
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, íne nōo cɛgbá fíyɛ́ dúú ā, wɛ ɛ̄nyā ā, Ísrɛ̄lu aá jāhɔ̄, Óndú ā Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ, anú ōfōōfūnū wɛ Óndú á.

eng_Latn: Then shall ye begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in thy presence, and thou hast taught in our streets.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá géē tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Alɔ lé ɔdōlé klla gwá mla awɔ. A nwū ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ipú igelī kú ɔlɛ́ alɔ.

eng_Latn: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down, and the glory of the LORD upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the LORD, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā le ɔlá nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō wā ajɛ ā má ā. É kwú okwúukwu ú kpó tāajɛ gblugudu leyī pīya klā ajɛ, yɔ̄ ī gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā, ohígbū ɔdā olɔhi nɛ̄ ó yá lɛ uwá ā mɛ́mla ihɔtū kú nū nɛ̄ ó gē mɛ ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
idu_Latn: Ó gē je ajɛ nōo ī yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ lɔɔlɔhi ā pīya ajɛ, nɛ̄ ó yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ glá ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bī nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe lā abɔ́ɔ ā gē yá ā.

eng_Latn: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, aá géē mā anú mɛ́mla ayí nū tá ga ɔlɛ́ uwā, ga ipú agbénú kú ádáádā nū.

eng_Latn: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Bethshemesh, and went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Bethshemesh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aɛ́na ā gbɔɔ́ lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ kú Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi, lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ ā kpaakpa, é nyā ga ɔwɛ ɔhá dúúmā ŋ́, é bá ī dɛ̄gba abɔ̄ é bá ī nyɔ̄ ā. Aɔ́cɛ́ ɛhɔ̄ kú Ufílīstiya ā yɛce uwá jāā ga ɛjī kú Ubɛ́ti Ussɛ́mɛ̄ssi.

eng_Latn: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú uwā le mu mla ojuju obɔ̄bí bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nōo mu útuló a. Ícɔ̄nū kú uwā yɔ̄ ī hetū bɛ̄ɛka ɔhɔ̄lá ā otú. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī ó kwú hɛ́ wulu gbɔɔ́ ō cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā.

eng_Latn: So when they had gone through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nēé lɛ ɔyā ahāanɛ ce ɛ̄cī ofu yá ā, é pīyɛyí wā Ujerúsālɛm, abɔ̄ é le odúúdú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kpó yɛ jīla āa.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul, that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla Udéfīdi le ɔ̄kā kú uwā kā mɛ ā, ɔyī kú Usɔ́lu, Ujonátan gbɔɔ́ ō yíihɔtū tá Udéfīdi nɛ̄hi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yíihɔtū tá īyī nū ā.

eng_Latn: For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔyí um nyā gekwú, ó kē kwú héyī abālɔbányā ɛɛ́. Ó gebí, é kē lɛ ɔ́ pīyɛ̄ ɛɛ́! Anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō gwéeyē gbɔɔ́ ō lé ucɛ á.

eng_Latn: Then said God, Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā da Uhosíya kóō kwú iyē ú ce ɔyí ā kahíníī, Ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú um ŋ́, ohígbū ka ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu í wɛ ācɛ kú um ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ūwā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nōó yɔ̄ ī habɔ̄ uwā tá ā, ó da uwá kahíníī, N géē kwúcē wā ɛgiyí aá igbɔhá ɛ́ɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka Ɔwɔicō cɛ̄. Anɔ́ɔ ó le tá úgbéenyi ŋmá Ɛ́fēsɔsi á.

eng_Latn: Cursed be he that lieth with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
idu_Latn: Ohóōō lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwutá mɛ́mla ɔyínɛ̄ nū nɔ̄nyā, ámāŋ ɔyí ádā nū nɔ̄nyā. Cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú ācɛ ā tóohi ka ɔ́ɔ̄ le yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And all the house of Joseph, and his brethren, and his father's house: only their little ones, and their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ujósɛ̄fu, mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nū, mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ ádā nū mɛ́mla ayí uwā le pɛ́ i yɛ mɛ́mla anú. Ayípɛ̄ ɔlɛ́ uwā, aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá, aɛ́wū mɛ́mla aɔ́dāajɛ ohile ā ōfōōfū uwā bá ajɛ kú Ugóssɛn, nēé nyɔ̄ mɛ́mla uwá ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
idu_Latn: anɔ́ɔ Alelékwū Ihɔ wā lɛbɛ̄ɛka okóoho ā wā ī ce ɔ́. Anɔ́ɔ é pó ɔkɛ̄lā nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō yɔ̄ ī ka kahíníī, Awɔ wɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um nōo he um ɔtū á, ɛlā uwɔ he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, géē yá kú uwá mɛ́mla ayááyí kú uwā kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kú uwá kéē géē bī odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā lɛ yíhɔtū tá ɔ̄. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ géē yɔ̄ ī lā ipú ajɛ ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalteth himself shall be abased; and he that humbleth himself shall be exalted.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, N da aá, ɔ̄cɛ odɔlɛ́ ā yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka kóō le kpaakpa á, ó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ufárisīi ā nóó. Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo lɛ iyī nū je gicō, é géē tá ɔ̄ wāajɛ. Ācɛ nēe kē tá iyī uwā wāajɛ ā, é géē jé uwā gicō.

eng_Latn: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations, and with thee will I destroy kingdoms;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ubábīlɔn, awɔ wɛ omútāgā mɛ́mla iyɛ́fú kú um á. N bī uwɔ le ca aéwo mɛ́mla aájɔ̄cɛ́ alɛwa tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baalhanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī leyīkwu aɔ́cí ólīifu mɛ́mla aɔ́cí usíkāmɔ nēe bá aóci kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā wɛ Ubáalhánan nōo ŋmá Ugɛ́da ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē leyīkwu inu nēé gē kpó anɔ̄ ólīifu tū ā wɛ Ujówāsi.

eng_Latn: And have hope toward God, which they themselves also allow, that there shall be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ī kpɔ́tū ce ka Ɔwɔicō géē je odúúdú ācɛ nēe gekwú ā, kwu ācɛ oyólɔhi mɛ́mla ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́nya nɛ̄hɛ́ ɛpa bá ī pi ɔ́mɛtá ā. Aɔ́nya o tína poópoó bá gē pi ɔ́mɛɛnɛ ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ da ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kahíníī, Aá lɛ ɔ́ ikpó mɛ́mla abɔ̄ kpó gbō kú aá kwú ɔ̄ ú tá tɛ́ɛcɛ ipú obū. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ācɛ ā géē jikwū í hīla ayīnu á.

eng_Latn: And if a man have committed a sin worthy of death, and he be to be put to death, and thou hang him on a tree:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu tū olī, ohígbū ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Blessed is every one that feareth the LORD; that walketh in his ways.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce Óndú ā, nōo klla gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú tíne ā.

eng_Latn: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt: but I wholly followed the LORD my God.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ācɛ nēe nyɔ̄ mla um ā, yá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ alɔ kéē yúufi. Amáŋ n lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú um Ɔwɔicō kú um kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: (And the children of Israel went up and wept before the LORD until even, and asked counsel of the LORD, saying, Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the LORD said, Go up against him.)
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄kā da Óndú ā ka aá nyɔ̄ í kpɛ́fú tá ayínɛ́ aá, ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn kpɔ́ ɔ̄? Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā tá uwā ohi ka anúɔ cɛ̄ kéē nyɔ̄ ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ɔtū kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu le tú kwu ɔtū á. Anɔ́ɔ é le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā kpó nyɔ̄ í kwāajɛ ɛga nēé tɛtɛ bá aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
idu_Latn: N le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Óndú ā, ó kē le ohi tá um. Ó le um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe yɔ̄ ī tū um ufi ā.

eng_Latn: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
idu_Latn: Aá klla le pó keé da ācɛ kú íkée ā ka, A híīī gbɛka ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, amáŋ a géē je ɔdā nɛ̄ a ce Óndú ā oji kú nū ā lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ éyi kú aígabɔ̄ nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ fu kóō kwú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ú ce ɔnya kú ɔcɛ́ ā, yɛ Usúsa bilíbilí, cɛ́ɛ́ igabɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā kóō klla yɔ̄ í tɔ́ɔga tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu kahíníī, Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ̄cɛ nōó tíne ō le ce ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām lɛ ɔnyā ɔhā lɛ nɛ̄ iyē kú nū lē ka Ukɛtúra.

eng_Latn: And Moses and Aaron did as the LORD commanded them, so did they.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā da uwá ā yá á.

eng_Latn: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla uwá ā, n lɛ uwá tū ŋmá ɔfú kú iyē kú uwɔ nāa je gā um ā. N lɛ uwá tū, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwā í kē bī ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ɔ̄cɛ nōo í nyíleyī piíí ā nɛ̄ n, odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, le yá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛlā nēé tá ipú ɔkpá ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kóō le yá jīla.

eng_Latn: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um lɛ ɛlā ka kɔ́ɔ í yá, n géē yá kóo le cɛ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ā. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um dúúmā tū lɛ ojuju kú um ka tɛ́ɛcɛ, n gē yá ka ojuju kú um ɔ́ɔmā kóō le yá jīla. Ami ā piíí gē ka lɛ Ujerúsālɛm ka ācɛ géē lā ipú nū kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ á. Ami klla gē da aígelī kú ajɛ Ujúda ké kllá í tū uwā gwó igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́ á. Ka n klla ī tū aígelī nēe wúlatāajɛ ɔ́ɔmā gllayá á.

eng_Latn: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ aá nēe wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā lɛ ɔtū olɔfú, klla ī yíīkpɛ̄yí olɔfú. Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ hɛ̄ um tá nyɔ̄ í bá ī yá ɔdā ɔtū aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō páhɔ̄. Ɔdā nōo gwū ɔ̄ okónu ā le fu, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō kɛlā gēdēē á.

eng_Latn: And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si tóohi kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō lɔfú ō yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ í yá glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Oh let not the LORD be angry, and I will speak yet but this once: Peradventure ten shall be found there. And he said, I will not destroy it for ten's sake.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām klla kahíníī, Kócōō, ā cɔ̄nū ŋ́, Óndú, ká n̄ klla lɛ ɛlā ámōōmɛ ka. Ɔ́dāŋ ka ācɛ igwó nɛ̄ a má abɔ́ɔ á bɛ́ɛ? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, Ohígbū ācɛ igwó ā, n gaá je abɔ́ɔ yíífi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kɛlā gɔbū kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄, ugbɛ kú Ujékɔ̄pu, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu nɛ̄ n fu ā.

eng_Latn: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ogbonɛnɛ gē má itene kú ogbonɛnɛ, amáŋ ɔ̄cɛ olɔnɔɔtū gē yá iyī nū ágbe.

eng_Latn: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo géē tá ɔ̄kōōlɔhi ā abɔ̄ ā ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ alɔ lɔfú yá glá mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Alɔ í yúklɔ́ nōo ī bɛyíkwu ɔ́ glá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.
idu_Latn: É géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, é kē gáā kwú ŋ́. Uwá wɛ ayí kú Ɔwɔicō ohígbū kéē le héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And, behold, Saul came after the herd out of the field; and Saul said, What aileth the people that they weep? And they told him the tidings of the men of Jabesh.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu tá igbīhi aɔ́bá ɛna kú nū yɔ̄ ī pīyɛyí ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔ̄kā kú ɔdá nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācɛ bá ī jikwū ā kā ɔ̄. É le ɛhɔ̄ kú ācɛ Ujábesi ā cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
idu_Latn: Ámmīyēlu, Ísāka mɛ́mla Upéyuletáyi.

eng_Latn: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ aá kē í ka ámāŋ ka úklɔ́ nɛ̄ aá í yá, aá yá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī nū ŋmá lɛ iyē kú Ujísɔ̄si, Óndú ā, abɔ̄ aá gē bá ī tá Ɔwɔicō, Ádā alɔ ahínyá ŋmá lɛ iyē kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Despise not prophesyings.
idu_Latn: Aá híīī leyī gwō olɛhɔ̄ kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō bónū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
idu_Latn: Ojīlīmā ō ce Óndú ā mla o tá iyī ɔ̄cɛ wāajɛ, gē gbō ɔ̄cɛ ŋmá ukpa nōo ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá.

eng_Latn: By these three was the third part of men killed, by the fire, and by the smoke, and by the brimstone, which issued out of their mouths.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ámíyā nɛ̄hi ɛtá nyā, nēe wɛ ɔlá, ódūdū mɛ́mla ɛcɔ̄ ōwō ā nēe ŋmá okónu kú aɔ́nya ā, lɛ āyā éyi ŋmá okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú alɛɛcɛ kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n le kwu ga ɔkpáncō, a yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, ɔ́dāŋ ka n kwú agōdō kú um ú kwu ɔlékwū, a kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
idu_Latn: Uhɔ́ssan gekwú anɔ́ɔ Uhádādi, ɔyí kú Ubɛ́dādi, nōo yá ācɛ kú Umídiya lé, ajɛ kú Umówābu ā, mīyɛ ɔkwū nū. Anɔ́ɔ é hī ajɛ kú abɔ́ɔ ā ka Áfīti.

eng_Latn: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
idu_Latn: Īkpēyī kú ɔ̄cɛ gē yá nɛ̄ iyē kú nū gē mɛ́ɛbɛ á, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka agege nōo ī cɛ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́dāŋ ka ikpēyī kú uwɔ lɛ gēdēē, ó lɛ āa ɔlá gē fíyáajɛ klá odúúdú iyē kú uwɔ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ gē wú ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā ɔtū. Amáŋ ācobɔ̄bíipú gē yá ucē nōo ī kpó uwēyi tū uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: And he went unto his father's house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
idu_Latn: Ó le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ ádā nū, Ɔ́fra. Ó le ayínɛ́ nū, ayí kú ádā nū, Ugídīyɔn, ofɛtá cigwó, kpó ŋmó ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ ékpónú abɔ́ɔ. Amáŋ, Ujɔ́tam, ɔyí ámōōmɛ kú Ugídīyɔn ā, le kwu tayínū. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ó ŋ́mó anú ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And our adversaries said, They shall not know, neither see, till we come in the midst among them, and slay them, and cause the work to cease.
idu_Latn: Aólɛlā kú alɔ gbɛlá ka alɔ í gáā má uwā ámāŋ ka o jé ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé gaá fu alɔ igbledū, lɛ alɔ kpó ŋmó, cɛ́ɛ́ úklɔ́ kú alɔ ā kwú ci.

eng_Latn: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Udéfīdi nyɔ̄ gaá lā ɛyí ɛfu, ɛga olɔfú kú uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ é gbɔɔ́ ō hī abɔ́ɔ ka Igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́há lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kwú, le uwēyī je lɛ uwá, klla le uwá kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
idu_Latn: Anú gáā wɛ ukata kú ojīlīma mɛ́mla ɛgahi klá uwɔ ɛyí á.

eng_Latn: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?
idu_Latn: Obōōbū nɛ̄ Uháman gā inu ā, ɔcɛ́ ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcɛ́ éyi yɔ̄ amānyā, nɛ̄ n tíne ō lɛ ojīlīmā ce ɔ́ nɛ̄hi. Ɔdí nɛ̄ n géē yá lɛ ɔ́ ā? Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ā lɛ ɔ̄kā nyā da ɔ́ ā, anɔ́ɔ Uháman gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú nū ka anúɔ piíí nɔ́ɔ gáā ce ojīlīmā nyā á.

eng_Latn: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kɛlā ŋmá ipú ojuja ā kahíníī, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú um, nɛ̄ n fu ā yɔ̄ á. Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot also.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujúda má ka n tá Ísrɛ̄lu bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī tá ɔnyā nū ā. N klla le ɔ́ nū, ohígbū ka é lɛ igbīhi cē kwu um bá ī pā ɛcí bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū nyɔ̄ ī yá akwuna ā. Nááná ācɛ Ujúda nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ nɔ̄nyā kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā í yúufi ŋ́, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá gbɔɔ́ ō pā ɛcí dúú bɛ̄ɛka akwuna ō gbajā ā.

eng_Latn: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.
idu_Latn: É gē pi ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄fú bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́fiyɛ ā kéē gwó ɛdɔ kú aínu ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú úklɔ́ olɔfú dóódu nēe bá ɛhɔ̄ kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Because thou hast said, These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there:
idu_Latn: Aá gē ka ka Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú aá mɛ́mla ajɛ kú uwā, ka aá ɔ́ɔ í mīyɛ uwá anú nááná nɛ̄ ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore will I also deal in fury: mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: and though they cry in mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.
idu_Latn: N géē bī ícɔnū kú um le yá uwā odée nɛhi. N gáā habɔ̄ uwā tá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n gē ményinyi uwá ŋ́. É géē bá ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā um gbōmgbōm, amáŋ ń gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
idu_Latn: A klla le ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú nū ā wúla tāajɛ ɛɛ́. A kwú ɛga olɔfú kú nū ā ú tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The LORD said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king, Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree, and there hath played the harlot.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujosíya wɛ ɔcɛ́ ā, Óndú ā da um kahíníī, A má ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu gē ya bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nōo ī gbajā āa? É habɔ̄ ɛ̄gbā ō gbā um tá gaá gbɔɔ́ ō pā aɛ́cí ɔkwu aɔ́cí ɛ̄mɛ̄mɛ̄ nēe kwu ɛyí ɛfu dóódu ā. Ucē nēé yá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ákú ɔnyā nōo kwu ŋmá ɔlɛ́ ɔbá nū nyɔ̄ í klá ī yá akwuna ā.

eng_Latn: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the coasts of the earth, and with them the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her that travaileth with child together: a great company shall return thither.
idu_Latn: Óndú, kahíníī, Aá má ɔ̄, ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ ā géē bī uwā wā ŋmá ajɛ kú ɛhícō, klla í tū uwā bá ŋmá ɛga dóódu kú ipú ɛcɛ. Kwu aópeyī, aócīkpó, anyā oyīipú, mɛ́mla anyā nɛ̄ ɔmā lɛ uwá kwú géē bá ipú uwā dúú. Álūka kú uwā nēe géē kwúcē wā í wɛ ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú éwo.

eng_Latn: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
idu_Latn: Eko éyi géē wā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ éyi géē lé, nōo géē gbō ajɛ ipú okpaakpa. Aígabɔ̄ kú nū kē í gbō ajɛ í bá ī kɛpɔ̄ okpaakpa.

eng_Latn: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
idu_Latn: A da ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nēe ī lɛyítáajɛ gā uwɔ kpaakpa ā, ipú ɛbɛ íkée kahíníī, N le ícɔ́ɔja nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā tábɔ̄ ɛɛ́, n kwú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n fu ŋmá ipú ācɛ ā ú pīya ɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nōó lɛ owu ā má ā, ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó gbɔɔ́ ō bī á. Ó dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Óndú, lɛ um nyatá.

eng_Latn: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ igwó ā géē kpɛ́fú tú Ɔyí álá ā. Amáŋ Ɔyí álá ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō hīgwú klla fu, nēe klla háyi kpaakpa ā, géē yá uwā lé. Ohígbū ka Ɔyí álá ā wɛ Óndú kú aóndú, klla wɛ Ɔcɛ́ kú aɔ́cɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
idu_Latn: N lɛ uwá ca tāajɛ, kwú uwā ú gbā báajɛ putuu bɛ̄ɛka úmlá, nɛ̄ owu gē gwu bónū ā. N lɛ ikpó da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ, bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ge lɛ ikpó da ɔ́tɔ̄ ipú úláyi ā.

eng_Latn: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka ka anúɔ géē wɛ ádā ɔyí nū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ kē géē wɛ ɔyí anúɔ. Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí yá, anúɔ géē yá ɔ̄ italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ádā gē yá ɔyí nū italā ā.

eng_Latn: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son's son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔ́dāŋ ka uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā tíne ō yēeyī ligbó ipú ɛcɛ ā, uwá mɛ́mla odúúdú ayí uwá, mɛ́mla ayí kú ayí uwā kéē yúúfi Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ odúúdú íne kú nū tū ipú oyēeyī kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upíta wā aflɛ́yí ā, ó húmáyī lé ɔdōlé mla ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēe wɛ aílɔ́wá, nēé gē lɛlá wu apī ō hɛ́ ŋ́ mā a. Amáŋ igbīhi nɛ̄ ācɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ujémīsi gā ā, Upíta tá ka anúɔ í lé mla aílɔ́wá ā gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū koó gē yúufi ācɛ nēe gē ka kéē lɛ aílɔ́wá ā apī hɛ́ piíí ā a.

eng_Latn: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well's mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyā kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā kwu odée ú pīya klá okónu obugā ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le īkpɔ̄dā pahīla klá ɛyí nū kóō ŋmó á. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kóō jé ka odée ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klla lɛ ācɛ Ulífāyi a kɔ̄ ígwu ɛtá, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔma kú uwá lɛ a Ugɛ́ssɔn, Ukóhati mla Umerári.

eng_Latn: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
idu_Latn: nɛ̄ aá mīyɛ ajɛ ā, ɛ́ɛ́ kú aá géē pīyɛyí. Ohígbū ka eko nyā aá géē lɛ úklɔ́ kú aá yá lɛ Óndó ā mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́mpa aá ɛɛ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ Óndú ā í jé ka ajɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā, ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú aá.

eng_Latn: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gē ga ajɛ kú Ufílīstiya gāá na ɛnū mɛ́mla o tū ɔ̄ ulé. Abɔ́ɔ nēé gē nyɔ̄ ī yá āgā mɛ́mla ɛ̄wā klla gē nyɔ̄ ī tū uwā ulé dúú á.

eng_Latn: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
idu_Latn: É lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí nēé tū ɔlɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, nōo ī jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.)
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é lɛ ɛwa kú ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā nēe cɛ̄lɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā katū ɔ̄ lɛ Óndú ā kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
idu_Latn: N gē yá ɔdā nōo le okpaakpa, n klla ī yá ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth, and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔdā nyā le yá, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē je lɔfú iyē, n klla í yá awɔ, Isíkɛ̄lu, ká ē kɛlā gbōmgbōm, ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ dóódu géē pó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwá ká ē le jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea, and had life, died; and the third part of the ships were destroyed.
idu_Latn: Éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú ísu ā kwú pīya oyī. Éyi ŋmá ipú okɔ̄ ɛga ɛtá kú aɔ́dā oyēeyī nēe bá ipú ísu ā le pɛ́ gekwú. Éyi ŋmá ipú ɛtá kú aúgbéényi le kpó yíífi.

eng_Latn: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó le lɛ ā, Udéfīdi le da odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū nēe bá mla anú Ujerúsālɛm ā ka ɛ́ɛ̄ páápá cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Ábsālɔm amáŋ ɔ́ɔ géē wā ɛga nɛ̄ aá ɔ́ɔ bá ā gaá lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe bá ipú igelī ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And this spake he not of himself: but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus should die for that nation;
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔfú kú abɔ̄yī nū nōó bī le kɛlā nyā ŋ́, amáŋ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya iháyí ɔ́ɔmā ā, ó le ɛbɛ má ka Ujísɔ̄si ɔ́ɔ géē kwú ohígbū ācɛ Ujíyu ā.

eng_Latn: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lɔtūce okónu nāa ce ā glá, ó kē he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lū dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō le ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ alɔ ɛɛ́. Alɔ nyɔ̄ gáā tɔ́ɔ́na ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá nyā lɛ ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Then said the LORD, Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for the which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow; which came up in a night, and perished in a night:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔcí nyā jɛ̄ ɛ̄cī éyi, ɛ̄cī ɔhá anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú á, á yá ɔdā dúúmā lɛ ɔ́ ŋ́, ó wɛ awɔ yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ́ ó jɛ̄ klá kwú ā ŋ́, amáŋ ikwū kú ɔcí nyā kē le kwú uwɔ iyē nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And many believed on him there.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa lɔtūce ɔ́ abɔ́ɔ á.

eng_Latn: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
idu_Latn: É géē tá uwɔ ohi ka Ehée, Ā kpó īyī uwɔ owu bónū ŋ́. Alɔ géē bá ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ gbɛ́lá ō yá ā. Odúúdú alɔ géē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔtū olɔfú mɛ́mla ɔtū obɔ̄bí kú alɔ da alɔ ka alɔ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī wā ɛgiyí okómpinu kú eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā. Ɔwɛ ā le gwū.

eng_Latn: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that thou hast done? thou didst fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, thou didst rise and eat bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ā le ɔ̄kā da ɔ́ ka aá ɔ́ɔ jɛ́yí ka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko nɛ̄ ɔyí nū ā ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ɛɛ́ mā, ɔ́ɔ jikwū klla gwōkónu ohígbū nū, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ ɔyí ā ɔ́ɔ gekwú ā, ɔ́ɔ cāŋjɛ klla le ɔdōlé lé.

eng_Latn: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
idu_Latn: Íne kú Óndú ā le mɛ́ɛ́lɛ́ ā, ó gē je ɔfú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ. Ɛlā kú Óndú ā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú lɛ ɔtūce ɔ́ glá. Ó gē yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō jééyī.

eng_Latn: Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
idu_Latn: N le da uwɔ ɛɛ́ ka, ā lɛ ɔtū lɛ, ká ā klla lɔfú tīyē. Ā híī yúufi, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ ge gbenyi ŋ́. Ohígbū ka, ami Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā yɔ̄ mla uwɔ ɛga dóódu nāa géē nyɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah:
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti ā le ɛlā ka lɛ Ussípfra mɛ́mla Upúwa, anyōkɔ́ɔma nēe gē kɔ́ anyā Uhíbru ɔma ā kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
idu_Latn: Ó kpó uwā trɛ̄yí ɛbɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é yúufi ŋ́ kpɔ́ á. Amáŋ ísu le cēenyi klá aólɛlā kú uwā ɛyí.

eng_Latn: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ukpɛ̄ kú Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ŋmá ipú ɛbɛ́ kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā, nēé le tū lɛ uwá ŋmá ɛ̄cī nēé le abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí kéē wɛ ācogwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what thou hast seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujówābu le da ɔ̄cɛ Ukúss nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ā ka ɔ́ɔ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ má ā ka lɛ ɔcɛ́. Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ ā le túkpɛɛ́ anɔ́ɔ ó le inya kwu le yɛ á.

eng_Latn: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ā híī lííla bɛ̄ɛka ɔnya ámāŋ ka ijakī ā ŋ́. Ohigbū ka é gē jé ɛga nēé gē nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́, jāā gbéeko nēé kwú anjámī ú wu uwā okónu, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē pīya uwā ɛyí tá ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ ɔtōce nɛ̄ Ébrahām lɛyítáajɛ eko nēé hī ɔ̄ igwú kóō ga ɛga nōó géē mīyɛ bɛ̄ɛka úgwū ā. Ó gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄, nááná nōó jé ɛga nōó ī nyɔ̄ ā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēé gāa hile ŋma ipú uwá a gēe ŋá fíyɛ́ ije ɔdɔ á.

eng_Latn: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before thee, and I will proclaim the name of the LORD before thee; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, N géē wā í yɛ iyɔ̄bū uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ oōlɔhi mɛ́mla ohéyīfuú kú um lɛ āa. N kē í hī iyē ōtīihɔ kú um gā uwɔ. Ami wɛ Óndú ā á, n gē gbonɛnɛ klla ī ményinyi ācɛ nɛ̄ n fu ā.

eng_Latn: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá uwā ā le mafú ka ita nēe kwu ā wɛ ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi. Ewō gē kwúcē ga ɛga nɛ̄ ó gba bá ā, anɔ́ɔ ókóome nɛ̄ ācɛ le kwu ŋmá ipú ɔ́tɔ̄ le ɔ́ iyē gwā ā, gē kwúcē nyɔ̄ í míya blibli ipú ɔ́tɔ̄ kpɔ́. Oyēeyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ ɛplɛ́ɛpa ā le bɔ̄bí fíyɛ́ eko aflɛ́yí ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.
idu_Latn: Óndú, lɛ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā yá lɔhi, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
idu_Latn: N jé ka aá wɛ ayí kú Ébrahām, amáŋ aá tíne ká aá lɛ um ŋmó ohígbū ka ɛlā kú um í lā ipú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.
idu_Latn: Eko ō mɔyí kú nū le yá, anɔ́ɔ ó le áplɛ́ ma á.

eng_Latn: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄gbā kú nū lɔfú je gbo ɛnɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ipú ajɛ, nɛ̄ ikpankini kú nū gē kwú glá.

eng_Latn: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
idu_Latn: Ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kú aá géē yá nwuné nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, nɛ̄ aá géē bá ī cē ɔdɛ̄hīcō nááná nɛ̄ eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ī kpó īkpō ufáyin le yá ā. Aá kē í yɔ̄ ī cē īkpō ufáyin, nááná nɛ̄ eko ō nyi ɔdɛ̄hīcō le yá ā. Aá géē lɛ odúúdú aɔ́dā dóódu nɛ̄ aá dɔɔ̄kā ō lé. Aá kē í lā ɛbɔ́ ɔlɛ́ aá.

eng_Latn: And it was told Tamar, saying, Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnath to shear his sheep.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi le da Utáma kahíníī, Ádā ɔbá uwɔ yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ajɛ kú Utímna gáā wā aálá kú nū ɔnwū.

eng_Latn: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū bá ɔwɛ yɔ̄ gē yɛ gicō, ī ga Ujerúsālɛm. Ujísɔ̄si le hɛ́ gɔbū kú ayíkpó ā. Ó le hɛ́ uwā idáagó, ufi gbɔɔ́ ō yá ācɛ nēe tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu igbīhi ā. Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó ā kpó gā áklō ɛga éyi, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ aɔ́dā nēe gáā yá ɔ̄ kpɛ́mm ā kpó ka lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ le ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyā lá kóō je ɔ́ lɛ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ kóō wɛ ɔnyā nū, ó géē je ɔ́ bɛ̄ɛka éyi kú ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
idu_Latn: Utíca, Umósīsi tá íne nyā lɛ alɔ ka ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ éyi gekwú hɛ̄ ɔnyā nū tá, nōó ma ɔyí ŋ́, ka ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɔ́ɔ cíkā ō kwú ɔnyā ā ú ɔnyōkwū. Ó yá ɛ̄nyā cɛ́ɛ́ é géē lɛ ayí nēé géē je uwá ka ayí kú okwūmā ā.

eng_Latn: And he answered him, I am: go, tell thy lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɛláyíja da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ami nɛ. Nyɔ̄ gaá da Áhābu ɔkpáni uwɔ ka n yɔ̄ amānyā.

eng_Latn: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī da aá nyā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ n. Ɔwɔicō je ka ń yɔ̄ ī kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ lɛ aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
idu_Latn: Alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā tá ɔ̄ ohi, klla da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ tíne ō jé iyē kú anúɔ āa?.

eng_Latn: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tá ɔ̄ ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā kahíníī, Eko kpií nōo ī wā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ ī wā ā géē wāajɛ, ó gáā gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ kōō wā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n bī ucē ɔhá le gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō, alelékwū kú um yɔ̄ gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ōfōōfūnū á, n gáā jɛ́ɛyí kú ɔdā nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ gē ka ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau's son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
idu_Latn: Uréyūwɛlu wɛ ádā kú ayí kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Unáhāti, nēe bá aā: Usɛ́ra, Ussáma mɛ́mla Umíssa. Uwá ā wɛ ipɔ́ɔma nēe nyīla ŋmá iyē kú Ubásɛmati á.

eng_Latn: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ o lɛ ánya gē yá ucē kú íla, ɔ̄cɛ ojéeyī ā gē yɔ̄ cíí, klla gē gbēyī cíí.

eng_Latn: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si klla le ita nyā kwu lɛ uwá. Opeyī éyi í bī opeyí ɔhá jé ɔwɛ glá ŋ́. ɔ́dāŋ nēé le yá lɛ ā, uwá ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa í míya tū ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄.

eng_Latn: For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,
idu_Latn: Eko géē wā nɛ̄ aólɛlā kú uwɔ géē cīíbɔm tū uwɔ biílí géē kpɛ́fú tá uwɔ ŋmá áklō dóódu. É géē je awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá ipú igá ā yíífi.

eng_Latn: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ka a kwú um ú tayínū, klla yɔ̄ ī gbō um ɔlékwū, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwɔ le gbo, nɛ̄ á cɔ̄nū gɛ ŋ́. Cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ eko tū nɛ̄ a géē blakwu um.

eng_Latn: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn le ɛfú kpó wā í gwū Ujúda. Ó lɛ Ujehóyākim kwú klla kwú ɔ̄ ú tá agbá Ubábīlɔn.

eng_Latn: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
idu_Latn: Ɔhā yɔ̄ lɛ ācɛ nēe gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄ íne ka ā, nēe klla gē tíne Óndú ā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú uwā.

eng_Latn: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔcɛ́ gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄, odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú nū, géē wɛ ācɛ okɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But my covenant will I establish with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n géē le ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo ā tū mɛ́mla Áyísīki, nɛ̄ Usára gaá ma gā uwɔ ekomā kú ɛyí ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who am I, O LORD God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le tá ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ nōo Óndú ā yɔ̄ ā, gaá cīce iyɔ̄bū Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó da Óndú ā kahíníī, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, woó, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ n wɛ, ɔdí nɛ̄ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um wɛ, ɛɛ́ nɛ̄ a gē yá ɔdā nɛ̄hi nyā gā um mɛ́mla ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú um ā?.

eng_Latn: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
idu_Latn: Átāyi, Ɛlíyēlu.

eng_Latn: I have many things to say and to judge of you: but he that sent me is true; and I speak to the world those things which I have heard of him.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɔdā alɛwa nɛ̄ n géē ka lɛyíkwu aá mla ɛpɔ̄ alɛwa nɛ̄ n géē ka tū aá, amáŋ ń gáā yá lɛ ā ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo kē tū um ɛhɔ̄ ā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, n ka ɔdā nɛ̄ n pó ŋmá ɛgiyí nū ā lɛ ācɛ kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujékɔ̄pu da Ujósɛ̄fu kahíníī, Abɔ̄ a yɔ̄ ī má um nyā, n gaá kwú ɛɛ́. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē yɔ̄ mla uwɔ, klla í bī uwɔ kwúcē ga ajɛ kú aádā uwɔ, igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́.

eng_Latn: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus, and called the elders of the church.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ alɔ gāājɛ Umilétɔ̄si ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū ga Ɛ́fēsɔsi fu anyākwɔ́cɛ kú icɔ́ɔci kú Ɛ́fēsɔsi, yɔ̄ ī da uwá kéē le pɛ́ wā í jīla mla anúɔ eyī.

eng_Latn: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū koó ka ɔ̄cɛ í lɛ itene dúúmā ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ cēyītīkwū yɔ̄ í yá ɔdā nōo he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
idu_Latn: Ussɛmáya, Ɛlísa, Ússi, Ujehóhanān, Umákīya, Ɛ́lam, mɛ́mla Ésa gboce uwá. Ācogwíijē nɛ̄ Ujeremíya wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā, bā í gwííjē gbōmgbōm mla odúúdú ɔfú kú uwā.

eng_Latn: But we preach Christ crucified, unto the Jews a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
idu_Latn: Ákú alɔ ā, alɔ gē kɛlā tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēé nyɔ́kpá ā. Olɛhɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔdā ō ŋmó ɔwɛ tū ācɛ Ujíyu, ó kē wɛ ɔdīcííci tū aílɔ́wá ā.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.
idu_Latn: Aá le abɔ̄ da ācɛ ogbɛhá ā ɛyí tāajɛ. Aá klla gē nú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ abɔ̄fú ŋmá ɛgiyí uwā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, aá gáā lā ipú ɔlɛ́ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ aá gwó lɛ iyī aá ŋ́, aá klla gáā gwá ejē kú ɔcí ufáyin o lɔhi nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ aá hí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he brake in pieces the images, and cut down the groves, and filled their places with the bones of men.
idu_Latn: Ó kwu ɛcɔ̄ kú ede nēe bá aíkpɛ́cí ā ú kpó ca nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó kwu ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra nēé ma kwu ajɛ ā ú kpó ca. Ajɛ ɛga nɛ̄ ede nēe bā ā mɛ́mla ɛga nɛ̄ ojibó kú Ássɛ̄ra kwu ā, ó lɛ ɔ́ bū klá ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ tū mu mla ikpokwú kú ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
idu_Latn: Ɔyí um, jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú um, ká ā pó ɛlā nɛ̄ n gē ka ā.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that hath ten pounds.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nēe háyi abɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī, Aá mīyɛ ikpīije ugóolu éyi ā ŋmá abɔ̄ nū cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ikpīije ugóolu igwó ā.

eng_Latn: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath, and Jehozabad the son of Shomer, his servants, smote him, and he died; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David: and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Ujósáka, ɔyí kú Ussímīiti, mɛ́mla Ujɛhósābadi, ɔyí kú Ussóma aígabɔ̄ kú Ujówāsi ā lɛ ɛ̄wā gɔ̄ ɔ̄ le ɔ́ ŋmó. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ nyi mla aádáádā nū ipú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udéfīdi á. Anɔ́ɔ Amásīya ɔyí nū lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me: and behold a basket of summer fruit.
idu_Latn: Émɔ̄si klla kahíníī, Óndú, Ɔwɔicō le ɛbɛ ɔhá mafú gā um. Ipú ɛbɛ ā, n má ómblí kú īkpɔ̄cí nēe le pīya ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And when Samuel had caused all the tribes of Israel to come near, the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu cɛ̄ lɛ ipɔ́ɔma éyééye gbɔɔ́ ō wā iyɔ̄bú Óndú á, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā kwú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubénjamīn ú á.

eng_Latn: Saying, What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ a tíne ká n̄ yá gā awɔ ā? Ó tóohi kahíníī, Ɔkpani, n dɔɔ̄kā ó mɛ́ɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: Therefore he said unto Judah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought the LORD our God, we have sought him, and he hath given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
idu_Latn: Ó da ācɛ kú Ujúda kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔdɔ mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nɛ̄ alɔ géē gwū mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda ā kpó gwó tū aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda. Abɔ̄ kú alɔ bī ajɛ kú alɔ ícɛ, ohígbū ka alɔ gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ alɔ klla í yá ɔdā nōo wɛ ɔtū kú nū. Anú yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē gbō alɔ āyā dóódu á. Anɔ́ɔ é le ɔdɔ, ɔwɛ, mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda a kpó gwó tū aípɔ́lɛ́ kú uwá á.

eng_Latn: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ ācɛnyā ɛpa nēe bá nyā, Uyodíya mɛ́mla Usíntīki. Kóocōō aá lɛ iyī aá kagwó abɔ̄ aá wɛ ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá ékpó ipú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki le pó ka ācɛ kú Ussɛ́kɛm, ɛ́ɛ bá ī túbā kéē ga ipácí.

eng_Latn: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
idu_Latn: Le ɔcí hɛ́ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē yá ká ācɛ kéē le kpó kɔ̄ ā aflɛ́yí mɛ́mla igbɔɔ́mpa, cɛ́ɛ́ a le hɛ́ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū, ā lé tɔ̄há mla anú gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
idu_Latn: Ujɛhóram, Ahasíya, Ujówāssi.

eng_Latn: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
idu_Latn: Ujówa, Íddo, Uséra mɛ́mla Ujeyatɛ́rāyi.

eng_Latn: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
idu_Latn: Ɛya nɛ̄ n géē gwó nōo í he Ɔwɔicō ɔtū ā wɛ o tú iyī um wāajɛ. Á kē gáā tá ɔ̄cɛ nōo le iyī nū tú wāajɛ klla le pīyabɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu le yɛ ŋmá igelī kú Unásārēti, ajɛ kú Ugálīli ā, le tá igelī nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m kú Ujudíya, ɛga nɛ̄ Udɛ́fīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā ŋmá ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ ɛpɔ̄bí lé, ó géē ka ɔdōbɔ̄bí nōó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Then she that is mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, aólɛlā kú um géē má ɔ̄, uwēyī kē í kwú ɔ̄cɛ nōo da um kahíníī, Ɛhɛ̄ɛ, iní nɛ̄ Óndú Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ ā kē yɔ̄ gɛ? N géē gwéeyē tū ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, eko nɛ̄ n géē má abɔ̄ é je uwá kpó yíífi bá úláyi nɛ̄ ācɛ yɔ̄ ī lɛ ikpó da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔ́tɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
idu_Latn: Ɔkōolɔhi ā wɛ íne ojōjīla kú Ɔwɔicō nōó gē bī le hɛ́ ācɛ tá. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɔtū tá ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ipú nū ā, lɛ ɔ́ kílɔ́cɛ lɔɔlɔhi nōo mlanyī ɔdā nēé nwū ā ŋ́, amáŋ nɛ̄ ó bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́, ó lɛ ā, ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔma í jɛ̄ gɔbū ipú ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ ó ī yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.
idu_Latn: A géē bī Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla ayīnu nɔ̄nyilɔ ā wā okómpinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ɛga nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ a da uwá kéē lɛ iyē uculo gwā.

eng_Latn: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
idu_Latn: É kwú ɔdā nōo hile ā í tū gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Umósīsi da uwá ā. Ó kē bīya ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ó gē gbɛkɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā ā kpó ŋmó kwɛyí, ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛtá mɛ́mla ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ kú ɔyā nēé hī ka Áda ā, é klla má aólɛlā kú uwá dúú ŋmó ɛ̄cī ɔ́migwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwu ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ú yá ucɛ kú éeyē ō gwó á.

eng_Latn: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
idu_Latn: Ó le ɔwɛ tá bū ipú ísu igwɛ̄bɛ́ ā, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men's hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
idu_Latn: É í mīyɛ aígelī mɛ́mla aɔ́lɛ́ nēé gwó ɔdɔ tū uwā lɔfú nɛ̄hi kú nū ā tū abɔ̄. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā, aícɔ́ɔja kú Umówābu géē yúufi bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔma lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā he aígabɔ̄ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ujúda ɔtū nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é le ije kú uwā kpó wā í le ikpati ā mu á.

eng_Latn: And the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
idu_Latn: Ɔdā o hile ɔhá dóódu nɛ̄ Ussíya yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment, than for you.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n̄ da aá ka, ó géē tētēyi lɛ Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn fíyɛ́ aá ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up; and it was in my mouth sweet as honey: and as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.
idu_Latn: N kwú ēpɔ̄kpá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā ú ŋmá abɔ̄ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā, anɔ́ɔ n kwú ɔ̄ ú lé ā. Ó lɔnyɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛnwú ā okónu kú um, amáŋ eko nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔ́ cēmlɛ ā, ó cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtūomá gbɔɔ́ ō yá um.

eng_Latn: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi lɛ uwa gbaáluka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko ōhī ó gē ga ígbíli, ɛga nōo le fíyóó gaá gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Udóyēgu nōo wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ācogbɛna kú Usɔ́lu, nōo ŋmá Ɛ́dɔm ā yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ, ícíícɛ ɔ́ɔmā, ohígbū ka ó wā gaá yá uculo kú iyē ō gwu abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
idu_Latn: jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n lɛ aólɛlā kú uwɔ yá uka ō lɛ ikpó ce ɔ́ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, that the city which is next unto the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take an heifer, which hath not been wrought with, and which hath not drawn in the yoke;
idu_Latn: Ó ka anyākwɔ́cɛ kú ipú igelī nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ kwu ɛga nɛ̄ okwū ā tá ā ajaajɛ ā, géē bī ɛdrɔ́ kú ɔbá ɛna nēé lɛ̄ ɔ́ hɛ́hɔ̄ jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā ā wɛ odúúdú aíne nɛ̄ Óndú ā je lɛ Umósīsi ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi kóō je lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ í je ɔtū tónū ŋ́ má. Nááná nɛ̄ ɔkpíyē kú alɔ yɔ̄ ī wa ɛmɛɛma ā, amáŋ é kē yɔ̄ ī je alelékwū kú alɔ pīya ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
idu_Latn: Ɔyā ɔ́migwó ā: Umahárāyi wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú igwu nyā á.

eng_Latn: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si tá uwā ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó jé Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ bɛ̄ɛka aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú eko nyā ā, gē dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōcābɔ̄ á. É gáā je ɔdōcābɔ̄ dúúmā lɛ aá ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ ayíka ɛdɔ ɔdōcābɔ̄ nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō mafú lɛ Ujóna, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the LORD's house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried them to Babylon:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ipú iháyí ɛpa nōo ī wā ā, anúɔ géē je odúúdú aíyó kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú anúɔ nɛ̄ Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn kpó ŋmá amānyā ā kpó kwúcē wā amānyā.

eng_Latn: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
idu_Latn: Aá gbɛlá ka ó wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ka, Óndú ā kóō lɛ á fu ŋmá ipú ójila kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá wā ɛgiyí nū ajaajɛ, kú aá yúklɔ́ lɛ ɔ́ ipú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ kú nū, kú aá yúklɔ́ lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā nɛɛ?.

eng_Latn: Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.
idu_Latn: Ebilíi yá ɔ̄ ojámá ɛ̄cī ofɛpa abɔ́ɔ. Ipú aɛ́cī nōó yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ā, ó lé ɔdā dúúmā ŋ́, ɛmiyɛ kē gbɔɔ́ ō ŋmó ɔ̄ eko nɛ̄ aɛ́cī ɔ́ɔmā le gla ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened, and be ye valiant: for your master Saul is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ abɔ̄ lɔfú, kú aá kē lɔtúlɛ. Usɔ́ɔlu, ɔcɛ́ kú aá gekwú ɛɛ́, ācɛ kú Ujúda kē lɛ anɔ̄ tū um ɛyí kwú um ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú uwá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
idu_Latn: N jé ka aá gē da īyī aá ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ géē yá ɔ̄ nōó géē móōwē fíyɛ́ dúú ā? Anú hɛ́ odúúdú unwalu nyā klá īyī nū á.

eng_Latn: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí nū ā gē gwíijē klla ī gwō ɛ̄ngwū ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā, ɛháajɛ kú ádā uwá, Ásāfu, mɛ́mla Ujɛ́dūtɔn mɛ́mla Uhɛ́mān abɔ̄yī uwā kē bá ɛháajɛ ɔ́da kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
idu_Latn: Óndú, a gē gbō um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ́cɔ̄ ā. A klla gē hɛ́ um tá bɛ̄ɛka ɛga nɛ̄ n gē tayínū ā.

eng_Latn: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā n háyi amānyā kéē kɛpɔ̄ tū um ohígbū ka n kpɔ́tūce yɔ̄ ī gbēyī ka Ɔwɔicō géē yá okónu nōó ce lɛ aádáádā alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
idu_Latn: Ɔ́kplá kú nū ā wɛ Ábudɔn. Ayí nū ɔhá ā wɛ, Usɔr, Ukíss, Ubáalu, Unɛ́ɛ, Unádābu.

eng_Latn: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, wherewith he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́. Ó lɛ awulú kú ɛgahi mɛ́mla ahilíki kú ɔfú wiyē. Ó le ɛcɛ yá kwu ɛga nɛ̄ ó kwu ā kli, nɛ̄ ó tōō fu ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Uhásɛ̄rɔtu.

eng_Latn: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi yɔ̄ ɛga odɔ̄lɛ́ nɛ̄ iyē nū lé ka Umátīyu. Ó da ɔ́ kahíníī, Yɛce um. Anɔ́ɔ ó cāŋ́jɛ le yɛce ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto his daughters, And where is he? why is it that ye have left the man? call him, that he may eat bread.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā kē yɔ̄ ā. Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá mā ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā tá āa? Aá nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ hīgwú wā kóō gaá lɛ ɔdōlé lé.

eng_Latn: When I shall bring again their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Ujerúsālɛm ka anúɔ géē yá Usódom mɛ́mla Usɛmérīya mɛ́mla aípɔ́lɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú uwā ā ka é gbagbénú igbɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ka anúɔ géē yá ka Ujerúsālɛm abɔ̄yī nū kóō gbagbénú dúú.

eng_Latn: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka, a le yɛ tá ɔlɛ́ nū, ayíka a yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔlékwū ɛɛ́. Ɔnyā ā wɛ ɔwɛ kpíí nōo gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū.

eng_Latn: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
idu_Latn: Eko nēe bī ɔ̄ gaá nyɔ̄ í nyi ā, ācɛ alɛwa ī yɛce ɔ̄, iyɔ̄bū mɛ́mla igbīhi. Ācɛ gē gbō únóji kú nū. Ajɛ kú ipú únóji ā nááná gē gbo ɔ̄ iyē nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
idu_Latn: Aá yúúfi ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū gē hɛ́ aá ko ŋ́. N tɛtɛ le ka tɛ́ɛcɛ lɛ aá ŋmá íkée ɔdā nōo géē yá ā ɛɛ́. Aá kē wɛ ijáalí kú um á. Ɔwɔicō ɔhá yɔ̄ gwū um tá ɛɛ́? Ɔwɔ dúúmā ɔhá í yɔ̄ nōo lɔfú klla ī yɔ̄ piyóó bɛ̄ɛka ápátɛ̄cɔ̄ nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́. N jé odúúmā ɔhá gwū īyī um tá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu kwú odúúdú ācɛ ā ú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ ipú ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ajɛ kú Íjīpiti.

eng_Latn: And he that was over the house, and he that was over the city, the elders also, and the bringers up of the children, sent to Jehu, saying, We are thy servants, and will do all that thou shalt bid us; we will not make any king: do thou that which is good in thine eyes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aígabɔ̄ nēe gē leyīkwu ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla ákú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Usamérīya, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē gbō ayí kú ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Ujéhu kahíníī, Alɔ wɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ nɛ̄, ɔdā dúúmā nāa da alɔ, alɔ géē yá, amáŋ, alɔ í gaá je ɔcɛ́ ɔhá dúúmā ce ŋ́. Yá ɔdā dúúmā nāa má ka ɔ́ɔ lɔhi tū uwɔ ā mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipú ayááyí kú Ulífāyi ā wɛ āyā nōo cɛgbá ipú íne nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ́lu ā. Abālɔbányā, ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi le ɔdā nēé cíkā ō yá ā yá nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í cɛgbá kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ɔhá bɛ̄ɛka Umɛlikísɛ̄dɛki kóō wɛ̄ɛcɛ gɛ ŋ́, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Árɔ̄ni ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Usénaa wɛ, úlā ahāanɛ ce ofu cigwó .

eng_Latn: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nɛ̄ ojuja ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā, ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu géē je cālɛ́ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ga ɛga nɛ̄ ó géē wā í háyi igbɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.
idu_Latn: Ipú okómpīinu nēe bá ā ācɛ odoōcē bá, ācɛ opeyī, ācɛ ocīkpó, mɛ́mla ācɛ nɛ̄ iyē kú uwā le ŋmó. É bá gē gbēyī eko nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ ā géē jíliyē ā.

eng_Latn: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, a ī gbō ohílipú alɛwa nɛ̄hi, ɛlá nāa ī gbo ā kē lɔnɔ tū um ō jé nɛ̄hi. É klla le lɛwa ce um bá.

eng_Latn: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
idu_Latn: A jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nēé ī yīipú ligbó lɛ āa? A jé eko nēé ī ma ɔyí kú uwá āa?.

eng_Latn: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā pīyeyī má ɛcɛ, ŋmá ɔkpáncō, le odúúdú ayí kú alɛɛcɛ má.

eng_Latn: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king's sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
idu_Latn: Ujónādāabu klla da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ɔ híī kpɔ́tūce ɔ̄kā nēé kā ɔ̄ ka odúúdú ayí nū ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ gekwú ā ŋ́. Ó ka Ámnɔn ōfōōfūnū nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless.
idu_Latn: Uwá ɛplɛ́ɛpa wɛ ācɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō. É gē lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō Óndú ā tū, klla gē yá ɔdā nōó ka ā lɔɔlɔhi.

eng_Latn: And when these days were expired, the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace, both unto great and small, seven days, in the court of the garden of the king's palace;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ó le ɔdu kú nū ā mafú kwɛyí ā, ó lɛ ucɛ nɛ̄hi yá lɛ odúúdú ācɛ nēe lā Usúsa, ɔlɛ́ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú ajɛ Upɛ́sīya ā. Ó yá ucɛ nyā lɛ odúúdú ācɛ. Ucɛ nyā nōó yá, ipú ɛhɔ̄ kú ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú nū ā, lé ɛ̄cī ahāapa.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da awɔ nōo wɛ Ussɛ́bna ā ka eko nɛ̄ anúɔ kwú uwɔ í tá ajɛ ā, ka anúɔ géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu Ɛlíyākim nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ, ɔyí kú Uhilkíya ā.

eng_Latn: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō da ācobɔ́bíipú kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē bá ī jé íne kú um tū ɛyí ā? Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē bá gē kɛlā lɛyíkwu okónu nɛ̄ n ce ā?.

eng_Latn: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
idu_Latn: N géē yá ka aísu kéē cēenyi lɛ uwá ɛyí aɛ́fu. Njɔlɔ alɛwa kē í pɛ́ klá aɔ́pɛ́ lɛ uwá. Ígbíli ā géē je pīya aókpoó kú éŋkpɔ̄ ɛbɛɛbɛ. Ajɛ íkpākplā kē í je bū njɔlɔ ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
idu_Latn: É le ɛ̄cī kú okónu ōgwū tū, le ācɛ kú igelī ā hīgwú tɔ̄há klla le ɛga ocīce kú ojīlīmā je lɛ Unábɔ̄tu.

eng_Latn: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
idu_Latn: Ó bīyíne ɔwɛ dóódu ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúú pó ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ō kā ŋmá okónu kú nū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
idu_Latn: Ussámmōtu ŋmá Uhárɔ̄du, Uhɛ́lɛsi ŋmá Upéleti.

eng_Latn: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gwó inu ā gē lɛ ojīlīmā fíyɛ́ inu nōó gwó āá. Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si cíkā ō lɛ ojīlīmā nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ Umósīsi á.

eng_Latn: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔkpáncō gwū uwɔ tá ā. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a wɛ ákú um ā, ɔnyɛ ɔhá nɛ̄ n gē tíne ipú ɛcɛ nyā kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ?.

eng_Latn: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é wā ɛgiyí Ujɔ́ni gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Itica, ɔ̄cɛ nōo yɔ̄ mla awɔ ogbeé kú Ujɔ́dan, nāa cē ijáalí kú nū ā, yɔ̄ ī yá ācɛ Ubatísim abɔ̄yī nū, ācɛ dóódu gē pɛ́ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí nū.

eng_Latn: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé lɛ ɔ́ jé ā, é gwéeyē ohígbū ɔfú nēé le tū uwā iye ā.

eng_Latn: In the days of Pekah king of Israel came Tiglathpileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abelbethmaachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Upéka wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā, anɔ́ɔ Utígaláti Upilɛ́sa, ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya wā í le ɛfú kpó, klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi nēe bá ā abɔ̄fú; Íjɔn, Ébɛ̄lu Ubɛti Umáka, Ujanówa, Ukɛ́dɛssi, mɛ́mla Uhásɔ, mɛ́mla ajɛ kú Ugílɛ̄di, Ugálīli mɛ́mla Unáfutāli. Ó klla le ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā kpó kwú. Ó kwú uwā ú pīya alagbá kú ɛfú, anɔ́ɔ ó le uwá kpó ga Asírīya á.

eng_Latn: And they taught in Judah, and had the book of the law of the LORD with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Judah, and taught the people.
idu_Latn: Uwá kwú ɔkpá kú íne kú Óndú ā ú le yɛ ga aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú Ujúda dúúdú ā, anɔ́ɔ é le íne kú Óndú ā nwū odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda á.

eng_Latn: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
idu_Latn: É gáā je iyī uwa tēelihɔ eko nɛ̄ ohilí uwā gekwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
idu_Latn: Usséssan í ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā ŋ́, ayínɔ̄nyā ōfōōfūnū nōó ma á. Ó lɛ ɔfiyɛ kú Íjīpiti éyi, nōo lé ka Ujássa.

eng_Latn: Now therefore make a new cart, and take two milch kine, on which there hath come no yoke, and tie the kine to the cart, and bring their calves home from them:
idu_Latn: Aá lɛ úgbɔ́ɔnya gbā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɛna o bī ɔyí ɛpa, nēé lɛ ogbló ō lɛ wu ɛna ɛpa ɔkɔ kéē lɛ pi odée wu uwá ɔkɔ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā kpó. Cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ogbló ō lɛ wu ɛna ɛpa ɔkɔ kéē pi odée ā ú wu uwá ɔkɔ, cɛ́ɛ́ aá kwú ɔ̄ ú wū úgbɔ́nya ā, cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ayí uwā ā kpɔ́ nū tū ipú igá.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD remaineth under curtains.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, eko ɔ́ɔmā Udéfīdi má lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú abɔ̄yī nū nōó gwó Ujerúsālɛm ā ɛɛ́, Udéfīdi le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Unátan, ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Mɔ́ɔ, n lā ipú agblɔ̄cɛ́ kú um, nɛ̄ n bī ɔcí kú usɛ́da gwó ā, ámāŋ Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā kē tá ipú áklɔ̄kpɛ.

eng_Latn: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Ujóktan wɛ ācɛ nēé hī ka, Alumódādi, Usélefu, Uhásāmáfēti, Ujɛ́ra.

eng_Latn: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver's beam.
idu_Latn: É kpɛ́fú igbɔhá kpɔ́. Ipú ɛfú ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɛlhánan, ɔyí kú Ujɛ́ɛ ŋmó Ulámi, ɔyínɛ́ kú Ugolíyati nōo ŋmá Ugáti á. Ɔ́kpa kú óbō kú ɔ̄cɛ Ugáti ā cɔkpɛ́nú bɛ̄ɛka ogbló nēé gē bī gē le tá īlī ā.

eng_Latn: Of the sons of Pahathmoab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
idu_Latn: Ɛliyehóyenāyi, ɔyí kú Userahíya ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Upatimówābu mɛ́mla ācɛ ofigwó kú ipɔ́ɔma kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: Wherefore then do ye harden your hearts, as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts? when he had wrought wonderfully among them, did they not let the people go, and they departed?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá gē bā í yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú bɛ̄ɛka ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Íjīpiti ā? Aá híī je mlanyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá uwā olíla klla yá uwá ɛbɛ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
idu_Latn: Iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya ā, Óndú ā le yá ká ɛlā nɛ̄ ó ka bū okónu kú ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ujeremíya ā kóō le yá jīla. Óndú ā yá ka Usáyírɔ̄si kóō lɛ ɔna tá ipú odúúdú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla lɛ ɔ́ tá tāajɛ kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day as the flock of his people: for they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā gā ā, Óndú ā géē nya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū tá, lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogbāálá gē nya álá kú nū tá ŋmá ikwū ā. É géē bá ī ceyī ipú abɔ̄ kú Óndú ā ipú ajɛ kú nū bɛ̄ɛka ɛcɔ̄ o gbɔɔ́lá kú ɔfulā kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ayí ɔbá ɛna kú ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú ā, wɛ igwɛ́ɛpa, aómlede igwɛ́ɛpa, aálá kú iháyí éyi igwɛ́ɛpa mɛ́mla aópī igwɛ́ɛpa kú ɛya kú íne ō bīya.

eng_Latn: And they came, both men and women, as many as were willing hearted, and brought bracelets, and earrings, and rings, and tablets, all jewels of gold: and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the LORD.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄e dɔɔ̄kā ō je, kwu ācɛnyīlɔ mɛ́mla ācɛnyā, bī aágá o bī yíifa, aɔ́dōplahɔ́, aéliká, aágbá ō tɔ̄ɔkɔ, mɛ́mla aɔ́dīifa kú ugóolu ɛyɛ́ɛ́yɛ́yí, anɔ́ɔ é kwú uwā ú kpó lɛ Óndū á.

eng_Latn: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the LORD of hosts.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu í gāa cē ɛpɔ̄ īyī nū glá ŋ́. Ācɛ kú Udamáskɔ̄s kē í je pīya aɔ́fiyɛ. Ācɛ kú Isírīya nēe gēe hile a, uwēyī gēe kwú uwá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu a. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ānɛ̄ o nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a lɛ ɛ̄nyā ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú. Ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú, aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
idu_Latn: Lɛ ka lɛ ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā ka, eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá ā, ɛjī kú ajɛ ā géē lɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā.

eng_Latn: And I have declared unto them thy name, and will declare it: that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them, and I in them.
idu_Latn: N le yá kéē lɛ uwɔ jé, n klla géē yɔ̄ ī yá kéē jé uwɔ, ká ihɔtū nāa lɛ ɛgiyí um ā kóō yɔ̄ lɛ uwā, ká n̄ kē ī piyatɔ̄há mla uwá.

eng_Latn: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya, ayí kú Ulífāyi ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ ōhī má lā kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ. Ācogwííjē mɛ́mla ācogbɔ̄ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, má lā aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ ā. Ācɛ ɔhá dóódu nēe hile ā, kwú pɛ́ ga ipɔ́ɔma kú aádā uwá gaá lā ɛga nɛ̄ aádáádā uwā tɛtɛ lā ā.

eng_Latn: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac being eight days old, as God had commanded him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áyísīki le pīya ɛ̄cī ahātá ā, Ébrahām lɛ ɔ́ apī hɛ́, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je íne lɛ ɔ́ āa.

eng_Latn: And it was so, when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ Ɛláyíssa le pó ka, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ le īlī kú nū híla bónū ā, ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū gaá da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔdíyá nāa híla īlī kú uwɔ bónū ā? Kwú ɔ̄cɛ ā í tɛ̄hɔ̄ fu um, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō le jé ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu.

eng_Latn: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
idu_Latn: Óndú lɛ um jámá ká ā má ɔ̄, lɛ aɔ́dā nēe kwu um ɔtū ā mɛ́mla ɛlá nɛ̄ n gē gbo ā jila.

eng_Latn: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
idu_Latn: Oŋmá lɛ íkwu kú Óndú ā, n gē pi aá ahɔ̄ kú aá híīī lā bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēé lɔtūce Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ma ŋ́. Ɔdā nēé gē gbɛlá nū ā í wɛ ɔdā o tīile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
idu_Latn: Ugáti, Umárēsa, Usífu.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, ye have no life in you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, n̄ da aá ka, ń táafú ŋ́ aá lɛ ɔkpíyē kú Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā lé, klla lɛ oyī kú nū gwá, ámāŋ aá lɛ oyēeyī dúúmā ipú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Upíta le blakwu ɛlā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si ka ā kahíníī, Gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔbúgwū kóō tōgwú ā, a géē híhó ka anúɔ í je um ŋ́ igbɛ ɛtá. Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá ɛcɛ gaá gbɔɔ́ ō jikwū nɛ̄hi á.

eng_Latn: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ ká Ucɛ kú Onyatá ā kóō wā ā, Ujísɔ̄si gā Ubɛ́tāni ɛga nɛ̄ Ulásārɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā lā ā.

eng_Latn: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom, that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace, to the house of the women, unto the custody of Hege the king's chamberlain, keeper of the women; and let their things for purification be given them:
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdá je lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú uwɔ nēe bá ɛga dóódu ipú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, kéē lɛ ayípɔ̄nɔ̄nyā ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā kpó ŋmá ɛga dóódu kú ipú ajɛ kú uwɔ ā. Kéē wā í jīla uwɔ eyī Usúsa, amānyā. Kéē lɛ uwá kpó tū Uhégāyi, idibo nōo gē leyīkwu anyā ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā abɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē je ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔdā nōo géē yá kéē jɔ̄ɔnyā klla lɔhi fíyɛ́ ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gēe méyīnyinyi kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū, Ísrɛ̄lu ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́, nōó klá gēe fu uwá, ācɛ kú nu kpɔ́ ɛɛ́. Ó gēe yá ka uwá ka e lā ipú ajɛ kú uwá ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ̄, nɛ̄ aéwo ɔhá gēe wā ipú ajɛ kú uwá í lā mla uwá ɔhá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord, let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord.
idu_Latn: Ɔkpáni, kóocōō, mīyɛ ɛhi nɛ̄ n bī wā nyā, ká ā le je lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: O LORD, I beseech thee, let now thine ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants, who desire to fear thy name: and prosper, I pray thee, thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king's cupbearer.
idu_Latn: Óndú, pó ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gē gbā gā uwɔ, mɛ́mla ɔkɔ nɛ̄ odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ɔhá nēe gē lɛ ojīlīmā ce uwɔ klla í tíne kéē lɛyítáajɛ ga uwɔ ā, gē gbā ā. Óndú, tá um abɔ̄ ícɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi ā kóō lɛ āhɔ̄ jē gā um, kóō klla lɛ eyīnyinyi kú um má. Ɛplá eko ɔ́ɔmā, Unehemíya ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o tū ejé lɛ ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ óndú nū tóohi da ɔ́ kahíníī, Awɔ, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ obɔ̄bíipú mɛ́mla okwáahi, a jé ka n gē cē ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ ń nyi ŋ́, n klla ī gla ŋmá ɛga nɛ ń kpó bá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
idu_Latn: Uhɔ́ma, Árādi.

eng_Latn: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛlā kú Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ géē lɛ ikpó gbo ɔ́ í túgagá kē í gwōnū. É túgagá í gwōnū ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya lɛ uwa á.

eng_Latn: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, awɔ, Óndú ā, wɛ ɔcɛ́ piyóó, odúúdú ācɛ kú eko ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí gē blakwu uwɔ ŋmá eko éyi ga eko ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si klla kahíníī, N da aá ka, aá bī agbénú kú íne o bīya kú ɛcɛ nyā le yá ɔdā o tīile lɛ ācɛ ɔhá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le aɔ́ya lɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ eko nɛ̄ agbénú kú aá í tīile dúúmā gɛ ŋ́, é géē mīya aá wā ɔlɛ́ nōo ī yɔ̄ piyóó ā.

eng_Latn: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
idu_Latn: N géē jikwāidɔ, klla í yēkwu ohígbū aɛ́fu ā mɛ́mla ipácí nɛ̄ aɛ́bɛ́ gē lúlé ā. N géē yá lɛ ā ohígbū ka aácí kwú kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ ɛɛ́. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gē bū ipú nū gɛ ŋ́. Ɛna dúúmā í kē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé ī po uya kú uwā abɔ́ɔ gɛ ŋ́. Kwu aígbáanɔ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ kwú pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ajɛ ā le yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ó ce ɔ̄ yɔ̄ ī nyɔ̄ ā, ācɛ le úwé kú uwā plla bá iyɔ̄bū ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ da anúɔ ka anúɔ da ācɛ ā kéē yɛ bū ogwoogwu kú ajɛ kú ayínɛ́ uwā, ayááyí kú Ísɔ́, nēe lā Uséyɛ ā. Ó ka ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm gēe yúúfi uwā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɛlá kwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
idu_Latn: Óndú āgēe je ísu kú Íjīpiti, a ŋ́mó ŋmá ajɛ, klá í tū owu gāa je ísu kú Iyufarétīs a kpó ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ, klá ije aóhile kú nu í kɔ̄ áyɔ́kpá ahāapa fílɛ́fílɛ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dóódu lɔfú bū ipú ísu a ɛyí ɔjɛ áncā glá.

eng_Latn: And I gathered them together to the river that runneth to Ahava; and there abode we in tents three days: and I viewed the people, and the priests, and found there none of the sons of Levi.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́sra kahíníī, N le odúúdú ācɛ ā kpó bá okónu ísu kú ɔ́gilɔ́ nōo gē pɛ́ ga igelī kú Aháfa ā, alɔ bá abɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɛtá. N má ka ācogwɛ́ɛya ā bā ipú ācɛ nēe wā í jīla um eyī ā, amáŋ ayí kú Ulífāyi í bā ipú uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yēeyī. N cɛ̄tra anú nōo gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ um ā. N ka ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ó gē bī lɛ nya um tá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: The men of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.
