idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uráma mɛ́mla Ugéba wɛ úlā ce ofigwóléyi ce éyi.

eng_Latn: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ kwú mlanyī um bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ n gekwú ɛɛ́ mā. N lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kwú tá tónū ɛɛ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And now therefore hear the word of the LORD, ye remnant of Judah; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; If ye wholly set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to sojourn there;
idu_Latn: Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā, kahíníī, Aá nēe hile Ujúda ā, ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ aá kwú eyī kú aá kwu ō nyɔ̄ Íjīpiti gaá lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of slaying them with a very great slaughter, till they were consumed, that the rest which remained of them entered into fenced cities.
idu_Latn: Ujóssuwa mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó, amáŋ, ācɛ ōhī kú uwā lɛ ɛga má le kwu gaá tayínū ipú ɔ́gba kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā, nēé kē ŋmó uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: He that smiteth a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúú nōo le ɔdée yá ɔ́mpa nū, nɛ̄ ɔ́mpa nū ā gekwú, é géē je ɔ́ ŋmó kwɛyí nū.

eng_Latn: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔ̄hī kú uwā ge bēé ga ipú ɔlɛ́ ācɛ ōhī ge nyɔ̄ ī kwú ācɛnyā nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwa ī lɔfú ɛgiyí ínōbīya ŋ́ mā, ācɛnyā nɛ̄ ɛdɔ únwū dóódu gē nū uwā tɔ́ɔwɛ á.

eng_Latn: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ɛbɛ nēé má lɛyíkwu ígbíli éyi nōo kwu pī ísu nɛ̄hi. Aólɛlā bá ī wā í kpɛ́fú aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ofúlutu nōo gē kpó wā kwūūū ŋmá ipú ígbíli kú Unégebu ā.

eng_Latn: But I said, How shall I put thee among the children, and give thee a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations? and I said, Thou shalt call me, My father; and shalt not turn away from me.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, n tíne ō mīyɛ aá bɛ̄ɛka ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ōcɛ̄ kú um ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ kwú ajɛ nōo lɔhi ō lā fíyɛ́ dúú ipú odúúdú ajɛ kú ɛcɛ ā ú lɛ aá. N tíne ká aá hī um ka ádā aá, ká aá klla cīgbīhi kwu um ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
idu_Latn: Aá bī ɔ̄ le yá ɔdā dúúmā glá āa? Aá gbā ɔcí lígíi dúúmā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ɔcí ufáyin kú a hé kwu ɔdɔ lɛ ɔdā dúúmā playi anú glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son's mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son's mandrakes.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɛ́ya da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔbá um nɛ̄ a mīyɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ um ā í jɛ̄ uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Abālɔbányā, a klla yɔ̄ ī tíne ō mīyɛ umándrēki kú ɔyí um ŋmá abɔ̄ nū. Urécɛ̄lu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka a kwú umándrēk kú ɔyí uwɔ ā ú gā um, a lɔfú gbo mla Ujékɔ̄pu otú mā glá.

eng_Latn: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ɔ́ɔ géē leyīkwu uwá, klla í kpó odúúdú aéwo nēe bá ipú ajɛ ā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká uwá kéē géē mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā. Ó da uwá ka Ujóssuwa ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ ɔ̄cɛ oleyīkwu uwá mɛ́ɛ̄ á, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
idu_Latn: Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ uklɔ́ lígíí, nɛ̄ ó géē yɔ̄ ī yá nōo í je ɛbɔ́ lɛ ɔ́, ikɔkɔ ō kpó abɔ̄ ɛpɛplɛ́ɛpa tū ipú uklɔ́ ō yá nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka inya oōnū owu ā.

eng_Latn: Remember what Amalek did unto thee by the way, when ye were come forth out of Egypt;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi da uwá kéē blakwu ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki ɔ́ɔ yá uwā, eko nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ bá yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā.

eng_Latn: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwu pīya otrɛ̄yí kú ācoyíkpala, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ í lɛ uwá ŋ́ mā á. Ɔdā nyā yá igbīhi eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le Uhádadésa yálé klla le ācɛ nēe tīīpú mɛ́mla anú ā kpó ŋmó ā. Anɔ́ɔ Urésɔn nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le tá Udamáskɔ̄si gaá lā abɔ́ɔ á. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya ɔcɛ́ kú Usiríya á.

eng_Latn: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ka lɛ ípú ɔkōolɔhi nɛ̄ n tɔ́ɔna nū ā, ka Ɔwɔicō í bī Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá le kɛpɔ̄ tū ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ gbɛlá ipú ɔtū kú uwā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá dúú í jé ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Now therefore, my lord, as the LORD liveth, and as thy soul liveth, seeing the LORD hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood, and from avenging thyself with thine own hand, now let thine enemies, and they that seek evil to my lord, be as Nabal.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō í cɛ̄ gā uwɔ gwō aólɛlā kú uwɔ ɔ́ci, kú ā kpó uwā ŋmó ŋ́ yɔ̄ á. N bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī ā lɛ okónu ce gā uwɔ, ka Óndú ā géē yá Unábalu italā bɛ̄ɛka odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwɔ nēe gē tíne kéē je uwɔ ŋmó ā.

eng_Latn: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
idu_Latn: N le yá lɛ iyó mɛ́mla ɔdā ō bī gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā túbá ɛɛ́. Kwu oje ɔdɔ , oje nɛ̄hɛ́, oje, ɔcí, ɛcɔ̄, ɛcɔ̄ ɔwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Israel rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
idu_Latn: O ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā jāā kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā nɛ̄ aípɔ́ɔma igwó ā hímāyi bɛ́yíkwu ipɔ́ɔma kú Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ gē kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka aíne nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ géē le tū klla géē bī yúklɔ́ ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā ɔ́ɔ je lɛ uwá kéē lā anú piyóó ipú ɛcɛ ā bá yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ abɔ̄ kla ahɛ ŋmá údɔ̄bū kú uwɔ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ a géē má ɔdōlé lé á, jāā gbéeko nēé je uwɔ cīgbīhi ga ipú ajɛ. Ohígbū ka ipú ajɛ nēé yá uwɔ ŋmá á. Ipú ajɛ ā nɛ̄ a kē í kwúcē nyɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:
idu_Latn: É kē má um bā n yɔ̄ gē táafú mla ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ámāŋ ka ō wu ɔtū kú ɛwa klíicō ŋ́, ó kōō wɛ ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ámāŋ Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ámāŋ ɛga dóódu kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when the LORD made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dúúmā ɔhá í klla yɔ̄ ipú ikpáti nyā gwū Usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa kú íne nɛ̄ Umósīsi mīyɛ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu kú Usáyínāyi, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá eko nēé yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
idu_Latn: É ī gwá īkpō eko nēé le hīla nááná, ēpū kú uwā wɛ ɛ̄mɛ̄ɛ̄mɛ̄ eko dóódu, é gē wúla ŋ́, é klla lɔfú nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: And the king of Jericho sent unto Rahab, saying, Bring forth the men that are come to thee, which are entered into thine house: for they be come to search out all the country.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā le ɛhɔ̄ tū fu Uréhābu kahíníí, Ācɛ ɛpa nēe wā ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā, lɛ uwá kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ, ohígbū kēé wā gáā jila ajɛ kú alɔ wɛɛlɛ nɛ.

eng_Latn: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that makest thy nest in the cedars, how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee, the pain as of a woman in travail!
idu_Latn: Aá lā ɛbɔ́ cíí ipú agblɔ́cɛ́ nēé lɛ aɔ́cí Usɛ́da nēé kpó ŋmá Ulɛ́bānɔn ā gwó ɔ̄ ā. Amáŋ, aá géē jikwū klla í tíifu nɛ̄hi, eko nɛ̄ aá gē jé ɔnɔ nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā nɛ̄ ɔmā lɛ ɔ́ kwú ā.

eng_Latn: Woe to thee, O land, when thy king is a child, and thy princes eat in the morning!
idu_Latn: Ohóō yɔ̄ lɛ ewo dóódu nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú nū wɛ ɔyípɛ̄ nɛ̄ aígabɔ̄ kú nū bá ɛyí ucɛ ō lé otú gbɔ́ɔ̄cī ɛ̄cī dóódu.

eng_Latn: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n géē da iyī um ka n wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɛyí nū lɔhi nɛ̄hi! N le aɔ́dā olɔhi nɛ̄ n cɛgbá iháyí alɛwa ā lɛ ɛɛ́. N géē yá oyēēyī ɛmɛɛma, n géē lé í gwá cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔtū kóō he um.

eng_Latn: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
idu_Latn: Ó kwú ɔ̄ í tɛ́cɔ̄ ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄ nōo lɛ oŋmɛ́yí ŋ́ mā kwú igodó ú kwu ɔ̄, klla lɛ ɔja he klá anú kóō yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó ɔ́ɔmā. Ó yá lɛ ā cɛ́ɛ́ ka ebilíi kóō wā í plla ācɛ glá gɛ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó le yā. Igbīhi nɛ̄ iháyí úlā ɛpa cofigwó ā yá, é géē hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá eko lígíí.

eng_Latn: Then the LORD said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear ye the words of this covenant, and do them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā da um ka amiyɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga odúúdú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda mɛ́mla aúláyi kú Ujerúsālɛm, kā amiyɔ̄ tɔ́ɔna lɛ ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aá jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá cíkā ō yá ká aá lɛ ɛka nɛ̄ um gbo mɛ́mla aá ā tū, ká aá lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Uhɛ́sbɔn mɛ́mla Ɛlíle bá í jikwū. É kē pó ikwū kú uwá ā jāā gáā kwu Ujáhasi. Ācɛ kú Usóya kē pó dúú. É klla pó jāā kwu Uhorónéyim mɛ́mla Ɛglat Uselísīya. Ɔkpá kú Unímrim ā kwú ŋmó dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell on sleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Udéfīdi le ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō miya ā yá tū ɔ̄ ɔtū eko kú nū, anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, é le ɔ́ nyi mla aádáádā nū, anɔ́ɔ ɔkpíyē kú nū kwú watāajɛ ipú únóji á.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
idu_Latn: Ije kú uwɔ lɔfú mɛ ipú eyī ōcēbeé igbeékpónú glá, bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ acá bū le wu ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ bɛ̄ɛka okpé ā.

eng_Latn: And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray thee, of whom speaketh the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ nēé búdá ā da Ufílīpu kahíníī, Kócōō, ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ī kɛlā nyā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā? Ó gē ka lɛyíkwu iyī nū kɛ̄ɛ ka lɛyíkwu ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá.

eng_Latn: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
idu_Latn: Ó klla je ɔ́da lɛ uwá kahíníī, Aá bī ɔdā ɔhá dúú mla iyī aá ipú iyāwu nyā ŋ́, ń táafú ŋ́ okwutɛ ōfōōfūnū. Aá bī igbō ŋ́, aá bī ɛkpa kú ācɛ o bɔdā ŋ́, aá híī bī ije ipú alítā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the LORD, to the mighty One of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔtū géē he aá nēe wɛ ācɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā, nɛ̄ aá klla í gwéeyē. Aá géē bá ī gwíjē bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gē yá otú kú ɛ̄cī kú ucɛ kú aá ā. Ɔtū géē he aá bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ nēe bá ī yāwu ce ɛ́mla nēé ī tá ā ga ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Óndú ā gē gbō Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya géē ka tɛ́ɛcɛ ka ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ agwú ikpɛ̄yí kú nū.

eng_Latn: And he shall prepare a meat offering of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and an hin of oil for an ephah.
idu_Latn: O géē bī okoolo kú īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɛtɛ́-nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kú anɔ̄ olífu bá ɔbá ɛna éyi dóódu mɛ́mla omlede éyi dóódu nɛ̄ ó géē yɔ̄ ī gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
idu_Latn: Eko nēé ī ŋmó odée yɔ̄, eko nēé ī nya odée tá kē yɔ̄. Eko kú ɔdā ō ca tāajɛ yɔ̄, eko kú ɔdā ō gwó gicō yɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cē únwū kú aá tū glá ŋ́, aá nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔnyā ámāŋ ɔbá lɛ. Ó lɔhi fíyɛ́ kú aá lɛ ɔnyā ámāŋ ɔbá lɛ ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú aá ī yá ā nwulanwula ohígbū unwū ɔnyā ámāŋ ka unwū ācɛnyīlɔ.

eng_Latn: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
idu_Latn: Íjéeyī kú Ɔwɔicō nwuné fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛcɛ gbɛ ā, klla nwúné fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ísu nɛ̄hi lɔwá ā á. Á kē jɛ́yí nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da Urútu eko ɔ́ɔmā kɔ́ɔ̄ híī je unwalu lɛ iyīnū gɛ ŋ́. Ó da ɔ́ɔ ka anúɔ géē yá ɔdā dóódu nɔ́ɔ tíne ā lɛ ɔ́. Ohígbu ka odúúdú ācɛ kú Ubɛ́tilɛhɛm jé ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɔnyā olɔhi.

eng_Latn: And when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and, lo, an horror of great darkness fell upon him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛnɔ yɔ̄ ī gaajɛ ā, iyɔ̄ɔ̄lā nɛ̄hi kwú Ébram ú. Anɔ́ɔ obócádede kú ufi mɛ́mla obū nɛ̄hi gaá klá Ébram á.

eng_Latn: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
idu_Latn: Kwu ɛcɔ̄ kú inu ā, yɔ̄ ī jikwū klá aá gbōō, ɔcí ō gba ɔlɛ́ ā gē jikwū mla uwá klá aá dúú.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Israel:
idu_Latn: A géē lɛ ɛcɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nɛ̄hi ɛpa kpó, cɛ́ɛ́ a lɛ iyē kú ayí igwɛ́ɛpa kú Ujékɔ̄pu ā tá tū uwā.

eng_Latn: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ile dúúmā ŋ́. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka īmīyōjó kú oje nɛ̄hɛ́ áncā, ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā tá uwā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And he went on his journeys from the south even to Bethel, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Hai;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Unégēbu lɛyíkwu Ubɛ́tɛlu jāā ga ɛga nɛ̄ áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū kwu aflɛ́yí ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Ubɛ́tɛlu mɛ́mla Áyi ā.

eng_Latn: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó yɔ̄ gē yāwu eyī éŋkpɔ̄, é gbɛlá koó wɛ inambo nɛ̄, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɛgba dɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō da ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ Ussɛmáya kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Israel this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā n gē lɛ abɔ̄ gbo aá ɔtū, aá lɛ ɔtū, aá lɛ ɔ̄cɛ éyi fu gā um kóō nuunu tá um.

eng_Latn: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
idu_Latn: Ā yɔ̄ í tíne ō tū ami nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ēpū ā ufi nɛɛ? Kɛɛ ka a yɔ̄ í nū um inya bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ nɛ̄ owu gē kpó igbóngbō ā?.

eng_Latn: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.
idu_Latn: Agīje yɔ̄ ī pɛ́ ŋmá um eyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔkpá ī pɛ́ ā, ohígbū ka ācɛ í lɛ íne kú uwɔ tū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́bíipú kú ācɛ ā géē yi bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú ácí úgbá, mla ɔlá kú ūpū nɛ̄hi, nōo gē tá ódūdū kpúmm ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
idu_Latn: Ó ka igbīhi ɛ̄cī ofɛpa ɔ́ɔmā, Óndú ā kwú usiléeti kú ɛcɔ̄ ɛpa nōó tá ɛka nōó gbo ā tū ɔ̄ ā ú kpó lɛ anúɔ.

eng_Latn: The length of a board was ten cubits, and the breadth of a board one cubit and a half.
idu_Latn: Olicō kú ɔ́kpa dóódu wɛ ekābɔ̄ ɛnɛ, olɔwá kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ekābɔ̄ éyī ce āyá.

eng_Latn: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?
idu_Latn: Eko nyá nɛ̄ ami nōo wɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwɔ ā, gáā gbēyī í kwu ā? Eko nyá nāa géē hɛ́pɔ̄ ká ācɛ nēe bá ī yá um ŋmó ā?.

eng_Latn: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
idu_Latn: É ŋmá Ubɛne-jaákan gaá lā Uhɔ-haggidgādi.

eng_Latn: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying unto him,
idu_Latn: Éfrɔn tá Ébrahām ohi kahíníī.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Israel,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔyā ɛpa ā gā ā, ó le tá ɛgiyí ádā nū. Anɔ́ɔ ádā nū kwú ɔ̄ ú gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú lɛ Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ɔ́ lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú, í jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ ŋ́ má. Ɛ̄nyā ɛga nɛ̄ uculo kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā ŋmá á.

eng_Latn: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ Ulífāyi lɛ īyī wā iyē gwu yēŋēē kéē gaá je Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicó kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā.

eng_Latn: I intreated thy favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word.
idu_Latn: N gbɔ̄ɔkɔ gā uwɔ mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um, ményinyi kú um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ okónu nāa ce ā lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ā da ɔ́ kóō yɔ̄ líígíí ā, ó tá.

eng_Latn: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
idu_Latn: Aá géē hīíjémā ka aá nyɔ̄ í pɛ̄cí ɔkwu aɔ́cí nēé hī ka óoku ā.

eng_Latn: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka n gē yúklɔ́ kú nū, nɛ̄ aá kē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um ŋ́ nááná, aá í cɛ̄ ohígbū úklɔ́ ā. Ká aá le jé, klla lɛyí nū jé, ka Ádā ā yɔ̄ ipú um, n kē yɔ̄ ipú nū.

eng_Latn: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
idu_Latn: Eko dóódu nēé le fu ajɛ nɛɛ, ó gē wɛ ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā. Ācɛ nēe bá ɛháajɛ kú ígwu kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda ā gbɔɔ́ aflɛ́yí. É yɛ ígwíígwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Unássɔn, ɔyí kú Ammínādābu, otrɛ̄yí kú uwā ā ka lɛ uwá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And when David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, Blessed be the LORD, that hath pleaded the cause of my reproach from the hand of Nabal, and hath kept his servant from evil: for the LORD hath returned the wickedness of Nabal upon his own head. And David sent and communed with Abigail, to take her to him to wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi le pó ka Unábalu ɔ́ɔ gekwú ā, ó ka anúɔ wóofu iyē kú Óndú ā, ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔ́ci gwō Unábalu kú ɛcá nɛ̄ ɔ́ cá anúɔ ā. Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ klla lɛ anúɔ gbō ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá ɛɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɛhɔ̄ tū nyɔ̄ í le ɔ̄kā Abígɛ̄lu ō lɛ da á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ahɔ̄ ōpɛ́ɛ́lā, kóō pó ɛlā nyā.

eng_Latn: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ohígbū ka Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlá nɛ̄ ɔ́ ī je ɔdā dóódu kpó yi tāajɛ dúúdú ā. Ó ka ɔ́ɔ gē kpópú nɛ̄hi, ka ɔ́ɔ gáā cɛ̄ kéē gbā ɔwɔ ɔhá ɛ̄gbā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.
idu_Latn: Urúbɛn da ádā nū kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ń bī Ubɛ́njamīm cīgbīhi wā gé lɛ uwɔ ŋ́, a lɔfú lɛ ayí um ɛpa ā kpó ŋmó. Kwú ɔ̄ ú tū um abɔ̄, n géē je ɔ̄ cīgbīhi gé lɛ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of God made he man.
idu_Latn: N yá ɔ̄cɛ gbla ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā, ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ŋmó, ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá géē je ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋmó.

eng_Latn: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ubálam tá ijakī ā ohi kahíníī, Ohígbū ka a yɔ̄ ī yá um olíla, ɔ́dāŋ ka n kōō bī ɔkpacaŋgelī abɔ̄ nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í lɛ uwɔ ŋmó.

eng_Latn: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
idu_Latn: ɔlékwū, ɔnyā nɛ̄ ó ma ɔyí ŋ́, ajɛ ō ŋmíkpākplā nōo gē cɛgbá ɔwɔ, mla ɔlá nōo yɔ̄ ī yi piyóó.

eng_Latn: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá kplá, nɛ̄ ó lɛ ágbe lɛ, ámāŋ ka ɛbɛ́ ā gekwú eko nɛ̄ óndú nū í yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ŋ́. Ó géē gbā ulé nū lɛ óndú nū āa.

eng_Latn: After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛ̄nyā, Ujísɔ̄si le tá Ujerúsālɛm ɔnū ucɛ kú ācɛ Ujíyu.

eng_Latn: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
idu_Latn: Óndú, yá ká n̄ kɛlā, ká n̄ klla cɛ̄tra awɔ.

eng_Latn: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē yɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī Ugálīli, yɔ̄ gē nwɛ̄lā ipú aɛ́gogbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú uwā, yɔ̄ gē kā ɔ̄kōolɔhi kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ ā. Ó klla hɛ́ ācodoōcē ɛdɔ ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí tá.

eng_Latn: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do anything to her.
idu_Latn: Ámnɔn í má ɛga fu Utáma ŋ́ ohígbū ka abɔ̄ Utáma, ɔyí ádā nū ā, í jé ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ jéjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, é kē cɛ̄ le ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dóódu túbla anú ŋ́. Ó gbɛlá nū gáágá nōó cɛ̄ lɛ ōcē gbɔɔ́ ō yá ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
idu_Latn: Ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla ɔdā otūufi nɛ̄hi le yá ipú ajɛ nyā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD, and said, We beseech thee, O LORD, we beseech thee, let us not perish for this man's life, and lay not upon us innocent blood: for thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased thee.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔma é gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄ hī Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Alɔ ī ba uwɔ, ó! Óndú, ā cɛ̄ lɛ alɔ pɛ́ yíífi ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ ā ŋ́, káā je ɛpɔ̄bí kú nū ce alɔ ɛyí ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔdā nōo he uwá ɔtū ā nēé yá ɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.
idu_Latn: N géē kpó ācɛ Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu wā ɔlɛ́ ŋmá ajɛ nēé kwú uwā aɔ́fiyɛ nyɔ̄ ā. N kē ī tá uwá gwó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é tɛtɛ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Whiles it remained, was it not thine own? and after it was sold, was it not in thine own power? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart? thou hast not lied unto men, but unto God.
idu_Latn: Agbénú nyā wɛ ákú uwɔ eko nɛ̄ á je ɔ́ lá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. Eko nāa kē kwú ɔ̄ ú lá ā, ije ā kē wɛ ákú uwɔ. Ɔdíyá nāa miya ká ā yá ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā ipú ɔtū kú uwɔ ā? Á kɛ̄ŋmgbɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ ŋ́ amáŋ a le ɛ̄kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ka lɛ Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Igbeékpónú, Óndú ā le ɔlá tū wā í kwú uwā ú kpó yi iyɔ̄bū nū abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Then said these men, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā tá īyī uwa ohi kahíníī, Alɔ ī gáā má ɔdōbɔ̄bí dúúmā ɛgiyí Udánīyɛlu nɛ̄ alɔ géē kwú ɔ̄ ŋ́, ayíka ɔdā nōo lɛyíkwu ɔwɛ nōó gé gbā Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɛ̄gbā, klla ī lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú nū tū ā.

eng_Latn: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: É ma Ujísɔ̄si ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā. Ujósɛ̄fu lɛ Umerí, ɛ́nɛ́ Ujísɔ̄si, kwelūbi. Amáŋ gbɔbū ɛ́ kéē lɛ īyī uwā ā, Umerí kwú ipú í yɔ̄ ŋmá lɛ ɔfú kú Alelékwū Ihɔ.

eng_Latn: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
idu_Latn: Ɔtū kú um le mu mla ijē olɔhi, abɔ̄ n gáā gwíije nyā lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā. Ígblɛ́nyī kú um lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛkɔ o bī tɔ́kpá kú ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ɔmálɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā kú ɛ̄gbā kú ɛya kú ɛbɔ́ kú Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Udúwɛ̄lu ā, wɛ aɔ́bá ɛna ɛpa, aómlede ɛhɔ̄, aópī ɛhɔ̄, mɛ́mla álá kú iháyí éyi ɛhɔ̄.

eng_Latn: A good name is better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.
idu_Latn: Iyē olɔhi ō lé, lɔhi fíyɛ́ anɔ̄ ōkpóocu ā. Ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ kwú ā lɔhi fíyɛ́ eko nēé ma ɔ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
idu_Latn: Ó le ācɛ iyē gwu ŋmá ine nēé bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ anú mɛ́mla ācɛ nōó gwu uwá iyē ā le ádā ékpó á. Anú yá nōó tū ɔ̄ uwēyī kóō hī uwā ka ayínɛ́ nū ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: And they said unto him, We neither received letters out of Judaea concerning thee, neither any of the brethren that came shewed or spake any harm of thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníi, Alɔ í kē mīyɛ ɔkpa dúúmā ŋmá Ujudíya ohígbū uwɔ ŋ́, odúúmā kú ayínɛ́ nēe wā amānyā í kē kpɛ́pɔ̄ ámāŋ o ka obɔ̄bí kú uwɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Ó tɔ́ɔtɛ lɛ inyankwūlūmi kóō yɛ bū ipú ɔgɔ̄ inyilá fíyɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ olagbénú kóō wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: Who is there even among you that would shut the doors for nought? neither do ye kindle fire on mine altar for nought. I have no pleasure in you, saith the LORD of hosts, neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā kahíníī, Eyī yá um kú ɔ̄cɛ éyi kóō lɛ ɔwɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú um gwū, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ dúú kóō nyɔ̄ í gwɛ́ɛya kú ɔdā icííci ɔ́ɔmā ɛyí ede kú um ŋ́. Ɔtū aá í he um ŋ́. Ń kē gaá mīyɛ ɔdā ɛ̄gbā nɛ̄ aá bī gé um ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́lɛsi, Ɛlísa.

eng_Latn: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka, Ami abɔ̄yī um géē mafú lɛ ɔ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó géē móōwē nɛ̄hi piíí ohígbū um ā.

eng_Latn: For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek him; but his power and his wrath is against all them that forsake him.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó géē tū um uwēyī ɔ́dāŋ ka n klla le da ɔcɛ́ kú Upɛ́sīya kóō lɛ aícɔ́ɔja o cɔɔnya kpó lɛ alɔ kéē gbō alɔ ɛyí, ohígbū ka n tɛtɛ le da ɔcɛ́ ɛɛ́ ka, Ɔwɔicō kú alɔ gēe hɛ́ ɔhá ce ɔ̄cɛ dóódu klla í gbō ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē lɔtūce ɔ́ ā. Amáŋ ó í yá ɔ̄cɛ dóódu nōo lɛ igbīhi ce kwu ɔ́ klla í yá īkpɛ̄yí olɔfú tá ɔ̄ italā.

eng_Latn: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔkpani ā da ɔ̄cɛ éyi kahíníī, Mīyɛ ɛkpa éyi kú īkpīije ɔdɔ ā ú ŋmá abɔ̄ nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá kwú lɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ ɛkpa ɛhɔ̄ kú īkpīije ɔdɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he hath barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom's servants set the field on fire.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ábsālɔm le ɛlā ka lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū ka Ujówābu ɔ́ɔ hɛ́hɔ̄ gboce ákú anúɔ á. Ka ɔ́ɔ kē hí igwu nōo yɔ̄ ī jɛ̄ ipú nū. Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ̄ nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā tɔ̄lá. Anɔ́ɔ é nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ tɔ̄lá á.

eng_Latn: On the sixth day Eliasaph the son of Deuel, prince of the children of Gad, offered:
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛhīlī ā wɛ ákú Ɛlíyāsafu, ɔyí kú Udúwɛ̄lu, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi ā géē bī aɔ́dā kú ɛ̄gbā nēe bá ā:.

eng_Latn: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ipú unwalu nōo lɛ uwá ŋmó igbō ā, ī cā okónu ga um klla ī lɛ ahɛ mīyɛ um abɔ̄. Otábɔ̄ nɛ̄ n yá anyōkwū ā gē cɛ̄ lɛ ɔtū kóō he uwá.

eng_Latn: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;
idu_Latn: Unebúkádinēsa, ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn í kpó aɔ́dā nēe bá ā, eko nōo je Ujɛhóyācin, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda, ɔyí kú Ujɛhóyākim ā, mɛ́mla odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú Ujúda aɔ́fiyɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ga Ubábīlɔn ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Benjamin came again at that time; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabeshgilead: and yet so they sufficed them not.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā gā ā, ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu le ayípáncɛ́nyā nēé kpó ŋmá Ujábɛssi ā kpó lɛ uwá, amáŋ é jīla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he enquired of the LORD for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
idu_Latn: Ó da Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ kahíníī, Ahímɛ́lɛ̄ki da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā ɔdā nɛ̄ Udéfīdi géē yá ā, anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɔdōlé mla ɔkpacaŋ́gelī kú Ugolíyāti ɔ̄cɛ Ufilístiya ā, kpó lɛ Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Christ died?
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ nyā nɛ̄ ɔtū kú nū í lɔfú ŋ́ mā, nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā kwú ohígbū nū ā, kwú yíífi ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ a jé ā.

eng_Latn: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄nyɛ géē ŋmó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí glá ā? Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si, nōo kwú ohígbū alɔ, nēé je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū, nōo yɔ̄ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú Ɔwɔicō, yɔ̄ ī gbɔ̄ɔkɔ ohígbū alɔ ā, í kē gáā ŋmó alɔ ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, ma Ádā ā fú lɛ alɔ, ká ɔtū kóō he alɔ.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nōó lɛ lɛ aá dúú á ayínɛ́ um nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ayínɛ́ nɛ̄ um nɔ̄nyīlɔ. Ɛjī kwɛjī lɛ íne ā nɛɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī kɛla, aá gekwú dúú ohígbū ka aá wɛ ābɔ̄ kú ɔkpíyē kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā. Anɔ́ɔ abālɔbányā é le aá piyatɔ̄há mla ɔ̄cɛ nēé je héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ā, o yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká ālɔ̄ yá ɔdā olɔhi ohígbū Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ipú iháyí aflɛ́yí nɛ̄ Usáyírɔ̄si lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, ó lɛ ɔ́da je ka aá kóō gaá lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā tú gwó Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
idu_Latn: Ássan mɛ́mla Ubɛ́tissémess mɛ́mla ajɛ ácí ɛga o lúlé kú aɛ́bɛ́ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā nēé kpó aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ igwɛ́ɛpa, ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi mɛ́mla Usébūlɔn lɛ ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú Umerári.

eng_Latn: And the LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did unto Sarah as he had spoken.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā le afa cē klá Usára, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu ka anɔ́ɔ í yá ā.

eng_Latn: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
idu_Latn: Aá cɛ̄tra Óndú ā. Aá gwííjē ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ lɛ Óndú ā. Aá cɛ̄tra anú ipú ójīla kú ācɛ okpaakpa kú nū ā.

eng_Latn: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Aá kē lɛ ɔmáapú dúú nōo lé ka Ujɔ́ni ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄gba gbōmgbōm, lɛ abɔ̄ kpó gwū ahɔ̄, odúúdú uwā kwinya tɔ̄há lɛyíkwu ɔ́.

eng_Latn: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Ɔwɔicō géē tū alelékwū kú nū ɛhɔ̄ fu alɔ igbīhāajɛ. Ígbíli ā géē je pīya ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ olɔhi, ajɛ ɛhɔ̄ ā kē í yá ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kpúmm bɛ̄ɛka ipú ūpū ā.

eng_Latn: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:
idu_Latn: Ujémīsi mla ɔyínɛ́ nu Ujɔ́ni, ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi .

eng_Latn: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā gē bī ācomɛ́ɛbɛ alɛwa le pi Ujúda mɛ́mla Ísrɛ̄lu ahɔ̄ kahíníī, Aá kwúcē ŋmá ɔwɛ obɔ̄bí kú aá, ká aá lɛ odúúdú íne nɛ̄ n je lɛ aádáádā aá, ŋmá ɛgiyí ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú um ā tū.

eng_Latn: I have heard a rumour from the LORD, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather ye together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ka n miyɛ olɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Óndú ā ɛɛ́. Ó lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū fu aéwo ā kéē lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá túbá kéē wā í kpɛ́fú tū Ɛ́dɔm ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ā géē yɔ̄ ɛbɔ́, nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í gáā tū uwɔ ufi ŋ́. Ācɛ alɛwa klla í bá í ka olɔhi kú uwɔ, kéē lɛ odée lɛ ŋmá abɔ̄ uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And Lot went out, and spake unto his sons in law, which married his daughters, and said, Up, get you out of this place; for the LORD will destroy this city. But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ulɔ́tu le bɛ̄cɛ gaá le ka lɛ aóhilí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ, nēe gaá lɛ ayí nū nɔ̄nyā ā kahíníī, Aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá amānyā ohígbū ka, Óndú ā gaá je amānyā yíífi ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, aóhilí nū ā gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ ī hiijā.

eng_Latn: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed thee out of the house of servants; and I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
idu_Latn: Ami bī aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ Íjīpiti á. Ami nya aá tá ŋmá ajɛ kú ɔfiyɛ á. N tū Umósīsi mɛ́mla Árɔ̄ni mɛ́mla Umírīyam ɛhɔ̄ gé lɛ aá, kéē bī aá tá.

eng_Latn: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
idu_Latn: mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́, mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ nēe tú agblɔ̄cɛ́, nēe tá alácɛ̄ ā gwó lɛ īyī uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
idu_Latn: Ācokwébéenyi í gáā bá ī kwɔ̄ɔ́lá lɛyíkwu ɛmulá nēé géē je ɔ́ lá ā ŋ́. Ācotɔ́sú í gáā je ɔ́ kpó hɛ́ lá ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n̄ le yá lɛ ā nɛɛ, ó géē yɛ í wɛ ucē ɔ́bíipú nōo wɛ ínē ō kpó nēé í yá um italā kú nū. Ohígbū ka ɔ́ɔmā lé ka n tá Ɔwɔicō abɔ̄yī nū ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I speak that which I have seen with my Father: and ye do that which ye have seen with your father.
idu_Latn: N gē ka ɔdā nɛ̄ um má ɛgiyí Ádā um, aá kē ī yá ɔdā nɛ̄ aá pó ŋmá ɛgiyí ádā aá ā.

eng_Latn: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī lɛ eyī yɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɛbɛ nyā wɛ ā, n má opī éyi le bɛ̄cɛ yɔ̄ ī kwinya nɛ̄hi ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄. Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī kwinya lɔfú lɛ ā, ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó kú nū í kōō kwaajɛ ŋ́ mā. Ó bū ajī nɛ̄hi éyi nōo kwu ɛplá kú īkpēyī ɛplɛ́ɛpa kú nū.

eng_Latn: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
idu_Latn: Igbɔhá, ó lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔhá tū ga ɛhɔ̄ ā, nɛ̄ áluka kú uwā fíyɛ́ ákú aflɛ́yí ā. É yá uwā ɔdā ékpó ɔ́ɔmā dúú.

eng_Latn: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Drink ye, and be drunken, and spue, and fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō da um kahíníī, Lɛ da uwá ka ami nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā ka, aá gwá kóō lɛ aá kwú, kú aá gba klá iyē, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá gwōnū, nɛ̄ aá klá gáā cāŋjɛ glá ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka um yɔ̄ ī tū ācɛ ɛhɔ̄ wā í kpɛ́fú tá ā.

eng_Latn: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
idu_Latn: Utáhāti, Ássɛ, Ɛbíyāsafu Ukóra.

eng_Latn: And many resorted unto him, and said, John did no miracle: but all things that John spake of this man were true.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí nū, é gē klla kahíníī, Ujɔ́ni í yá ɔdā ocābɔ̄ dúúmā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔdā dóódu nōó ka ohígbū ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi.

eng_Latn: And he carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, and the king's mother, and the king's wives, and his officers, and the mighty of the land, those carried he into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ Ujɛhóyākin mla ayí nū, ɛ́nɛ́ nū, mla anyā nū kpó bɛ̄ɛka aálagbá ā ga Ubábīlɔn dúú.

eng_Latn: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ulífāyi ɔ́mpa uwā gē yá ɛdɔ úklɔ́ ɔhá kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā á. Amáŋ úklɔ́ kú uwā ā wɛ ɛya nēé gē gwó ā.

eng_Latn: And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized.
idu_Latn: Ukríspɔ̄si, otrɛ̄yí kú Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Óndú ā, anú mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū dóódu. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ alɛwa kú Ukɔ́rīnti, nēé pó ɛlā kú Upɔ́lu ā cɛ̄, é kē le ubatísim yā uwā.

eng_Latn: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.
idu_Latn: Ā kpɔ́tūce ɔdōbɔ̄bí ō yá mɛ́mla ɔ́bíipú ō bī ŋ́. Aá kpɔ́tūce agbénú ō lɛ ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ɔ̄cɛ o pīyatū ŋ́. Aá kē lɔtūce itene ō lɛ ŋmá uwī ō wī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn thee aside from following me: wherefore should I smite thee to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother?
idu_Latn: Ábna klla da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ā nū um inya ŋ́. Ā híī yá ká n̄ ŋmó uwɔ nóó. Ó le lɛ ā, n gáā leyīkwu Ujówābu, ɔyínɛ́ uwɔ eyī glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the LORD they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō yá ojuju kéē je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋmífī nōo gbo ɔ́ ō yá īkpɛ́yí olɔfu tá Óndú ā. Anɔ́ɔ ó le kwú ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm gaá tayínū igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ulákissi. Amáŋ aólɛlā kú nū ā tá ɔgwu nū jāā ga abɔ́ɔ, gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmó.

eng_Latn: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka n lɛ ɔyókwū dúúmā pīyatū, ohígbū ka n jé ka n lɛ ācɛ nēe ī hɛ́pɔ̄hi gā um ɛga okɛpɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest thou by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king's household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, le ɔ̄kā da ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ gáā yá mla odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ bī ā? Anɔ́ɔ Usíba tá ɔ ohi kahíníī, Aíjakī ā wɛ ákú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū kéē ce. Aígbō mɛ́mla aíkpɔ̄cí ā kē wɛ ákú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē lé. Ejé ā kē wɛ ákú uwá kéē gwá eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jē uwá ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: And it shall come to pass, if ye diligently hearken unto me, saith the LORD, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ ācɛ nēe bá nyā kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ odúúdú íne kú um. É gáā bī iyo dúúmā bēhé wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm ɛ̄cī Usábāti ŋ́. É géē lɛ ɛ̄cī Usábāti ā tū ɛ̄cī otīhɔ lɛ Óndú ā, é gáā yúklɔ́ dúúmā ipú ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then fell she down straightway at his feet, and yielded up the ghost: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu ɔ́ɔmā ɔnyā ā fīyɛ̄ ajɛ gekwú iyɔbū Upíta. Eko nɛ̄ ayípɛ̄ oklóbīya ā gā inu ā, é má kóō gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ hɛ́ cabɔ̄ ga ɛcɛ, klla nyɔ̄ í lɛ ɔ́ nyi áklō kú ɔbá nū.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.
idu_Latn: Ó ka Óndú ā, ɔ́ɔ ka ɛlɔ̄kwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ ka á.

eng_Latn: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda nēe lā ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda ā le ɛhi kú éyi ŋmá ipú igwó kú aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá, mɛ́mla aɔ́dā ɛ̄gbā nēé le tīihɔ lɛ Óndú ā kpó wā gaá kpó bá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ ā le kpó hídáagó ohígbū ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mafú ā. Eko nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ bá ī hídáagó kú odúúdú ɔdā nōó yá ā, ó da ayíkpó kú nū kahíniī.

eng_Latn: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
idu_Latn: Ó gē gbō ajɛ piyóó mla ɔfú kú nū. Eyī kú nū kwu odúúdú ɛcɛ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo ī yíkpɛ̄yí olɔfú kóō cāŋjɛ lɛyíkwu ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
idu_Latn: Aá yá Ubábīlɔn ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yá ācɛ ɔhá ā. Aá kóō yá ɔ̄ ce ɛpa kú ɔdā nóō yá ācɛ ɔhá ā. Lɛ ejé nōo lɔfú igbɛpa kú ɛ̄nɛ̄ ó je lɛ ācɛ ɔhá ā tū íkókwū kú nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū Udéfīdi fu, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú ŋmá álá nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ gē gbō ipácí ā.

eng_Latn: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Ujíyu da ɔ́ ɔ́kā kahíníī, A ka anúɔ lɔfú gwó ɔ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛtá nāa ka āa? Ó je alɔ iháyí ofɛpa cɛhīlī ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ alɔ gwó Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā á.

eng_Latn: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ó lɛ ā, ɛgba kú aálá mɛ́mla ákú aɛ́na nɛ̄ n kē yɔ̄ ī pó nyā kē ŋmá iní nɛ.

eng_Latn: Is this thing done by my lord the king, and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant, who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔcɛ́ ka ɔ́ɔ le ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā yá, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ nū, ɔ̄cɛ nōo géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí nū ŋ́ máā?.

eng_Latn: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka a le yá lɔhi nɛɛ, ń géē yɛ í mīyɛ uwɔ mɛ́mla ɛ̄gbā kú uwɔ ŋ́ nɛɛ? Amāŋ abɔ̄ a le yá bɔ̄bí ā íneōbīya yɔ̄ ī tɔ́ɔ́tɛ́ uwɔ kóō lɛ uwɔ kwú. Amáŋ leyī kwɛcɛ ká ā lɛ ɔ́ yálé.

eng_Latn: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Umanásɛ lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ igwó mla Ugílɛ̄di mɛ́mla Ubássan ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú isú kú Ujɔ́dan ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and ye shall sow the land.
idu_Latn: Ujósɛ̄fu da ācɛ ā kahíníī, N lɛ aá mɛ́mla ajɛ kú aá lá lɛ Uféro ɛɛ́. Īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ yɔ̄ á, aá mīyɛ kú aá nyɔ̄ í nyi ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the sword shall come upon Egypt, and great pain shall be in Ethiopia, when the slain shall fall in Egypt, and they shall take away her multitude, and her foundations shall be broken down.
idu_Latn: Ɛfú géē yɔ̄ ī kpó ajɛ kú Íjīpiti. Ákanya nɛ̄hi géē bī Itiyópiya, É géē ŋmó ācɛ alɛwa nɛ̄hi Íjīpiti. É í kpó agbénú kú ajɛ ɔlɛ́ nū wu, klla í je ɔ́ tá alácɛ̄.

eng_Latn: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō géē je ācobɔ̄bíipú ā kpó hɛ́ ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā, ó klla í je ācobīyíne ā kpó fu ŋmá ajɛ tɛgbatɛgba ā bɛ̄ɛka aɔ́cí ā.

eng_Latn: And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ lɛ ɔ̄cɛ yá kóō gbla alɔ, kóō leyīkwu ɔdā nēe bá ā. Kóō klla lɛ íkwu īkpɛ̄yí kú aɛ́béenyi kú ísu mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ nōo ī wu icō ā mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla aɛ́bɛ́ ipácí, Ɔkpá ō pīyabɔ nɛ̄ncɛ̄ éyi aɛ́bɛ́, ákú ɔlɛ́ mla ákú ácí, ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: Was the LORD displeased against the rivers? was thine anger against the rivers? was thy wrath against the sea, that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation?
idu_Latn: Óndú, ísu ā yá uwɔ cɔ̄nū á nɛɛ? Ísu nɛ̄hi yá ɛ́ɛ́ nāa cɔ̄nū nɛ̄hi á nɛɛ? A ce ojuja bɛ̄ɛka ɔnyā ā. Ojuja nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ ō tū nɛ̄hi ā, wɛ úgbɔ́nya kú uwɔ, eko nāa yá kú ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē lɛ aólɛlā kú uwā yálé ā.

eng_Latn: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi le tíícō ga ɛyí ɛfu ga ipú ojuja ā. Umósīsi yɔ̄ ɛyí ɛfu ā ɛ̄cī ofɛpa, mla otú ofɛpa.

eng_Latn: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according unto all that he hath commanded you:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ami nōo wɛ Ujeremíya ā da ācɛ ipɔ́ɔmā kú Urécābu ā ka Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ami, Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbā ā ka aá gē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ íne kú aádáádā á, Ujónādaabu, ɔyí kú Urécābu, ī yɛce odúúdú ukɔ́ nōó tū aá, klla ī yá ɔdā dóódu nōó da aá ā.

eng_Latn: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
idu_Latn: Aá cokónu dóódu mla ācɛ ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka eko nēé gē pā ɛcí kú uwā gē ŋmó odée lɛ ɔ́, é géē hī aá igwú kú aá lé mla uwá, unwū kú ɛbɛ́ lɔfú já aá má, cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lé ɔdōlé nēé yá lé ɛcí ā glá.

eng_Latn: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
idu_Latn: N géē wā í nū ācɛ Ɛ́dɔm ŋmá ɔlɛ́ uwā achígilí lɛbɛ̄ɛka ágábá nōo yɔ̄ ī bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipu ūpū nɛ̄hi kú Ujɔ́dan wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā. Cɛ́ɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo he um ɔtū, n le fu kóō gbō ɔ̄. Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ami ā glá? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē lɛ abɔ̄ gbo um ɔtū glá? Ɔcɛ́ nyá í bɛyíkwu um glá āa?.

eng_Latn: And they said unto Joshua, We are thy servants. And Joshua said unto them, Who are ye? and from whence come ye?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ, é da Ujóssuwa ka, aá wɛ aɔ́fiyɛ kú nū nɛ. Ujóssuwa kē tá uwā ohi ka, ānyɛ nēé wɛ ā? Iní nēé ŋmá wā āa?.

eng_Latn: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
idu_Latn: Aá gwííjē, ká aá cɛ̄tra anú. Ka ɔdā ohídáagó nɛ̄hi nōó yá ā tɛ́ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki wɛ iháyí ofɛpa ɛ́ɛ́ nōó lɛ Urebéka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ubɛ́tūwɛlu, ɔ̄cɛ Arámu nōo ŋmá Umɛsopotámīya ā. Ulában wɛ ɔyínɛ́ nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Urebéka á.

eng_Latn: Then the king said to the wise men, which knew the times, (for so was the king's manner toward all that knew law and judgment:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ucē kú aɔ́cɛ́ kéē da ācɛ o jɔ́ɔ́dā nɛ̄hi ā ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu íne mɛ́mla ɔ́da. Anɔ́ɔ ó le ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ahɔ̄ bá ɔ̄ ahɔ̄ kpó hīgwú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē da ɔ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ó cíkā ō yá ā.

eng_Latn: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
idu_Latn: Ɔdānyā yá ipú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛnɛ nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā. Eko ɔ́ɔmā ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya nōo lé ka Usenakérīibu ā lɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú nū kpó gā Ujúda. É gaá le ɛfú kpó tú ācɛ nēe lā aígelī nēé lɛ igá hɛ́ tū uwā ā. É klla lɛ uwá kpó kwú.

eng_Latn: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord : wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord .
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ofītɛ́ nɛ̄hi o ŋmá o tábɔ̄ kú Óndú ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā ā nēé gē ka kahíníī, Óndú ā kóō lɛ uwɔ yá ofītɛ́ bɛ̄ɛka Unímrɔ̄du, nōo Óndú ā ī tá ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said furthermore unto him, Put now thine hand into thy bosom. And he put his hand into his bosom: and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous as snow.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō klla le ɛlā ka lɛ Umósīsi igbɔhá kpɔ́ kahíníī, Kwú abɔ̄ kú uwɔ ú wu awulú kú uwɔ. Umósīsi kwú abɔ̄ kú nū ú wu awulú kú nū. Eko nɛ̄ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú wɛ̄ɛcɛ ā, ó le má ka abɔ̄ ā ɔ́ɔ le gbagwú kwúláá bɛ̄ɛka áfū ā.

eng_Latn: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá lɛyíkwu ɛlā nyā ā? Ɔ̄cɛ éyi lɛ ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa. Ó le yɛ tá ɛgiyí ákú aflɛ́yí ā da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɔyí um, nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ úklɔ́ yá ipú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú um ícɛ.

eng_Latn: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ má ojibó otīihilɛ kú aéwɔhá nēe bī ɔcí, ɛcɔ̄, oje nɛ̄hɛ̄, mɛ́mla ugóolu le yá uwā ā.

eng_Latn: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but God delivered him not into his hand.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi gaá tayínū ipú ígbíli nōo kwu ɔlɛ́ kú ɛyí ɛfu nōo kwu Usífu ajaajɛ ā. Usɔ́lu yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā nū ɛ̄cī dóódu, amáŋ Óndú ā í je ɛga lɛ ɔ́ kwú ɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ō je ɔ́ ŋmó ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é tá ɔcɛ́ ohi kahíníī, Uháman yɔ̄ amānyā, ó ī tíne kóō má ɔcɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá ka Aá da ɔ́ kóō le bēhé wā inu.

eng_Latn: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
idu_Latn: Upátrɔsi, Ukáluh mɛ́mla ācɛ Ukréti mɛ́mla Ukaftórim.

eng_Latn: Ain, Remmon, and Ether, and Ashan; four cities and their villages:
idu_Latn: Ipɔ́ɔma kú Usímīyɔ̄n klla mīyɛ aígelī nɛ̄hi ɔhá kpɔ́ mɛ́mla aígelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ nēe yɛ jīla uwá tá ā. Aígelī nɛ̄hi ā wɛ, Áyin, Urímɔn, Ɛ́ta, mɛ́mla Ássan.

eng_Latn: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ami ā, ó hile lígíí ká n̄ má gwōnū. Ɛtrɔ kwú um ikpó igbō.

eng_Latn: And now, behold, the LORD hath kept me alive, as he said, these forty and five years, even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses, while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness: and now, lo, I am this day fourscore and five years old.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, má ɔ̄, iháyí ɔ́mofɛpa cɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ Óndú ā da Umósīsi ɛlā ā yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á. Ɔdā nyā kē yá eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu yɔ̄ í bū ipú ígbíli ā, Óndú ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó cokónu lɛ ā, ó kē le oyēeyī kú um tū jāā kwu eko nyā. Má ɔ̄ n kwú pīya iháyí ofɛnɛ cɛ̄hɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ lɔfú yá kú ɛbɛ́ ipácí dóódu mɛ́mla aígbáanɔ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ o lipúpiyajɛ dóódu mɛ́mla ɛbéenyi dóódu kéē je pīya ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ glá. Ācɛ kē lɛ uwá pīya ɛbɛ́ ɔlɛ́ lɛ ā dúú ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I the LORD have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
idu_Latn: Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le uwɔ hīgwū klla kwú ɔfú ú gā uwɔ cɛ́ɛ́, ká ā yá ɔdā nōo le kpaakpa ipú ɛcɛ nyā. N géē je uwɔ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kú ā wɛ ocābɔ̄ kú ɛka nɛ̄ n gbo lɛ uwá ā. Awɔ ā gáā wɛ ɔlá ofíyajɛ nōo í bī aéwo kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā jé ɔwɛ wā ɛgiyí um á.

eng_Latn: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́ kahíníī, Nyɔ̄, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú uwɔ yēeyī ɛɛ́. Ogbāājɛ ā cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si da ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night: that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The LORD is his name:
idu_Latn: Óndú yá ínyílɔ́wɔ, mla ogbɔ̄lɛ́ gbēyī ɔyā á. Ó gē je otú pīya ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ, klla ī je ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ pīya otú glá. Ó le éŋkpɔ̄ hīgwú ŋmá itekwú ā, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú pīya klla ɛcɛ. Iyē kú nū wɛ Óndú.

eng_Latn: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
idu_Latn: É le tá ipú inu ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔyí ā mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́ nū, Umerí, má á. É le okwúukwu kpó kwajɛ, lɛ ɛ̄gbā gbā ɔ̄. É kē lɛ ɛga nēé kpó agbénú kú uwā tū ā nwūla, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛhi kú ugóolu, mɛ́mla ufránkīnsɛns mɛ́mla umáar kpó lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ n lɛ ɔtā kú uwɔ nú ŋmá uwɔ abɔ̄lúfīyē, klla cɛ̄ lɛ aɔ́yī hɛ́ uwɔ abɔ̄lɔ́ná wā ajɛ.

eng_Latn: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh; and the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint, as he wrestled with him.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ā le má ka anúɔ í yá Ujékɔ̄pu lé glá ŋ́ mā ā, ó le abɔ̄ kwu ikpokwú ákwúta kú Ujékɔ̄pu, anɔ́ɔ ɔ́kwu ā kwú hīlií á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master saith unto thee, Where is the guestchamber, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples?
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá da óndú ɔlɛ́ ā kahíníī, Utíca ā ka, Iní nɛ̄ inu aúgbɔga nɛ̄ ami mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú um géē lé ucɛ kú onyatá ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
idu_Latn: É gē wā ɔfɔ́ɔ́fú kéē yúfú, ɔ̄cɛ dóódu gē yúufi ō wā kú uwā. Ɛwa kú ācɛ nēé kwú ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka úmúlá kú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
idu_Latn: Ufílīpu mɛ́mla Ubatɔlómi, Utɔ́mɔ̄si mɛ́mla Umátiyu, ɔ̄codɔ̄lɛ̄ ā, Ujémīsi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Álfīyɔsi, mɛ́mla Utádīyɔsi.

eng_Latn: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king's dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom's place.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ábsālɔm yēeyī ā, ó le ígbɛ́cɔ̄ éyi nēé géē bī lɛ bla kwu ɔ́ gbā kwaajɛ ipú ɔpɛ́ kú ɔcɛ́, nōo kwu Ujerúsālɛm ajaajɛ. Ó yá lɛ ā ohígbū koó lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ dúúmā nōo géē cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ blakwiyē kú nū ŋ́. Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú iyē nū í ce ɔ́ á. Jāā kwu eko nēé yɔ̄ ī tá ɔkpá nyā, é gē hī ɛcɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā ka, ɔdā ō bī le blakwu Ábsālɔm.

eng_Latn: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of the LORD, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
idu_Latn: Nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā, Uhilikáya cɛ́ɛ́ káā gaá mīyɛ áluka kú ije nɛ̄ ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya nōo ī yúklɔ́ okómpíinu kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā gē mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ ā wā.

eng_Latn: Then the prophets, Haggai the prophet, and Zechariah the son of Iddo, prophesied unto the Jews that were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, even unto them.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔmā, ācomɛ́ɛbɛ, Uhágāyi mɛ́mla Usekaríya, ɔyí kú Íddo gbɔɔ́ ō mɛ́ɛbɛ klla gbɔɔ́ ō bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō le kɛlā lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka éwɔhá dúúmā í lɛyítáajɛ gā um ŋ́, n géē fu ɔ́ ɔkwu ŋmá ajɛ dúúdú, klla í je ɔ́ yíífi. Ami Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ óndú aá ā kɛlā nyā á.

eng_Latn: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cohumɔtū klla lɛbɛ̄ɛka odódó kú ipácí nōo gē nwūla ipú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú Éngēdi ā.

eng_Latn: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ísɔ kahíníī, Ālɔ̄ tíkpó nyɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: Thus were their faces: and their wings were stretched upward; two wings of every one were joined one to another, and two covered their bodies.
idu_Latn: Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ kú uwā lɛ acá ɛpa kú nū je gicō, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛyí acá ɛpa kú nū ā gaá kwu ɛyí acá ɛpa kú ɔ́mpā nū. Ó klla lɛ acá ɛpa ɔhá kú nū ā ce klá īyī nū iyē.

eng_Latn: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ Upɔ́lu lɛ ɛlā nēe bá ā ka ā, ācɛ Ujíyu ā nyɛ̄ɛ̄ gē táafú nɛ̄hi mla iyī uwā.

eng_Latn: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
idu_Latn: Á gáā lɛ ɔdájī gwū ɔ̄ ɔkpíyē kóō yɛ ɔ́ glá ŋ́. Óbo nēé ī le ŋmó ɛbéenyi ā í yɛ ɔ́ ɛyí glá?.

eng_Latn: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā íne ā tīihɔ, ɔ́da ā kē tīihɔ, ó le kpaakpa ó kē lɔhi.

eng_Latn: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó gekwú eko nōó le pīya iháyí úla ɛpa ce ofɛnɛ ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD's, and he will give you into our hands.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ójila nēe bá nyā kéē le jé ka, ó wɛ ɔkpacaŋgelī, óbō mɛ́mla ɔ́kpa nɛ̄ Óndú ā gē bī le hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ tá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɛfú ō kpó wɛ ákú Óndú ā nɛ, ó kē í je uwɔ tá ipú abɔ̄ kú alɔ ícɛ.

eng_Latn: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father's servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
idu_Latn: Uhádādi mɛ́mla ayí kú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ádā nū nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ Ɛ́dɔm ā ōfōōfūwā nēé kpó ŋmó ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
idu_Latn: Uhɛ́sro nōo ŋmá Ukámɛ̄lu ā. Upaárāyi nōo ŋmá Árba ā.

eng_Latn: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
idu_Latn: Aá yá ɔtūnōbí, ká aá jikwū ikɔkɔ nɛ̄ aá ī yɛhɛ. Aá jikwū, áa gwéeyē ŋ́, ámāŋ aá cɔ̄nū.

eng_Latn: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe kwú ipú ōcē obɔ̄bí nyā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe kwú eko kú Ukɔ́ra ā í wɛ áluka kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā, wɛ ulá ofu ce igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ ce úlā éyi ce ofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ .

eng_Latn: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
idu_Latn: Oklóbīya um éyi nōo ŋmá iyāwu ā le yɛ ce ɔlɛ́ um, ń kē lɛ ɔdōlé dúú nɛ̄ n ge je lɛ ɔ́ lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n gbā ā, ká ā lɛ um nyatá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a cokónu lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
idu_Latn: Alɔ kē i má, ī cījáalí ka Ádā ā lɛ Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū tū wā ɛɛ́, kóō gaá wɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá kú ɛcɛ.

eng_Latn: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi lɛ ikpokwú kú Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla Ujonátan mɛ́mla ákú ayááyí nɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɔ́ɔlu ahāapa ā kpó.

eng_Latn: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him, and gave it to David, and his garments, even to his sword, and to his bow, and to his girdle.
idu_Latn: Ujonátan klla le úwé kú nū plla ŋmá iyē, anɔ́ɔ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú kpó lɛ Udéfīdi. Ó klla le aíyɔ́fú kú nū, kwu ɔkpacaŋgelī mɛ́mla ɔtā mɛ́mla ɔdā ó kwɛ́nyɔ́ kú nū, kpó lɛ ɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: Then said he unto me, The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of perverseness: for they say, The LORD hath forsaken the earth, and the LORD seeth not.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō tá um ohi kahíníī, Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu mla ācɛ Ujúda lɛ ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi yá lɛ ɛpɔbí lé. É ba ī ŋmó ācɛ ɛga dóódu, klla bá ī yá ucē obɔbí Ujerúsālɛm ɛbɛɛbɛ. É ka, ami, Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ kwú ɛlá gwū hɛ́ ajɛ ɔlɛ́ aá, í klla má aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Babylon smote them, and slew them at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away out of their land.
idu_Latn: ipú ajɛ kú Uhámāti. Anɔ́ɔ é le ācɛ kú Ujúda ā kpó ga ipú ajɛ kú éwo ɔhá abɔ̄fú ŋmá ajɛ kú uwā.

eng_Latn: For he cometh in with vanity, and departeth in darkness, and his name shall be covered with darkness.
idu_Latn: Olɔhi lɛ ɔyí ɔ́ɔmā abɔ̄ é ma ɔ́ ŋ́ mā. Ohígbū koó gebí tāajɛ ga ipú obū, cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú mlanyī nū bōōbū.

eng_Latn: And he made the holy anointing oil, and the pure incense of sweet spices, according to the work of the apothecary.
idu_Latn: Ó le anɔ̄ otīihɔ mɛ́mla ɔtulalī umuumu ōkpóocu nɛ̄hi yá. É le ɔ́ wīya tɔ̄há bɛ̄ɛka ɔtulalī ā.

eng_Latn: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll: and he took it out of Elishama the scribe's chamber. And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔcɛ́ lɛ Ujɛ́hūdi tɛ̄hɔ̄ ka ɔ́ɔ gaá kwú ɔkpá ā ú wā á. Ó gaá kwú ɔkpá ú ŋmá ipú inu kú Ɛlíssāma klla lɛ odúúdú nū jé lɛ ɔcɛ́ mɛ́mla odúúdú aótrɛ̄yí nēe háyi jīla ɔcɛ́ ā tá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?
idu_Latn: N géē yɔ̄ gē má ɛfú nōo yɔ̄ ī kpó alɔ ā, klla í yɔ̄ ī pó opo kú ɛfú nyā piyóó ōō.

eng_Latn: Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:
idu_Latn: Aá mīyɛ ijáalí nɛ̄ ācɛ cɛ̄ lɛyíkwu, Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā dúúdú.

eng_Latn: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú ɔyā aflɛ́yí kú iháyí ɔ́migwɛ́ɛpa nɛ̄ alɔ bá ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā, Óndú ā lɛ ɛlā ka gā um.

eng_Latn: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó klla le ɔkɔ gbā igbɔhá lɛ Ɔwɔicō, anɔ́ɔ ɔwɔ kē le yā ŋmá ɔkpáncō, anɔ́ɔ ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ kē lɛ kpó bū ŋmá ipú ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Against Moab thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu Umówābu. Uyáwɛ, nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu gē gbɛ̄ɛ̄gbā ā kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Unebo le jī ɛɛ́, ohígbū ka é kwú ɔlɛ́ uwá ú yíífi. É mīyɛ Ukiriyatéyim tābɔ̄ ɛɛ́, é kē kwú ɔdɔ nɛ̄hi kú ɔlɛ́ ā ú wúlatāajɛ, klá lɛ uwēyī kpó tū ācɛ kú ɔlɛ́ a ɛyi ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put thou on thy robes. So the king of Israel disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
idu_Latn: Áhābu da Ujɛhósāfati kahíníī, Abɔ̄ alɔ gē nyɔ̄ ɔgbɛ́fú ā, n géē je īyī um pīyabɔ̄. N géē bī úwé ɔhá, amáŋ awɔ ā géē bī awulú kú ɔcɛ́ kú uwɔ. Anɔ́ɔ Áhābu le īyī nū pīyabɔ̄ le tá ɔgbɛ́fú á.

eng_Latn: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God:
idu_Latn: Ása yá ɔdā nōo he Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú nū ɔtū. Ó klla yá ɔdā nōo le kpáakpá.

eng_Latn: The great day of the LORD is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of the LORD: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi nɛ̄ Óndú ā í kɛpɔ̄ tū ācɛ ā le bá ɛɛ́. Ó le kwu ajaajɛ klla yɔ̄ í wā fíyaa. Ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā géē wɛ ɛ̄cī olɔ̄nɔ ohígbū ka ícɔ́ɔ́ja nōo lɔtū fíyɛ́ dúú ā géē jikwū gbōmgbōm ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā!.

eng_Latn: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men's words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi da Usɔ́lu, ɔcɛ́ ɔ̄kā ka ɔdíyá nɔ́ɔ gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā kú ācɛ nēe ka anúɔ Udéfīdi ɔ́ɔ tíne ō ŋmó ɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: And he made fifty taches of gold, and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches: so it became one tabernacle.
idu_Latn: É lɛ uwɔ kú ugóolu ofɛpa ce igwó yá, nēé géē bī le kwú āyā kú īlī éyi bɔ́há.

eng_Latn: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people, that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem. I Darius have made a decree; let it be done with speed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō nōo fu Ujerúsālɛm klla kwú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú nū kwu abɔ́ɔ, ka abɔ́ɔ nēé géē gbā anúɔ ɛ̄gbā ā kóō lɛ ɔcɛ́ dóódu nōo tá kóō lɛyí táajɛ lɛ ɔ́da kú um nyā bī wāajɛ ŋmá akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū. Ɔcɛ́ dúúmā nōo klla tíne ō je Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā yíífi kpɔ́, Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ ɔcɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ dúú. Ami Udáyírɔ̄si ā je ɔ́da nyā á. Aá kē í lɛyí táajɛ lɛ odúúdú ɔ́da kú um ā.

eng_Latn: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā, ka n cīla ɔ̄kā lɛyíkwu ācɛ nēe gē lé ɔdōlé nēé le gwɛ́ɛya lɛ ɛcí gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ mā. Odúúdú alɔ jé ka ɛcí kwɛyí ɔdā nōó yēeyī ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ŋ́. Alɔ jé ka Ɔwɔicō ékpónú yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya gē bī oyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ ā ga ipú ɛga otīihɔ fíyɛ́ dúú kóō je ɔ́ gwɛ́ɛya kú íneoōbīya, amáŋ ɔkpíyē kú ɛbɛ́ abɔ̄yī nū ā, é gē tū uwā ɔlá eyɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ kú igelī ā.

eng_Latn: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ gē tókónu lɛ ācɛ nēe gē kpó ɔdōlé tayínū gbéeko nɛ̄ ɔ́lá nū le tíicō, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē kpó wɛ̄ɛcɛ í je lá ígbólá nɛ̄hi ā. Amáŋ, ācɛ kē ī cɛ̄tla ācɛ nēe gē kpó ákú uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ kē je lá ɔlá ɔlamu ā.

eng_Latn: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
idu_Latn: É lɛ um tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ oyēeyī ga ipú ɔ̄gɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɛcɔ̄ í míya gwū okónu ɔ̄gɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ācɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi ā le kɔ̄ ɛpa, ācɛ ōhī yɛce ācɛ Ujíyu, ācɛ ōhī kē yɛce ācotɛ̄hɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
idu_Latn: Yá ká ālɔ̄ le jɛ̄ gɔbū igbɔhá kpɔ́, Ɔwɔicō, ohɔ́nyɛtá kú alɔ. Ká ɛlā kú alɔ kóō híī wú uwɔ ɔtū gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was so, that all that saw it said, There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day: consider of it, take advice, and speak your minds.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo le ɔ́ má gē ka ka aá í má ɔdā ɛ́gɛ́nyā jéjéee ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ɔdā ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā í yá ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā jéjéee ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ŋmíífī nɛ̄ aá bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá Íjīpiti ā. Anɔ́ɔ é ka aá géē yá odée lɛyíkwu ɛlā ā. É ka ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔdā ā gáā wɛ āa?.

eng_Latn: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
idu_Latn: Ó ka anúɔ da uwá kéē má ɔ̄, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā kwú ajɛ ā ú lɛ uwá ɛɛ́. Kéē nyɔ̄ ipú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē gáā lā anú, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú ádáádā uwā ɔ́ɔ ka lɛ uwá ā. Ó da uwá kéē híī yúúfi ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwā gē gbenyi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: Ń gbɛlá ka n lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n cíkā ō yá ā yá kwɛyí ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́, ámāŋ ka n le pīya ɛdɔ ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ n cíkā o wɛ ā ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Amáŋ n bī ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔfú kú um yɔ̄ ī ceyītīkwū ká abɔ̄ kú um kóō lɛ ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si lɛ um pīya ákú nū ā kwú.

eng_Latn: And when they began to sing and to praise, the LORD set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Judah; and they were smitten.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é gbɔɔ́ ō gwíijē ā, Óndú ā kwú aícɔ́ɔja kú aólɛlā kú uwā ɔtū ú kpó gbájí.

eng_Latn: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before, that ye might have a second benefit;
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n lɛ ɛ̄nyā jé kpɔcíí ā, n le miya ka n wā í lɛ aá má gbɔbū, cɛ́ɛ́ ká aá lɔfú mīyɛ ɔhā ɔ́klɛ́ɛpa.

eng_Latn: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ádā je kóō wɛ ɛ̄gbā-ōgbā olɔhi dúúdú nōó lɛ ɛnyá ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ á, ká aá tá anyōkwū mɛ́mla ayōkwū abɔ̄ ipú ōwē nɛ̄ é bá yɔ̄ ī má ā. Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē lɛ iyínu tū ŋmá ɔdōbɔ̄bí kú ipú ɛcɛ nyā ā.

eng_Latn: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ka a géē kwúcē ga ɔlɛ́ um, ɛgiyí ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, gaá lɛ ɔnyā lɛ Áyísīki, ɔyí um.

eng_Latn: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king's commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó le ka kwɛyí ā, odúúdú ācɛ ā lɛ okónu kú uwá klá hímm, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya, ɔcɛ́ kú uwá ā da uwá ka ɛɛ́ yá ā. Ācɛ ā í kē tá ohi dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I speak not this to condemn you: for I have said before, that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you.
idu_Latn: Ń ka ɛnyā, ká n̄ bī ɔ̄ le ŋmó aá ɛpɔ̄bí ŋ́. Ohígbū ka n ka aflɛ́yí ka, aá he alɔ ɔtū nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ka ɔdá dúú í fō alɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí aá glá ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ gekwú amáŋ ka alɔ yēeyī.

eng_Latn: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kwú úwé kú Ɛláyíja, nōo je pɛ́ wā ajɛ ā ú kpó, anɔ́ɔ ó kwúcē igbīhi gaá háyi okónu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan ā.

eng_Latn: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
idu_Latn: Ó géē cɔ̄nū tū aólɛlā kú nū, klla í yá uwā italā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔdā nēé yá ā lɛ ā, ó kōō kwu aɛ́nɛ̄ e lā ogbeé kú ísu ɛga oligbó ā dúú.

eng_Latn: And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.)
idu_Latn: Eko nōó má ka ɛ̄nyā le he ācɛ Ujíyu ɔtū ā, ó i yɛ gaá le Upíta kwú. Ɛ̄nyā yá ɛpléeko uculo kú igbō nōó ī nū ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi jikwū ayidɔ nyā ohígbū Usɔ́ɔlu mɛ́mla Ujonátan.

eng_Latn: And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é má ɔwɛ ō le ŋmó ɔ̄ ŋ́, ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ ā gē jāhɔ̄ gē pó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛlā nōo ī ka ā tá ɔkɛklɛ kú nū.

eng_Latn: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ nyā nōó gáā bī lɛ hɛ́ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēe wɛ ɔfiyɛ ipú oyēeyī kú uwā dúúdú ohígbū ufi ikwū ō yá ā tá glá á.

eng_Latn: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɔfú nɛ̄hi, ó cíkā kéē cɛ̄tra uwɔ nɛ̄hi. Ó cíkā kéē yúufi nū fíyɛ́ aɔ́wɔ ɔhá dóódu.

eng_Latn: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
idu_Latn: Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ó má ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Énesi nōo húmáyī gwutá ɛyí agōdō iháyí ahātá. Ɔŋmɛ́ɛŋmɛ́ɛ le iyē yá ŋmɛnɛŋmɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
idu_Latn: É le yɛ um jīla tá abālɔbányā, ɛga dúúmā nɛ̄ n pīya nyɔ̄ ā. É bá ī gbēyī kéē lɛ ɛga má kéē lɛ um pi wāajɛ.

eng_Latn: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Alelékwū ā gē yá kú ālɔ̄ yēeyī ā, Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō kóō bī alɔ tá dúú.

eng_Latn: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí um, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n̄ géē lɛ íne kú Ɔwɔicō kú um tū.

eng_Latn: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.
idu_Latn: Ajɛ abɔ́ɔ ā ó gaá le Ɔ̄cɛ Ujíyu éyi nēé hī ka Akwíla, ɔ̄cɛ ajɛ kú Upɔ́ntɔ̄si ā jé iyē, Ɔ̄cɛ ā mɛ́mla ɔnyā nū Uprisílaí ŋmá Ítāli gbojī ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́. Ohígbū ɔ́da nɛ̄ Uklɔdíyɔ̄si Usísa je ka odúúdú ācɛ Ujíyu kéē le pɛ́ nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ajɛ Uróm ā. Upɔ́lu le yɛ kóō lɛ uwá má.

eng_Latn: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɔwɔ í yā kú ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ dúúmā kóō jɛ̄ ŋ́ mā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Pray without ceasing.
idu_Latn: Aá kɛlā lɛ Ɔwɔicō ipú ɔkɔ ō gbā eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan's sister was Timna.
idu_Latn: Ulótan wɛ ádā kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Uhɔ́ri mɛ́mla Uhɛ́man á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, Óndú ā tá Umósīsi ohi kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka ádā nū le ahɛ tá klá anú eyī, ó géē bī uwēyī kú nū gaá kwu ɛ̄cī ahāapa. Kéē lɛ ɔwɛ gwū tū ɔ̄ eyīyɛ̄cɛ kú ɛga nēé lā ā ɛ̄cī ahāapa, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē géē bī ɔ̄ wā ɔlɛ́.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt smite the house of Ahab thy master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of the LORD, at the hand of Jezebel.
idu_Latn: Ó da Ujéhu kahíníī, A géē je ipɔ́ɔnū kú Áhābu, ɔkpáni uwɔ yíífi ŋmá ajɛ, cɛ́ɛ́ ká n géē lɛ ɔ́ci kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú um mɛ́mla ákú odúúdú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú um nɛ̄ Ujɛ́sēbɛlu kpó ŋmó ā gwō ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But the rest fled to Aphek, into the city; and there a wall fell upon twenty and seven thousand of the men that were left. And Benhadad fled, and came into the city, into an inner chamber.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ohile kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Usiríya nēe yēeyī ā kwú pɛ́ kwu ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Áfēki, amáŋ ɔdɔ nēé le hɛ́ igá tū igelī nɛ̄hi ā kwú wúla klá uwá le ācɛ úla ofɛtá cahāapa cofu igwɛ́ɛhɔ̄ kú uwá kpó ŋmó. Ubenhádādi le kwu ga igelī nɛ̄hi kú Áfēki, gaá taánū igbīhi inu kú ɔlɛ́ éyi.

eng_Latn: Thus saith the LORD; I am returned unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts the holy mountain.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla kahíníī, N géē cīgbīhi ga ɛgiyí ācɛ Ujerúsālɛm gáā lā ipú ācɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē hī ɔlɛ́ uwā ka ɔlɛ́ otīihɔ mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kú ācɛ ō cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛfu otīihɔ kú Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā.

eng_Latn: And they went up into the city: and when they were come into the city, behold, Samuel came out against them, for to go up to the high place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é le tá ipú igelī nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā. Abɔ́ɔ é bá ī bēhé ga ipú nū ā, é le Usámūwɛ̄lu má yɔ̄ í wɛ̄ɛcɛ lɛyíkwu uwá, ɔwɛ nōo yɔ̄ í yɛ ga ɛyí ɛfu ɛga nēé gē gbā Óndú ā ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ kwú hɛ́ um iyē bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ nēé pīya klá ajɛ ā. Ikpokwú kú um dúúmā í kwu ɔhá gɛ ŋ́. Ɔtū kú um le gbogodo klla kwú gbeny ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɛlā nēé ka kahíníī, É lɛ ɛpɔ̄hi hɛ́ lɛ ɔ́ ā, é tá ɔ̄ ohígbū anú ōfūnū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ́da je lɛ ɔ́ kahíníī, A híīī da ɔ̄cɛ dúú ɔdā dúúmā lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ŋ́, amáŋ nyɔ̄ ɛgiyí ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā gaá lɛ iyī uwɔ mafú lɛ ɔ́ kóō lɛ uwɔ jila. Cɛ́ɛ́ a nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɛya nɛ̄ íne kú Umósīsi ka ā gwó kóō wɛ ijáalí lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ ka a le hɛ́tá ɛɛ́ mā gwó.

eng_Latn: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ igbeékpó ede ā kwú yíla ɛpa, anɔ́ɔ ewo nōo bá ɛyí nū ā kwú pīya kláajɛ, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ka ā á.

eng_Latn: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu gbo iyāwu kú nū ŋmá abɔ́ɔ ā, aálelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō jīla ɔ́ ɔwɛ.

eng_Latn: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
idu_Latn: A bī ɔfú nɛ̄hi kú uwɔ ā lɛ ísu kɔ́ ɛpa lɛ alɔ, a klla le aíkpɛ̄yí kú aɛ́bɛ́ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú ipú ísu ā kpó ca.

eng_Latn: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
idu_Latn: Eko dúúmā nēé lɛ ɔ́ yá cɔ̄nū, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í lɔtū hayi iyɔ̄bū nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
idu_Latn: É le tá ipú inu kú ɔlɛ Umíka, ɛga nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ Ulífāyi ā lā ā. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
idu_Latn: Ó kahíníī, Ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ, n géē hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, n géē yá kú ayááyí kú uwɔ kéē le nyīla.

eng_Latn: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
idu_Latn: Aá nyɔ̄ gaá ī ka lɛ odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka, ɛ̄cī igwó kú ɔyā nyā ā, ɔ̄cɛ éyééye géē bī ɔyí álá éyi ámāŋ ka ɔyí ɛwū éyi kwɛyí ipɔ́ɔnū kú ɔlɛ́ nū.

eng_Latn: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú kē mā ɔ́bíipú kú nū ō bī tá, klla gbo ɔdā okpaakpa mɛ́mla ɔdōlɔhi ō yá, ó géē nyā oyēeyī kú īyī nū tá ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ojumɛlá opiyóó kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mla um, ohígbū ka ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā yá ɔkpáncō mɛ́mla ɛcɛ ipú ɛ̄cī ɛhīlī, anɔ́ɔ ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa ā n mā uklɔ́ ō yá tá, anɔ́ɔ n le mulɛ́nyɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Reuben; Hanoch, and Phallu, and Hezron, and Carmi.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Urúbɛn wɛ: Uhánɔ̄ku, Upállu, Uhɛ́srɔn mɛ́mla Ukámi.

eng_Latn: MAKE HASTE, O GOD, TO DELIVER ME; MAKE HASTE TO HELP ME, O LORD.
idu_Latn: Lɛ um nyatá Ɔwɔicō. Óndú tá um abɔ̄ abālɔbányā.

eng_Latn: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ dúúmā nēé gē lɛ íne tū ŋ́, wɛ ācɛ nēe gē lɛ ɔkwu yá ékpó mla ācobɔ̄bíipú. Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka a gē lɛ íne tū, ayíka á cɛ̄ tɔ̄há mla uwá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔdā ékpónú ōfōōfūnū cɛgbá á. Ɛ̄nɛ̄ o le kpaakpa ā nɛ̄ Umerí je á, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í kē gáā mīyɛ ɔ́ ŋmá abɔ̄ kú nū glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The LORD hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that ye should be officers in the house of the LORD, for every man that is mad, and maketh himself a prophet, that thou shouldest put him in prison, and in the stocks.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō lɛ uwɔ fu ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya kwɛyí Ujɛhóyāda, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā leyīkwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā. Á cíkā ō kwú ojɛɛ́lɛ́ dúúmā, nōo ka anúɔ wɛ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā ú ce odó klla lɛ agbá kwu ɔɔ́ ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ a kwú cɔ̄nū mla ɔcɛ́ nāa fu ā ɛɛ́, a le igbīhi pīya kwu ɔ́ klla tá ɔ̄ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite: let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n pó abɔ Óndú da ācɛ o hile ā kahíníī, Aa yɛ ce ɔ́ nyɔ̄ ga ipú igelī ā gáā ŋmó ācɛ ā. Aá mā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā tá, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá gé ményinyi kú ɔ̄cɛ̄ dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄nyā le yá lɛ ā, nɛ̄ ɔdā nōo ge kwú le pīyabɔ̄ ga ɔdā nōó gē kwú ŋ́, cɛ́ɛ́ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō le yá jīla. Ó kahíníī, É lɛ ikwū yíífi, le ɔ́ yálé kwɛyí ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
