idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla da Árɔ̄ni Kahíníī, Á gáā mīyɛ agbénú dóódu nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē je lúgwū ŋ́. Á kē gáā lɛ āyā kú ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā ŋ́. Ami Óndú ā, géē yá ɔdā dóódu nēe ce uwɔ ɛgbá ā á.

eng_Latn: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
idu_Latn: Ohóō kóō yɔ̄ lɛ aá nōo gē gwó igelī nɛ̄hi kú aá mla oyī kú ācɛ nɛ̄ aá ŋmó ā, mɛ́mla ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄ aá yá ā.

eng_Latn: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
idu_Latn: Ā híī pīya ɛlā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō ka ā abɔ̄ ŋ́. Ohígbū nɛ̄ ó géē pi uwɔ ahɔ̄, cɛ́ɛ́ kóō mafú gā awɔ ka a wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄.

eng_Latn: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
idu_Latn: N yɔ̄ í tíifu gbōmgbōm, n kwú nyinyi ŋmá ajɛ gaá hile ikpokwú yēgēē ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nōó ī fu ā, ó fu uwá ŋmá eyīnyinyi uwā nōó má ā nɛ̄ n, ó ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ nēé yá ā ŋ́. Ohígbū ka ɔ́dāŋ́ ka Ɔwɔicō ī fu ācɛ ŋmá lɛ úklɔ́ nēé yá nɛɛ, ó lɛ ā ó ményinyi ācɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
idu_Latn: Náaná nɛ ɛwa kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpō ɔcá ícɛ a, ācɛ nēe gēe hile a, í kwúcē wā ɔlɛ́ a, í gāa lɛ ɛwa ŋ́. É lɛwa bɛ̄ɛka ɔjɛ kú ísu a, náaná ícɛ a, ífi mla ikwū ba ī gbēyī uwā, uwá kē cíkā la ōwē ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
idu_Latn: Ugadíyɛ, ɔyí kú Usɔ́di ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Usɛ́būlɔn.

eng_Latn: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
idu_Latn: Ɛwa kú odúúdu ācɛnyīlɔ kú uwā nēe wɛ ɔyā éyi gɔbū ā wɛ úlā ofu ce éyi ce ofigwó .

eng_Latn: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ a ŋmá? Anɔ́ɔ ó tá ɔ̄ ohi kahíníī, N kwu ŋmá ɛga nɛ̄ aícɔ́ɔja kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwu aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú ā.

eng_Latn: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
idu_Latn: Aá leyī yɛ aɔ́tágláma ɛ́ɛ́. É gē nyī īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́, é kē ī ce ikpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ ŋ́. É kōō lɛ aɔ́bā nēe gē kpó īkpɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú uwā tū ŋ́. Amáŋ Ɔwɔicō kē í je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá. Aá cɛgbá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi fíyɛ́ aígbáanɔ á.

eng_Latn: And did not he make one? Yet had he the residue of the spirit. And wherefore one? That he might seek a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka Ɔwɔicō ɔ́ɔ yá uwɔ mɛ́mla ɔnyā uwɔ ɔkpíyē ékpónú mla alelékwū ékpónú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Ɔdí nɛ̄ ó bī ɔtū lɛyíkwu ɛ̄nyā āa? Ó ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ohígbū kéē ma ɛdɔ ayí nēe í wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā. Ó ka ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é híī cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ dúúmā nyíla okónu nɛ̄ ó ce lɛ ɔnyā nū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
idu_Latn: Óndú, Ɔwɔicō, cāŋjɛ ká ā lɛ italā yá uwā. Óndú, ā híīī mlanyī ācɛ nēé bá ī yá ōwē nyá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
idu_Latn: N géē tá uwɔ ahínyá Óndú, ipéyī aéwo ā. N géē cɛ̄tra uwɔ ipéyī odúúdú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
idu_Latn: Eyī yá um ká n̄ lɛ ɛga nɛ̄ n gēe má Ɔwɔicō ā jé. Cɛ́ɛ́ ń yɛ í le tá ɛga nōo ī kɛpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
idu_Latn: Ó kwu abɔ́ɔ ā ú pīya ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ ɛmiyɛ gē ŋmó uwā gē lā, é klla le igelī nɛ̄hi gwó abɔ́ɔ nēé lā anú.

eng_Latn: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nēé kōō ma um ā mɛ́ɛ̄? Ohígbū kú n wā í lɛ unwalu mɛ́mla ɔtūnōbí nyā mɛ́mla oōkwú ipú uwēyī nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And there appeared a great wonder in heaven; a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars:
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔdā ō hídáagó nɛ̄hi éyi le hɛ́wɛ̄ɛ̄cɛ ɔkpáncō á. Ɔnyā éyi yɔ̄, nōo lɛ ɛnɔ wiyē bɛ̄ɛka úwé ā, kē lɛ aíkpó gwó ce ɛyí ɔyā. Ó kē lɛ ukata nɛ̄ aínyílɔ́wɔ igwɛ́ɛpa kwu ɔ́ kwɛyí.

eng_Latn: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things saith he that is holy, he that is true, he that hath the key of David, he that openeth, and no man shutteth; and shutteth, and no man openeth;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da um kahíníī, Le tá fu ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Icɔ́ɔ́ci kú Ufiladɛ́lfiya ka ami kwú īyī um ú lɛ Ɔwɔicō dúúdú, kē ī cɛ̄ ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ kpaakpa ā. Ami klla bī ɔyíigodó kú Udéfīdi á. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔwɛ nwūla ɔ̄cɛ dúú í gwū ɔ̄ glá ŋ́. Ɔ́dāŋ́ nɛ̄ n kē le ɔwɛ gwū, ɔ̄cɛ dúú í nwūla anú glá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
idu_Latn: O ka anúɔ kɛlā lɛ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, klla je ɔdā alɛwa nɛ́ɛ má ā lɛ uwá á. Ó ka anúɔ bī okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ ā, le pi ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ ahɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Howl ye; for the day of the LORD is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
idu_Latn: Aá je ikwu hɔ́ɔnɔ, ka aá hīla humm, ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī kú Óndú āle bá ajaajɛ ɛɛ́, ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Anú nōo nwuné fíyɛ́ dúu a gē bī ífi wā a.

eng_Latn: And all the kings of Tyrus, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the isles which are beyond the sea,
idu_Latn: N le je lɛ odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Utáya, mɛ́mla aɔ́cɛ́ kú Usídɔn mɛ́mla odúúdú aɔ́cɛ́ kú ajɛ kú okónu ísu ogbehé kú ísu nɛ̄hi ā le gwá.

eng_Latn: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ewɔhá ōhī bá ipú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu bá ī nyɔ̄ mla uwá. É wɛ ācɛ o yúnwɛ̄bɛ́ nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi. Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kōō gbɔɔ́ ō ka iŋini dúú kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ ka, alɔ kōō lɛ ɛbɛ́ má kwú lé ōfōōfūnū.

eng_Latn: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpó ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo tá ɔbá nū nyɔ̄ gaá lɛ ɔbá ɔhá lɛ, ajā nɛ̄ ó gē gbo á.

eng_Latn: Your words have been stout against me, saith the LORD. Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka ɛ́ɛ húmáyī kɛlā obɔbí alɛwa tá anúɔ, amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ gē dɔɔ̄kā ka, ɛlā obɔbí nyā nɛ̄ aá ka tá ɔ̄ ā?.

eng_Latn: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
idu_Latn: A gē tū ɔwɔ klá aɛ́fu nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā, ŋmá ɔkpáncō, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛcɛ kóō le mu mla ɔhā kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
idu_Latn: Umérāyɔtu, Amárīya, Ahítūbu.

eng_Latn: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēe bá nyā géē yá eko nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī nɛ̄hi ɔ́ɔma gā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe cɛ̄ɛ̄lā nū ā géē je iyē nū gicō, é klla géē kɛlā olɔhi nɛ̄hi lɛyíkwu ɔ́. Aá géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ dúú, ohígbū ka aá cɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there were chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving unto God.
idu_Latn: O ŋmífī kú eko kú Udéfīdi, ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla Ásāfu, ɔ̄cɛ o leyīkwu ɔ̄cogwíijē kú íkée ā, ācogwíijē húmáyī í bī ācɛ tá mla ijē nēé bá gē gwó ī cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō klla bá yɔ̄ gē tá ɔ̄ ahínyá.

eng_Latn: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā lɛ okónu nōó ce lɛ Usólōmɔn ā tū. Ó lɛ íjééyī je lɛ Usólōmɔn. Ɛbɔ́ klla yɔ̄ ɔtáhɛ́ kú Usólōmɔn mɛ́mla Uhíram. É klla le abɔ̄ tɔ́ɔkpá, kéē lā mɛ́mla īyī uwā ɛbɔ́.

eng_Latn: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
idu_Latn: Ícɛ a, Aólɛlā a bá ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Unób, é kē ba í jīla ɔfú kú uwá iyē lígíi, ɛyí ɛfú kú Usáyɔn, ipú ɔlɛ́ kú Ujerúsālɛm.

eng_Latn: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
idu_Latn: Aá lā ipú ɛcɛ nyā yɔ̄ ī ŋmó ije kú aá tū ɔdā nōo géē je abahi lɛ aá. Aá lɛ iyē kú aá yá jɔ̄kwū gbēyī ɛ̄cī ɛpɔ̄ ā ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And Rachel died, and was buried in the way to Ephrath, which is Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ Urécɛ̄lu gekwú ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ɔwɛ nōo yɛ ga Ɛ́frāti, nēé hī ka Ubɛ́tlɛhɛ̄m abālɔbányā ā.

eng_Latn: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nēé le ɔ̄cɛ nēé nyatá ā má háyi pī uwā ā, é lɛ ɔdā dúú nēé ī ka ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄cī éyi, Usɛkaríya yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ kú ɛya ō gwó kú nū ɛyí ede ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, ohígbū ka ɔgba wā í ce ɔ́ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
idu_Latn: Ipú ɔyā kú aflɛ́yí ā, odúúdú ójila kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le pɛ́ wā ipú ígbíli kú Usín, gaá lā Ukádɛssi. Abɔ́ɔ ā, Umíriyam gekwú, é lɛ ɔ́ nyi.

eng_Latn: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
idu_Latn: Ayááyí kú Ujɛ́rōham wɛ, Ussamssɛ́rāyi, Ussɛhárīya, Atálīya.

eng_Latn: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day. So the LORD turned from the fierceness of his anger. Wherefore the name of that place was called, The valley of Achor, unto this day.
idu_Latn: É le ɛcɔ̄ ā tīkwū klá uwá. Ɛcɔ̄ ā wɛ oō tīkwū klá gónóó abɔ́ɔ kwu eko nēé tɔ́kpá nyā ā. Ɔdā nōo yá ɛ́ɛ́ nēé hī abɔ́ɔ ka, ɔpɛ́ kú unwalu ā yɔ̄ á. Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā í klla cɔ̄nū mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gɛ ŋ́ má.

eng_Latn: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
idu_Latn: Ákú ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ ɔ́ɔmā géē lɔhi ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ ɔkpani uwā gaá má uwā béeyī klla le tútū eko nōó pīyɛyí ā! N da aá koó géē lɛ iyī nū tútū, cɛ̄ lɛ uwá má cīce kéē lé ɔdōlé, ó kē ī wā í je ɔdōlé lɛ uwá abɔ̄yī nū.

eng_Latn: And the great court round about was with three rows of hewed stones, and a row of cedar beams, both for the inner court of the house of the LORD, and for the porch of the house.
idu_Latn: Inu kú ɔcɛ́ ā, mɛ́mla inu eyīpú kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla okómpinu kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, é le aígbɔ́cí kú usɛ́da cila ɛplá ɔgba ɛtɛ́ɛ́ta kú aigbɛ́cɔ̄ plla ce ɔdɔ ā kú aígbɛ́cɔ̄ nēé gbā. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé bī le gwó aínu ā gicō kpɛ́mm lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ cíkā ō yá ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā nōo cíkā ō yá ā lɛ ɔnyā nū. Ɔ̄cɛnyā cíkā ō yá ukpɛ̄ kú ɔdā nōo cíkā ō yá ā lɛ ɔbá nū. Ɔnyɔɔnyɛ cíkā ō yá ɛgbá kú ɔ́mpa nū lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
idu_Latn: Eko nāa lɛ ɔ́ɔmā yá kwɛyí, kwú ɛdrɔ́ kú ɛna mɛ́mla omlede nēé lɛ ɛnyá dúúmā ŋ́ mā ú.

eng_Latn: Better is it that thou shouldest not vow, than that thou shouldest vow and not pay.
idu_Latn: Ó géē lɔhi fíyɛ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka á cokónu ŋ́, fíyɛ́ o le okónu ce, nɛ̄ á yá ɔdā nāa cokónu nū ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́ mā a.

eng_Latn: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔ́dā o hile ɔhá nɛ̄ Ása yá ā, é le ɔ́ tá tū ipú ɔkpá kú ígwú ō gbo kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu mɛ́mla Ujúda.

eng_Latn: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
idu_Latn: Ń lɛ ɔfú ŋ́, n kē le gbɛhá nɛ̄hi. Ɔwɔicō wā ɛgiyí um fíyaa, awɔ wɛ Óndú um nōo gē tá um abɔ̄ á. Páápá wā í tá um abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
idu_Latn: Aɛ́nyā wɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Ádām á. Eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō yá alɛɛcɛ á, ó ya uwā gbla īyī nū.

eng_Latn: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
idu_Latn: Ɛlíssāma, Ɛlíyāda, mɛ́mla Ɛlífɛ̄lɛti.

eng_Latn: Now mine eyes shall be open, and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
idu_Latn: Eyī kú um má kwu Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi nyā ɛɛ́. Ɔkɔ dóódu nēé géē gbā gā um amānyā ā, n géē pó klla í cīla ɔkɔ nēé gbā ɔ́ɔmā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aá gā ipú ajɛ nɛ̄ aá gáā lā, nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ aá ā.

eng_Latn: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
idu_Latn: Uhágāyi klla dɔɔ̄kā ɔhá kahíníī, Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka ɔ̄cɛ le tēelihɔ o ŋmá lɛ o lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū, anɔ́ɔ ó gaá kwú abɔ̄ ú kwu odúúmā kú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā, ɔ́ɔmā géē yá ka ɔdā ɔ́ɔmā kóō kwú tēelihɔ dúú nɛɛ? Ācogwɛ́ɛya ā tóohi kahíníī, Īīī.

eng_Latn: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight.
idu_Latn: Ɔlá ŋmá ɔkpáncō gaá kwú aótrɛ̄yí ɛpa ā mɛ́mla aícɔ́ɔja kú uwá ú kpó ŋmó ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, kócōō méyinyinyi alɔ.

eng_Latn: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
idu_Latn: Ó le aígelī nɛ̄hi kpó gwó ɛyí aɛ́fu kú Ujúda. Ó klla kē le inīīcō o lɔfú nɛ̄hi mɛ́mla inɔ̄ɔda kú ipú ūpū kpɛ́mm ā kpó gwó.

eng_Latn: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka anúɔ géē cīgbīhi kwu ācɛ ɔlɛ́ anúɔ jāā gbéeko nēé lɛ ōwē kú íne nēé bīya ā má jɛ̄, nēé géē gbɔɔ́ ō wā í dɔɔ̄kā anúɔ. Eko ōhī, ipú ōwē mla ákanya kú ūwā ā, ɛ́ɛ géē dɔɔ̄kā anúɔ.

eng_Latn: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
idu_Latn: Aólɛhá mɛ́mla ācɛ nēé lɛ abɔ̄ da uwá ɛyí tāajɛ ā bá í lɛ ikpó da umúlá kú igelī ā tāajɛ.

eng_Latn: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄gɔ̄ kú ɔmɛ nōo yɔ̄ ɔtāhɛ̄ kú Usúkōtu mɛ́mla Usáretan, ɔpɛ́ kú Ujɔ́dan ā nɛ̄ Usólómɔ̄n, ɔcɛ́ ā, je lɛ Uhúram nōó le yá odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá ā kpɛ́mm á.

eng_Latn: And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day?
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si le ɛlā ka lɛ aútíca kú íne ā mɛ́mla ācɛ Ufárisīi ā kahíníī, Īné kú alɔ jɛga lɛ ɔ̄cɛ kóō hɛ́ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá tá ŋmá ōcē ɛ̄cī usábāti, kɛ̄ɛ koó je ŋ́?.

eng_Latn: The rings, and nose jewels,
idu_Latn: Ó géē kpó aéliká kú uwā nēé gē le wū ayíkābɔ̄ ā, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ é gē le wu ɛnwū ā.

eng_Latn: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n wā ɛgiyí aá, ayínɛ́ um, ń bī okónu o jé mɛ́mla ɔdōojé nɛ̄hi wā í le tɔ́ɔna kú olɛhɔ̄ kú ɔdōtayínū nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
idu_Latn: abɔ̄ ōcē kú um junwalu lɛ aá nááná ā, aá leyī gwū um tónū ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ aá kōō tū um ŋ́. Amáŋ aá kē mīyɛ um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá í lɔfú mīyɛ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō nōo ŋmá ɔkpáncō ā, aá klla mīyɛ um ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá í mīyɛ Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si ā.

eng_Latn: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:
idu_Latn: É le iyē kú odúúdú uwā mɛ́mla anyā uwá mɛ́mla ayí uwā kpó tá tū ipú ɔkpá, ohígbū ka ó cɛgbá kéē le tútū eko dúúdú kéē nyɔ̄ gaá yúkɔ́ kú uwā eko dúúmā ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: That hath taken off his hand from the poor, that hath not received usury nor increase, hath executed my judgments, hath walked in my statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
idu_Latn: Ó tá ka ó yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí, í klla ī je ije tū akwunugba ŋ́. Ó gē lɛ íne kú um tū, klla í lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɔ́da dóódu nɛ̄ n je ā. Ó gáā kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú ádā nū ā ŋ́. Ó géē yēeyī piíí.

eng_Latn: And said, Where have ye laid him? They said unto him, Lord, come and see.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ aá lɛ ɔ́ gwutá ā? Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Óndú, wā gaá má ɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
idu_Latn: Otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú Asírīya ā da uwá ka ɔcɛ́nɛ̄hi kú Asírīya ā ɔ́ɔ tíne ō jé ɔdā nɛ̄ Uhɛsɛkíya lɔtūce ɔ́ lɛ ā, ɛ́ nōó cɔ̄nyā ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And he brought me to the north gate, and measured it according to these measures;
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ā lɛ um bī ga okómpinu kú ɛhícō ā á. Ó lɛ ɔ́ mīya, ó kē wɛ ɔdā ékpónú mɛ́mla aókómpinu ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
idu_Latn: Alɔ ā wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō, ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo jé Ɔwɔicō ā gē jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nɛ̄ ó kē wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, í kē gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ alɔ ŋ́. Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ alɔ ī bī i jé Alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō ɔkwɛ̄yi mɛ́mla alelékwū nōo ī plla ācɛ á.

eng_Latn: And Elimelech Naomi's husband died; and she was left, and her two sons.
idu_Latn: Ɛlímɛ́lɛ̄ki gekwú, gaá hile Unaómi mɛ́mla ayí nū nɔ̄nyīlɔ ɛpa ā ōfōōfū uwā.

eng_Latn: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Unáaman le yɛ gaá lɛ iyē wu ísu kú Ujɔ́dan igbo ahāapa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ kú Ɔwɔicō ā ka lɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ agwú kú nū mɛ, ɔkpíyē kú nū klla kwú yá mɛ́ɛ́lɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔkpíyē kú ɔyípɛ̄nɛŋcɛ́ obene ā.

eng_Latn: And the next unto him was Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven princes of Persia and Media, which saw the king's face, and which sat the first in the kingdom;)
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ī nwū ɔ̄ ɛlā íbí ā wɛ, Ukasséna, Ussɛ́ta, Adimáta, Utássissi, Uméresi, Umaséna mɛ́mla Umémūkan. Uwá wɛ aígabɔ̄ kú nū ahāapa nɛ̄ āhɔ̄ kú uwá fíyɛ́ dúú ipú ajɛ kú Upɛsīya mɛ́mla Umɛ́dīya á.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si da uwá kahíníī, Aɔ́cɛ́ kú aílɔ́wá bī íkwu gē le gbō ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā, nááná é gē dɔɔ̄kā kéē hī uwā ka aóklóbīya kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us,
idu_Latn: Alɔ cɛ̄tra Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔfú kú nū nōo yɔ̄ ī yúklɔ́ ipú alɔ ā lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄hi yá lɛ alɔ fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ alɔ kōō gbɛlá nū ā.

eng_Latn: Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,
idu_Latn: N le má ka ɔyínɛ́ nɛ̄ŋcɛ̄ ā le bīya bɛ̄ɛka ɔyínɛ́ nū nɔ̄nyā nɔ̄nyākwɔ́ɔcɛ ā dúú. Uwá wɛ ɔdā ékpónú.

eng_Latn: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī kɛlā mla Uháman kpɔ́ ɛ́ɛ́ mā, idibo kú agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā, nwúleyīkwū gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú bī ga ɔnū ucɛ nɛ̄ ɔcányā, Ɛ́sta, yá lɛ anú mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And there came in two men, children of Belial, and sat before him: and the men of Belial witnessed against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, Naboth did blaspheme God and the king. Then they carried him forth out of the city, and stoned him with stones, that he died.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ɔdāhá ā mɛ́mla ācobɔ́bíipú ɛpa ā le ije cē bá ɔ̄ ipú ɛwa ā ka, ɔ́ɔ le ɛcá cá Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́. Anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ́ ú ga eyīyɛ̄ɛcɛ kú igelī nɛ̄hi gaá lɛ ɛcɔ̄ tá klá anú le ɔ́ ŋmó á.

eng_Latn: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
idu_Latn: Aájī igwó nɛ̄ a má ā mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā géē wɔ́tū akwuna ā, géē kpó ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nōó lɛ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ é habɔ̄tá tóohɛ́ɛwa. É géē je ɛbɛ́ nū lé, klla géē je ɔ́ tɔ́lá bónū.

eng_Latn: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
idu_Latn: Ɔdíyá nɛ̄ aá kē ī lɛlá wu ɔdā nɛ̄ aá í lɛ wiyē āa? Aá má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ácí ō yá ododó ī jɛ lɛ́ āa. É gē yúklɔ́ ŋ́ ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē tá odōwiyē abɔ̄yī uwā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm, cāŋjɛ ŋmá ipú úmúlá cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá lɛ úmúlá gwōbónū ŋmá iyē. Kú aá lɛ agbá nōo kwu aá ā wi cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá nyīliyē tá.

eng_Latn: And the likeness of the firmament upon the heads of the living creature was as the colour of the terrible crystal, stretched forth over their heads above.
idu_Latn: Odée yɔ̄ icō kú aɔ́dā olɛ oyēeyī ā yɔɔlɔ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ mɛ́ɛbɛ bū ɔ̄ɔ glá lɛbɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā, nōo yɔ̄ ī ceyī ŋaáŋaá ā.

eng_Latn: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicó ōfōōfūnū jé ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ gē le jééyī ā á. Anú ōfōōfūnū jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ ī le lɛ íjééyī á.

eng_Latn: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?
idu_Latn: Áyísīki da ádā nū kahíníī, Ádā um! Anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á, ɔyí um. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ɔlá mɛ́mla ɛfú yɔ̄ á, amáŋ iní nɛ̄ ɔyí omlede o bī gwɛ́ɛya oyi ɔlá dúúdú ā yɔ̄ āa.

eng_Latn: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
idu_Latn: É kpó Ugóolu mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ kú uwá ā bónū úláyi bɛ̄ɛka īmū ā. Ugóolu mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ mla odúúdú agbénú kú uwá a í gáā hɛ́ uwá tá glá ŋ́, eko nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē bī ícɔnū nɛhi kú nū ā le yá uwā italā ā ŋ. É gáā bī ije a ŋmlá ɛgbá kú uwá dúúmā glá, ɛɛ nēé ge lé ɔ́ nū ipú glá ŋ́. Ugóolu mɛ́mla ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ā bī uwá ga ipú ɔbíipú ō bī á.

eng_Latn: And I have heard of thee, that thou canst make interpretations, and dissolve doubts: now if thou canst read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation thereof, thou shalt be clothed with scarlet, and have a chain of gold about thy neck, and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ n pó ka a gē ka ɛyí ɔ̄na lɛ ɔ̄cɛ klla ī ŋmúla unwalu kú ɔ̄cɛ lɛ ɔ́. Ɔ́dāŋ ka a lɛ ɔkpá nyā jé nɛ̄ a klla lɛ ɛyí nū ka gā um, n géē je awulú nɔ̄wá wu uwɔ iyē, klla í lɛ agbá kú oje ɔdɔ tū uwɔ ɔkɔ. A klla géē wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o gbāājɛ ɔ́mɛɛtá ipú ajɛ kú Ubábīlɔn ā.

eng_Latn: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
idu_Latn: Ó kōō wɛ ɔnyā nɛ̄ó gbaajā ŋ́ nááná nɛ̄ ɔbá nū gbɔɔ́ ō kpéyīce ɔ́.

eng_Latn: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ é tá ō lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú um ā. É kpó aɛ́cí ōtīihilɛ kú uwá ā bónū, ɛɛ́ nēé gē ma aójibó kú Íjīpiti tá ŋ́. N le tútū ō yá uwā ɛlā ohígbū ka n le cɔ̄nū mla uwā ipú Íjīpiti abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ kú ɛ́ɛ yēeyī ligbó ipú ajɛ olɔhi nɛ̄ Óndú ā cokónu kóō je lɛ ádáádā uwā mɛ́mla ayí uwā ā.

eng_Latn: Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying, When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?
idu_Latn: Le ka lɛ odúúdú ācɛ kú ajɛ ā mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya ā ka, eko nɛ̄ aá gē gwū okónu gē yá ɔtūnōbí ipú ɔyā ɔ́mɛhɔ̄ mɛ́mla ɔyā ɔ́mahāapa kú ipú iháyí ofɛtá cigwó nēé yɛ nyā, ohígbū um nɛ̄ aá gē gwū okónu á ā?.

eng_Latn: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
idu_Latn: ɛcɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá nēé hī ucanɛ́liyan ā mɛ́mla aɛ́cɔ̄ ō gbɔɔ́lá ɔhá nēé gē lɛ wu ipú ɛ́fɔ̄du ō playi ɔtū kú ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ā, mɛ́mla ipú ɛkpa ō bɔ́ɔtū kú nū a.

eng_Latn: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
idu_Latn: Aá géē je ɛbɛ́ ā lé ícíícɛ nɛ̄ aá gwɛ́ɛya ā ámāŋ ka ɔŋmɔ́cī nū. Aá géē je ɛbɛ́ dóódu nōo hile gbó ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛɛtá ā yɔlá.

eng_Latn: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and eight.
idu_Latn: Ubébāyi wɛ, úlā ce ofigwóléyi ce ahātá.

eng_Latn: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.
idu_Latn: Ó yɔ̄ amānyā gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū koó le héyī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó ka ā ɛɛ́. Aá wā gaá má ɛga nɛ̄ okwū nū tɛtɛ gwutá ā.

eng_Latn: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó le īlī kú nū nōo tína ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí ā wiyē, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé bī ɔ̄ tá gē lɛ ɔcɛ́ á. Áncɛ́nyā nū nēe ī tá ɔ̄ ɔkwu ā, yɛce ɔ́ wā ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth.
idu_Latn: Ó le bēhé ga ɔlɛ́ Usɛkaríya anɔ́ɔ ó le okónu hɛ́ tū Ɛlísābēti á.

eng_Latn: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
idu_Latn: anyā uwā, ayí uwā mɛ́mla aúgbɔga dóódu nēe lā ɔlɛ́ uwā ā, mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe gē yíla ɛfú lɛ uwá, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e gē hɛ́ éŋkpɔ̄ lɛ uwá kpɛ́mm ā, kéē háyi iyɔ̄bū kú Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā.

eng_Latn: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛla gɔbū kpɔ́ ka ācogwɛ́ɛya kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ā ɔ́ɔ gáā lɛ ukpɛ̄ kú ajɛ dúúmā Ísrɛ̄lu ŋ́. Ó ka ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ géē lɛ ɔdōlé kú uwā ŋmá ɔdā ɛhi mɛ́mla ɔdā nɛ̄ ācɛ géē bī wā í lɛ gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David's throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ a da uwá ka, ami nōo wɛ Uyáwɛ ā, géē yá kú odúúúdú ācɛ kéē le ejé gwá cɛɛnyi, cɛ́ɛ́ ó le uwá kwú lɔɔlɔhi. Kwu aɔ́cɛ́ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Udɛ́fīdi ā, mɛ́mla ācogwɛ́ɛya, kwu ācomɛ́ɛbɛ mɛ́mla odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujerúsālɛm ā.

eng_Latn: And of all my sons, (for the LORD hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.
idu_Latn: Ó je ayí alɛwa gā um, amáŋ oŋmá ipú ayí nōó je ga um ā, ó kwú Usólōmɔn, ɔyí um ú ka anú ɔ́ɔ géē lé ɔcɛ́ kwɛyí um klla í gbō Ísrɛ̄lu, nōo wɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Óndú ā á.

eng_Latn: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēe jéeyī ā, gē yɛ gɔbū kpaakpa ga ipú oyēeyī, ŋmá ɔwɛ nōo gē bī ɔ̄cɛ ga ɔlékwū ā.

eng_Latn: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
idu_Latn: Da odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú uwá gbenyi ā ka ɛ́ɛ lɛ ɔtū lɛ, ka ɛ́ɛ klla lɔfú tū īyī uwā iyē. Ka ɛ́ɛ híī yúúfi gɛ ŋ́ ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō gē wā í hɛ́ uwā tá ɛɛ́. Ó klla í wā í gwū aólɛlā kú uwā ɔ́ci.

eng_Latn: And they had breastplates, as it were breastplates of iron; and the sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to battle.
idu_Latn: É lɛ odée klá ɔtū nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka oje oklá ɔtū bī kpɛ́fú ā. Uya nɛ̄ efū kú uwā gē yá ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka uya kú aɔ́nya alɛwa nēe bá gē pi aúgbɔ́ɔnya ga ɔgbɛ́fú ā.

eng_Latn: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ le ɔcɛ́ lé ɛɛ́, ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ ɔkpá kú íne kú Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɔdā nēé bī nwū ācɛ nēé tá ŋmá íne ā abɔ̄yī nū nɛ̄ ayí Ulífāyi ācogwɛ́ɛya leyīkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Usáyílāsi má ka ó cɛgbá ká anúɔ géē yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
idu_Latn: É gē pīya anyōkwū tū gē mīyɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu cɛ́ɛ́ o yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ācɛ kéē jé ɛdɔ ācɛ nēé wɛ ŋ́ mā, é gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ olīkpō ajɛ nɛ̄hi. Ɔwɔicō géē yá uwā italā nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
idu_Latn: Lɛ abɔ̄ kú uwɔ nāndaa ŋmá ɔkpáncō, ká ā lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá ipú itekwú nyā. Lɛ um hɛ́tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú aéwɔhá.

eng_Latn: Forasmuch as thou sawest that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it brake in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God hath made known to the king what shall come to pass hereafter: and the dream is certain, and the interpretation thereof sure.
idu_Latn: Ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a má ka ɛcɔ̄ le hɛ́ ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu abɔ̄yīnū, nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ fu ɔ́ ŋ́ mā, nōó gaá le oje ɔlamu, oje udɔ, ɔmɛ, oje nɛ̄hɛ́ mɛ́mla oje ɔdɔ ā kpó catāajɛ nyɛŋɛnyɛŋɛ ā, Ɔwɔicō nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yɔ̄ ī da Ágábáidu ɔdā nōo géē yá ɛ̄cɔ̄bū. Ɔ̄na ā wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yi, ó kē í cɛ̄ píii.

eng_Latn: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó géē bī ɔ̄ wā abɔ̄yī nū kóō wɛ ɛya kú ɔdōlé gé lɛ Óndú ā. Ó géē bī ijē mɛ́mla amɛ̄ ā wā, cɛ́ɛ́ ó kwú ɔ̄ ú ɛ̄gbā nōo cɛgbá nɛ̄hi lɛ Óndú ā.

eng_Latn: And to his father he sent after this manner; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way.
idu_Latn: Ó le iyó kú aíjakī igwó kú aɔ́dā nōo lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú ajɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla iyó kú aíjaki igwó kú igwu, igbō mɛ́mla aódōlé ɛdɔ̄ ɔhá kpó lɛ uwá kú iyawu kú uwā.

eng_Latn: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ okpaakpa ā gē gbo ɔ̄cɛ nōo tū ɔ̄ ɛhɔ̄ ā ɔtū nɛɛ, bɛ̄ɛka éŋkpɔ̄ ō hīlaŋ́dɔ́ eko kú ɔnɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done.
idu_Latn: Alɔ leyīce gbɔbū ka anú wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo wā gáā hɛ́ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu tá á nɛɛ n! Amáŋ ícɛ wɛ ɛ̄cī ɔmɛtá ŋmífi nɛ̄ ɔdā ā yá yɔ̄ mɛ́ɛ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
idu_Latn: Ubakubáka, Uhɛ́rɛ̄ss, Ugálal mɛ́mla Umɛtánīya, ɔyí kú Umíka nɛ̄ aádáádā nū wɛ, Usíkri mɛ́mla Ásāfu.

eng_Latn: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
idu_Latn: Ussɔ́ppim mɛ́mla Uhɔ́pim wɛ ipɔ́ɔma nyā dúú. Udáni mɔyí éyi nōo lé ka Uhɔ́ssim.

eng_Latn: Remember therefore how thou hast received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore thou shalt not watch, I will come on thee as a thief, and thou shalt not know what hour I will come upon thee.
idu_Latn: Aá bla kwu ɔkwɛ̄yi kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá nēé nwū aá ā. Aá bī ɔ̄ le yúklɔ́ cɛ́ɛ́ kú aá le pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá íne nɛ̄ aá bá ī bīya ā. Ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá héyī ŋ́, n géē wā ɛgiyí aá bɛ̄ɛka uwī ā, nɛ̄ aá kōō gáā jé eko nɛ̄ n gáā wā ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Give a portion to seven, and also to eight; for thou knowest not what evil shall be upon the earth.
idu_Latn: Je ɔdā ɛhi kú uwɔ lɛ ācɛ alɛwa, ohígbū ka á jé ɔdā obɔ̄bī nōo géē yá uwɔ óócí ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
idu_Latn: Aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ Ujíyu le ɛga mīyɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Upáyílēti kéē lɛ ikpó kú ācɛ nēé nyɔ́kpá ā kpó cē, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lɛ uwá kpó wāajɛ ŋmá ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá ā. É ba ɛba nyā ohígbū kóō wɛ ɛ̄cī Ajúmā, é kē tine kú ācɛ ā kéē playicō abɔ́ɔ jāā gbó ɛ̄cī Usábāti ŋ́, ofíyɛ́ dúú abɔ̄ Usábāti nōo ī wā ā wɛ ɛ̄cī otīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Israel was holiness unto the LORD, and the firstfruits of his increase: all that devour him shall offend; evil shall come upon them, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ísrɛ̄lu, aá tɛtɛ wɛ ákú um ōfōōfū um. Aá lɛbɛ̄ɛka aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ olɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú kú aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé cē aflɛ́yí ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ nēe ī wɛ ákú um ā. N gē ŋmó ācɛ nēe lɛ abɔ̄ kwu aá ɛpɔ̄bí klla ī yá uwā italā. Ācɛ ɛ́gɔ́ɔ́mā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cɛ nōo le ɛbéelihɔ lé ā. Ami nōo wɛ Óndú ā le ka ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: He shall receive the blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Óndú ā gáā hɔ́hā ce ɔ́ á, nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nōo hɛ́ ɔ̄ tá ā í hɛ́ ɛpɔ̄hi lɛ ɔ́ á.

eng_Latn: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar .
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɛ̄nyā wā ī le yá da Unebúkádinēsa.

eng_Latn: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu kwú kɔ̄ ɛpa. Āyā éyi tíne ō je Utíbīni, ɔyí kú Ugínāti ā cɔcɛ́, āyā ɔhá ā kē le yɛce Ómri.

eng_Latn: And the other woman said, Nay; but the living is my son, and the dead is thy son. And this said, No; but the dead is thy son, and the living is my son. Thus they spake before the king.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔnyā ɔhá ā ka ehée, ɔyí nɛ̄ ɔ́ɔ yēeyī ā wɛ ákú anúɔ á, o ka ɔyí nōo kwú ā kē wɛ ákú ɔnyā aflɛ́yí ā á. Anɔ́ɔ ɔnyā kú aflɛ́yí ā da ɔnyā ɔ́mpa ā ka ɔyí nōo kwú ā ɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú ɔnyā ɔhá ā á, ka ɛ̄nɛ̄ oyēeyī ā wɛ ákú anúɔ á. Ɔwɛ ɛ́gɛ́nyā nēé bá gē táafú mla iyī uwā iyɔ̄bū ɔcɛ́ á.

eng_Latn: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
idu_Latn: Jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā nēé gē nwū ā, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā kē lɛ abɔ̄ bī ukɔ́ nēé tū uwɔ ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú ā géē le jéeyī.

eng_Latn: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
idu_Latn: Ayínɛ́ um, ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɛlā nɛ̄ n bī le ŋmó ɔkpá kú um ɛyí á. Aá gwéeyē ohígbū ka aá le pīyatɔ̄há mla Óndú ā. Ó je unwalu gā um ŋ́ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ n lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ n tɛtɛ ka gbɔbū ā ka kpɔ́. Ó géē tá aá ikpó kwajɛ.

eng_Latn: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nōo ka ā kē yɔ̄ á, É géē je Ujérobōwam ŋmó ɔgbɛ́fú, cɛ́ɛ́ é lɛ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó kwú ga ajɛ kú aéwɔhá kéē nyɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ ɔfiyɛ.

eng_Latn: And Hannah prayed, and said, My heart rejoiceth in the LORD, mine horn is exalted in the LORD: my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies; because I rejoice in thy salvation.
idu_Latn: Uhána gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kahíníī, Óndú ā lɛ ɔtū kú um mu mla éeyē. N bī iyē kú Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī gwéeyē, ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi, ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ga um nyá ā. N gē yɛhɛ tū aólɛlā kú um. Ɔtū he um nɛ̄hi ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō, le abɔ̄ tá um.

eng_Latn: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka aá abɔ̄yī aá jé lɔɔlɔhi ka Óndú ā géē wā eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í leyīce ŋ́ mā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cowūwī gē wā eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í yɔ̄ ī leyīce ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
idu_Latn: Oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū ā, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ufilístiya wā kéē kpó iyó ŋmá iyē kú okwū ā, é má okwu kú Usɔ́lu mɛ́mla ayí nū ɛtɛ́trɛ́ɛtá ā bá ɛyí ɛfu kú Ugílibōwa.

eng_Latn: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ɛwa kú ācɛ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si yɛjīlatá biílí ā, ó gbɔɔ́ ō ka kahíníī, Ācɛ nēe yēeyī abālɔbányā ā bɔ̄bíipú íbí! É dɔɔ̄kā ɔdōcābɔ̄ ohídáagó, amáŋ é gáā yá ɔdōcābɔ̄ ohídáagó dúú lɛ aá ŋ́. Ɔdā nēé géē je lɛ aá ōfōōfūnū ā wɛ ɔdōcābɔ̄ kú Ujóna á.

eng_Latn: Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubébāyi ā wɛ, Ujehóhānan, Uhananíya, Usábāyi mɛ́mla Atīlayi.

eng_Latn: And the king of Israel said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ uwá má ā, ó da Ɛláyíssa ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Ádā um, n̄ lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó nɛɛ? N lɛ uwá kpó ŋmó ōō.

eng_Latn: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou it for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um jikwū klá um, kahíníī, Nááná nɛ̄ íne nɛ̄ alɔ bīya kōō cīijáalí tū alɔ. Óndú, tá alɔ abɔ̄ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a ce okónu lɛ ā. Alɔ kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ igbalɛwa ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: I gathered me also silver and gold, and the peculiar treasure of kings and of the provinces: I gat me men singers and women singers, and the delights of the sons of men, as musical instruments, and that of all sorts.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ugóolu mɛ́mla oje nɛ̄hɛ́ tīīkwū bá lɛ īyī um, mɛ́mla ɛdɔ kú agbénú kú aɔ́cɛ́ mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄ kú aéwo nēe bá ɛháajɛ um ā. N lɛ ācɛ alɛwa kpó bá gē gwíijē gā um, ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ. N lɛ anyā nɛ̄ n gē ciikpó ūwā alɛwa nēe lɛwa fíyɛ́ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛnyīlɔ dúú lɔfú tíne.

eng_Latn: And they gave him audience unto this word, and then lifted up their voices, and said, Away with such a fellow from the earth: for it is not fit that he should live.
idu_Latn: O jāā gaá kwu ɛlā nyā é le ahɔ̄ je lɛ ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ é le ɔkɔ cɛyí gbɔɔ́ ō dɛ̄gba kahíníī, Lɛ ɔ̄cɛ ā bī nyɔ̄! Le ɔ́ ŋmó! Ohígbū kóō cíkā kóō yēeyī ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā hīgwú ga ɛkwūbá anɔ́ɔ ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá mɔ́ɔ̄, alɔ yɔ̄ ī tū ɛfu í nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm. Abɔ́ɔ nɛ̄ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nɛ̄ ācomɛ́ɛbɛ tá tāajɛ lɛyíkwu ami, Ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Ɔ̄cɛ ā géē yá jīla á.

eng_Latn: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.
idu_Latn: É bá ī lé ɔdōlé abahi klla le jɔ̄kwū nɛ̄hi. Ɔ́bíipú nēé ī bī ā í lɛ ɛjī ŋ́. É gē hɛ́pɔ̄ okpaakpa ká ayókwū kéē le ɔdā nōo cíkā ō wɛ ákú uwā lɛ ŋ́. É klla gē cɛ̄pɔ̄ ācɛ nɛ̄ ācɛ ī pīyatū ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é dɛ̄ tɛ́ɛcɛ abɔ̄ é lɛ ódūdū kú ɔlá nōo je igelī ā yi tāajɛ ā má ā kahíníī, Igelī ɔhá dúúmā í lɛbɛ̄ɛka igelī nɛ̄hi nyā jééjé ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
idu_Latn: Ābɔ̄ ɔhá kú nū ā, ācɛ Ujíyu bá ī dɔɔ̄kā íne nōo géē ka uwá gwó mla Ɔwɔicō, amáŋ é pīyɛ̄ ɔ̄ ŋ.

eng_Latn: Except the LORD of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, í mā ācɛ ōhī tá kéē yēeyī ŋ́ nɛɛ, é géē yɛ í lɛ alɔ kpó yíífi ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ó kpó ācɛ kú aígelī kú Usɔ́dɔm mɛ́mla Ugomóra yíífi ā.

eng_Latn: And their brethren, Shebaniah, Hodijah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
idu_Latn: Upéláya, Uhánan.

eng_Latn: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
idu_Latn: É géē wɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um, n kē í wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā.

eng_Latn: The works of the LORD are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
idu_Latn: Úklɔ́ nɛ̄ Óndú ā yá ā nwuné nɛ̄hi, Odúúdú ācɛ nɛ̄ úklɔ́ ā he uwá ɔtū ā, géē gbɛlá tū ɔ̄ kéē jɛ́yí nū.

eng_Latn: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half was the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it, and a cubit and a half the height of it:
idu_Latn: Ubɛsálilu le Ikpati kú okónu ōce ā gbā ŋmá ɔcí kú akésiya, olīkpō kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛtá ce āyā, olɔwá kú nū wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyá, olicō kú nū klla kē wɛ ikpó ɛpa ce āyá.

eng_Latn: From that time forth began Jesus to shew unto his disciples, how that he must go unto Jerusalem, and suffer many things of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be killed, and be raised again the third day.
idu_Latn: Ŋmá eko ɔ́ɔmā Ujísɔ̄si gbɔɔ́ ō da ayíkpó kú nū pée ka anúɔ géē nyɔ̄ Ujerúsālɛm piíí. Anúɔ klla géē móōwē nɛ̄hi abɔ̄ kú anyākwɔ́cɛ mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ā mɛ́mla aítíca kú íne ā. É kē géē ŋmó anúɔ piíí, amáŋ anúɔ géē héyī ŋmá ɔlékwū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mɛtá.

eng_Latn: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven,
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ n má māháyi eyī ísu mɛ́mla ɛyí ajɛ ā lɛ abɔ̄lɔ́ná kú nū jegiico lɛyíkwu ɔkpáncō.

eng_Latn: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si yɔ̄ gē nwū ācɛ ɛlā Ɔwɔicō ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā ɛ̄cī dóódu, amáŋ ɔ̄nɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ dóódu ó gē nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ga ɛyí ɛfu kú ɔcí olīifu gē klá abɔ́ɔ gbɔ́ɔ̄cī.

eng_Latn: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh's cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
idu_Latn: N bī íkókwū kú ɔcɛ́ ā abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ n kwú īkpō kú ufáyin ā ú, le ɔ́ pí tū ipú íkókwū ā klla kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Uféro, ɔcɛ́ ā á.

eng_Latn: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.
idu_Latn: Kóō yá ɛgbá kú uwɔ nāa tíne ā ipú odo kú uwɔ ā gā uwɔ. Kóō yá ká ā lɛ odúúdú ɔdā nāa yá ojuju kú nū ā yá lɔhi.

eng_Latn: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ nɛ̄ Udímasi gbɔɔ́ ō pi ɔtū ɔdā kú ɛcɛ nyā, anɔ́ɔ ó nyɛ̄ɛ̄ le ta Utesalónīka á. Ukrisens le tá Ugaletiya ɛɛ́, Utáyítɔ̄si kē le tá Udamatíya.

eng_Latn: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
idu_Latn: Ɛlā nɛ̄ ɔcɛ́ ī ka ā ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nɛɛ n. Ɛpɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó kē í hɛ́ ā ī le kpaakpa piyóó.

eng_Latn: For thus hath the LORD of hosts said, Hew ye down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ aɔ́cɛ́ nēe bá nyā kéē lɛ ɔcí kpó hɛ́ wā ajɛ kéē lɛ úbɔ́ kú íbɔm mā jīla Ujerúsālɛm tá. Ohígbū ó kahíníī, N géē yá igelī nɛ̄hi nyā italā piíí ohígbū ka ācɛ nēe ī pīya ācɛ tū ā wɛ omōōmu nū.

eng_Latn: And, behold, there appeared unto them Moses and Elias talking with him.
idu_Latn: Ikpííkpó ɔ́ɔmā, é má Umósīsi mɛ́mla Ɛláyíja bá ī kɛlā mɛ́mla anú.

eng_Latn: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and acco
idu_Latn: Ɔdā nyā yá ɛ̄cī ɔ́mofu ce ɛtá kú ɔyā ɔ́mɛtá nēé hī ka Usífan ā. Umɔ́dɛkāyi, lɛ odúúdú aɔ́málɛ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kpó hīgwú, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔdā nēé í tá kpó ka lɛ uwá kéē lɛ ɔkpá tá gé lɛ ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla odúúdú aígbómína mɛ́mla aígabɔ̄, ofu ɛhīlī ce ahāapa kú ajɛ kú Upɛ́siya, nōo gbɔɔ́ ŋmá Índīya jāā ga Etiyópīya ā. É tɔ́kpá nyā okónu ucē kú ācɛ dóódu, mɛ́mla ɔwɛ nēé gē tɔ́kpá okónu kú ɔlɛ́ uwā ā. Ó klla le ɔkpá nyā tá fu ācɛ Ujíyu okónu Uhíbru dúú.

eng_Latn: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔkwɛ̄yí koó le ɔ́kpa gbō ɛcɔ̄ nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ pɛ́ wɛ̄ɛcɛ ŋmá anú. Amáŋ ó lɔfú je igbō mɛ́mla ɛbɛ́ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū glá āā.

eng_Latn: Great is my boldness of speech toward you, great is my glorying of you: I am filled with comfort, I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation.
idu_Latn: N lɔtūce aá nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi, n kē ī bī aá gwō. Odúúdú unwalu nɛ̄ alɔ bū ipú nū á í kōō pīya ɔtū kú um abɔ̄ lɛyíkwu aá ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmá n gē gwéeyē eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: Concerning the Ammonites, thus saith the LORD; Hath Israel no sons? hath he no heir? why then doth their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
idu_Latn: Olɛhɔ̄ nyā lɛyíkwu ācɛ Ámɔ̄ri. Ɔwɔicō kahíníī, Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ayí alɛwa nēe í lé úgwū ajɛ kú uwā. Ó lɛ ā, ɔdíyá nɛ̄ ācɛ nēe gē pā ɛcí nēé hī ka Umílkom ā mīyɛ ajɛ kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Ugádi tū abɔ̄, gaá má lā anú āa?.

eng_Latn: And in the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
idu_Latn: Ahasíya lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda iháyí igwóléyi, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ Ujóram ɔyí kú Áhābu lé ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́ɔmā kē ī wɛ ɔdōōcābɔ̄ lɛ uwá. Amáŋ n géē ma ācɛ ōhī kú uwá tá yēeyī klla í tū uwá ɛhɔ̄ nyɔ̄ ga ajɛ kú éwɔhá nēe bá ɛga oligbó nēe pó ofu um ámāŋ nēé má ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɔfú lɛ ā jéjée ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ mā. N gēe tū uwá ɛhɔ̄ ga ajɛ Uspéni, Ulíbīya mɛ́mla Ulídīya nɛ̄ ācɛ kú nū gē tɔyī nɛ̄hi ā, mɛ́mla Utúbal klla mɛ́mla Ugríísi. É géē bī ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n lɔfú lɛ ā le tɔ́ɔna ipú aéwo nēe bá nyā.

eng_Latn: Art thou greater than our father Abraham, which is dead? and the prophets are dead: whom makest thou thyself?
idu_Latn: Awɔ fíyɛ́ ádā alɔ Ébrahām mɛ́mla ācomɛ́ɛbɛ nēe pɛ́kwú ā á nɛɛ? Ɔdí nāa hī iyī uwɔ ā mɛ́ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
idu_Latn: É gé pi ācɛ abɔ̄fú kéē lɛyítáajɛ lɛ aíne nēe lɛbɛ̄ɛka iyó ogbɛnú nōo lɔnɔ ō bī nēé le ce ācɛ igbīhi ā. É kōō tútū kéē lɛ aíkābɔ̄ áncā je iyó ā gicō tá ācɛ abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí nū le tá ɔkpancō ŋmá ɛga nōó kɛlā lɛ ɔ́ aā.

eng_Latn: As I live, saith the King, whose name is the LORD of hosts, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
idu_Latn: Ami, Uyáwɛ, olɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā wɛ ɔcɛ́ á. Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛfu kú Utábɔ jɛ̄ fíyɛ́ ɛfu dóódu ā, nɛ̄ ɛfu kú Ukámɛ̄lu hayi ɛgiyī ísu gɔ̄mm ā, ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē kpɛ́fú tú aá ā géē lɔfú fíyɛ́ aá lɛ á.

eng_Latn: Wherefore now rise up early in the morning with thy master's servants that are come with thee: and as soon as ye be up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, Udéfīdi, óócí, odúúdú aá nēe nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Usɔ́lu wā ɛgiyí um mla awɔ abɔ̄yī uwɔ dúú, géē cāŋjɛ ofúlɔ̄cī kú aá nyɛ̄ɛ̄.

eng_Latn: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ɛ́gɔ́ɔmā aá lɛ ɛgbá kú aɔ́dā kú ɛcɛ nēe bá ī yúklɔ́ ipú ɔtū kú áa ā kpó bónū. Aɔ́dā o lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛdɔ kú ajā ōgbo ɛyɛ́ɛyɛ́yí, unwū kú ɔdōōbɔ̄bí ō yá, mɛ́mla unwū ɔdā nɛ̄hi o yá .

eng_Latn: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ayááyí kú Ugɛ́ssɔn á: Ulíbini, Ujáhāti, Usíma.

eng_Latn: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
idu_Latn: Ɛgahi kú ɔfulā kú aótrɛ̄yí oyɔ́bɔ́ɔ́cɛ ɔ́ɔmā nōo yɔ̄ ī cá ā, gē bī tāajɛ. Ó géē lɛbɛ̄ɛka īkpō kú ɔcí ufígi nēe gwá kú aflɛ́yí nēé gē je hɛ́ lé bōōbū, eko nēe le pīya ā.

eng_Latn: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛnyā nōo wɛ ɔ̄cɛ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá, ā éyi lɛ ɔbá nōó wɛ ɔ̄cɛ nōo kpɔ́tūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā ŋ́, nɛ̄ ɔbá ā cɛ̄ ka anúɔ géē yɔ̄ tɔ̄há mla anú glá, ɔnyā ā kóō híīī tá ɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness.
idu_Latn: Ánnāsi mɛ́mla Ukayéfāsi kē wɛ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya. Eko ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ olɛhɔ̄ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō wā gé lɛ Ujɔ́ni ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usɛkaríya ipú ígbíli.

eng_Latn: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
idu_Latn: Nááná nɛ̄ ń yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ŋ́ mā, Ɔwɔicō gē bī ɔkɔ nɛ̄ n ka piiíí ā le ŋmó um ɛpɔ̄bí. Nááná nɛ̄ n gē yá ucē kpaakpa ā, ó géē pi ɛpɔ̄ tū um ɔkɔ.

eng_Latn: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
idu_Latn: Ā híī cɛ̄ lɛyí ō táajɛ mɛ́mla o cɛ̄ lɛ ācɛ kpɔtūce uwɔ nyɔ̄ ŋmá ipú oyēeyī kú uwɔ nó n. Bī uwā yɔ̄ ī yɛ mla iyī uwɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ ī lɛ agbá tū ɔkɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú úklɔ́ kú ō gwó kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā gaá kwú ŋmɛ́yí. Ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu lɛ ɔdā dóódu ā yá ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā cābɔ̄ lɛ Umósīsi lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
idu_Latn: Okónu ō kwu uwɔ okónu lɔhi bɛ̄ɛka ejé ō lɔhi fíyɛ́ dúú, nēe ī bū ákpókónu mɛ́mla ɛplá ayīnu flɛɛlɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā tá uwá ohi ka ipɔ́ɔma kú Ujúda géē nyɔ̄ aflɛ́yí á. Ó ka anúɔ géē je ajɛ ā lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king; but my lord the king is as an angel of God: do therefore what is good in thine eyes.
idu_Latn: Ó da Ágábáidu ka ije nɛ̄ Usíba, ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú anúɔ ā, ɔ́ɔ cē bá anúɔ lɛ ɔ́ á. Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔcɛ́ ā ka ɔ́ɔ lɛbɛ̄ɛka alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā nɛ, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, ɔ́ɔ yá ɔdā dúúmā nōo gbɛlá ka ɔ́ɔ le kpaakpa ā.

eng_Latn: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee's children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɛ́nɛ́ kú ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usébēdi lɛ ayí nū kpó wā ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si á. Ó le okwúukwu kwajɛ lɛ Ujísɔ̄si, le ɛ̄ba éyi ba ŋmá abɔ̄ nū.

eng_Latn: And while he yet spake, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him.
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si bī ɛlā okónu yɔ̄ ī ka lɛ ayíkpó kú nū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛwa kú ācɛ pɛ́ wā á. Ujúdasi nōo wɛ éyi kú ayíkpó igwɛ́ɛpa ā kpó uwā tɔ̄ɔkwu wā á. Ó le tá ɛgiyí Ujísɔ̄si kóō lɛ ɔtū má ɔ̄ ɔtū.

eng_Latn: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
idu_Latn: Ayisáya klla kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka anúɔ pó ɔkɔ kú Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ nɛ̄ n géē tɛ̄hɔ̄ ā? Ɔ̄nyɛ géē nyɔ̄ kwɛyí alɔ āa? Anɔ́ɔ n tá ɔ̄ ohi ka, Ágábáidu, ami yɔ̄ á, tū um ɛhɔ̄ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
idu_Latn: Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá géē yá ɛ̄cī nɛ̄ Óndú ā géē yá aá italā ā ŋmá lɛ ámíyā nɛ̄hi nōo géē wā ŋmá ɛga oligbó bɛ̄ɛka owu nɛ̄hi ā? Ɔnyɛ nɛ̄ aá géē kwu ga ɛgiyí nū kóō tá aá abɔ̄ ā? Iní nɛ̄ aá gáā kpó agbénú kú aá ā tayínū ā?.

eng_Latn: Moreover they reckoned not with the men, into whose hand they delivered the money to be bestowed on workmen: for they dealt faithfully.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe gē leyīkwu úklɔ́ nyā, wɛ ɛ́nɛ́nɛ̄ ācɛ, nɛ̄ abɔ̄ kú uwā le yēŋēē. É gē cē ɔdā dúúmā bá ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, é gē da uwá ɔ̄kā ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é ŋmó ije ā lɛ á ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
idu_Latn: Aákwuna mɛ́mla anyā ōgbajā wɛ ukpa o ŋmó ɔ̄cɛ glá nɛ̄ n.

eng_Latn: And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe bá ī yɛ ɔwɛ ā jílɛyí jigijigi tū ɔ̄. É klla cá ɔ̄ ɛcá, yá ɔ̄ ɛbɛ́ gē kahíníī, Aháa! awɔ nōo géē lɔfú ca Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā tāajɛ, klla í lɔfú gwó ɛ̄nɛ̄ ɔlɛɛcɛ í bī abɔ̄ gwó glá ŋ́ ɛ̄cī ɛtá glá.

eng_Latn: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
idu_Latn: É gáā kpó okwū uwā nyí ŋ́, amáŋ é géē kpó wā bá ɛcɛ bá ī nípī fiyúu. Oyī kú uwā í pɛ́ klá aɛ́fu ā yōō ɛbɛɛbɛ.

eng_Latn: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the LORD cast out before the children of Israel.
idu_Latn: Ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ācɛnyīlɔ kwú kpó pīya akwuna kú aɛ́cí ɔ́ɔmā aíkpɛ́cí kú uwā. Ācɛ kú Ujúda klla gbo odúúdú ucɛ obɔ̄bí mɛ́mla ucē kú uwēyī kú ācɛ kú aéwɔhá nɛ̄ Óndú ā nū bɛ̄cɛ hīla uwá ā.

eng_Latn: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
idu_Latn: A kwú ɔdā dóódu ú kpó tū uwā abɔ̄. O ka ka Ɔwɔicō kwú uwā ú yá aótrɛ̄yí kú ɔdā dóódu, ɔdā dúúmā í yɔ̄ nɛ̄ ó kpó tū uwā abɔ̄ ŋ́ nɛɛ ŋ́. Amáŋ, abālɔbányā, alɔ má ka alɛɛcɛ í wɛ otrɛ̄yí kú ɔdā dóódu ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: But to the king of Judah which sent you to enquire of the LORD, thus shall ye say to him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, As touching the words which thou hast heard;
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, Aá nyɔ̄ ga ɛgiyí ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda nōo tū aá ɛhɔ̄ wā ā gaá da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ohi nɛ̄ Óndú ā tá ohígbū ɛlā kú íne nēé tá ipú ɔkpá nāa pó ā.

eng_Latn: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si mɛ́mla ayíkpó kú nū le hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí ɛfu ga ajɛ ā, ó má mahayi ɛga ogblāgādā éyi mɛ́mla ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ayíkpó kú nū. Ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ nēé ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī Ujudíya, mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e ŋmá Ujerúsālɛm mɛ́mla ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e ŋmá igelī kú okónu ísu kú Utáya mɛ́mla Usídɔn ā bá abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: I make a decree, That in every dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, and stedfast for ever, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed, and his dominion shall be even unto the end.
idu_Latn: N le íne yá lɛ abɔ̄ tá ɔ̄, klla kwú ɔ̄ ú kwaajɛ ícɛ, ka odúúdú ācɛ kéē yúúfi, kéē klla gbā Ɔwɔicō kú Udánīyɛlu ɛ̄gbā. Ohígbū ka anú wɛ Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī á. Ó klla yɔ̄ piyóó. Ó í cɔcɛ́ piyóó, ɔdā dúúmā í je ɔ́ yíífi glá ŋ́. Ó lɛ ajɛ ɛga dóódu kwú tābɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God.
idu_Latn: Aá leyī kwɛcɛ, ayínɛ́ um ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá, cɛ́ɛ́ ká ɔ̄cɛ dúú kú ipú aá kóō lɛ ɔtū obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ ó ī cɛ̄ɛ̄lā ŋ́ mā ŋ́, ohígbū nɛ̄ ó géē lɛ aá eyī pīya ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nōo yēeyī āa.

eng_Latn: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
idu_Latn: Aɔ́dā ō lɛ acá oōbī wu ā háyi ɛháajɛ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā, eko nɛ̄ ó nyɔ̄ ipú inu ā. Anɔ́ɔ ódūdū kwú mu odúúdú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā.

eng_Latn: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
idu_Latn: ká um wɛ ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Ohɔ́nyɛtá Ujísɔ̄si lɛ aílɔ́wá ā. N yúklɔ́ kú um bɛ̄ɛka ɔ̄cogwɛ́ɛya ipú ɔna kú ɔkōōlɔhi nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ n tá ā. O yá ɛ́ɛ́ ká aílɔ́wá ā kéē le pīya bɛ̄ɛka ofídákā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō í mīyɛ lɔhi glá ā, nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā je lɛ ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: Who bare record of the word of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujɔ́ni lɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɔdā nēé mafú lɛ ɔ́ ā kpó ka wɛ̄ɛcɛ á. Olɛhɔ̄ nōo ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō mɛ́mla ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si Ohɔ́nyɛtá mafú ā yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers' with thee.
idu_Latn: Ayí abɔ̄yī uwɔ ā kéē jɛ̄, kéē tá uwɔ abɔ̄, ó híī wɛ ayí kú anyā ɔhá nēe bá mla uwɔ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: If there be a controversy between men, and they come unto judgment, that the judges may judge them; then they shall justify the righteous, and condemn the wicked.
idu_Latn: Umósīsi klla yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá gɔbū kpɔ́. Ó ka ācɛ lɔfú bī ikpɛ́lā wā inɛ̄pɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ éyi kú uwā le ɛpɔ̄hi lé, anɔ́ɔ ɔ̄cɛ ɔhá ā le ɛpɔ̄bí lé á.

eng_Latn: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ kéē jé ɔ̄ lɔɔhɔhi ōfōōfūnū ŋ́, amáŋ aícɔ́ɔci ā lɛ ɔ́ fu ɔ̄cɛ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí kóō tá alɔ ɔkwu ipú iyāwu kú alɔ. Ó géē tá alɔ abɔ̄ kóō leyīkwu ije ojīlīmā nɛ̄ alɔ yɔ̄ ī da nyā, nōo géē yá kú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra Óndú Ujísɔ̄si, Ohɔ́nyɛtá. Ɛ̄nyā kē ī mafú ka alɔ le tútū ō tá ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Ɔwɔicō ɔ́mpā alɔ nɛ̄ ɛgbá ce uwá ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned: in his trespass that he hath trespassed, and in his sin that he hath sinned, in them shall he die.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ̄cɛ o yá ucē okpaakpa ā kwú pīyabɔ̄ ŋmá olɔhi oōyá, klla gbɔɔ́ ō bī ɔ́bíipú mla ɛdɔ ucē ɛbí nɛ̄ ācōbɔ̄bíipú ɔhá gē yá ā, ó géē yēeyī kɛ̄ɛ? Ehée! É klla gáā blakwu odúúdú olɔhi kú nū dúúmā nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ yá ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó géē kwú ohígbū ɔ́bíipú kú nū mɛ́mla abɔ̄ ó yá ucē ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛyi ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not thy peace:
idu_Latn: Otú éyi, Óndú ā da Upɔ́lu ipu ɔ̄na kahíníī, Ā yúufi ācɛ nēe bá nyā ŋ́, amáŋ yɔ̄ ī kɛlā lɛ uwá kpɔ́, ā híī lɛ okónu klá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
idu_Latn: Íne kú Ɔwɔicō ō bīya wā ipú ɛcɛ nyā ŋmá iyē ɔ̄cɛ ékpónú, ikwū kē wā ŋmá lɛ íne nōó bīya ā, anɔ́ɔ ikwū le nyīla ɔwɛ ékpónú ɔ́ɔmā gé lɛ odúúdú ācɛ ā ohígbū ka odúúdú ācɛ le íne bīya.

eng_Latn: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ó kɛlā ɛga éyi ipú ɔkpá kú ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ā lɛyíkwu ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa kahíníī, Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō mlɛ́nyɔ́ ŋmá ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī úklɔ́ kú nū ɛ̄cī ɔ́mahāapa á.

eng_Latn: And shall lay thee even with the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.
idu_Latn: É gáā mabɔ̄ ɛcɔ̄ dúúmā tá ce ɛyí ɔhá ipú uwɔ ŋ́. Odúúdú aɔ́dā nēe bá nyā í yá uwɔ ohígbū ka á jé eko nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō wā kóō nyā uwɔ tá ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ aɔ́cɛ́ nēe lé ce īyī uwā ɔgbace ɔgbace igbīhi ikwū kú éyééye kú uwā gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔ̄cɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu dúúmā kóō gbɔɔ́ ō lé ɔcɛ́ ā á. Ubéla, ɔyí kú Ubéyɔ nōo ŋmá igelī nɛ̄hi kú Udinhába.

eng_Latn: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo gē gbā ɛcí ɔ́ɔmā í lɛ ohílīpú dúúmā ŋ́. Óō lɛ nɛ̄, ó yɛ í da īyī nū kahíníī, N kwu ōhī kú ɔcí nyā ú kpó ce kwu ɔlá, kē lɛ igbō yá ɛyí ɔlá ā. N klla le ɔlá ā pá ɛbɛ́ le lé. Ohile kú ɔcí ā nɛ̄ n je gbā ɛcí yɔ̄ á. Abɔ̄ ó lɛ ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ ī tukpɛɛ́, yɔ̄ ī gbā ígbɔ̄cí ɛ̄gbā ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass after these things, that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ éyi nēé hī ka Unábɔ̄tu ā lɛ ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin éyi nōo kwu pī agblɔ́cɛ́ kú Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu nōo yɔ̄ Ujɛsiríili ā.

eng_Latn: And when Judah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ujúda gā ɛgiyí inɔ̄ɔda nōo kwu ígbíli ā, é le icō tū gaá fēēyīkpeé má aáklɔ̄kpɛ kú ɛfú kú aólɛlā kú uwā ā, anɔ́ɔ é má ka odúúdú aólɛlā kú uwā le pīya okwū bá ajɛ gbeélé. Odúúmā kú uwá í hile ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For shame hath devoured the labour of our fathers from our youth; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ŋmá eko íkée ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu, nōo wɛ ɔdā uwēyī ɔ́ɔmā, nɛ̄ alɔ húmáyī pā ā, cɛ̄ lɛ aɛ́na mɛ́mla aálá kú alɔ mɛ tū ajɛ ɛɛ́. Kwu ayí alɔ mɛ́mla ɔdā dúúdú nɛ̄ aádáádā alɔ húmáyī yúklɔ́ nū ā mɛ tū ajɛ dúú.

eng_Latn: And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ó da uwá kahíníī, N géē nyɔ̄ gaá tɔ́ɔna kú ɔ̄kōolɔhi ohígbū ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō ipú aígelī ɔhá dúú, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō tū um ɛhɔ̄ wā á.

eng_Latn: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō gē cɔ̄nū da uwá í kpó uwā yíífi ŋmá ajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ owu nɛ̄hi gē kpó odée bónū ā.

eng_Latn: And Isaac called Jacob, and blessed him, and charged him, and said unto him, Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le Ujékɔ̄pu hīgwú, ó le ɔhā hɛ́ ce ɔ́, anɔ́ɔ ó kahíníī, A híī lɛ ɔnyā ŋmá ipú ayínɔ̄nyā kú Ukénan ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.
idu_Latn: Igbīhi ɛnyā ā, Umanásɛ le ɔdɔ kú igelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujerúsālɛm ɔhá gwó kwu āyā kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā kú ɛgiyí ɔpɛ́ kú ɔkpá kú Ugíhɔn ā, ɛgiyí ɔwɛ kú ɛbéenyi ā. Ó ma ɔ́ gaá kwu ɛga nēé hī ka Ófelu ā. Ó klla le aótrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kpó kéē leyīkwu aícɔ́ɔja nēe bá ipú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú Ujúda nēé hɛ́ igá olɔfú tū uwā kpɛ́mm ā.

eng_Latn: The breaker is come up before them: they have broken up, and have passed through the gate, and are gone out by it: and their king shall pass before them, and the LORD on the head of them.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō géē nwūla ɔwɛ lɛ uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ ó lɛ uwā kpó bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ajɛ nēé kwú uwā nyɔ̄ abɔ̄fú ā. É géē je ca wɛ̄ɛcɛ bū ɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī ā kéē nyɔ̄ áncā. Ɔcɛ́ kú uwā, Óndú ā abɔ̄yīnū géē kpó uwā bɛ̄cɛ.

eng_Latn: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent me unto you.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka abɔ̄ n kē le ka lɛ aá ɛɛ́ mā, aá kē cɛ̄ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ ɛlā kú Uyáwɛ, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aá ā, nōó tū um ɛhɔ̄ ka amíyɔ̄ da aá ā gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears; not that ye should be grieved, but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ n tɔ́kpá ɔ́ɔmā fu aá ā, ɔtū bīya gā um nɛ̄hi, ɔtū kú um klla le wuklíicō nōo cɛ̄ gā um yɔ̄ gē jikwū. N tɔ́kpá ā fu aá, o yá ká n̄ lɛ aá ɔtū bīya ŋ́, amáŋ o yá kú aá jé ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aá he um ɔtū lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Zidon; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee: and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall have executed judgments in her, and shall be sanctified in her.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ ami, Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka lɛyíkwu uwá ā ka lɛ ācɛ nē e bá abɔ́ɔ ā. Da uwá ka ami ɔ́ɔ ka, Usídɔn, n kwú pīya olɛlā kú uwɔ ɛɛ́. Ācɛ géē cɛ̄tra um ohígbū ɔdā nɛ̄ n géē yá ipú uwɔ ā. É kē géē jé ka ami ɔ́ɔ wɛ Óndú ā á, eko nɛ̄ n le mafú ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ n tīhɔ lɛ a ŋmá lɛ ōwē nɛ̄ n gáā je lɛ ācɛ nɛ̄ ē lā ipú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ā.

eng_Latn: Now they have known that all things whatsoever thou hast given me are of thee.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā é jé ka ɔdā dóódu nāa je gā um ā ŋmá abɔ̄ kú uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
idu_Latn: Ucérūbim ɛpa ā géē lɛ acá kú uwá nāńda klá ɔ̄wū kú ikpati ā kúē géē pīyeyī tá iyī uwā. Cɛ́ɛ́ acá kú uwá nōo nāŋdaa ā géē klá ɛyí ɔ̄wū ā.

eng_Latn: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.
idu_Latn: É lɛ ijakī ā bī gé lɛ Ujísɔ̄si. Anɔ́ɔ é lɛ úwé kú uwā kpó klá ijakī ā, anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si nyɔ̄ í ce ɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
idu_Latn: O lɔhi, ufi Ɔwɔicō nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ i yá ā i yá kú ɔ̄cɛ kóō lɛ agbénú, ɔ́dāŋ ká ɔdā nɛ̄ ó lɛ ā jɛ̄ ɔ̄ eyī.

eng_Latn: It may be the LORD thy God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God; and will reprove the words which the LORD thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left.
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɛ́ɛ̄ da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ekōhī, Óndú ā, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ kē pó odúúdú ɛlā kú Urábisāke otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔcɛ́ nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Asírīya, nɛ̄ ɔkpani nū, ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya tū wā í cá Ɔwɔicō oyēeyī kú alɔ ɛcá ā. Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú uwɔ kóō lɛ ɛcá ā pó, cɛ́ɛ́ kɔ́ɔ̄ lɛ italā yá ɔ̄cɛ nōo kɛlā nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, gbɔ̄ɔkɔ lɛ Ɔwɔicō ohígbū ācɛ kú alɔ nēe hile ā.

eng_Latn: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath in them.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ n yɔ̄ ī má ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ ī yá ā, aíli mɛ́mla ɛ́nɛ́bɛ́ ɔkpíyē gáā klá uwá iyē, anɔ́ɔ ɔkpíyē gáā klá uwá á. Amáŋ é lɛ owu dúúmā ipú uwá ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
idu_Latn: Ukóhāti ma ayí nēe bá ā: Ámram, Ísiha, Uhɛ́brɔn mɛ́mla Usíyɛ̄lu á.

eng_Latn: And the flax and the barley was smitten: for the barley was in the ear, and the flax was bolled.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú aɔ́dɛ̄hɔ̄ nɛ̄ bá ī héepu mɛ́mla aɛ́nɛ̄ e bá ī nwūla kpɛ́m ā, kwú kpó yíífi ŋmáajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ kú ɛcɛ ā géē lā ipú ofíyajɛ kú ɔlá nōo ŋmá igelī ā. Aɔ́cɛ́ kú ɛcɛ ā kē í bī agbénú kú uwā wā ipú nū.

eng_Latn: Therefore say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even gather you from the people, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
idu_Latn: Le da uwá ka ami, Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā, ka n géē tá uwá bá ŋmá ipú aéwo nɛ̄ n pa uwá hīla nyɔ̄ ā. N klla í je ajɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu a kwúcē igbīhi lɛ uwá.

eng_Latn: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as the LORD of hosts thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath he dealt with us.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ɛlā nɛ̄ n ka bū okónu kú ācomɛ́ɛbɛ kú um lɛ aádáádā ā, í lɛ uwá kwú ŋ́ nɛɛ? Eko nēé le italā kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nēé yá ā yá uwā ā, é le pīyabɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ é lɛ um jé klla kahíníī, Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā le italā yá alɔ ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ o cíkā lɛ ucē obɔ̄bí nɛ̄ alɔ yá ā, mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā dɔɔ̄kā kóō yá alɔ lɛ á ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew it unto you.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā dóódu nɛ̄ Ádā um lɛ ā wɛ ákú um, ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ n ka, Ó géē da aá ɔdā nɛ̄ ó í pó ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā á.

eng_Latn: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú gē kwinya eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í nū ɔ̄ inya ŋ́ mā. Amáŋ ācɛ okpaakpa lɛ ɔtū lé ká bɛ̄ɛka ágábá ā.

eng_Latn: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and mine eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, ń cɛ̄ ŋ́ jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n wā í lɛ ɔ́ má abɔ̄yī um. Amáŋ ń kōō pó gaajɛ āyā kú ɔdā nɛ̄ um má ā ŋ́. Íjééyī mɛ́mla agbénú kú uwɔ ā fíyɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ n pó ā á.

eng_Latn: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ n ka ā, le kpó yá ɛɛ́. Aá cíkā ō cɛ̄ ka ɛlā nɛ̄ um ka ā ɔ́ɔ le yá ɔkwɛ̄yi mɛ́ ŋ́? Oŋmá abālɔbányā, n géē da aá aɔ́dā ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ nēe gáā yá ā. Aɔ́dā ɔ́ɔmā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ aá tɛtɛ jé gbɔbū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá Umídiyan le tá Upáran ɛga nɛ̄ ācɛnyīlɔ ōhī le pɛ́ tū ipú uwā. É klla ŋmá abɔ́ɔ le tá Íjīpiti, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ ga ɛgiyí Uféro, ɔcɛ́ kú Íjīpiti. Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Íjīpiti ā le ajɛ mɛ́mla ɔdōlé mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ kpó lɛ Uhádādi.

eng_Latn: And he builded an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there: and there Isaac's servants digged a well.
idu_Latn: Áyísīki le ede ma abɔ́ɔ, le ɔkɔ gbā lɛ Ɔwɔicō klla le áklɔ̄kpɛ kú nū cē kwaajɛ abɔ́ɔ. Abɔ́ɔ ā, ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Áyísīki ā klla le obugā ɔhá bū.

eng_Latn: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ ā géē gwéeyē, ohígbū ka Ɔwɔicō le aólɛlā kú nū kpó yálé lɛ ɔ́. Ācɛ nēe kē ī bī iyē kú Ɔwɔicō cokónu ā géē cɛ̄tra anú. Amáŋ okónu kú ācɛ o kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ā géē klá cíí.

eng_Latn: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
idu_Latn: N géē gbēyī lígíí ɛga nēé ī hɛ́ ɔkpá bēhé ga ígbíli ā, jāā gbéeko nɛ̄ n le ɔdā nōo gáā yá ā pó ŋmá ɛgiyí uwɔ.

eng_Latn: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ híī jāhɔ̄ lɛ uwá ɛ́ɛ́, nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ kōō ī pó ɛlā kú uwā ŋ́. Ó ka ɛ́ɛ híī méyīnyinyi kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɛ́ɛ gē je ɔ́ tayínū ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā blakwu ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ a gbonɛnɛ klla gē ményīnyi klla gē yíihɔtū tū um eko dóódu ā.

eng_Latn: And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; they shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla ka kpɔ́ kahíníī, N géē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um kwúcē wā í lā ajɛ kú uwā kpɔ́. É géē tú aígelī nɛ̄hi kú uwā gwó kpɔ́, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē lā abɔ́ɔ. É géē nyi ɔcí kú ufáyin klla í gwá ejé kú nū, É géē hɛ́hɔ̄ klla í lé ɔdɛ̄hɔ̄ nēé bī ŋmá ɛhɔ̄ nēé hí ā.

eng_Latn: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
idu_Latn: Ó ka é géē má ɛdɔ ōwē ékpónú ā mla ācɛ o hile ā dúú. Ó klla ka anúɔ géē cíla uwá ulé, í yá ūwā italā kú íne nēé bīya ā.

eng_Latn: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
idu_Latn: N má ācɛ kú Ukússan bá ī yúufi, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Umídiya kē bá ī fīyégbúlú á.

eng_Latn: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Umósīsi, ɔ̄cotɛ̄hɔ̄ kú Óndú ā gekwú ipú ajɛ kú Umówābu, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Óndú ā tɛtɛ ka lɛ āa.

eng_Latn: Then David went over to the other side, and stood on the top of an hill afar off; a great space being between them:
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi mɛ́mla Abíssāyi le bēhé ɔpɛ́ ā le tá āyā ɔhá kú ɛfu ā, gaá háyi ɛyí ɛfu ɔhá, ɛga nɛ̄ abɔ̄ í gáā kwu ɔ̄ glá ŋ́ mā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had invaded the south, and Ziklag, and smitten Ziklag, and burned it with fire;
idu_Latn: Igbīhi nɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɛpa le gla ā, Udéfīdi mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū gā Usíkilāgi. Eko nɛ̄ Udéfīdi í yɔ̄ ɔlɛ́ ŋ́ mā, ācɛ kú Ámālɛ̄ki wā í le ɔfú kpó kwū ɛháajɛ kú Ujúda mɛ́mla Usíkilāgi. É kwú Usíkilāgi ú yɔlá tāajɛ dúúdú.

eng_Latn: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
idu_Latn: Ipú iháyí ɔ́mɛɛnɛ nɛ̄ Ujɛhóyākim, ɔyí kú Ujosíya wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā, Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛhɔ̄ tū Ujeremíya lɛyíkwu odúúdú ācɛ kú Ujúda.

eng_Latn: The LORD shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father's house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā yɔ̄ ī bī unwalu wā gé lɛ awɔ mɛ́mla ācɛ kú ipɔ́ɔ́nū kú ɔlɛ́ uwɔ ŋmá ɛgiyí ācɛ kú Asiríya. Ó géē wɛ ɛdɔ kú unwalu nɛ̄ ɛdɔ kú nū í kōō yɔ̄ jééjéē ɛ́ɛ́ ŋ́ ŋmíífī nɛ̄ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu je fō ŋmá Ujúda ā.

eng_Latn: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ulífāyi ohile ā gē leyīkwu iyō kú ipú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ɔhá á. É gē kpó uwā wɛ̄ɛcɛ lɛ ācɛ, ɛ́ɛ́ kéē klla kpó uwā tū ɛga nēé ī kpó uwā ŋmá gaá bī uwā le yá odée ā.

eng_Latn: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
idu_Latn: Ujɛramīīlu lɛ ɔnyā ɔha lɛ, iyē ɔnyā ā lé ka Atára. Anú wɛ ɛ́nɛ́ kú Ónam á.

eng_Latn: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok's son, and Jonathan Abiathar's son; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear.
idu_Latn: Ó klla da ɔ́ ka Ahímāasi, ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú Usádɔ̄ku, mɛ́mla Ujonátan, ɔyínɔ̄yīlɔ kú Abíyāta bá mɛ́mla uwá. Ka ɔ́ɔ lɔfú tū uwā ɛhɔ̄ fu anúɔ ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔ́ɔ lɛ ɔdā dóódu pó ŋmá agbla kú ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ ōhī kú ipú ɛwa ā le ɔkɔ cɛyí le odée ka, ācɛ ɔhá kē le ɔdā ɔhá ka. Abɔ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ā í lɔfú jé ɔdā nōo yá ā glá ŋ́ ohígbū ígbájí nōo yɔ̄ ā, ó lɛ ɔ́da je kéē lɛ Upɔ́lu bī ga ɔlɛ́ aícɔ́ɔja.

eng_Latn: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ɔyíkpó ɔhá, nōo wā ɛgiyí únóji ā aflɛ́yí ā, le bēhé wā ipú nū á, anɔ́ɔ ó le ɔ́ má, ó kē cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: And he said unto him, Went not mine heart with thee, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet thee? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ɛláyíssa da ɔ́ ɔ̄kā kahíníī, Alelékwū kú um í nyɔ̄ mla awɔ eko nɛ̄ Unáaman hīlatá wāajɛ ŋmá úgbɔ́nya gaá jīla awɔ ɔwɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ? Eko nyā í wɛ eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ í mīyɛ ije, otóngwō, anɔ̄ kú ɔcí nēé hī ka ólīfu, aálá, aɛ́na, aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla ɔfiyɛ nɔ̄nyīlɔ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the LORD be upon you: we bless you in the name of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā nōo yɔ̄ ī yɛ ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ má, ó gáā ka kahíníī, Ɔwɔicō kóō hɔ́hā ce uwɔ, ŋ́, ɛ́ɛ́ nēé gē ka, Alɔ hɔ́hā ce uwɔ o ŋmá iyē kú Óndú ā, ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n kahíníī, Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú, a jé ka ɔ̄comɛ́ɛbɛ ā yɔ̄ ī da ācɛ ā ka ɛfú ámāŋ ɔkpɛtā ɔ́ɔ́ gáā yɔ̄ gɛ ŋ́, ohígbū ka a lɛ okónu ce ɛɛ́, é ka, ɛbɔ́ ofōōfūnū gáā yɔ̄ ipú ajɛ kú alɔ á.

eng_Latn: And Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ó da ɔ́ kóō kwú aáhingílí ā í kpó wu ipú aácá kú nū, cɛ́ɛ́ ka ɔ́ngbá ā ka ɔ́ɔ yá ɔ̄ ágbe acá ŋ́. Ujeremíya lɛ yá lɛ ā.

eng_Latn: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
idu_Latn: Ahi ō kwú gē yá ɔ̄cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔwɛ nɛ̄ ó yɔ̄ ī yɛ ā, wɛ ujūūjē ā. Amáŋ ɔwɛ kú ɔ̄cɛ ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ā í lɛ unwalu ɛga dúúmā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ é gā ɔlɛ́ ɛgiyí ádā uwā, Ujékɔ̄pu, ajɛ kú Ukénan ā, é lɛ ɔdā dóódu nōo yá uwā ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́.

eng_Latn: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka ɛ̄cī nēe bá abɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ɛ̄cī nēé géē yá ācɛ italā. Ó yá ɛ́ɛ́ kú ɔdā nēé tá tāajɛ ipú ɔkpíihɔ ā kóō le cɛ̄.

eng_Latn: The children of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
idu_Latn: Ayí kú Ussɛ́m wɛ Ɛ́lam mɛ́mla Ássɔ mɛ́mla Ápākssadi mɛ́mla Ulúdu mɛ́mla Áram.

eng_Latn: And the man departed out of the city from Bethlehemjudah to sojourn where he could find a place: and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah, as he journeyed.
idu_Latn: Ó nyɛ̄ ŋmá Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m nyɔ̄ í dɔɔ̄kā ɛga ɔhá kóō lā. Eko nōó yɔ̄ ī ga iyawu kú nū ā, ó ga ɔlɛ́ Umíka nōo yɔ̄ ajɛ ɛyí ɛfu kú Ɛ́frem ā.

eng_Latn: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu gbo iyāwu ikpó kú uwā ŋmá Urámɛ̄sis lɛyíkwu Usúkɔ̄tu. É lɛbɛ̄ɛka ācɛ , ācɛnyā mɛ́mla ayípɛ̄ í kwu uwá ɛɛ́ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered morter, and will say unto you, The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
idu_Latn: Ó ka ɔwɛ ɔ́ɔmā nɛ̄ anúɔ géē cɔ̄nū í yá ɔdɔ ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe lɛ áfū nya ɔdɔ ā ɛlā. Ka anúɔ géē da uwɔ ka ɔdɔ ā mla ācɛ nēe lɛ áfū nya ɔ́ ā le pɛ́ le yɛ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
idu_Latn: Umósīsi yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ ka eko nɛ̄ uwá ɔ́ɔ pó ɔkɔ ŋmá ipú obū eko nɛ̄ ɔlá yɔ̄ ī yi odúúdú ɛfu ā, mɛ́mla obū ɛyí ɛfu ā, eko nɛ̄ ɛfu ā yɔ̄ ī yɔlá ā, aɔ́cɛ́ kú uwā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú aípɔ́ɔmā kú uwā ɛ́ɛ le pɛ́ wā ɛgiyí anúɔ.

eng_Latn: Then came in all the king's wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ odúúdú ācojééyī kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā kwú pɛ́ wā inu, amáŋ é jé ɔkpá nyā glá ɛɛ́ nēé gē jé ɛyí nū, nēé gē ka lɛ ɔcɛ́ ā ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;
idu_Latn: Ɔwɛ ékpónú ā, ācɛ o yúklɔ́ ipú icɔ́ɔci cíkā ō lɛ ucē o lɔhi. É gáā kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́, ó híī wɛ ɔ̄cɛ o gwá ije nɛ̄ɛ̄nɛ̄hi ŋ́, ámāŋ ka ācɛ o hágágā ije ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
idu_Latn: Āyā nēé je mɛ́ɛ́ ā, kwú pīya āyā nɛ̄ Umɔ́dɛkāyi je ɔkwu ujɔ̄ nēé tū gāá ŋmó ɔcɛ́ ā tɛ́ɛcɛ ā. Ujɔ̄ kú Ubigītána mɛ́mla Utéresi, aídibo ɛpa, nēe gē gbō ɔwɛ kú inu ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā.

eng_Latn: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
idu_Latn: Awɔ yá otú mɛ́mla ɔlɛ́ɛnɔ á. Awɔ kpó ɛnɔ mɛ́mla ɔyā kwu ɛga nēé kwu á.

eng_Latn: When the princes of Judah heard these things, then they came up from the king's house unto the house of the LORD, and sat down in the entry of the new gate of the LORD's house.
