idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ aótrɛ̄yí kú ācɛ ā lɛ ɛ̄nyā pó ā, é le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá agblɔ̄cɛ́ ā gaá cíce okómpinu ɛ̄yīpɛ̄ kú Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: Then said David, O LORD God of Israel, thy servant hath certainly heard that Saul seeketh to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi le ɔkɔ gbā ka awɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú Ísrɛ̄lu, anúɔ le pó ka Usɔ́lu ɔ́ɔ yɔ̄ í yá ojuju ká ɔ̄ wā ɛga nɛ̄ anúɔ yɔ̄ ā, gāá kpó ācɛ kú Ukéyīla ŋmó ohígbū anúɔ.

eng_Latn: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
idu_Latn: Ɛcɛ le kpɔ́kpɔ́lɔ́kpɔ́ ā. Ó klla táncā. Éŋkpɔ̄ nɛ̄hi bɛ̄ɛka itekwú ā mīyɛ ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ɛcɛ tābɔ̄. Ɛbɛɛbɛ le dobū kpímm. Cɛ́ɛ́ alelékwū kú Ɔwɔicō yɔ̄ ī yɛ gla eyī kú éŋkpɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
idu_Latn: N lɛ ɛbɛ kú ɔdōbɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi má ɛɛ́. Ó wɛ ɛbɛ kú ibīyāajɛ nēe í yá tū uwɔ, mɛ́mla ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ é géē je uwɔ yíifi ā. Aícɔ́ɔja kú Ɛlam, aá gaá kpɛ́fú tú ɔ̄, aícɔ́ɔja kú Umɛ́dīya, aá lɛ íbɔm cē tū ɔ̄ kú aá kpɛ́fú tá uwá. Aá mīyɛ igelī kú uwá ā, cɛ́ɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō lɛ odúúdú ōwē nɛ̄ Ubábīlɔn tū klá ācɛ ā ŋmɛ́yí.

eng_Latn: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔ́dāŋ ka aá cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú ɔdā nōó tá ā ŋ́, ɛ́gɛ́nyā nɛ̄ aá géē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā kú um glá ā.

eng_Latn: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the LORD.
idu_Latn: Eko ɔ́ɔma ā, n géē kpó ācɛ ɔlɛ́ aá nēe fíyákátā ā wā ɔlɛ́. Eko nɛ̄ n lɛ aá túbá tɔhā kwɛyí, n géē yá kú aá le lóofu odúúdú ipú ɛcɛ nyā, ká odúúdú ācɛ kéē cɛ̄tra aá. N géē yá kú aá jɛ̄ gɔbū, kú aá klla le gbagbénú kpɔ́. Abɔ̄ Óndú ā ka lɛ a á.

eng_Latn: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.
idu_Latn: Usólōmɔn yɔ̄ ī kɛlā gɔbū kpɔ́ kahíníī, N lɛ Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi kú ojīlīmā, ɛga nāa géē lā piyóó ipú ɛcɛ nyā gwó gā uwɔ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
idu_Latn: Hokónu tū Uprisílla mɛ́mla Akwíla mɛ́mla ācɛ ɔlɛ́ Onesifórɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
idu_Latn: Óndú í gē yíihɔtū tá ācɛ nɛ̄ ɔdōbɔ̄bí í he uwá ɔtū ŋ́. Ó gē gbō oyēeyī kú ācɛ kú nū. Ó gē nya uwá tá ŋmá ɔfú kú ācobɔ̄bíipú.

eng_Latn: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side, a portion for Naphtali.
idu_Latn: Unáfutāli géē lɛ ukpɛ̄ éyi, nōo gboce Ássa ŋmá ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ga ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄nɛ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the LORD.
idu_Latn: Ó yɛce ɔwɛ kú ɔ́bíipú mɛ́mla ɔwɛ kú íne ō bīya kú aɔ́cɛ́ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā. Ɛdɔ kú ɔ́bíipú nɛ̄ Áhābu, ɔcɛ́ ā bī ā, nɛ̄ ó bī dúú á. Ohígbū ka ó lɛ ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Áhābu éyi lɛ. Ujɛhóram le ɔ́bíipú bī tū Óndú ā nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujísɔ̄si lɛ ɔdā nōo yɔ̄ gē yá ā má ā, ó le cɔ̄nū mla ayíkpó kú nū anɔ́ɔ ó ka, aá jɛɛga lɛ ayípɛ̄nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ kéē wā ɛgiyí um, aá híī ci uwá anú ŋ́, ohígbū ka ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō wɛ ákú aɛ́dɔ ācɛ nēe bá mbáa.

eng_Latn: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
idu_Latn: Aá dɛ̄ íbá, ācɛ kú Ugálim; aa jāhɔ, ācɛ kú Iláisa, Aá tá ohi, ācɛ kú Ánatɔ̄ɔtu!.

eng_Latn: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity shall have an end,
idu_Latn: Ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu, awɔ, ɔ̄cobɔ̄bíipú, nɔ́ɔ wɛ ákú Ɔwɔicō ŋ́ ma. Ɛ̄cī kú uwɔ nēé gáā yá uwɔ ōwē ā ga ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛ ā, n géē yá aá, ɔdā nɛ̄ n gbɛlá ō yá ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand: and I heard the number of them.
idu_Latn: É da um álūka kú aícɔ́ɔja nēe ce ɔnya ā. É wɛ ācɛ umíliyɔn ofigwó.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in the morning, that he went out, and stood, and said to all the people, Ye be righteous: behold, I conspired against my master, and slew him: but who slew all these?
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔɔcī ā, ó le tá okónɔɔwɛ kú igá kú igelī ā, anɔ́ɔ ó da ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā kahíníī, Ami tū ujɔ̄ tū ɔcɛ́ Ujóram je ɔ́ ŋmó á. Ó wɛ aá lɛ ɛfiyɛ kú ɔ́ɔmā ŋ́, amáŋ ɔnyɛ ŋmó ācɛ ɛ̄nɛ̄ e bá nyā ā.

eng_Latn: He said, Bring them hither to me.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujísɔ̄si kahíníī, Áá lɛ uwá kpó gē um amānyā.

eng_Latn: These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.
idu_Latn: N le ɛlā nēe bá nyā ka lɛ aá eko nɛ̄ n yɔ̄ mla aá ā.

eng_Latn: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
idu_Latn: Ó ka ācɛ ā wɛ aágwu. Ɛ́ɛ klla lɛwa, bɛ̄ɛka ācɛ kú Ánāki ā, amáŋ Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ le uwá yíífi, gbɔbū ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔni nyɔ̄ í mīyɛ ajɛ abɔ́ɔ, klla má lā anú á.

eng_Latn: And when they of Ashdod arose early on the morrow, behold, Dagon was fallen upon his face to the earth before the ark of the LORD. And they took Dagon, and set him in his place again.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɔ̄ɔ̄cī kú oŋmɔ́ɔ̄cī nū, ācɛ kú Ássīdɔdu má ka ojibó kú ɛcí kú uwā, Udégɔn ā má gwōnū lɛ eyī pīya klá ajɛ iyɔ̄bū Ikpati kú Ɛka kú Óndú ā. É gaá kwú ɔ̄ ú gicō, kwú ɔ̄ ú hayi ɛga nɛ̄ ó tɛtɛ háyi ā.

eng_Latn: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ nēe pɛ́ gebí ipú éŋkpɔ̄ ā le pɛ́ nyɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō kɛpɔ̄ tū uwā. Ikwu mɛ́mla ɔlékwū mabɔ̄ ācɛ nēe bá ipú uwā ā tá wɛ̄ɛcɛ dúú. Anɔ́ɔ Ɔwɔicō lɛ ɛpɔ̄ ka tū odúúdú uwā ɛ́gɛ́ ɔdā nɛ̄ ɔnyɔɔnyɛ yá ā.

eng_Latn: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast forgotten me, and cast me behind thy back, therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms.
idu_Latn: Ɛ̄nyā wɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā gē ka á, Abɔ̄ a kwú ɛlá um gwō, kwú igbīhi ú ce kwú um ā, a géē móōwē kú unwū ācɛnyīlɔ mla akwuna nāa yá ā.

eng_Latn: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she lighted off the camel.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Urebéka le Áyísīki má ā, ó le hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí inyankwūlūmī nōó cɛyí nū ā.

eng_Latn: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
idu_Latn: Aá híī je ɔtū nɛ̄ aá kpóce Óndú ā tónū ŋ́, ohígbū ɔ́dāŋ́ ka aá yɔ̄ ī lɔtū, aá géē mīyɛ ulé nɛ̄hi.

eng_Latn: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā lɛ ɔkwu kú ɔ́kpa nōó bī ā kwu ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla igbō mɛ́mla anɔ̄ kú nū ā ɛyí ɛcɔ̄ á, anɔ́ɔ ɔlá le bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ɛcɔ̄ ā kwú ɛbɛ́ mɛ́mla igbō ā ú kpó yi. Anɔ́ɔ alelékwū-ōtɛ̄hɔ̄ ā gebí tāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.
idu_Latn: Ɔkwɔɔkwu nɛ̄ Atálīya le pó ka Ujéhu ɔ́ɔ kwú ɔyí anúɔ ú ŋmó ā, ó le ɔ́da je gaá lɛ odúúdú ayí kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ kú Ujúda ā kpó ŋmó.

eng_Latn: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink.
idu_Latn: É le ejé nēé cēkplá mɛ́mla ɔdā ohɔ́nɔ je lɛ ɔ́ kóō gwá. Amáŋ eko nōó lɛ okónu kwu ɔ́ ā, ó tá ō gwá.

eng_Latn: Then sought they for Jesus, and spake among themselves, as they stood in the temple, What think ye, that he will not come to the feast?
idu_Latn: É bá yɔ̄ ī dɔɔ̄kā Ujísɔ̄si, uwá ka ɔtāhɛ̄ iyī uwā eko nēé bá Agblīihɔ-nɛ̄hi ā kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ aá gbɛlá? Kóō gáā wā ɛgiyí ucɛ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled, and got him out.
idu_Latn: Eko nōó le pó ka n le ɔkɔcɛyí le ɛgba dɛ̄ ā, ó habɔ̄ úwé kú nū tá wu um abɔ̄, anɔ́ɔ ó le kwu bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá inu á.

eng_Latn: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
idu_Latn: Ó ka nááná nɛ̄ Ísrɛ̄lu ɔ́ɔ kōō jɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ácí kú okónu ɔkpá ā. Ó ka anúɔ géē tū owu okwɔ́lá kú ɛnɔ̄ɔ̄cī ā wā í je njɔlɔ kú éŋkpɔ̄ kú nū ā ŋmó ŋmá ajɛ. Ɔdā dóódu nōo ce ɔ́ ɛ̄gbā kóō bī ɔ̄ jɛ̄ ā, anúɔ géē kpó ɔ̄ ŋmá ajɛ.

eng_Latn: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
idu_Latn: Ó géē je uwá kpó yíífi ohígbū ɛlā nēé ka ɔ́ɔmā, odúúdú ācɛ nēe í má uwá ā géē yá uwā ɛbɛ́.

eng_Latn: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kahíníī, Ohígbū ka ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í pūla alɔ úklɔ́ ŋ́. Ó da uwá kahíníī, Aá ga ipú ɛhɔ̄ ufáyin kú um nyɔ̄ í yúklɔ́ dúú.

eng_Latn: And when the centurion, which stood over against him, saw that he so cried out, and gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ eko nɛ̄ otrɛ̄yí kú aícɔ́ɔja ofɛhɔ̄ nōo háyi iyɔ̄bū nū ā, nōo má ɔ̄ abɔ̄ ó dɛ̄gba klla mā owu ā kahíníī, Ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi, ɔ̄cɛ ā wɛ ɔyí kú Ɔwɔicō.

eng_Latn: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ é kwú aɛ́cɔ̄ ɔhá ú gwu ɔkwu kú aɛ́nɛ̄ é fu ŋmá ɔdɔ ā, klla lɛ ɔdɔ ā plla igbɔhá kpɔ́.

eng_Latn: But meat commendeth us not to God: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
idu_Latn: Ɔdōlé o yɔ̄ í lé í je alɔ pīya ācɛ olɔhi fíyɛ́ iyɔ̄bū Ɔwɔicō ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka alɔ í lé ŋ́, ɔ́ɔmā í tá alɔ gɛcɛ ŋmá ɛgiyí Ɔwɔicō ŋ́. Ɛma kú alɔ mɛ́mla Ɔwɔicō í kē lɔhi fíyɛ́ ɔ́dāŋ nɛ̄ alɔ le lé ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
idu_Latn: N jé kpɔ́cíí ka n géē tíne ká n̄ yēeyī gɔbɔ̄ɔ̄bū. N géē yēeyī gɔbū kú n tá aá abɔ̄, kú ɔtū kú aá kóō wɛ ɛnɛ̄hɛ́ abɔ̄ aá gē lɔtūce Ohɔ́nyɛtá ā.

eng_Latn: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, they shall come near to me to minister unto me, and they shall stand before me to offer unto me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō ā klla kahíníī, Ācogwɛ́ɛya nɛ̄ ē ŋmá ipɔ́ɔma kú Ulífāyi ipú inū kú Usádɔ̄ku ā lɛyítáajɛ gā um, klla gbā um ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa, eko nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu o hile ā kwúcē ŋmá ɛgiyí um ā. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā, uwá gáā cɛ̄ um ɛhɔ̄ klla í wā ɛyí ede kú um ā gáā je ijē mɛ́mla oyī kú aɛ́bɛ́ ɛya ā gā um á.

eng_Latn: And there they preached the gospel.
idu_Latn: É tɔ́ɔna kú Ɔ̄kōolɔhi ā abɔ́ɔ dúú.

eng_Latn: But it came to pass at the time when Merab Saul's daughter should have been given to David, that she was given unto Adriel the Meholathite to wife.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ eko nɛ̄ eko le yá kéē je Umérabu lɛ Udéfīdi kóō lɛ ā, é kwú ɔ̄ ú lɛ Adríyɛlu nōo ŋmá Umēhóla ā.

eng_Latn: And the men arose, and went away: and Joshua charged them that went to describe the land, saying, Go and walk through the land, and describe it, and come again to me, that I may here cast lots for you before the LORD in Shiloh.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ā gbɔɔ́ ō nyɔ̄ í jīla ajɛ ā eko nɛ̄ Ujóssuwa le ukɔ́ tū uwā kwɛyí, kéē ga ipú odúúdú ajɛ ā kéē lɛ ɔ́ má, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē le pīyɛyí wā ɛgiyí anúɔ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ujósuwa kahíníī, Cɛ́ɛ́ Ussílo amānyā ā, n lɛ ūlī tá ká n̄ má ɔdā nɛ̄ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō kú aá bī ɔtū lɛyíkwu ɔ́ ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Áyísīki lā abɔ́ɔ yɛɛ ā, Abímɛ́lɛ̄ki, ɔcɛ́ kú Ufilítiya le eyī bū uwíndo yɔ̄ ī má ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó má Áyísīki yɔ̄ gē tɔ́ɔkɔ tá ɔnyā nū á.

eng_Latn: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu abɔ̄yī uwā ā í wɛ ipú úklɔ́ abɔ̄fú kú Usólōmɔn nyā ŋ́. Amáŋ é wɛ aícɔ́ɔja kú úgbɔ́nya, aícɔ́ɔja īkpó mɛ́mla ācɛ okpɛ́fú ɔnya.

eng_Latn: So David prevailed over the Philistine with a sling and with a stone, and smote the Philistine, and slew him; but there was no sword in the hand of David.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Udéfīdi bī ítū mla ɛcɔ̄ lɛ Ugolíyāti yálé klla le ɔ́ ŋmó á. Udéfīdi í bī ɛ̄wā dúúmā abɔ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
idu_Latn: Aá kllɔcɛ́ kú aá jé ɔdā nōo he Óndú ā ɔtū.

eng_Latn: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
idu_Latn: Iyē kú nū yɔ̄ ī fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔwɔ o límanya ā, eyī kú nū gē cɛ bɛ̄ɛka ɔlá kú akpáabana ā. Īkpēyī kú nū yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄ bɛ̄ɛka ígblɛ́nyī ɔlá ā. Abɔ̄ mɛ́mla ikpó kú nū gē fíyajɛ bɛ̄ɛka oje ɔdɔ nēé le nyā péee ā. Ɔkɛlā kú nū gē gwō bɛ̄ɛka ɔkɔ kú ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ ā.

eng_Latn: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ alɛwa le úwé kú uwā kpó klá ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ kóō yɛ ɛyí nū. Ācɛ ōhī lɛ abɔ̄ kú ɔcí hɛ́ anɔ́ɔ é lɛ ɔ́ kpɔ́ bá ɔwɛ lɛ ɔ́ kóō yɛ ɛyí nū dúú á.

eng_Latn: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the LORD, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
idu_Latn: Lɛ ɔbɛ́ɛna ā ŋmó abɔ́ɔ ipéyī ami Óndú ā, Okómpíinu kú Áklɔ̄kpīihɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And the LORD delivered it also, and the king thereof, into the hand of Israel; and he smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls that were therein; he let none remain in it; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā klla cɛ̄ lɛ uwá lɛ ɔlɛ́ ɔ́ɔmā mɛ́mla ɔcɛ́ kú nū yálé. É mā ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā kú uwá tá ŋ́. É le uwá kpó ŋmó. Ɔdā néē yá ɔcɛ́ kú Ujérīko ā néē yá ɔcɛ́ kú abɔ́ɔ dúú á.

eng_Latn: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
idu_Latn: N gē gbɔ̄ɔkɔ kú Ɔwɔicō kóō yɔ̄ gē méyīnyinyi aá, yɔ̄ ī je ɛbɔ́ lɛ aá, klla yɔ̄ ī ma ihɔtū fú lɛ aá ā nwunééné fíyɛ́.

eng_Latn: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ owu okwɔ́lá gbɔɔ́ ō tá ŋmá ɛháajɛ ā, a gē yɔ̄ ī bū ahɛ tū ipú īlī nɛ̄ a le wiiyē ā.

eng_Latn: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
idu_Latn: É tū kpu ɔ̄cɛɔnɛ̄ mla ámíyā, amáŋ ɔciɔcī a é gebí tū ajɛ. Ɛ́gɛ́nyā géē wɛ, Ukpɛ̄ kú ācɛ nēe gēe kpɛ́fú gwō alɔ, je alɔ wulé piyóó á a.

eng_Latn: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ ɔcɛ́ kú Asírīya ā, lɛ ojuju obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú abɔ̄yī nū ipú ɔtū kú nū dúú. Ó le tútū ō kpó aéwo alɛwa yíifi.

eng_Latn: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
idu_Latn: Ó ka aá mīyɛ ajɛ kú uwā, le ɔ́ kɔ̄ lɛ aípɔ́ɔma kú Urúbɛ̄n, Ugádi, mɛ́mla āyā éyi kú ipɔ́ɔma kú Umanásɛ.

eng_Latn: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Uréhobōwam wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu, nēe lā ipú ajɛ kú Ujúda ā á.

eng_Latn: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king hath delight in thee, and all his servants love thee: now therefore be the king's son in law.
idu_Latn: Usɔ́lu le ɛlā ka lɛ ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū kéē lɛ ɛlā ka lɛ Udéfīdi ka ɔ́ɔ he anúɔ, ɔcɛ́ ā ɔtū, ɔ́ɔ klla kē he odúúdú aígabɔ̄ kú ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ɔtū. Anɔ́ɔ é da ɔ́ kú ɔ̄ kwú pīya ohilí kú ɔcɛ́ mɛ́ɛnɛ.

eng_Latn: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, eko nɛ̄ é le odúúdú ɔdā nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu da uwá ā kpó ka lɛ ɔ́ ā, nōó klla le aúgbɔ́ɔnya nɛ̄ Ujósɛ̄fu tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē bī lɛ je ɔ́ wā ā má ā, ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔtū kú ádā uwā, Ujékɔ̄pu wāajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
idu_Latn: Aá le tútū ō kɛlā obɔ̄bí eko dóódu. Aá gē kpó eko bónū kú aá kɛ̄mgbɛ̄ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, saith, Did not I see thee in the garden with him?
idu_Latn: Éyi kú ɔ̄cocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú otrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya nōo wɛ ɔmáapú kú ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ Upíta hɛ́ ɔ̄ ahɔ̄ ā kahíníī, Ń má uwɔ mla anú ipú ɛhɔ̄ ā ŋ́ nɛɛ.

eng_Latn: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.
idu_Latn: Ɛbɛ́ nɛ̄ n má ā lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɛjɛ ā, ikpó kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka ikpó kú ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí ɔhá nēé hī ka Ubɛ́ɛ ā. Okónu kú nū lɛbɛ̄ɛka okónu kú ágábá ā. Anɔ́ɔ ɛbɛ obɔ̄bí nɛ̄hi kú aflɛ́yí ā kwú ɔfú kú nū, akpa kú ɔcɛ́ kú nū, mɛ́mla íkwu nɛ̄hi nōó lɛ ā í kpó lɛ ɛbɛ́ ɔhá ā.

eng_Latn: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
idu_Latn: Lɛ éeyē nɛ̄hi je lɛ alɔ ɛ̄jīla kú ɔtūnōbí nɛ̄hi nāa je lɛ alɔ eko kú odúúdú iháyí kú ōwē kú alɔ ā.

eng_Latn: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
idu_Latn: É nyɛ̄ɛ̄ ŋmá abɔ́ɔ gaá lā Ulíbna.

eng_Latn: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
idu_Latn: N pīyeyī, n má ojuja nɛ̄hɛ́, anɔ́ɔ n má ɔdā nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ɔlɛɛcɛ ā cīīce ɛyí ojuja. Ó lɛ ukata kú ugóolu kwɛyí, anɔ́ɔ ó bī ɛwā nēé ī bī cɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ olulé abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
idu_Latn: N gē ba ɔ́ kóō géē cɛ̄ ká n̄ wā abālɔbányā gaá lɛ aá má.

eng_Latn: O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.
idu_Latn: Íne kú uwɔ he um ɔtū nɛ̄hi. Anú nɛ̄ n gē gbɛlá nū eko dóódu ɛ̄cī dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And Joshua made peace with them, and made a league with them, to let them live: and the princes of the congregation sware unto them.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Ujóssuwa lɛ okónu kú oklóbīya ce mla ācɛ kú Ugíbīyɔn ka aá í gáā ŋmó uwá ŋ́. Aígabɔ̄ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ka aá ɔ́ɔ géē lɛ okónu nɛ̄ aá ce ā tū.

eng_Latn: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
idu_Latn: Abālɔbányā le hīlatá ŋmá ɛyí ɔcóōnyɔ́kpá cɛ́ɛ́ ká ā lɛ iyī wɔ nyatá mɛ́ɛ́nɛ.

eng_Latn: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
idu_Latn: ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yēŋēē ā géē lɛ oōgwá kú uháyísɔ̄pu ā wu éŋkpɔ̄ nēé ī bī le yá ācɛ yēŋēē ā mī klá inu ā mɛ́mla ɔdā dóódu nēe bá ipú nū ā mɛ́mla ācɛ nēe bá abɔ́ɔ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ nōo le yēŋēē ā í mi éŋkpɔ̄ ā klá ɔ̄cɛ nōo lɛ abɔ̄ kwu okwū, ámāŋ ikpokwú kú okwū ámāŋ únóji ā.

eng_Latn: And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spake, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed.
idu_Latn: Ɔdā ékpónú nōo híkpó du uwā ipú ajɛ kú Ántiyɔ̄ku kú Upisídiya ā yá Ukónīyɔm. Upɔ́lu mɛ́mla Ubánābasi le tá Ɛgogbɔ̄ɔkɔ ā, anɔ́ɔ é le ɛlɔ̄ɔwɔicō ka ɔwɛ nōo yá ká ɛwa nɛ̄hi kú ācɛ Ujíyu mɛ́mla aílɔ́wá kéē cɛ̄ɛ̄lā Ujísɔ̄si.

eng_Latn: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
idu_Latn: Ó le ɛcɛ gwó ce eyī éŋkpɔ̄, ohígbū ka ihɔtū nōo lɛ lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū ā yɔ̄ piyóó.

eng_Latn: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
idu_Latn: É gbɛlá ka ɔ̄na nēé bá í nā ī ka lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ um ā géē yá kéē kwú ɛlā um gwō, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ aádáádā uwá je ɛlā um gwō nyɔ̄ gaá bá ī pā ɛcí nēé hī ka Ubáalu ā.

eng_Latn: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
idu_Latn: Ɛjɛ̄ɛ̄jī ācɛ nēé gbaáluka eko kú ɔlɛ́ ō ka ā, le áluka kú oje nēé ka ā gbā, anɔ́ɔ áluka kú ācɛ ā nēe ŋmá iháyí ofu gɔbū ā wɛ .

eng_Latn: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder, and pushed all the diseased with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
idu_Latn: Aá nēe jɔ̄kwū klla lɔfú ā bī iyē mɛ́mla ajī kú aá le kwú aálá nēe lɔfú ŋ́ mā jāā kwú uwā ú nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ ā.

eng_Latn: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ Itiyópiya mla Íjīpiti le ɔfú tū uwā iyē á. Ɔfú kú uwā í kē lɛ ɛjī ŋ́. Aéwo kú Upúti mla ācɛ kú Ulíbīya wɛ ācɛ nēe gē tá uwā abɔ̄ dúú.

eng_Latn: All my bones shall say, LORD, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
idu_Latn: N géē da Óndú ā ɔ̄kā mla odúúdú ɔtū kú um ka, n géē yɔ̄ ī cɛ̄tra, klla í da Óndú ā kahíníī, Ɔ̄nyɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka awɔ ā? Ohígbū ka a gē hɛ́ ācɛ nēé lɛ otábɔ̄ ŋ́ mā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ nēe le lɔfú ce uwá bá ā. A klla ī hɛ́ ācɛ nēé lɔfú ŋ́ mā tá ŋmá abɔ̄ kú ācɛ o pīya ɔ̄cɛ tū.

eng_Latn: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
idu_Latn: Ó le jɛ̄ lɔfú nɛ̄hi klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá aícɔ́ɔja kú ɔkpańcō mɛ́mla aínyílɔ́wɔ abɔ̄yī uwā. Ó kōō le ōhī kú uwā kpó tɛ́ɛcɔ̄ wā ajɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpó da uwá bá ajɛ á.

eng_Latn: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
idu_Latn: Ó lɛbɛ̄ɛka aótrɛ̄yí kú ācogwɛ́ɛya ohile ā ŋ́. Ó cɛgbá kóō gwɛ́ɛya lɛ Ɔwɔicō ɛ̄cī dóódu ohígbū iyī nū aflɛ́yí, cɛ́ɛ́ ó klla le yá ohígbū ācɛ ā gɛ ŋ́. Ó gwɛ́ɛya igbeékpónú ohígbū odúúdú ācɛ, eko nōó je iyī nū gwɛ́ɛya ā.

eng_Latn: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
idu_Latn: Ācogwɛ́ɛya nēe lā Ujerúsālɛm ā wɛ, Ujɛdáya, Ujɛhóyāribu, mɛ́mla Ujakín.

eng_Latn: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
idu_Latn: Ohígbū ka eko í wā nɛ̄ ācɛ í gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛlā olɔhi kú ācɔ̄lóhɔ́nyɛtá nēé ī nwū ā ɛ́ɛ́ gɛ ŋ́. Ikɔkɔ ɔ́ɔmā a, é géē dɔɔ̄kā ō jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí nēe ī nwū āa. Ohígbū ɔ́ɔmā é géē tū aítíca bá nēe géē da uwá ɛdɔ kú ɛlā nēe lɛ ahɔ̄ coge kéē pó piíí āa.

eng_Latn: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the congregation.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ aícɔ́ɔja ā kwú ācɛ nēe kwú ŋmá Ujúda ā ú kpó lɛ ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwā mɛ́mla aótrɛ̄yí kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
idu_Latn: Ohígbū íne nēé bīya ā. Eko nɛ̄ alɔ le íne bīya fíyábɔ̄ ā, a kwú yá alɔ ɛhi.

eng_Latn: O LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of thy people, and prepare their heart unto thee:
idu_Latn: Óndú ā, awɔ nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú aádáádā alɔ, Ébrahām, Áyísīki mɛ́mla Ujékɔ̄pu ā, lɛ ɛdɔ ɔtū nyā je lɛ alɔ ká ālɔ̄ je ga awɔ, ká ālɔ̄ klla háyi kpaakpa mɛ́mla awɔ piyóó. Cɛ́ɛ́ ká ācɛ ɔlɛ́ uwɔ kéē yɔ̄ ī gbā uwɔ ɛ̄gbā kpaakpa eko dóódu.

eng_Latn: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nōo ī páhɔ̄, kóō jāahɔ̄ lɛ ɔdā nɛ̄ Alelékwū Ihɔ ā ī ka lɛ aícɔ́ɔci ā ā! Ācɛ nēe le ɔfú kú ebilíi yálé, n géē jɛɛga lɛ uwá kéē le īkpō kú ɔcí nōo ī je oyēeyī nōo kwu ipu ɛhɔ̄ kú Ɔwɔicō ā.

eng_Latn: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire: and them that had gotten the victory over the beast, and over his image, and over his mark, and over the number of his name, stand on the sea of glass, having the harps of God.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ n má odée nōo lɛbɛ̄ɛka ísu kú ogigo nōo le wīya tɔ̄há mɛ́mla ɔlá ā. N klla má ācɛ nēe yá ɛbɛ́ obɔ̄bí ā mɛ́mla ojíbó kú nū mɛ́mla álūka nōo kwɛyí iyē nū ā lé ā. É māháyi pi ísu nōo gē ceyī bɛ̄ɛka ogigo ā bī ogwúmogwú nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō je lɛ uwá ā abɔ̄.

eng_Latn: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
idu_Latn: É géē lé ɔdā nēé bī le yá uculo kú ojeyɛ́ɛhi kú ínoōbīya eko nēé le abɔ̄ ce uwá ɛyí ā. Ācogwɛ́ɛya ōfōōfū uwā lɔfú lé ɔdōlé nyā glá á ohígbū koó tīihɔ.

eng_Latn: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ádā nū ámāŋ ka ɛ́nɛ́ nū he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ um, ó cíkā ō wɛ ákú um ŋ́. Ɔ̄cɛ nɛ̄ ɔyínɔ̄nyīlɔ kú nū ámāŋ ɔyí nū nɔ̄nyā kē he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ um, ó cíkā ō wɛ ákú um ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
idu_Latn: Aá kwú uya kú ije kú aá ú ŋmá ɛgiyí um. Ń gáā jāhɔ̄ lɛ ɛ̄ngwū o gwo lɔnyɛ kú aá ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And there was war again: and David went out, and fought with the Philistines, and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.
idu_Latn: Eko nēé klla gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú mla ācɛ Ufilístiya igbɔhá ā, Udéfīdi le tá ɔgbɛ́fú gaá kpɛ́fú tá ācɛ Ufilístiya ā. Ó ŋmó ācɛ Ufilístiya alɛwa nɛ̄hi, anɔ́ɔ é le pɛ́ kwu ŋmá ɛgiyí Udéfīdi á.

eng_Latn: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
idu_Latn: Aéwo nɛ̄ aá yálé ā bá ī yúklɔ́ tū ōwē áncā. Ɔda dóódu nēé gwó ­ā géē yɔlá gbewo. Óndú ā nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā yá ɛ̄nyā á.

eng_Latn: Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
idu_Latn: Óndú ā ka amíyɔ̄ klla da ācɛ ā kahíníī, Aókwū kú alɛɛcɛ géē bá ajɛ ɛga dóódu bɛ̄ɛka īmū kú ɛyí éétutulu ā. É géē tīkwū klá ajɛ lɛbɛ̄ɛka ocikāpā nēé le hɛ́ klá ajɛ ā. Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í kē gáā kpó aókwū ā ŋmá ajɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
idu_Latn: Uréhobōwam lɛ anyā igwáahātá mɛ́mla anyā ō ciikpó kú nū ofɛɛtá, ó ma ayínɔ̄nyīlɔ ofɛnɛ ce ahātá mɛ́mla ayínɔ̄nyā ofɛtá. Umáaka he ɔ́ ɔtū fíyɛ́ odúúdú anyā nū mɛ́mla anyā ó cikpó kú nū dóódu á.

eng_Latn: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
idu_Latn: Aádā aá, aɛ́nɛ́ aá, ayínɛ́ aá nɔ̄nyīlɔ mɛ́mla aɔ́máapú aá mɛ́mla aóklóbīya aá géē yíbīyāajɛ tū aá. É géē ŋmó ācɛ ōhī kú aá.

eng_Latn: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
idu_Latn: Cɛ́ɛ́ aá lɛ ɔyínɛ́ aá nɛ̄ŋcɛ́ ā bī gé um, kú n lɛ ɛlā ɔkwɛ̄yi kú aá jé, cɛ́ɛ́ ń gáā ŋmó aá gɛ ŋ́.

eng_Latn: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
idu_Latn: Awɔ Óndú, Ɔwɔicō fu Ébram klla bī ɔ̄ bɛ̄cɛ ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú Ɔ́ɔru kú Ubábīlɔn á. Awɔ klla je iyē kú nū pīyabɔ̄ ga Ébrahām á.

eng_Latn: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.
idu_Latn: N géē gwíijē lɛyíkwu íne kú uwɔ, ohígbū kóō le kpaakpa.

eng_Latn: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?
idu_Latn: Awɔ nōo wɛ ɔnyā ɔ̄cōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ā cíkā ó jé ka ɔbá aá lɔfú pīyabɔ̄ ohígbū uwɔ glá. Awɔ nōo wɛ ɔ̄cōlóhɔ́nyɛtá ā cíkā ō jé ka ɔnyā uwɔ lɔfú pīyabɔ̄ glá ohígbū uwɔ.

eng_Latn: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
idu_Latn: Ó wɛ ɔcɛ́ Ujerúsālɛm iháyí ofɛpa ceéyi. Ɛ́nɛ́ nū nɛ̄hi lé ka Umáaka, ɔyínɔ̄nyā kú Ábsālɔm.

eng_Latn: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
idu_Latn: Ujísɔ̄si le ɔ̄kā da kahíníī, Ɔdí nɛ̄ ɔ̄cɛ géē lɛ ajɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Ɔwɔicō gbla anú ā?.

eng_Latn: And he that sat on the cloud thrust in his sickle on the earth; and the earth was reaped.
idu_Latn: Anú nōo cīīce ɛyí ojuja ā tá ɛ̄wā o cɔ̄dɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū ga ipú ɛcɛ, anɔ́ɔ ó lɛ ɛcɛ ce bɛ̄ɛka ɛhɔ̄ ā á.

eng_Latn: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ é bá ī bū ɔpɛ́ kú ajɛ íkpākplā kú Ubáka ā, ó kwú pīya ɛga nɛ̄ éŋkpɔ̄ bá nɛ̄hi. Ɔwɔ kú aflɛ́yí ā le yā le aúnjɔlɔ ā tū mu mla éŋkpɔ.

eng_Latn: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Ujékɔ̄pu le ɔ́da je lɛ ayí nū kwɛyí ā, anɔ́ɔ ó le ikpó kú nū kpó ŋmá ajɛ ga agōdō, má gwutá. Anɔ́ɔ ó mā ɛ́nyɔ́ le tá ɔlékwū á.

eng_Latn: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
idu_Latn: É klla gaá lā pīyē Ujɔ́dan oŋmá Ubɛti-jessímɔ̄tu jāā ga Abɛlissitím ɔpɛ kú Umówābu ā.

eng_Latn: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.
idu_Latn: Anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā le igwú hī ɔ̄ kahíníī, Usámūwɛ̄lu, Usámūwɛ̄lu, anɔ́ɔ ó tá ohi kahíníī, Ami yɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And the LORD shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt: and there shall nothing die of all that is the children's of Israel.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ, n géē lɛ aɛ́bɛ́ kú ācɛ kú Íjīpiti mɛ́mla ācɛ kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā kɔ̄ ɛyɛ́ɛ́yí hī iyí uwā tá. Aɛ́bɛ́ dúúmā nēe wɛ ákú ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu ā í gáā kwú ŋ́.

eng_Latn: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
idu_Latn: Eko nɛ̄ Usɔ́lu lɛ ācɛ tɛ̄hɔ̄ kéē kwú Udéfīdi ú wā ā, Umáyíka da uwá ka ɔ́ɔ gē doōcē.

eng_Latn: And the men of Israel, beside Benjamin, were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword: all these were men of war.
idu_Latn: Aípɔ́ɔma ohile kú Ísrɛ̄lu ā le aícɔ́ɔja kú uwā, úlā bá ɛga úlā ɛpa, cofigwó tútū, kéē ga ɛfú.

eng_Latn: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
idu_Latn: Ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā í má eyīnyinyi kú uwɔ jɛ̄, nɛ̄ ó gē yá ɔdā dúúmā nēe bá nyā ga uwɔ ŋ́. Eko nēe ma uwɔ á, he ɔ̄cɛ dúúmā ɔtū ŋ́, é kwú uwɔ ú tá tónū ɛcɛ ipácí.

eng_Latn: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
idu_Latn: Umanásɛ gekwú, anɔ́ɔ é kwú ɔ̄ ú nyi ipú ɛhɔ̄, igbīhi ɔlɛ́ ɔcɛ́ ā, ɛhɔ̄ kú Íssa, anɔ́ɔ ɔyí nū Ámɔn lɛ ɔcɛ́ lé kwɛyí nū á.

eng_Latn: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
idu_Latn: Ɔ́dāŋ ka ajɛ ā lɔhi, ámāŋ ka ó lɔhi ŋ́, ɔ́dāŋ ka ɔcí yɔ̄ abɔ́ɔ ámāŋ ka ó yɔ̄ ŋ́. Aá lɛ ɔtū lɛ, kú aá lɛ ikpɔ̄ɔ̄cí ōhī kú ajɛ ā bī wā. Eko nēé nyɔ̄ ā, wɛ eko nɛ̄ īkpɔ̄cí ufáyin yɔ̄ ī pīya.

eng_Latn: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
idu_Latn: Ayí Ulífāyi ā í kpó abɔ̄ kú uwā ce ɛyí kú aɔ́bá ɛna ā. A géē je éyi gwɛ́ɛya kú íne ō bīya, a klla í je ɔhá gwɛ́ɛya o yɔlá dúúdú kóō wɛ uculo kú iye ogwu mɛ́mla o yá yēŋēē kú uwā.

eng_Latn: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.
idu_Latn: Ó gbēyī Usámūwɛ̄lu ɛ̄cī ahāapa ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ Usámūwɛ̄lu da ɔ́ ka ɔ́ gbēyī ā, amáŋ ó wā ŋmá Ugígalu ŋ́ kpɔ́. Ācɛ gbɔɔ́ ō kwu hɛ Usɔ́lu tá.

eng_Latn: And there came against Gibeah ten thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and the battle was sore: but they knew not that evil was near them.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú uwá wɛ ācɛ ulá ofu cɛhɔ̄ nɛ̄ ācɛ Ísrɛ̄lu kpó tayínū á. É gbɔɔ́ ō kpɛ́fú tá Ugíbɛya. Ɛfú ā kwú hɔ́lá nɛ̄hi. Anɔ́ɔ ācɛ ipɔ́ɔma kú Ubɛ́njamīn ā le jé ka ɛfú ɔ́ɔ gáā lé aá ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
idu_Latn: Ó da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ lɛyítáajɛ lɛ Óndú ā, nōo wɛ Ɔwɔicō kú uwā ā, cɛ́ɛ́ odúúdú aɔ́hā nēe bá ā ɔ́ɔ géē wɛ ákú uwā.

eng_Latn: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ Ufínɛ̄hasi cāŋjɛ le italā yá ācɛ nēe lɛ́pɔ̄bí ā, anɔ́ɔ Óndú ā cɛ̄ lɛ ōcē obɔ̄bí nōo yɔ̄ ī kpó uwā ŋmó nyā mɛ á.

eng_Latn: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say, Wherein have we wearied him? When ye say, Every one that doeth evil is good in the sight of the LORD, and he delighteth in them; or, Where is the God of judgment?
idu_Latn: Umálakāyi da uwá ka ɛ́ɛ cɛ̄ lɛ ɛ̄jɛ̄ le jɛ̄ Óndú ā ohígbū ɛlā ō ka kú ūwā ā ɛɛ́. Amáŋ, ɛ́ɛ dɔɔ̄ka kahíníī, Ɔwɛ nyá nɛ̄ alɔ cɛ̄ lɛ ɛ̄jɛ̄ jɛ̄ Óndú ā ā? Ó da uwá ka o ŋmá lɛ ɛlā nɛ́ɛ ka ka Óndú nōo lɔfú fíyɛ́ dúú ā, ɔ́ɔ gbɛlá ka odúúdú ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā lɔhi. É klla ka ka ɔ́ɔ wɛ ɛlā ɔkwɔ̄ɔ̄kwɛ̄yi ka ācɛ o yá ɔdōbɔ̄bí ā he Óndú ā ɔtū. Ámāŋ ɔ̄kā nɛ̄ aá gē da kahíníī, Iní nɛ̄ Ɔwɔicō nɔ́ɔ cíkā ō hɛ́pɔ okpaakpa ā yɔ̄ ā.

eng_Latn: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
idu_Latn: Ɔwɔicō, á yɛ í cɛ̄ lɛ ɛnɔ cɛ̄ ɛ̄cī ɔ́ɔmā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ā ī gbɛlá kwu ɔ́ gbóógbóō ɛ́ gɛ ŋ.

eng_Latn: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.
idu_Latn: Abɔ̄ ācɛ kú Ámɔn mɛ́mla Uhánɔn, ɔcɛ́ ā le jé ka aá kwú Udéfīdi ú pīya olɛlā kú uwā ā, é bī ije nɛ̄hɛ́ ulɛpa cofigwó gaá lɛ aúgbɔ́ɔnya mɛ́mla ācɛ o pɛ́ úgbɔ́ɔnya ā pula ŋmá ɛhícō kú Umesopotámīya mɛ́mla Umáaka mɛ́mla Usóba, aájɔ̄ɔ̄cɛ́ kú Usiríya ā.

eng_Latn: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
idu_Latn: Ami Ujɔ́ni, ɔnyākwɔ́cɛ tɔ́kpá nyā gé lɛ Ugáyɔ̄si ɔ̄cɛ ohe um ɔtū, nōo kē he um ɔtū kú ɔkwɛ̄yi ā á.

eng_Latn: For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
idu_Latn: Ami ā dúú, yɔ̄ ɛháajɛ aótrɛ̄yí nēe lɛ íkwu fíyɛ́ um, ami ā kē lɛ aícɔ́ɔja bá ɛháajɛ um. N da ícɔ́ɔja éyi ka Nyɔ̄, ó kē le yɛ. N da ícɔ́ɔja ɔhá kóō wā, ó kē gā a. N lɛ ɔ́da je lɛ ɔfiyɛ kú um kóō lɛ odée yá, ó kē lɛ ɔ́ yá.

eng_Latn: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
idu_Latn: Ācɛ kú Umówābu da anyākwɔ́cɛ kú Umídīyan kahíníī, Ɛwa nyā géē je alɔ mɛ́mla odúúdu ɔdā nēe yɛ alɔ jīla tá ā kpó yíífi ānāānā, ɛ́gɛ́nɛ̄ ɛna géē je ácí lé ŋmá ajɛ ā. Anɔ́ɔ Ubálāki, ɔyí kú Usípɔ, nōo wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú Umówābu eko ɔ́ɔmā ā.

eng_Latn: All these had taken strange wives: and some of them had wives by whom they had children.
idu_Latn: Odúúdú ācɛ nēé cɔ̄ɔcí nēe bá ajɛ nyā lɛ anyā éwɔhá kpɛ́mm. Anɔ́ɔ é tá odúúdú anyā éwɔhá kú uwā ā mɛ́mla ayí nɛ̄ anyā éwɔhá ā ma lɛ uwā ā. É klla lɛ odúúdú anyā ā mɛ́mla ayí uwā kpó nū ŋmá ipú ajɛ kú ɔlɛ́ uwā.

eng_Latn: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
idu_Latn: Ó ka eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, aéwo alɛwa géē wā ɛgiyí Óndú ā, klla géē je pīya ācɛ ɔlɛ́ nū. Óndú ā kē í lā mla uwá, cɛ́ɛ́ é géē jé ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ tū anúɔ ɛhɔ̄ á.

eng_Latn: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
idu_Latn: Óndú āka, Ɛ̄cī éyi gēe wā, nɛ̄ oonwuné mla ɔhi kú Ísrɛ̄lu a gēe mɛ; ɛhá gāa kwɛyí agbénú mla ɔdu kú nū á.

eng_Latn: And Gideon said unto them, I will not rule over you, neither shall my son rule over you: the LORD shall rule over you.
idu_Latn: Ugídīyɔn tá uwā ohi ka anúɔ í gáā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā ɛ́ɛ́ nɛ̄ ɔyí anúɔ dúúmā géē wɛ ɔcɛ́ ŋ́. Ó ka Óndú ā ɔ́ɔ gáā wɛ ɔcɛ́ kú uwā á.

eng_Latn: But ye turned and polluted my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom he had set at liberty at their pleasure, to return, and brought them into subjection, to be unto you for servants and for handmaids.
idu_Latn: Amáŋ abālɔbányā, aá kwú pīya kɛnɛpɛɛ, le iyē kú um tá nyílá. Ɔnyɔ̄ɔnyɛ kú aá klla gáā lɛ aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyā mɛ́mla aɔ́fiyɛ nɔ̄nyilɔ nɛ̄ aá hɛ́tá, kéē ga ɛga dúúmā, nēe he uwá ɔtū ā kwú, cɛ́ɛ́ kéē kwú pīya aɔ́fiyɛ kú aá kpɔ́ ɛɛ́.

eng_Latn: So Abraham returned unto his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
idu_Latn: Ébrahām mɛ́mla Áyísīki pīyɛyí gā ɛgiyí ācocɛ̄hɔ̄ kú nū, anɔ́ɔ é pīyɛyí tɔ̄há gā Ubiyɛssɛ́ba á. Ébrahām gaá lā abɔ́ɔ.

eng_Latn: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines' garrison was then at Bethlehem.
idu_Latn: Udéfīdi klá ɛyí ɛfu nēé le igá olɔfú hɛ́ tū ɔ̄ eko ɔ́ɔmā ā, anɔ́ɔ ācɛ kú Ufilístiya gaá mīyɛ Ubɛ́tilɛhɛ̄m.
